lore.name: Aither
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RSI Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Civilian Named for an ancient god of light and the heavens, the Aither quantum drive honors its namesake as it ferries people places their ancestors could never imagine. This classic RSI medium-sized component has graced civilian ships for centuries.

lore.name: Ajax Security Uniform Hat
lore.description: This black soft-domed, billed hat from Code Blue Apparel features eye-catching bronze accents and is imprinted boldly with "Security" across the front. Comfortable and distinct, it makes for an ideal accessory to any security professional's uniform.

lore.name: Ajax Security Uniform Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU The Ajax Security Uniform Jacket is a standard security accessory produced by Code Blue Apparel's professional division. The jacket is a uniform intended for security professionals and does not provide any armored protection.

lore.name: Ajax Security Uniform Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU The Ajax Security Uniform Pants are a standard security accessory produced by Code Blue Apparel's professional division. Flexible and durable, the pants are designed to match the Ajax Security Uniform Jacket and feature the same high-visibility piping. The pants are flexible and allow for a full range of motion.

lore.name: Ajax Security Uniform Shoes
lore.description: Ajax Security Uniform Shoes are a standard security accessory produced by Code Blue Apparel's professional division. The boot-styled shoes feature a unique thick-body construction that increases durability in exchange for overall bulk. A heavy-duty rubberized exterior protects the shoes from weather and general day-to-day wear.

lore.name: Alban Shirt
lore.description: The Alban is a long sleeve shirt made from comfortable, natural fabrics. Featuring a deep V-neck, its asymmetrical patchwork design provides it with a bit of texture and a two-toned look.

lore.name: Alban Shirt
lore.description: The Alban is a long sleeve shirt made from comfortable, natural fabrics. Featuring a deep V-neck, its asymmetrical patchwork design provides it with a bit of texture and a two-toned look. The Smoke edition features a worn gray color.

lore.name: Alban Shirt Striker
lore.description: The Alban is a long sleeve shirt made from comfortable, natural fabrics. Featuring a deep V-neck, its asymmetrical patchwork design provides it with a bit of texture and a two-toned look. The Striker edition is a worn grey with dark grey patches.

lore.name: Algid
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 4 Grade: Bespoke Class: Industrial The Reclaimer is a ship renowned for its ability to work long and hard. To help support even the most arduous salvaging projects, Aegis develop the bespoke Algid cooler.

lore.name: Alignment Blade
lore.description: An alignment blade essential to the function of mining lasers. Terminals at Platform Alignment Facilities require three of these blades to make the precise calculations needed to orientate the dish before the Orbital Laser Platform can fire.

lore.name: Allegro
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: ArcCorp Size: 4 Grade: Bespoke Class: Civilian Designed specifically for the 890 Jump, the Allegro quantum drive blends ArcCorp's expertise with Origin's exceptionally high standards, making it the ideal companion for a luxury cruise through the stars.

lore.name: Alloy
lore.description: Substances that are compounds of two or more metals or other materials with improved properties over the base ingredients.

lore.name: Allpa Pants Brown
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 400 µSCU If you're in the adventure business, you'll need clothing that can take the heat. The Allpa Pants were made with heavyweight cotton that features AlejoFlex technology, providing the wearer with a wide range of movement during tough jobs while maintaining its durability.

lore.name: AllStop
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Gorgon Defender Industries Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Military Gorgon Defender Industries first created the AllStop shield generator to hold off the Vanduul. They worked so well that many military crafts were known to prefer the AllStop. Just one of the many reasons to have one on your ship.

lore.name: Aloprat Skewer
lore.description: NDR: 25 Effects: Immune Suppressing Aloprat is a hearty species of rodent found across Human occupied space, and even can survive aboard space stations and ships eating a variety of food and scraps. This aloprat has been skewered and roasted rotisserie style for crisp skin and gamey, fatty meat.

lore.name: Altimont Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Octagon embraces a classic look and makes it boldly modern with the Altimont. These jodhpur style pants feature a slightly flared hip that becomes snug under the knees thanks to built-in garters. A uniquely shaped front seam secured by silver clips on the waist and shin provide further detailing that's both subtle and stylish.

lore.name: Altrucia Lacus (Revenant Tree) Plant
lore.description: Contrary to its ominous name, the Revenant is actually a variety of the Altrucia tree, an indigenous plant of Terra III known for its thick and colorful leaves. Geoengineers introduced fields of Altrucias to Hyperion in an effort to break up the dust storms. Although the project failed, the Altrucia trees adapted to the perpetual wind patterns, shedding its leaves and thickening the wood in the trunk. Botanists initially believed that the Altrucias had died, but on closer inspection, discovered that they were quite alive and thus, the name was born.

lore.name: Altruciatoxin
lore.description: Created by chemically processing the pollen of Revenant Tree (altrucia lacus), common effects of ingesting or smoking altruciatoxin include relaxing of the muscles, sensory enhancement, and lethargy. Heavy usage can cause staining of the tongue.

lore.name: Aluminum
lore.description: A chemically reactive, gray metal that is malleable, lightweight, ductile, strong, and resistant to corrosion. Capable of superconductivity.

lore.name: Aluminum (Ore)
lore.description: A chemically reactive, gray metal that is malleable, lightweight, ductile, strong, and resistant to corrosion. Capable of superconductivity.

lore.name: Amaris Shirt
lore.description: The rugged Amaris Shirt is a breathable long-sleeve shirt reinforced by raised fabric on the shoulders to create an elegant but industrial look.

lore.name: Ambit Coverall
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.4K µSCU The Ambit Coverall is ideal jobsite attire with its multiple pockets, special super-stain resistant fabric, and a generous cut to allow for unrestricted movement. Step in, zip up, and work all day in comfort thanks to Stegman's.

lore.name: Ambrus Suit
lore.description: MuyMuy's Ambrus suit was expertly crafted by artisans on Saisei from natural brocade silk and worsted ma'xy.un wool. Featuring bold coloration and a relaxed fit, it lets the wearer maintain comfort without sacrificing style.

lore.name: Amiant Pod
lore.description: Harvested from the amiant tree, the fibrous husks of these seed pods are used to make heat resistant textiles. Once removed, the husks must first be soaked in a chemical solution before the fibers can be separated out.

lore.name: Amioshi Plague
lore.description: Not nearly as ominous as its name, the Amioshi Plague is an invasive lichen that grows in the cracks of rocks. While the core of the lichen burrows out of sight to try and absorb as much moisture as it can find, the part near the surface sprouts hooded scales that eject spores to spread to other rocks. It's relatively short maturation period is the origin of its name.

lore.name: AMP-81 Turret
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Missile Turret Control the skies with the MPT-81 missile pod turret. With a wide sweeping range, precise targeting, and adaptable power options, this turret provides offensive security where you need it most.

lore.name: Animus "Quite Useful" Missile Launcher
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Missile Launcher Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 3 Rate Of Fire: 300 rpm (3 shot burst) Effective Range: 2 km Attachments: Optics (N/A), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (N/A) Lift the Animus onto your shoulder and level the opposition on the battlefield. This missile launcher from Apocalypse Arms features a rotating barrel that quickly fires three missiles, making it the perfect weapon to obliterate ground forces or damage vehicles and small ships. When you need to sow destruction to save yourself, you can trust Apocalypse Arms to deliver. One of the many items Wikelo has acquired in his travels, the 'Quite Useful' edition is a must have for any serious collector.

lore.name: Anvil Asgard PHB Flight Blade

lore.name: Anvil Hat Olive
lore.description: This dark green cadet hat is decorated with two diagonal yellow stripes, representing celebrated ship manufacturer Anvil Aerospace.

lore.name: Anvil Hornet F7C
lore.description: Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace Focus: Medium Fighter To the enemy, it is a weapon never to be underestimated. To allies, it's a savior. The F7C Hornet is the same dependable and resilient multi-purpose fighter that has become the face of the UEE Navy. The F7C is the foundation to build on and meet whatever requirements you have in mind.

lore.name: Anvil Hornet F7C Nose Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Turret Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace Size: 3 This nose turret was designed specifically for Anvil's F7C Hornet to allow for mounting two Size-1 weapons and precise gimbaled tracking of targets.

lore.name: Anvil Hornet F7CR Tracker
lore.description: Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace Focus: Pathfinder If the Ghost is made to hide, the Tracker is made to seek. The F7C-R Tracker boasts an advanced radar suite making it ideal for deep-space explorers who require depth and accuracy in their scan packages. Local militia and larger merc units will also repurpose Trackers to act as mobile C&C ships for their squadrons.

lore.name: Anvil Hornet F7CS Ghost
lore.description: Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace Focus: Stealth Fighter Through a combination of low-emission drives, low-draw weapons, and Void Armor technology capable of diffusing scans, the F7C-S Ghost is built for the pilot who wants to keep a low profile. The Ghost is capable of slipping past the most ardent of observers to accomplish whatever goal you need to accomplish. Don't worry, we won't ask.

lore.name: Anvil Hornet Ghost Center Cap
lore.description: This special center cap designed for the Hornet Ghost features additional faceted surfaces to potentially help radiate incoming radar energy.

lore.name: Anvil Hornet Ghost Mk II Center Cap
lore.description: This special center cap designed for the Hornet Ghost features additional faceted surfaces to potentially help mitigate incoming radar energy.

lore.name: Anvil Hornet Mk II S2 Nose Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Turret Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace Size: 2 This nose turret was designed specifically for Anvil's F7C Hornet Mk II to allow for mounting two S2 weapons and precision target tracking.

lore.name: Anvil Hornet Mk II S3 Nose Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Turret Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace Size: 3 This military-grade nose turret was designed specifically for the Mk II versions of Anvil's F7A and F7C-M to allow for mounting two Size-3 weapons and precise gimbaled tracking of targets.

lore.name: Anvil Hurricane Schematic
lore.description: See how Anvil engineers modernized the Hurricane’s classic design by Casse Aerospace with this official schematic generously donated by Anvil Aerospace, which is a part of Esperia’s “Masters of Design” series.

lore.name: Anvil Lightning F8C Turret
lore.description: This remote turret provides mounts for two Size 2 weapons, an expansive field of fire, and precise control to give F8C pilots a comprehensive weapon system to get out of any situation.

lore.name: Anvil T-Shirt Olive
lore.description: Show your love for the iconic manufacturer Anvil Aerospace with this dark green shirt, featuring the company's logo on the front.

lore.name: Anvil Terrapin Schematic
lore.description: This schematic penetrates the layers of armor protecting the Terrapin to show what makes this scanning ship one tough nut to crack. This is thanks to Esperia’s “Masters of Design” series, which shares classic ship schematics from their extensive archive.

lore.name: Anysta
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Civilian Avoid getting tunnel vision with the Anysta radar. Offering exceptional performance all round, this radar will help keep you informed.

lore.name: Aopoa Khartu-al Decoy Ammo
lore.description: Ammunition box for decoy countermeasures for the Aopoa Khartu-al.

lore.name: AP-7 Concussion Grenade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Grenade Area of Effect: 15 m Damage Type: Non-Lethal (Concussion) The Behring AP-7 is a battle-tested and operator approved tool for the field. This non-lethal explosive device is designed to disorient and disable enemy targets, allowing friendlies to safely breach and secure an area. Behring's proprietary reinforced casing construction minimizes the potential for accidental injury or death.

lore.name: Aphorite
lore.description: Decorative jewel crystal prized for its multi-hued tones.

lore.name: Apollo Alliance Aid Red & Gold Livery
lore.description: Showcase your dedication to helping Alliance Aid assist the people of Levski during their time of need with this red livery with golden accents.

lore.name: Apollo Alliance Aid Red Livery
lore.description: Showcase your dedication to helping Alliance Aid assist the people of Levski during their time of need with this red livery.

lore.name: Apollo Delphi Livery
lore.description: The Delphi livery turns the Apollo black with shimmering gold highlights.

lore.name: Apollo Frontline Livery
lore.description: Make the Apollo more discreet with the Frontline livery, which turns the front half grey with a white back half and red highlights.

lore.name: Apollo Lifeline Livery
lore.description: Swoop in to save the day in style with the Lifeline livery for the Apollo. It features a base white paint with teal and red highlights.

lore.name: Apollo Olympian Livery
lore.description: Be a beacon of hope with the Olympian livery for the Apollo with its striking silver and blue paint.

lore.name: Apollo Shockwave Livery
lore.description: The subtle style of the Shockwave livery brings an appealing blue with orange highlights to the Apollo.

lore.name: Apollo Tier 1 Module Left
lore.description: This module contains 1x Tier 1 medical bed.

lore.name: Apollo Tier 1 Module Right
lore.description: This module contains 1x Tier 1 medical bed.

lore.name: Apollo Tier 2 Module Left
lore.description: This module contains 2x Tier 2 medical beds.

lore.name: Apollo Tier 2 Module Right
lore.description: This module contains 2x Tier 2 medical beds.

lore.name: Apollo Tier 3 Module Left
lore.description: This module contains 3x Tier 3 medical beds.

lore.name: Apollo Tier 3 Module Right
lore.description: This module contains 3x Tier 3 medical beds.

lore.name: Aponte Explorer Goggles
lore.description: Outfitted with Rambler's scratch resistant lenses, the Aponte Explorer goggles provides a clear view of the path ahead. Their wraparound design keeps dirt and debris away while on windy plains, but still look stylish enough to wear when walking through bustling city streets.

lore.name: Apoxygenite
lore.description: Also commonly known as TXA (trifold explosive accelerant), apoxygenite is an odorless and tasteless chemical additive used in the production of explosives and in various industrial processes. Energetic and highly brisant, apoxygenite is an oxygen rich accelerant that is often added to more stable elements to increase their reaction rate.

lore.name: APT-18 Turret
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Item Type: Anti-Personnel Turret Size: 1 Damage Type: Ballistic Maintain order with the APT-18 anti-personnel turret. This compact design is ideal for interior locations to provide an obvious, but not intrusive presence. The turret features a special rotary design that provides excellent lateral and vertical rotation to minimize blind spots and maximize target coverage. It's also made with reinforced plating and parts to keep maintenance to a minimum.

lore.name: APX Fire Extinguisher
lore.description: Manufacturer: KE Group Item Type: Fire Extinguisher Class: Gadget Magazine Size: Gas Canister Rate of Fire: Constant Effective Range: 3-4 m The KE Group's APX Fire Extinguisher has been rated a best-in-class consumer grade safety equipment for well-over a decade making it the industry standard in fire prevention. Filled with a patented gaseous cooling compound, the extinguisher can rapidly smother any fire in sight. The digital screen on the device allows you to monitor the local temperature to help you contain and eliminate fire hazards.

lore.name: APX Fire Extinguisher Canister
lore.description: Item Type: Extinguisher Refill This canister refills the APX Fire Extinguisher with a full tank of the KE Group's patented cooling compound.

lore.name: Arame Laser Beam
lore.description: Manufacturer: Trident Attack Systems Item Type: Laser Beam Size: 4 Pulsating energy powers the Arame from Trident Attack Systems. This size four weapon produces a laser beam that’s particularly effective from short to medium ranges.

lore.name: Aranda Shirt
lore.description: Fiore makes it easy to be fashionable with the Aranda. This unique top combines a dress shirt and waistcoat styled in complementary colors. The shirt comes with short sleeves cuffed at the elbows while the waistcoat features a small geometric flourish on the front pockets that's mirrored across the back.

lore.name: Aranda Shirt Crusader Edition
lore.description: Fiore makes it easy to be fashionable with the Aranda. This unique top combines a dress shirt and waistcoat styled in complementary colors. The shirt comes with short sleeves cuffed at the elbows while the waistcoat features a small geometric flourish on the front pockets that's mirrored across the back. The Crusader Edition was made specifically for employees of Crusader Industries.

lore.name: Arc Duo 400
lore.description: ArcCorp's Arc Duo 400 was recently named one of Whitley's Ten Best Commercial Grade Thruster value buys. Designed to handle the payload requirements of larger class vessels, the Arc Duo 400 continues ArcCorp's design philosophy of lower signature and better efficiency.

lore.name: ArcCorp Cog Sphere Replica
lore.description: A miniaturized version of Memphis Avery's iconic sculpture displayed in Area18's plaza, representing the innovative and aesthetic nature of ArcCorp's technology.

lore.name: ArcCorp Hat
lore.description: A red and gray cadet hat with ArcCorp's name and logo emblazoned across the front panel.

lore.name: Archibald Hurston Figurine
lore.description: A brushed bronze scale replica of the statue commemorating the late Archibald Hurston, former CEO of Hurston Dynamics, that can be seen prominently displayed in the Lorville Central Business District.

lore.name: Archibald Jacket Cinder
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Simple, comfortable and understated. While most fashion designers avoid these terms, Escar Limited understands that sometimes you just want something that feels right. Based on the classic design from Centauri II, the Archibald is a simple, comfortable and understated light jacket made from a polyweave that doesn't restrict airflow.

lore.name: Archibald Jacket Cinder
lore.description: PH - eld_jacket_04_01_01

lore.name: Arclight "Glimmer" Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Pistol Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 30 Rate Of Fire: 300 rpm Effective Range: 30 m A handheld laser made famous as Kyle Fenris’ sidearm on the hit vid show The Frontier, the Klaus & Werner Model II Arclight has become extremely popular on the civilian market. Despite its media appeal, the Model II offers a higher rate of fire than any of its ballistic counterparts. While that may diminish the weapon's stopping power, its power cell offers more than enough shots to finish the job. This exclusive Glimmer edition features a distinct iridescent coating that makes the weapon shimmer with different colors based on lighting conditions and the angle from which it's viewed.

lore.name: Arclight "Herrero" Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Pistol Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 30 Rate Of Fire: 300 rpm Effective Range: 30 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) A handheld laser made famous as Kyle Fenris’ sidearm on the hit vid show The Frontier, the Klaus & Werner Model II Arclight has become extremely popular on the civilian market. Despite its media appeal, the Model II offers a higher rate of fire than any of its ballistic counterparts. While that may diminish the weapon's stopping power, its power cell offers more than enough shots to finish the job. The Herrero edition distinguishes itself by including geometric etchings on the frame and grip, plus a textured trigger guard.

lore.description: Item Type: Battery Capacity: 30 This plasma cell has enough capacity for the Klaus & Werner Arclight pistol to fire 30 rounds before needing a recharge.

lore.name: Arctic
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Military Providing the kind of durability that made Aegis products a mainstay with the military, the Arctic is an economic mil-spec cooler capable of withstanding the rigors of combat without sacrificing performance.

lore.name: ArcticStorm
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian If you’re after a cooler that balances performance, durability and stealth, then look to the ArcticStorm. This mid-grade cooler from Lightning Power Ltd uses their centuries old technology to provide performance that can be relied upon.

lore.name: Arcus Gloves Gray
lore.description: Temp. Rating: -35 / 25 °C The Arcus gloves are thin enough to wear on everyday excursions, yet capable of keeping your hands warm in frigid conditions. Textured touch fingertips even allow you to easily access your mobi and other touch screens without removing your gloves.

lore.name: Arden-CL Backpack
lore.description: Item Type: Light Backpack Carrying Capacity: 54K µSCU Core Compatibility: All Whether carrying supplies into a combat zone or simply hauling extra gear, the Arden-CL backpack is battle ready and tested. Roussimoff Rehabilitation Systems designed the backpack with a universal core connector allowing it to attach to a wide variety of armors.

lore.name: Ardent Boots
lore.description: Who says NorthStar can't keep it pro? The Ardent boot features a molded rubber sole and all-weather construction to withstand a constant battery from the elements. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Ardor-1 Salvaged Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 1 This Ardor-1 laser repeater was salvaged in the Pyro system. First manufactured in 2724, the Ardor series became popular for its split barrel design that helped mitigate heat when sustaining fire. Hurston eventually stopped manufacturing the weapon in favor of the Attrition line of laser repeaters. Despite the effects of time and constant usage, the weapon is still sought after because of the consistent performance delivered by Hurston Dynamic's expert design and solid construction.

lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 2 This Ardor-2 laser repeater was salvaged in the Pyro system. lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Aspire Livery
lore.description: With the Aspire livery, blue and white combine to evoke both the colors and frigid temperatures of New Babbage. In honor of the landing zone that inspired it, the livery also features a depiction of the Aspire Grand building that dominates the city's skyline.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Celestial Blue Livery
lore.description: A beautiful light blue base and grey highlights makes the Celestial Blue livery a stunning choice for the Ares Star Fighter.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Central Tower Livery
lore.description: Give the Ares Star Fighter a dramatic new look with the Central Tower livery. The orange and black color scheme is inspired by the furnaces of industry powering Lorville, and also features a representation of the landing zone's iconic Central Headquarters and Shared Services Center, aka Central Tower.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Cinder Livery
lore.description: The Cinder livery for the Ares Star Fighter is predominantly grey with a black trim accenting the ship's lines and enwrapping the cockpit.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Deadlock Camo Livery
lore.description: Disguise the silhouette of the Ares Star Fighter with the Deadlock Camo livery, featuring a grey camo pattern with yellow highlights.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Flint Livery
lore.description: Cut through the clouds with the Flint livery for the Ares Star Fighter. The livery uses several shades of grey and dark blue accent lines to give the ship its sharp look.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Golden Blossom Livery
lore.description: The Golden Blossom livery weaves an intricate golden flower pattern across the matte black paint of the Ares Star Fighter.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Hosanna Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the gorgeous clouds that enshroud Orison, the Hosanna livery blends red, ivory, and pink to give the Ares Star Fighter a distinct appearance. It also features a silhouette of the landing zone's famous Hosanna tree complete with its pink flowers.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Inferno Ember Livery
lore.description: With the Ember livery, the blazing barrel of the massive gatling gun isn't the only red thing on the Ares Star Fighter Inferno. This special livery uses vibrant red streaks to break up the grey and black paint that dominates the ship.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Ion Radiance Livery
lore.description: White and grey with red trim, the Radiance livery makes the Ares Star Fighter Ion a sight to behold even when it's not blasting its massive laser cannon.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Lovestruck Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your Ares Star Fighter.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Meridian Livery
lore.description: The Meridian livery gives the Ares Star Fighter a simple yet stylish metallic silver finish.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Missile Launcher
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Launcher Manufacturer: Crusader Industries Size: 7 Missiles: 12xS3 Bespoke missile launcher built into the body of the Ares Star Fighter that can carry and deploy twelve S3 missiles.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Outrider Livery
lore.description: The Outrider livery blends black with dark military green to highlight the Ares Star Fighter's warrior spirit.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Polar Camo Livery
lore.description: Modify your Ares Star Fighter with this white and grey camo livery specifically designed for the 2951 IAE.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Scrubland Camo Livery
lore.description: Use the Scrubland Camo livery to outfit the Ares Star Fight in green camo. A classic and commanding look that's also ideal for excursions across forests and grasslands.

lore.name: Ares Star Fighter Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom Ares Star Fighter livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.

lore.name: Argo Astronautics Hat
lore.description: Spacecraft manufacturer Argo Astronautics has been around for centuries. Support this indispensable UEE industrial brand by wearing this burnt orange hat bearing their name across the front.

lore.name: Argo Astronautics T-Shirt
lore.description: This orange shirt features the logo of Argo Astronautics. Before changing their name, the company was known as AR-GO Technologies with the 'AR' referencing founder Alana Redmond.

lore.name: Argo Hat Slate
lore.description: This dark gray cadet hat features a stylized, understated version of Argo's logo on the front.

lore.name: Argo MOTH Missile Launcher
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Launcher Manufacturer: Argo Astronautics Missiles: 16xS2 This bespoke missile launcher holds sixteen S2 missiles to help protect the MOTH while on salvage operations.

lore.name: Argo MPUV Schematic
lore.description: See what makes the Argo MPUV the classic, utilitarian cargo carrier found in every corner of the Empire; from civilian use to military service. All thanks to this detailed schematic from Esperia’s “Masters of Design” series.

lore.name: Argo T-Shirt Slate
lore.description: This dark gray cadet hat features a simple version of Argo's logo on the front, representing company with understated style.

lore.name: Argon
lore.description: Chemically inert under most conditions, argon is an odorless, colorless gas that is as soluble in water as oxygen. Appears lilac in a discharge tube.

lore.name: Argos IX Torpedo
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Cross Section Size: 9 The Talon Argos strike torpedo features a classic, straightforward design that relies on exacting manufacturing standards and a classic cross section targeting system.

lore.name: Argos IX-G Torpedo
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Cross Section Size: 9 The Talon Argos strike torpedo features a classic, straightforward design that relies on exacting manufacturing standards and a classic cross section targeting system. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

lore.name: Argus Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Virgil's Argus helmet utilizes advanced multi-layered composite construction to provide incredible protection from weapon fire as well as environmental hazards. The Aril armor is available in a variety of vibrant colors to fit your personal taste and for easy identification on the jobsite.

lore.name: Arlington "Gamekeeper" Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hedeby Gunworks Item Type: Rifle Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 20 Rate Of Fire: 320 rpm Effective Range: 50 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S3) Gunsmiths at Hedeby Gunworks looked to classic ballistic designs to construct a long rifle steeped in the past and the future. The Arlington provides accurate marksmanship, an easy cycling of rounds thanks to the lever action design, and multiple fire modes. Artisans shaped the weapon's body by hand to create a piece that's equally fit for the mantle as it is on the frontier. The Gamekeeper edition swaps the stock of the rifle to an elegant walnut wood.

lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 20 This magazine for the Arlington rifle comes pre-loaded with twenty-five rounds.

lore.name: Armada
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Industrial Basilisk started by making cutting edge hull plating that was renowned for being durable and dependable. Today they carry on that proud legacy with industrial shield generators like the Armada.

lore.name: Armin Trask Action Figure
lore.description: Not every hero can be found dogfighting through space, some heroes can see every day. Part of Takuetsu’s Citizen Series, this exquisitely crafted figure depicts an outpost worker doing what they do best: surviving. Modeled with a Gyson softshell helmet and multitool, this worker’s ready to tackle all the hardships and repairs needed to maintain an outpost in an inhospitable environment.

lore.name: Armin Trask Action Figure (Imperator Edition)
lore.description: Not every hero can be found dogfighting through space, some heroes can see every day. Part of Takuetsu’s Citizen Series, this exquisitely crafted figure depicts an outpost worker doing what they do best: surviving. Modeled with a Gyson softshell helmet and multitool, this worker’s ready to tackle all the hardships and repairs needed to maintain an outpost in an inhospitable environment.

lore.name: ARMOR
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian ARMOR is Seal Corps’ top-of-the-line shield generator. It was used extensively by the military prior to its shield tech being declassified for civilian use.

lore.name: Arrester III Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Firestorm Kinetics Tracking Signal: Cross Section Size: 3 Using cross section targeting to hunt for its prey, the Firestorm Arrester proximity missile makes quick work of enemies caught in the crosshairs.

lore.name: Arrester III-G Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Firestorm Kinetics Tracking Signal: Cross Section Size: 3 Using cross section targeting to hunt for its prey, the Firestorm Arrester proximity missile makes quick work of enemies caught in the crosshairs. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

lore.name: Arrow Citizens for Prosperity Liberation Livery
lore.description: Be a beacon of hope by equipping the Citizens for Prosperity Liberation livery, which features the group's name and symbol atop a green, black, and grey paint job.

lore.name: Arrow Foundation Guide Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Arrow Headhunters Reaper Livery
lore.description: The Headhunters Reaper livery lets you proudly proclaim your allegiance to the gang. It features the gang's name and highlights in red on a beige and grey paint scheme.

lore.name: Arrow Light Green and Grey Livery
lore.description: Customize your Arrow with this multi-tone green livery.

lore.name: Arrow Lovestruck Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your Arrow.

lore.name: Arrow Metallic Grey Livery
lore.description: Customize your Arrow with this sleek grey livery.

lore.name: Arrow Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Arrow with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Arrow PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Anvil Arrow with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: Arrow Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the Anvil Arrow.

lore.name: Arrow Tan and Green Livery
lore.description: Customize your Arrow with this multi-tone tan and green livery featuring gold accents.

lore.name: Arrow TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Anvil Arrow with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: Arrow Twilight Livery
lore.description: Customize your Arrow with this fragmented grey livery.

lore.name: Arrowhead "Lamplighter" Sniper Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Sniper Rifle Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 20 Rate Of Fire: 50 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Attachments: Optics (S3), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S2) Klaus & Werner’s Arrowhead Model VI long-range energy rifle features a fiberglass composite body capable of withstanding any number of rigorous environments both in atmosphere and out. Built with a precision stock, compound scope and built-in bipod, the Arrowhead offers a stable and devastating weapon for operators who want to keep their distance, but stay in the fight. First released during Luminalia, the Lamplighter edition was inspired by the traditional red holiday color.

lore.name: Arrowhead "Pathfinder" Sniper Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Sniper Rifle Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 20 Rate Of Fire: 50 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Klaus & Werner elevate the Arrowhead energy sniper rifle with the Pathfinder edition. Its bronze precision stock and compound scope feature a satin finish and elegant etchings. These elements create a weapon that's devastating from a distance and dazzling from up close.

lore.name: Arrowhead "Voyager" Sniper Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Sniper Rifle Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 20 Rate Of Fire: 50 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Survey the way ahead with the Voyager edition of the Klaus & Werner Arrowhead energy sniper rifle. The fiberglass composite body features a checkered metallic finish, while its blue and orange high-powered scope honors the ICC Stellar Surveyors. Chart a path to safety or surprise the enemy with this reliable long-range energy rifle.

lore.description: This telescopic sight attachment for the Arrowhead rifle allows 5 times optical magnification.

lore.name: Arrowhead Sniper Rifle Battery (16 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Battery Capacity: 16 This compact power source provides the Klaus & Werner Arrowhead rifle enough energy for 16 long-range precise shots.

lore.name: Arsenic
lore.description: A brittle, dense semimetal that is poisonous in large quantities.

lore.name: Ascension Astro Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Stealth Shield Generator Manufacturer: Ascension Astro Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Stealth
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Ascension Astro Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Stealth

lore.name: Ascension Astro Soloshield
lore.description: Manufacturer: Ascension Astro Ascension Astro's Soloshield is a baseline shield generator, projecting a single-field bubble to offer an additional layer of protection for your ship's hull and armor. The low electromagnetic emissions will also help minimize your ship's presence on scans.

lore.name: ASD Bomber Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Associated Science and Development is a company that defines what it means to be on the bleeding edge of technology. Originally exclusive to ASD workers in the Biological Research Division, this synthetic leather has the look, feel, and smell of the real thing. The company's logo is featured on the front and back.

lore.name: ASD Hat
lore.description: A red and green cadet hat with ASD's name and logo emblazoned across the front panel.

lore.name: ASD Technician Hat
lore.description: A white and black cadet hat with ASD's name and logo emblazoned across the front panel.

lore.name: Asgard 2955 Ship Showdown Poster
lore.description: Featuring a massive ramp designed to accommodate large ground vehicles and the rapid deployment of troops and supplies, it's no surprise the Anvil Asgard found itself in the final four of the 2955 Ship Showdown. This poster honors the accomplishment with an image of the ship streaking across colorful, cloud-filled sky.

lore.name: Asgard Alliance Aid Green Livery
lore.description: Showcase your dedication to helping Alliance Aid assist the people of Levski during their time of need with this green livery with yellow accents.

lore.name: Asgard Best in Show 2955 Livery
lore.description: Commemorate the Asgard making the final four of the 2955 Ship Showdown with this striking metallic orange and black Best in Show livery.

lore.name: Asgard Last Light Livery
lore.description: Wrap your Asgard in a black base with yellow accents with the Last Light livery.

lore.name: Asgard Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Asgard with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Asgard Sand Sea Livery
lore.description: The Sand Sea livery for the Asgard is primarily beige with black and red accents.

lore.name: Asgard Savannah Livery
lore.description: Make the Asgard green with black and yellow accents with the Savannah livery.

lore.name: Asgard Skullcrusher Livery
lore.description: Exude attitude with the Skullcrusher livery for the Asgard, which features a massive skull across the top.

lore.name: Asgard Sky Forge Livery
lore.description: Mainly blue, the Sky Forge livery for the Asgard also features black and red accents.

lore.name: Asgard SteelTek Livery
lore.description: The SteelTek livery features a shining metallic coating with a Damascus pattern that runs across the surface of the Asgard.

lore.name: Asgard Valhalla Livery
lore.description: The Valhalla livery melds a dazzling copper finish with green accents to give the Asgard a truly distinct appearance.

lore.name: Aslarite
lore.description: Aslarite is a naturally-occurring mineral that is most commonly found on asteroids. Sought for its natural thermal insulation properties, it can be processed and used in the construction of personal armor to help the wearer withstand extreme temperatures.

lore.name: Aspis
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Industrial Basilisk’s Aspis industrial shield generator features durable design and reliable performance, earning it a place on Whitley’s Guide ‘Best Buy’ list.

lore.name: Assailant IV Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Cross Section Size: 4 The Assailant missile from Talon is a perfect weapon solution for precision strikes against motivated opponents.

lore.name: Assailant IV-G Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Cross Section Size: 4 The Assailant missile from Talon is a perfect weapon solution for precision strikes against motivated opponents. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

lore.name: Astatine
lore.description: A dangerously radioactive, highly unstable halogen. Some of its isotopes have half-lives of one second or less.

lore.name: Aster Gloves Sand
lore.description: Pros at keeping your hands safe without sacrificing dexterity, the slip-resistant Aster Gloves deliver solid protection and lasting warmth during chilly or hostile conditions. The tough synthetic leather breaks in well and will stand up to years of frequent use.

lore.name: Astley Pants (Modified)
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU This version of DMC's Astley pants has been modified from its original form. Flaunt your rugged yet refined sensibility with these cargo pants from DMC. With grey accents and contrast stripes down each side, Astleys are durable, comfortable, and always on point.

lore.name: Astley Pants Black
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Flaunt your rugged yet refined sensibility with these cargo pants from DMC. With grey accents and contrast stripes down each side, Astleys are durable, comfortable, and always on point. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Asymetrical Undercut
lore.description: Taller on one side and shorter on the other.

lore.name: Atavi Shirt "Pathfinder"
lore.description: A casual and comfortable grey long sleeve shirt that looks good whether you're out and about or just lounging at home. MuyMuy's exclusive Pathfinder edition of the Atavi steps up the style by including striking silver sleeves.

lore.name: Atavi Shirt Dark
lore.description: MuyMuy's Atavi line of casual shirts are comfortable enough to wear at home, but stylish enough for a night out. They are made with EasyCare technology to maintain the colors during repeated washes.

lore.name: Ati Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Fiore's is a modern update of traditional Earth design. Slim tailoring, a high collar, and striking asymmetrical design make this overcoat a must-have item for any wardrobe.

lore.name: Atlas
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RSI Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Civilian Though it may seem commonplace today, Humanity’s ability to travel across solar systems at quantum speeds was built upon a foundation of Roberts Space Industries’ technology and craftsmanship. Now, space travel has reached even higher heights thanks to the top-of-class performance of RSI’s Atlas pushing quantum drive technology farther than it’s ever gone.

lore.name: Atlasium
lore.description: This very strong metal alloy is often one of the few materials salvageable from severe wreck sites.

lore.name: ATLS 2956 Auspicious Red Rat Livery
lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Rat livery. Outfit your power suit with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a rat.

lore.name: ATLS Auspicious Red Livery
lore.description: The Auspicious Red livery brings a bold red base paint and striking gold accents to the ATLS power suit.

lore.name: ATLS Carbon Black Livery
lore.description: The Carbon Black livery gives the ATLS power suit a sleek and professional appearance.

lore.name: ATLS Cobalt Livery

lore.name: ATLS Cold Snap Livery
lore.description: Combining bright white with a cool teal, the Cold Snap livery delivers a striking appearance to the ATLS suit.

lore.name: ATLS Foreman Livery
lore.description: Blending elements of olive green and saffron orange, the Foreman livery is completed with bold black accents.

lore.name: ATLS Foundation Fest Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: ATLS Granite Livery
lore.description: A base of grey is elevated with lime lettering across the side of the ATLS Granite livery.

lore.name: ATLS Ironside Livery
lore.description: Embody the strength of the ATLS power suit with Ironside livery.

lore.name: ATLS Keystone Livery
lore.description: Crisp white with blue accents, the Keystone livery celebrates the workers whose mining, refining, hauling, salvaging, and more have made the empire what it is today.

lore.name: ATLS Lionheart Livery
lore.description: Remain highly visible in the ATLS power suit with Lionheart livery, which is primarily light yellow.

lore.name: ATLS Monsoon Livery
lore.description: The Monsoon livery brings a bold blue tint to your ATLS power suit.

lore.name: ATLS Nightshift Livery
lore.description: Featuring a diffuse blue, subtle reds, and black accents, the Nightshift livery shows that style goes hand in hand with strength.

lore.name: ATLS Safety Orange Livery
lore.description: Ideal for bustling work sites, the Safety Orange livery brings a bright orange base and white stripes to the ATLS.

lore.name: ATLS Tectonic Livery
lore.description: Outfit your ATLS power suit in earth tones with the Tectonic livery.

lore.name: ATLS Thunderhead Livery
lore.description: The Thunderhead livery for the ATLS is black with grey stripes across the arms.

lore.name: Attrition-1 Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 1 The Attrition-1 laser repeater features Hurston Dynamics' unique cascade technology which provides increased performance while sustained laser fire is maintained. The result is a size one weapon that rewards a deft operator.

lore.name: Attrition-2 Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 2 When the battle is heating up, that's when Hurston Dynamics' cascade laser technology really shines. With the size two Attrition-2 repeater, an operator can utilize sustained bursts of laser fire in order to translate excess heat into greater weapon performance.

lore.name: Attrition-3 Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 3 Rather than limiting their weapon's performance to increase stability, Hurston Dynamics' cascade technology allows the operator to decide. While overheating is a risk, longer periods of sustained fire with the Attrition-3 laser repeater will increase performance as excess heat is translated into greater energy output.

lore.name: Attrition-4 Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 4 Hurston Dynamics has fully integrated it's cascade laser technology into their Attrition-line of repeaters. The size four Attrition-4 is no exception, operating at peak performance when near its maximum thermal capacity.

lore.name: Attrition-5 Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 5 More than a simple size five laser repeater, the Attrition-5 from Hurston Dynamics features advanced cascade technology to allow the weapon significant performance improvements the longer it sustains its energy output.

lore.name: Attrition-6 Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 6 With Hurston Dynamics' cascade technology, the Attrition-6 laser repeater maximizes it's combat potential. It's common for weapons to heat up when used heavily in combat, but what sets this size six repeater apart is that thermal energy is translating directly into increased offensive strength.

lore.name: ATVS Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Distortion Repeater Size: 2 Mess with an aggressor's electrical system with the ATVS from Behring. This disruptive, non-lethal distortion repeater is only compatible with the nose-mount on the Aegis Vanguard.

lore.name: Atzkav "Deadeye" Sniper Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Lightning Bolt Co. Item Type: Sniper Rifle Class: Electron Battery Size: 5 Rate Of Fire: 30 rpm Effective Range: 150m+ Attachments: Optics (S3), Underbarrel (S2) The Atzkav is a unique precision sniper rifle from Lightning Bolt Co. Once the charging handle is engaged, it accurately fires a charged electron to deal significant energy damage that spreads to nearby conductive targets. This special pulse effect also leaves a residual charge in the strike area that increases damage delivered by subsequent electron shots. Alongside the rifle's special firing capabilities, the Atzkav is best known for its distinct barrel that crackles with energy when powering its next shot. The exclusive Deadeye edition is black with gold highlights.

lore.name: Auditor Pants Grey
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Auditor is Octagon's top rated line of tactical dress pants. The Auditor's unique double-weave fibers allow for increased durability when action calls while its modern-cut, flat-front design disappears easily into the crowd. The Auditor also features an attached belt crafted from synthetic leather.

lore.name: Auditor Shirt Covalex Edition
lore.description: Octagon's Auditor line of shirts offers the ultimate in urban styling. The simple short-sleeve, button-down shirts feature an accent color and a collar that matches the modern fashion. Octagon's patented altsilk fabric allows for high breathability and a full range of flexible motion.

lore.description: Octagon's Auditor line of shirts offers the ultimate in urban styling. The simple long-sleeve, button-down shirts feature an accent color and a collar that matches the modern fashion. Octagon's patented altsilk fabric allows for high breathability and a full range of flexible motion.

lore.name: Aufeis
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Wen/Cassel Propulsion Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Civilian Impeccable design and unmatched attention to detail from Wen/Cassel Propulsion makes the Aufeis one of the premiere civilian coolers on the market.

lore.name: Aurora Mk I ArcCorp Livery
lore.description: The ArcCorp livery for the Aurora features the company's logo atop a maroon base paint with black and yellow highlights.

lore.name: Aurora Mk I Big Benny Livery
lore.description: Take that kacho to go with this official Big Benny livery, just don't blame us when you're assaulted by hordes of hungry Humans.

lore.name: Aurora Mk I CL Livery
lore.description: Standard livery for the RSI Aurora Mk I CL.

lore.name: Aurora Mk I Crusader Livery
lore.description: The Crusader livery for the Aurora features the company's logo atop a light blue base paint with black and white highlights.

lore.name: Aurora Mk I Disco Livery
lore.description: Equip the ship livery used by ace pilot Disco in the classic children's cartoon Rory Nova. While it turns the Aurora Mk I metallic dark blue, black, and red, whether you turn into the 'dynamic, instinctive spacecraft operator' that inspired the livery's name is up to you.

lore.name: Aurora Mk I Dread Pirate Livery
lore.description: Boldly show your true colors with this black and red livery, letting all know that you do as you please, and are pretty pleased with what you do.

lore.name: Aurora Mk I Exploration Livery
lore.description: This Aurora livery is perfect for those ready to go forth boldly with a black finish, white accents, and a large citizen emblem emblazoned on one side.

lore.name: Aurora Mk I False Colors Livery

lore.name: Aurora Mk I Hazard Livery
lore.description: Keep a lookout with this hazard-themed livery for your Aurora.

lore.name: Aurora Mk I High Roller Livery
lore.description: Ready to shut up the naysayers and show the 'verse that you made it big? Roll up with your Aurora decked out in this green and gold livery checkered with credit symbols.

lore.description: The Hurston livery for the Aurora features the company's logo atop a grey base paint with yellow highlights.

lore.name: Aurora Mk I MR Livery
lore.description: Standard livery for the RSI Aurora Mk I MR.

lore.name: Aurora Mk I Pirate Livery

lore.name: Aurora Mk I Pitchfork Livery

lore.name: Aurora Mk I Record Breaker Livery

lore.name: Avalanche
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Military Showcasing the best of mil-spec cooler technology, the Aegis Avalanche thermal management unit has been built from the ground up to endure the demanding needs of the battlefield.

lore.name: Avalos Scout Goggles
lore.description: Tech meets tough with the Avalos Scout goggles. Their unique and sturdy frame ensures that the lenses remain intact even after unexpected impacts or sudden atmospheric changes. Built for harsh environments but bold enough to be worn anywhere.

lore.name: Avalos Scout Goggles (Modified)
lore.description: This version of Rambler's Avalos Scout goggles has been modified from its original form. Tech meets tough with the Avalos Scout goggles. Their unique and sturdy frame ensures that the lenses remain intact even after unexpected impacts or sudden atmospheric changes. Built for harsh environments but bold enough to be worn anywhere.

lore.name: AvantX Glasses
lore.description: A distinct one piece lens with a unique geometric design makes the AvantX glasses stand out from the crowd. SPV expertly blends cutting edge style and technology for a distinct look and feel that's fashion forward.

lore.name: Avenger Copernicus Livery
lore.description: To honor the brave explorers that brought us to space and support those currently seeking new frontiers, the Interstellar Cartography Center (ICC) commissioned this special livery for the Avenger. Named in honor of famed astronomer Nicolaus Copernicus, the livery mixes two shades of blue with black highlights. All proceeds from the sale of the Copernicus livery goes directly to the ICC to support their efforts in "Charting the Way Ahead."

lore.name: Avenger De Biasio Livery
lore.description: To honor the brave explorers that brought us to space and support those currently seeking new frontiers, the Interstellar Cartography Center (ICC) commissioned this special livery for the Avenger. Named in honor of former ICC Director Loretta De Biasio, this livery mixes orange and grey with black highlights. All proceeds from the sale of the De Biasio livery goes directly to the ICC to support their efforts in "Charting the Way Ahead."

lore.name: Avenger Deck the Hull Livery
lore.description: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.

lore.name: Avenger IceBreak Livery
lore.description: Equip your Avenger with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

lore.name: Avenger Ironweave Livery

Named in honor of famed astronomer Johannes Kepler, the livery mixes dark blue and orange with black highlights. All proceeds from the sale of the Kepler livery goes directly to the ICC to support their efforts in "Charting the Way Ahead."

lore.name: Avenger PHB Flight Blade

lore.name: Avenger Stalker Standard Flight Blade

lore.description: Item Type: Flight Helmet Damage Reduction: 15% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s The AVS-E helmet's carbon fiber shell offers superb impact and penetration protection, an uninterrupted field of view and excellent stability making it ideal for all kinds of operations in the field.

lore.name: AVS-E Undersuit
lore.description: The AVS-E is a unique armor set designed to integrate seamlessly with the OMNI-CFS series of flight suits. The AVS features component armor plating, strategically placed to protect vital areas, but also integrates numerous pouches to keep you equipped in the field.

lore.name: Awaken
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Industrial No matter the job, you need to be sure that you're life support system is going to do its part - day in, day out. That's why Juno Starwerk built the Awaken life support system to be tough enough so you could breath easy.

Now with the Azrael helmet from CC's Conversions you can look the part with the grim visage of a skull peering out from beneath the visor of this otherwise normal looking helmet.

Suitable for everything from sand dunes to bustling backstreets, the Aztalan is the ideal choice for your next adventure.

lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Civilian Wherever you fly, the WillsOp Backlund radar is perfect for gathering information on what’s nearby and detecting a variety of emission signatures.

lore.name: Bacon Club Sandwich
lore.description: NDR: 41 Effects: None Two kinds of bacon - one thick cut and heavily smoked, the other crisp and sweet – join creamy aioli, roasted zucchini and bitter greens on white bread. At Twyn's, it's what's inside that counts.

lore.name: Badami Gloves Deadwood
lore.description: The Badami Gloves are lined with an advanced cut-resistant barrier that combines with a triple-layered interior to create an advanced impact protection system that could only have been designed by Caldera.

lore.name: Badami Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -38 / 68 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s The Badami helmet from Caldera provides premium head protection with a tough polycarbonate shell and an anti-microbial liner. Allowing you to boldly brave untamed locales and explore the dark corners of space.

lore.name: Baier
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian The Baier computer from WillsOp has a legion of fans thanks to consistent performance and renowned targeting software.

lore.name: Balandin
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Wei-Tek Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Military Wei-Tek built the Balandin with military and security personnel in mind. Following a series of test runs by veterans, engineers accelerated the spool and calibration times while also improving the component's precision and stability.

lore.description: A partial zip pullover shirt with mesh arm accents and a button collar. Escar Limited's Balboa line delivers cutting edge style suitable for any system or situation. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Ballet Bun
lore.description: Good for any work environment.

Rating: -75 / 105 °C Radiation Protection: 52800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 251.1 REM/s Every piece of the Balor was designed by Clark Defense Systems to more evenly distribute damage. This spreads the force of an impact across the heavy helmet, helping it hold up when others would fail. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Baltazar Stool
lore.description: Popularized by famed furniture designer Aldean Baltazar, the iconic Baltazar Stool has seen little iteration in its design since its inception fifty years ago.

lore.name: Bamoty
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Yorm Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Competition The Bamoty is Yorm’s take on a commercial style shield generator. This medium-sized component has won the company a wider fanbase because it expertly balances performance, durability, and stealth.

lore.name: Banded Fessle
lore.description: Known for its distinct blue and white banding, the Banded Fessle is indigenous to the warmer areas of the Anasazi Sea on Terra up to a depth of twelve meters. These carnivorous fish can grow to anywhere between forty and fifty centimeters and are known to eat small insects and fish.

lore.name: Bangs
lore.description: A straight cutting on the front part of the hair that hangs over the forehead.

lore.name: Bannock Jumpsuit Warm Ash
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Bannock jumpsuit combines comfort and durability. It features reinforced padding in critical areas, plenty of storage, and an adjustable belt to ensure a snug fit. Its unique design also includes a built-in secondary layer, allowing the wearer to unzip and cool down without fear of damaging their everyday clothes.

lore.name: Bantam Hat Badger Bad
lore.description: The Bantam hat from 987 offers a large bill and cushioned banding for all-day comfort. This version features a Badger Bad logo on the front with a gray back and red bill.

lore.name: Bantam Hat DMC
lore.description: The Bantam hat from 987 offers a large bill and cushioned banding for all-day comfort. This version features a Denim Manufacture Corporation logo on the front with an dark slate back and bill.

lore.name: Bantam Hat URW
lore.description: The Bantam hat from 987 offers a large bill and cushioned banding for all-day comfort. This version features a United Resource Worker's logo on the front with a gray back and bill.

lore.name: Banu Lockbox Replica
lore.description: This replica Banu lockbox mimics the look and feel of these rare and highly sought after collector's items. Usually owned by the heads of soulis to hold valuable items or documents, this realistic replica version was produced as a purely decorative item for Humans and can't be opened.

lore.name: Barbican
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Industrial Barricade your ship against external forces with the Basilisk Barbican. Originally fabricated for large industrial vessels, this shield generator has became quite popular due to its high damage absorption.

lore.name: Barrymore Pumps
lore.description: The Barrymore pumps are part of the Dyna Lei essentials collection. The shoes feature classic yet subtle curves and supportive insoles for an ultra-comfortable fit ideal for all day wear. Men sizes are currently unavailable.

lore.name: Barrymore Pumps

lore.name: Baru Gloves (Left Only)
lore.description: Ensure you hands are always dry and at the right temperature with the Baru gloves. An advanced sensor system protected by a metal plate on the back of the hand monitors and regulates conditions within the glove. A patented synthetic leather woven with special microfibers works with the sensors and a strap cuff provides a snug fit.

lore.name: Basher Blue Blossom Livery
lore.description: Turn the Basher into a beauty and a brute with the Blue Blossom livery, featuring a colorful and ornate flower pattern across the top of the ship.

lore.name: Basher Chopper Bodykit Top
lore.description: The quickest, surefire way to let everyone who sees you know that you're no one to mess with - the Chopper Bodykit gives the top of your ship a dramatic edge without sacrificing aerodynamics. With this giant steel-plated mast on, you won't just turn heads; your enemies will turn tail on your approach too.

lore.name: Basher Corroded Livery
lore.description: The Corroded livery embraces the Basher's less than conventional origins by featuring well-oxidized copper plating along the ship's hull.

lore.name: Basher Nightmare Livery
lore.description: Featuring a sinister skull atop a brown base paint, the Nightmare livery gives the Basher a look that sends shivers down the spine.

lore.name: Basher Razorburn Livery
lore.description: With an aggressive rusted look, the Razorburn livery shows that 'verse that you're ready to scrap.

lore.name: Basher Skull and Crossbones Livery
lore.description: This livery embraces classic pirate iconography by featuring several skull and crossbones symbols across the Basher's dark hull with blood red highlights.

lore.name: Basher T-Shirt
lore.description: Be an officially authorized party monster in this Gutterwash graphic tee from CBD with double-stitched hem and sleeves to help it survive those wild nights. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Basilisk Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Industrial The Steward is Basilisk’s entry level industrial shield generator. Its reinforced housing adds an extra level of durability to an already robust system, guaranteeing that your shield will be projecting even in the harshest conditions. Its reinforced housing adds an extra level of durability to an already robust system, guaranteeing that your shield will be projecting even in the harshest conditions.

lore.name: Basketball
lore.description: This inflatable ball features an orange synthetic composite with black ribbing that provides excellent bounce and control ideal for jamming while traveling in space.

lore.name: Bastion
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 0 Grade: D Class: Industrial You don’t need to be a multi-system megacorp to afford an industrial-grade shield generator for your vehicle. Basilisk’s Bastion provides enhanced shield durability without breaking the bank.

lore.name: Bastion
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Work harder for longer with GreyCat's award-winning Bastion safety harness. Featuring a reinforced composite harness and pads, the Bastion provides your workers with affordable impact protection that are capable of surviving the harshest of environments.

lore.name: Battani
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Civilian Expand your horizons with the WilsOp Battani radar and its advanced passive detection system.

lore.name: Battery This replacement battery powers Greycat's MaxLift tractor beam, so you can keep working without any delay.
lore.description: Item Type: Battery This replacement battery powers Greycat's MaxLift tractor beam, so you can keep working without any delay.

lore.name: Battle of Vega II Vanduul Skull
lore.description: Featuring a preserved skull from a defeated Vanduul footsoldier, this special commemorative display honors the brave members of the UEE military and public who fought so valiantly at the Battle of Vega II on October 5th, 2945.

lore.name: BC-Grey Hat
lore.description: A comfortable grey cadet hat.

lore.name: Be A Hero Poster
lore.description: Be a hero with this iconic poster, perfect for hanging on the wall of your hangar!

lore.name: Beacon
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Wei-Tek Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Military Wei-Tek has made other mil-spec component manufacturers sit up and take notice with the introduction of the highly praised Beacon quantum drive.

lore.name: Beacon Undersuit
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% RSI's Beacon undersuit is a general use utility designed to provide total protection against environments and vacuum. Built out of a durable but flexible polymers, the Beacon provides a wide freedom of motion for a variety of body types.

lore.name: Beacon Undersuit "Rust Society"
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% RSI's Beacon undersuit is a general use utility designed to provide total protection against environments and vacuum. Built out of a durable but flexible polymers, the Beacon provides a wide freedom of motion for a variety of body types. The Rust Society edition celebrates blue-collar workers with an exclusive red and tan coloration that hides dirt and wear and tear well.

lore.name: Bedhead
lore.description: For those who just woke up like this.

lore.name: Bedrock Boots
lore.description: This steel-toe workboot from Grindstone features SureFire grip technology, giving you firm traction even on slip, oil and abrasion surfaces.

lore.name: Bedrock Boots (Modified)
lore.description: This version of Grindstone's Bedrock boots has been modified from its original form. This steel-toe workboot from Grindstone features SureFire grip technology, giving you firm traction even on slip, oil and abrasion surfaces.

lore.name: BEHR PK-1 Sweeper
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring The PK-1 is a non-lethal anti-personnel mine that projects a dual-axis concussive and EMP energy to stun opponents and disrupt electronics caught in the blast.

lore.name: BEHR PK-1 Sweeper
lore.description: The PK-1 is a non-lethal anti-personnel mine that projects a dual-axis concussive and EMP energy to stun opponents and disrupt electronics caught in the blast.

lore.name: BEHR Single Platform
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring This Single Platform is a single-missile transport system that can add that extra edge for your ship in combat.

lore.name: Behring AP-7 Concussion Grenade
lore.description: The AP-7 is a battle-tested and operator approved tool for the field. This non-lethal explosive device is designed to disorient and disable enemy targets, allowing friendlies to safely breach and secure an area. Behring's proprietary reinforced casing construction minimizes the potential for accidental injury or death.

lore.name: Behring Ballistic Autocannon S4 Ammo Box
lore.description: Ammunition case for the Behring Ballistic Autocannon S4.

lore.name: Behring Ballistic Repeater S2 Ammo Box
lore.description: Ammunition case for Behring's Ballistic Repeater S2.

lore.name: Behring DS-12 Force Propulsion Grenade
lore.description: The DS12 is the latest in pacification technology, delivering a non-lethal force push intended to displace opponents in low or zero gravity situations.

lore.name: Behring EP-5 EMP Grenade
lore.description: Behring’s EP5 grenade produces a controlled electromagnetic burst to disrupt unshielded electronics for a short time, making it an invaluable addition to the loadout of military and law enforcement operators.

lore.name: Behring Flares x 16
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Type: Decoy Count: 16 These decoy countermeasures from trusted manufacturer Behring provide dependable IR signal spoofing to ably counter a wide range of ordnance.

lore.name: Behring Flares x 24
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Type: Decoy Count: 24 These decoy countermeasures from trusted manufacturer Behring provide dependable IR signal spoofing to ably counter a wide range of ordnance.

lore.name: Behring Flares x 32

lore.name: Behring Flares x 8
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Type: Decoy Count: 8 These decoy countermeasures from trusted manufacturer Behring provide dependable IR signal spoofing to ably counter a wide range of ordnance.

lore.name: Behring Marksman HS Double Platform
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring The Behring Marksman heat seeking missile utilizes an enemy's heat signature to obtain and maintain a lock on the target. This tried-and-true method of target acquisition has a few drawbacks: it is easily confused by flares and it may be difficult to establish lock on ships with low heat signatures. These issues aside, the Marksman is the go-to missile of choice for many independent operators and pilots. Rack of two (2).

lore.name: Behring Marksman HS Quad Platform
lore.description: The Behring Marksman heat seeking missile utilizes an enemy's heat signature to obtain and maintain a lock on the target. This tried-and-true method of target acquisition has a few drawbacks: it is easily confused by flares and it may be difficult to establish lock on ships with low heat signatures. These issues aside, the Marksman is the go-to missile of choice for many independent operators and pilots. Rack of four (4).

lore.name: Behring MK4 Frag Grenade
lore.description: A continuation of the iconic hand grenade first produced by Behring in 2894, the MK4 is an anti-personnel fragmentation grenade capable of saturating the kill-zone with lethal projectiles and a devastating concussive blast.

lore.name: Behring Quad Platform
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Behring's Quad Platform is a complete four-round missile system that can be mounted on any compatible hardpoint for reliable and effective weapon launch.

lore.name: Behring Quad Platform
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Behring’s Quad Platform is a complete four-round missile system that can be mounted on any compatible hardpoint for reliable and effective weapon launch.

lore.name: Behring SC-1 LIDAR Grenade
lore.description: LIDAR allows users to understand the battlefield before entering it. Once activated in the field, it emits an omni-directional scan that maps everyone in its radius. Then sends their precise positions to the operator.

lore.name: Bellator Jacket
lore.description: Damage Reduction: 20% Carrying Capacity: 0.4K µSCU Stylish, functional, and deadly: the Bellator clothing line is designed to fit in at dinner party just as well as a gunfight. Blending cutting edge technology with precise measurements, this jacket provides some combat protection thanks to the intricate weaving of layered graphene in its threads. Adorned with a decorative lapel pin, the jacket's spacious inner lining is also capable of subtly concealing small weaponry and devices.
