lore.name: Bellito Shirt
lore.description: Enhance your basic t-shirt game with this stylish short sleeve t-shirt from City Lights, which features a dynamic, asymmetrical line across the front. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Bello T-Shirt Blue
lore.description: This stylish t-shirt from City Lights is made from a lighter fabric that's perfect for warmer climates.

lore.name: Bello T-Shirt Navy
lore.description: Show your support with this special t-shirt featuring the official Navy logo. City Lights will donate a portion of every sale to Operation Solace's Vega Relief Fund.

lore.name: Benaderet Dress
lore.description: Dyna Lei has crafted the Benaderet dress out of rich, quilted, mocha-colored leather and gilded the look with a belted waist, off-the-shoulder straps, asymmetrical lines, and a matching choker to top it all off. Men's sizes currently not available.

lore.name: Beradom
lore.description: Formed when sap from the Beraber Fir is crystalized during forest fires, this transparent deep blue "gemstone" is often polished smooth and used in jewelry. While it can be manufactured by growing trees and then doing a controlled burn, the time investment for the trees to reach the proper maturity still make this a rare commodity.

lore.name: Berian
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Wen/Cassel Propulsion Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian The Berian delivers Wen/Cassel’s signature look and performance in an introductory cooler that will meet and surpass pilot’s expectations.

lore.name: Berry Blend Smoothie
lore.description: HEI: 35 NDR: 14 Effects: Immune Boosting A smoothie made with a fresh blend of berries.

lore.name: Berserker Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -90 / 115 °C Radiation Protection: 52800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 251.1 REM/s Modern and ancient armor converge with the Berserker helmet. This wildly original armor from CC's Conversions features golden horns and wings, plus a face covering inspired by lamellar armor. Beneath these unique aesthetic flourishes, this heavy helmet provides supreme protection with plating that extends low enough to protect your neck. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Beryl
lore.description: A mineral that creates natural hexagonal crystals. Colorless in its pure form, its impure forms include the gems emerald and aquamarine.

lore.name: Bexalite
lore.description: This mineral harvested from worlds with no natural magnetic core, has found widespread use in electrical systems.

lore.name: Bibiana Shirt
lore.description: Part of their Essential Professional line, Fiore designed the Bibiana for those who want that retro look but with modern durability. The top features a refined pinpoint Oxford long sleeve shirt woven into a dark grey vest and suspenders adorned with gold clips as colorful accents. Additional eye-catching accessories include a black bow tie and sleeve garters.

lore.name: Big Barrys T-Shirt
lore.description: Humans can't get enough of Big Barrys grab and go kacho. This shirt made by a Banu souli is for all Humans that love eating noodles so hot that they turn your eyes red!

lore.name: Big Benny's "Classic" Vending Machine
lore.description: A replica of the original Big Benny's vending machine designed to bring a nostalgic touch to any environment.

lore.name: Big Benny's Mug
lore.description: Grab Drink! This playful Big Benny's mug features the brand's iconic mascot. Its unique dual layer design features a chip and fade proof ceramic that feels comfortable in the hand with special plastic coating on the lip and handle to ensure it's never too hot to touch.

lore.name: Big Benny's T-Shirt
lore.description: This Big Benny's shirt embodies the joy of dining on their delicious kacho with an animated image that rotates between two versions of the brand's iconic logo. Wearing it is bound to remind everyone to grab and eat this tasty treat.

lore.name: Big Winner T-Shirt
lore.description: Featuring a stylized, neon-green X on the front and the phrase "Big winner!" on the back, when you wear this T-shirt, everyone will know that you're going places.

lore.name: Bioplastic
lore.description: A plastic replacement material created when fossil fuels began running low in Sol. It is derived from renewable biomass sources, often from vat grown bacteria but can be derived from industrial byproducts as well.

lore.name: Bison Military Boots
lore.description: Thick and robust, these black faux-leather military boots provide durable protection for your feet on a variety of terrains.

lore.name: Black Bean Ramian
lore.description: NDR: 40 Effects: Dehydrating, Hyper-Metabolic A thick ferment black bean sauce deliciously coats these thin chewy noodles. Sure to satisfy!

lore.name: Black Mountain Sujin Tea (Medium Blend)
lore.description: HEI: 21 Effects: Immune Boosting, Cognitive Boosting Sujin root tea, native to Elysium IV, is a traditional Tevarin beverage and has been produced for thousands of years. Black Mountain steeps only premium roots to make their delicious brew.

lore.name: Black Mountain Sujin Tea (Mild)
lore.description: HEI: 21 Effects: Immune Boosting, Cognitive Boosting Sujin root tea, native to Elysium IV, is a traditional Tevarin beverage and has been produced for thousands of years. Black Mountain steeps only premium roots to make their delicious brew.

lore.name: Black Mountain Sujin Tea (Rich)
lore.description: HEI: 21 Effects: Immune Boosting, Cognitive Boosting Sujin root tea, native to Elysium IV, is a traditional Tevarin beverage and has been produced for thousands of years. Black Mountain steeps only premium roots to make their delicious brew.

lore.name: Black Prism (8x Telescopic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Type: Telescopic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 8x Aim Time: +0% Size: 3 Delivering accurate fire at long distances is a skill that comes with practice – and the use of a proper scope like Kastak Arms' Black Prism. Crafted with rugged, multi-coated crystalens to deliver bright, clear visuals, this 8x telescopic sight is completely at home on your favorite rifle.

lore.name: BlastChill
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Civilian The BlastChill is a consumer-grade cooler from Lightning Power Ltd. It keeps your ship running without straining its signature, but is best known for a much mocked 2945 ad campaign that promised it was “Built to bring the chill.”

lore.name: Blizzard
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Military Navy mechanics worked with Aegis engineers to ensure the Blizzard met their specific needs. When it reached the commercial market, this top of the line, military-grade cooler became one of Aegis’ top selling components.

lore.name: BLOC
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Civilian Seal Corporation’s BLOC shield generator was the first to use the company’s revolutionary quantum core semiconductor to reduce the component’s power draw without compromising performance.

lore.name: Blood Bank Poster
lore.description: A poster for the cult classic horror vid “Blood Bank” that tells the story of a heist that goes very, very wrong.

lore.name: Blue Bilva
lore.description: NDR: 23 HEI: 10 Effects: Hydrating, Energizing The Blue Bilva is known for its distinctive rich flavor; which is highly astringent, aromatic and very high in fructose. The fruit can also be identified by its slightly pointed, ovoid shape, and dark blue to indigo skin. The fibrous flesh of the bilva clings firmly to its large stone which is so hard that it can only be cracked through mechanical means. It takes about 11 months to ripen on the tree. It is commonly eaten dried or turned into brandy.

lore.name: Bo-Go (Angeli Original)
lore.description: NDR: 30 Effects: None Croshaw’s signature meat and seafood stew is now available the Empire over! 'Angeli Original' flavor provides a real "taste of home" thanks to its classic family recipe.

lore.name: Bo-Go (Crawdad)
lore.description: NDR: 30 Effects: None Croshaw’s signature meat and seafood stew is now available the Empire over! 'Crawdad' flavor puts front and center the delicious crustacean loved by the people of Angeli.

lore.name: Bo-Go (Hot and Sweet)
lore.description: NDR: 30 Effects: None Croshaw’s signature meat and seafood stew is now available the Empire over! 'Hot and Sweet' flavor brings layers of spice and rich molasses to the traditional recipe.

lore.name: Bo-Go (Langoustine and Lamb)
lore.description: NDR: 30 Effects: None Croshaw’s signature meat and seafood stew is now available the Empire over! 'Langoustine and Lamb' flavor combines succulent langoustine tail meat with rich and hearty pieces of lamb in a lighter sauce that highlights them both.

lore.name: Bobcat Bomber Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Inspired by the traditional jackets worn by Earth's early pilots, this coat provides a flattering fit thanks to its elasticated waist and cuffs, blending fashion with functionality.

lore.name: Bolide
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Military The Bolide power plant from Aegis has logged innumerable hours of flight experience and is frequently used by the UEE Navy and security forces across the Empire.

lore.name: Bologna Sandwich
lore.description: NDR: 41 Effects: None Artisanally crafted in the old-world tradition, our lightly smoked bologna is paired with a sharp mustard and layered between soft, buttery rice bread. At Twyn's, it's what's inside that counts.

lore.name: Bolon
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Industrial Don’t let lesser craftsmanship put you and your precious cargo at risk. The Bolon industrial quantum drive was built with durability in mind to keep it working when you need it most.

lore.name: Bolt
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RAMP Corporation Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Stealth The RAMP Corporation continues their line of low emission quantum drives with the Bolt. This medium-sized component will blast you from one location to the next while producing a minimal signature.

lore.name: Boomtube "Clanguard" Rocket Launcher
lore.description: Manufacturer: Unknown Item Type: Launcher Class: Rocket Magazine Size: 1 Rate Of Fire: 20 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best. The Clanguard version has been modified with Vanduul materials and alien artifacts.

lore.name: Boomtube "Mean Green" Rocket Launcher
lore.description: Manufacturer: Unknown Item Type: Launcher Class: Rocket Magazine Size: 1 Rate Of Fire: 20 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best. The Mean Green version features a green tint.

lore.name: Boomtube "Ruby" Rocket Launcher
lore.description: Manufacturer: Unknown Item Type: Launcher Class: Rocket Magazine Size: 1 Rate Of Fire: 20 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best. This Ruby variant features a red tint.

lore.name: Boomtube Rocket
lore.description: Item Type: Rocket Capacity: 1 Made for the Boomtube launcher, this "rocket" is pretty much three grenades strapped together. Good luck!

lore.name: BoostPen (Modamphetamine)
lore.description: Manufacturer: CureLife Item Type: Medical Consumable From the Empire’s most trusted medical company, the CureLife BoostPen delivers a dose of the potent stimulant Modamphetamine to increase wakefulness and diminish awareness of pain in emergency situations.

lore.name: BoostPen Xtra
lore.description: Manufacturer: CureLife Item Type: Medical Consumable From the Empire’s most trusted medical company, the CureLife BoostPen Xtra delivers a high dose of the potent stimulant Modamphetamine to greatly increase wakefulness and diminish awareness of pain in emergency situations.

lore.name: Borase
lore.description: This highly thermally conductive material is often formed from cosmic ray spallation and is most typically found in younger star systems.

lore.name: Borase (Ore)
lore.description: This highly thermally conductive material is often formed from cosmic ray spallation and is most typically found in younger star systems.

lore.name: Boreal
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Military Designed to disperse the heat of battle, Aegis Dynamics’ Boreal cooler is a military standard with the capacity to survive stressful situations.

lore.name: Boron
lore.description: A metalloid element produced by supernovae and cosmic ray spallation. A semiconductor in its pure crystalline form.

lore.name: Bosco Weapon Display Rack
lore.description: Made for the weapon enthusiast who values their guns for more than just the amount of damage they can do. Complete with numerous display shelves for your favorite arms, as well as storage space for spare ammo and accessories, all in a stylish package that shows off your top picks.

lore.name: Boumbo Stew Omni Pack
lore.description: NDR: 56 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic Omni Packs use premium certified organic ingredients to create a complete balanced ready-to-eat meal with a premium taste.

lore.name: BR-2 "Blacklist" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 12 Rate Of Fire: 75 rpm Effective Range: 15 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S3), Underbarrel (S2) Originally designed for the military, Behring decided to sell the BR-2 ballistic shotgun to the general public after the initial weapon testers kept requesting to take one home. Featuring a semi-auto fire mode that can rapidly deliver devastating stopping power, the BR-2 is the ideal choice for both offensive and defensive operations. The Blacklist edition features a black finish.

lore.name: BR-2 "Permafrost" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 12 Rate Of Fire: 75 rpm Effective Range: 15 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S3), Underbarrel (S2) Originally designed for the military, Behring decided to sell the BR-2 ballistic shotgun to the general public after the initial weapon testers kept requesting to take one home. Featuring a semi-auto fire mode that can rapidly deliver devastating stopping power, the BR-2 is the ideal choice for both offensive and defensive operations. This special Permafrost edition features blue and grey coloring reminiscent of a glacier under a blinding winter sky.

lore.name: BR-2 "Purgatory Camo" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 12 Rate Of Fire: 75 rpm Effective Range: 15 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S3), Underbarrel (S2) Originally designed for the military, Behring decided to sell the BR-2 ballistic shotgun to the general public after the initial weapon testers kept requesting to take one home. Featuring a semi-auto fire mode that can rapidly deliver devastating stopping power, the BR-2 is the ideal choice for both offensive and defensive operations. The Purgatory Camo edition's grey-on-grey dressing creates a sleek, utilitarian profile.

lore.name: BR-2 Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 12 Rate Of Fire: 75 rpm Effective Range: 15 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S3), Underbarrel (S2) Originally designed for the military, Behring decided to sell the BR-2 ballistic shotgun to the general public after the initial weapon testers kept requesting to take one home. lore.name: BR-2 Shotgun Magazine (12 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 12 This magazine for the Behring BR-2 shotgun holds twelve 12-gauge rounds.

lore.name: Brace Mask
lore.description: Ever dream of standing out in a crowd while remaining completely anonymous? Vaporwear's Brace hood offer total facial coverage that keeps the wearer's identity hidden. Small optical sensors woven into the hood and run through a digital interface on the back provides the wearer with a perfect view of their surroundings.

lore.name: Bracer
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Military For those looking for a solid, dependable mid-line cooler, you can’t do much better than Aegis’ Bracer. This small-frame cooler system offers solid performance and durability to keep your ship firing on all cylinders.

lore.name: Bracer
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Military For those looking for a solid, dependable mid-line cooler, you can’t do much better than Aegis’ Bracer. This small-frame cooler system offers solid performance and durability to keep your ship firing on all cylinders.

lore.name: Bracewell Boots
lore.description: Durable, dependable, and comfortable. The Bracewell are high ankle boots designed to thrive amidst unpredictable weather conditions with a water-resistant finish, high-traction soles, and a toggle-locked top enclosure to help keep out any precipitation.

lore.name: Bravo Team Tank Action Figure
lore.description: Bring your favorite Star Marine character into your home with this collectible statue. Developed in close conjunction with Electronic Access and using the original assets from the smash video game, this meticulously detailed model is crafted out of polyresin and fiberglass and features the CDS’ devastating ADP-mk4 heavy armor recently added to the game.

lore.name: Bravo Team Tank Action Figure (Imperator Edition)
lore.description: Bring your favorite Star Marine character into your home with this collectible statue. Developed in close conjunction with Electronic Access and using the original assets from the smash video game, this meticulously detailed model is crafted out of polyresin and fiberglass and features the CDS’ devastating ADP-mk4 heavy armor recently added to the game.

lore.name: Brawler Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -61 / 91 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s True to its name, the Brawler is built to back you up in a fight. The helmet is an enclosed, full-cover shell made from molded titanium alloy designed to strike an imposing presence while offering maximum protection from incoming fire.

lore.name: Brawler Medium Armor
lore.description: The ideal balance of security and speed, Kastak Arm's Brawler armor is graded to be durable while also retaining combat flexibility, ensuring you can adapt your tactics to the situation at hand.

lore.name: Brawler Medium Armor
lore.description: The ideal balance of security and speed, Kastak Arm's Brawler armor is graded to be durable while also retaining combat flexibility, ensuring you can adapt your tactics to the situation at hand.

lore.name: Breakfast Dog
lore.description: NDR: 34 Effects: Dehydrating, Hyper-Metabolic Scrambled eggs make this hot dog great to get you going any time of day.

lore.name: Breakneck S4 Gatling
lore.description: Manufacturer: Unknown Item Type: Ballistic Gatling Size: 4 While the exact origins and designer are unknown, the Breakneck is built off an existing ballistic gatling then modified to cause more mayhem. When the Breakneck starts shooting, the fun begins.

lore.name: Breton
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Industrial The Breton embodies exactly what Juno Starwerk engineers wanted out of an industrial power plant — utilitarian, easy to repair and extremely powerful. You’ll be hard pressed to find a better balance of performance and durability from a unit this size.

lore.name: Brightspot Flashlight Purple
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Type: Flashlight Attachment Point: Underbarrel Size: 1 The Brightspot flashlight embodies Klaus & Werner's engineering ethos. A simple and sturdy design built to withstand intense combat and environmental conditions means the Brightspot always works when you need it most. This special edition projects a purple circle that makes the beam less conspicuous from a distance.

lore.name: BroadSpec
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Chimera Communications Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Industrial The Chimera Communications BroadSpec radar has an important job to do and does it well, detecting a wide range of emissions and signatures with a dependability you can count on.

lore.name: BroadSpec-Go
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Chimera Communications Size: 0 Grade: B Class: Industrial The BroadSpec-Go was designed with accuracy, reliability, and durability in mind. And that's exactly what this radar provides.

lore.name: Broadspec-Lite
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Chimera Communications Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Industrial Whether it’s tracking the members of your convoy or keeping an eye out for trouble, Chimera Communications understands how important your radar can be. That’s why they developed the Broadspec-Lite to have the range and sensitivity that’s so crucial to today’s operators.

lore.name: BroadSpec-Max
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Chimera Communications Size: 4 Grade: B Class: Industrial Keep your eyes on the prize with the BroadSpec-Max. Suitable for the largest of ships, this radar performs effectively without compromise.

lore.name: Brocius Waist Apron
lore.description: Habidash's Brocius Waist Apron features a quilted front panel paired with side skirting to protect the wearer from any overspills or other dirtying work while still providing freedom of movement.

lore.name: Bronze Mya Vase
lore.description: With subtle etched patterns and a brushed bronze finish, this artisanal vase emulates the original Mya vases used to store water during the planet's dry seasons.

lore.name: Brush Up Fade
lore.description: A disconnected fade with a bit of a brush up.

lore.name: Brushed Forward
lore.description: A classic hairstyle with nothing to hide.

lore.name: Brushed Up
lore.description: Combed up for that casual windswept look.

lore.name: BRVS Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Ballistic Repeater Size: 2 Only Vanguard owners can equip this unique version of Behring's line of ballistic repeaters to the nose of their ship. The BRVS is carefully calibrated so its ballistic barrage would fire fast enough to provide maximum target saturation while its improved venting reduces frequent overheating.

lore.name: Buccaneer Ghoulish Green Livery
lore.description: Embrace Day of the Vara mischievousness and mayhem any time of the year with this custom Buccaneer livery. It combines metallic green and black for a striking look that highlights the holiday's classic colors.

lore.name: Buccaneer Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Buccaneer with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Buccaneer Polar Livery
lore.description: Modify your Buccaneer with this white and grey livery specifically designed for the 2951 IAE.

lore.name: Buccaneer Redline Livery
lore.description: Featuring a fierce red base paint with black highlights, the Redline livery gives the Buccaneer a bold new look.

lore.name: Buccaneer Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom Buccaneer livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.

lore.name: Builders of Tomorrow T-Shirt White
lore.description: Crusader strives to be the builders of tomorrow through aerospace innovations and an unwavering commitment to philanthropy. Signal your support for Crusader's future-focused initiative with this shirt featuring the company logo and a cloudy Orison vista.

lore.name: BUL-H4 Ammo Carrier Stronghold
lore.description: Item Type: Ammo Carrier Core Compatibility: Medium & Heavy Carrying Capacity: 150K µSCU Custom built to store additional ammo for heavy machine guns, this carrier connects directly to your weapon via an ammo belt, ensuring prolonged continuous fire without impairment. The Stronghold edition features the fierce symbology of the Nine Tails gang with bold neon pink accents.

lore.name: BUL-H4 Armor
lore.description: Item Type: Super Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 90% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 4K µSCU Redefine personal protection with the BUL-H4 series. Utilizing advanced synthetic polymers, impacts are significantly mitigated transforming the wearer into a bulwark of defense. The armor's power-assisted frame helps maintain mobility, offsetting the heavy weight of the suit.

lore.description: Item Type: Super Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 90% Temp. CDS's proprietary PROWL hardware combines the video input from quad-visor slots to create one singular feed, offering uninhibited vision without compromising on safety.

CDS's proprietary PROWL hardware combines the video input from quad-visor slots to create one singular feed, offering uninhibited vision without compromising on safety. The SteelTek edition features a shining metallic coating with a Damascus pattern that runs across the surface.

lore.name: BUL-H4 Helmet Stronghold
lore.description: Item Type: Super Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 90% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Wreak havoc beyond belief while keeping your head intact with the XXXX helmet. With a full face visor and reinforced metal plating, plus extra internal padding to keep you comfortable, not just safe - you'll become a force to be reckoned with. Visor is AR crosshair compatible. The Stronghold edition features the fierce symbology of the Nine Tails gang with bold neon pink accents.

lore.name: Bulwark
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Industrial The Bulwark shield generator provides industrial-grade durability and increased performance, but at the expense of a higher emission level.

lore.name: Bun
lore.description: For the long-haired professional man on the go.

lore.name: Burgundy Paisley Bandana
lore.description: Made from only the finest cotton, this bandana from Alejo Brothers features a double-sided print and sewn edges to guarantee durability.

lore.name: Burke QD
lore.description: Manufacturer: Wei-Tek Type: Quantum Dampener Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Military See that justice is served with the Burke QD. This powerful quantum dampener from Wei-Tek projects a massive field that keeps ships from engaging their quantum drives, making it a valuable component for both law enforcement and security professionals.

lore.name: Burr Cut
lore.description: Buzzed, balding, and beautiful.

lore.name: Burst
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: ArcCorp Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Civilian With the Burst quantum drive, ArcCorp has taken their popular Rush model and through streamlined re-engineering, managed to improve upon it.

lore.name: Buster's Chocolate Bar
lore.description: NDR: 10 Effects: Energizing, Hyper-Metabolic Smooth sesame paste, salty roasted nuts, and a rich chocolate coating all combine to make Buster's, the classic treat that the Empire has loved for over two hundred years. Buster's or Bust!

lore.name: Buzzed Mohawk
lore.description: A mohawk featuring completely buzzed sides.

lore.name: C-07T Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Ballistic Cannon Size: 7 A dedicated anti-capital ship weapon adjusted to meet the combat demands of the Tiburon, the C-07T Ballistic Cannon delivers overwhelming offensive power, proving Behring continues to innovate in all areas of battlefield technology.

lore.name: C-71 Medical Case
lore.description: Item Type: Container (Medical) This sturdy container can be used to safely store and carry medical-grade supplies and devices. Built with shock-absorbing polycarbonate, its outer shell was designed to protect the contents in the event of sudden impacts.

lore.name: C-788 Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Ballistic Cannon Size: 4 Hurtling high caliber rounds with devastating velocity, Behring’s C-788 Ballistic Autocannon was built to punch through ship armor. Extremely durable with exceptional heat resistance, the “Combine” can handle a heavy workload that, even with the weapon’s slower rate of fire, makes it an ideal choice for taking on larger, less maneuverable targets.

lore.name: C-810 Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Ballistic Cannon Size: 5 Hurtling high caliber rounds with devastating velocity, Behring’s C-810 Ballistic Autocannon was built to punish ship armor. Extremely durable with exceptional heat resistance, the S5 variant of Behring's “Combine” line offers a steadier rate of fire, making it an ideal choice for taking on larger, less maneuverable targets.

lore.name: C-912 Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Ballistic Cannon Size: 6 Hurtling high caliber rounds with devastating velocity, Behring’s C-912 Ballistic Autocannon was built to punish ship armor. Extremely durable with exceptional heat resistance, the S6 variant of Behring's “Combine” line offers a steadier rate of fire, making it an ideal choice for taking on larger, less maneuverable targets.

lore.name: C1 Spirit 2954 Ship Showdown Poster
lore.description: With enough versatility to tackle multiple roles and unpredictable jobs, it's easy to understand why Crusader's C1 Spirit was part of the 2954 Ship Showdown's Final Four. A multi-purpose starship tuned for mid-range cargo delivery and courier work, this poster celebrates the C1 Spirit and Crusader Industries' commitment to excellence.

lore.name: C2 Hercules Starlifter Plushie
lore.description: Get your hands on Crusader's cargo hauling stalwart with this plushie version of the C2 Hercules Starlifter.

lore.name: C4-160f S5 Hornet Ball Turret
lore.description: Give your Hornet's firepower a boost with the C4-160f. Designed by Anvil specifically for its F7 series, this S5 ball turret can equip two S2 ship weapons.

lore.name: C4-163f S5 Hornet Mk I Ball Turret
lore.description: Give your Hornet's firepower a boost with the C4-163f. Designed by Anvil specifically for its F7 Mk I series, this S5 ball turret can equip two S3 ship weapons.

lore.name: C5-173f S5 Hornet Mk II Ball Turret
lore.description: Give your Hornet Mk II a boost in firepower with the C5-173f ball turret. Designed by Anvil specifically for its F7 Mk II series, this S5 ball turret can equip two S3 ship weapons.

lore.name: C54 "Justified" SMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Item Type: SMG Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 50 Rate Of Fire: 1,100 rpm Effective Range: 35m Attachments: Barrel (S1), Optics (S1), Underbarrel (S1) Easy to handle and a beauty to behold with its purple accented styling, the C54 is a sleek and precisely balanced SMG from Gemini. Its lightweight polymer frame and ergonomic design makes it ideal for close quarter engagements. The C54 is capable of firing 10mm rounds on full auto to provide maximum support and target saturation to ensure that any engagement ends quick. The "Justified" edition features a cool grey and bright red highlights.

lore.name: C54 "Luckbringer" SMG

lore.name: C8 Pisces Scrubland Camo Livery

lore.name: Cambio "Heartthrob" SRT
lore.description: Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Utility Class: Gadget Canister Size: Large Rate of Fire: N / A (Beam) Effective Range: 5 m Strip salvage and make repairs with the Cambio, a dual purpose salvage and repair tool (SRT) designed to collect and convert alloys and polymers found in scrap into recycled material composite that can either be sold or used to make quick repairs. The Cambio SRT features rapid stripping speeds and an impressive battery life, making it an essential gadget for mechanics and spacefarers. The "Heartthrob" edition is a dreamy, shimmering violet; perfect for making friends and foes weak in the knees.

lore.name: Cambio SRT
lore.description: Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Utility Class: Gadget Canister Size: Large Rate of Fire: N / A (Beam) Effective Range: 5 m Strip salvage and make repairs with the Cambio, a dual purpose salvage and repair tool (SRT) designed to collect and convert alloys and polymers found in scrap into recycled material composite that can either be sold or used to make quick repairs. The Cambio SRT features rapid stripping speeds and an impressive battery life, making it an essential gadget for mechanics and spacefarers.

lore.name: Cambio SRT Canister
lore.description: Item Type: RMC Canister (Large) Canister used by the Cambio SRT to store recycle material composite (RMC) reclaimed from scrap. Contents can be sold or used to make repairs.

lore.name: Cambio-Lite SRT Attachment
lore.description: MUST BUY BASE MULTI-TOOL TO USE: "Pyro RYT Multi-Tool" Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Multi-Tool Attachment Class: Salvage and Repair Greycat delivers once again, bringing their popular salvage and repair tool (SRT) as an attachment for the Multi-Tool. Though not as powerful as the Cambio, the Cambio-Lite also collects and converts alloys and polymers found in scrap into recycled material composite that can either be sold or used to make quick repairs. Whether stripping salvage for creds or patching a hull to make a ship space-safe, the Cambio-Lite is ready to get to work.

lore.name: Cambio-Lite SRT Canister
lore.description: Item Type: RMC Canister (Small) Canister used in conjunction with the Pyro RYT Multi-Tool and Cambio-Lite SRT attachment to store recycle material composite (RMC) reclaimed from scrap. Contents can be sold or used to make repairs.

lore.name: Cambrio SRT Battery
lore.description: Item Type: Battery This replacement battery powers Greycat's Cambrio salvage and repair tool, allowing your work to continue unabated.

lore.name: Camion Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Come prepared with the Camion. This button up blue jacket delivers on style with complimentary dark brown synthetic leather around the neck, shoulders, and arms. A cross-shoulder sling bag and integrated utility belt allows you to carry plenty of gear and keep it organized.

lore.name: Campo Shoes
lore.description: Slip into comfort with the Campo shoes, which have a supportive midsole, cushioned footbed, and a molded, slip-resistant outsole. These ankle high slip-ons deliver an ideal fit thanks to two adjustable straps with metal clasps.

lore.name: Canelo Pants Marigold
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 400 µSCU Whether you need them for work, play, or rest, the adaptable Canelo Pants from Habidash are guaranteed to fit the bill. Its convenient pockets allow you to carry all your essentials, and its stain-resistant fabric is comfortable enough to be worn for hours.

lore.name: Capston
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian Experience why WillsOp is a premiere manufacturer of ship electronics with their Capston radar. Outfit your ship with one today so you know what’s nearby.

lore.name: Capsulo
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian For a dependable radar with above average performance, the Capsulo is a trustworthy option.

lore.name: Captain's Mix Sandwich
lore.description: NDR: 38 Effects: None An assortment of cold cuts and cheese layered with mayo and spicy captain sauce on rice bread.

lore.name: Captor QD
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Dampener Manufacturer: RSI Size: 3 Designed by Roberts Space Industries in partnership with Mirai exclusively for the Guardian QI, the carefully crafted Captor Quantum Dampener generates a field that prevents quantum drive activation.

lore.name: Carafi Cube
lore.description: NDR: 10 Effects: Hypermetabolic A flavorless nutrient jelly with a firm, slippery texture.

lore.name: Carafi Noodles
lore.description: NDR: 35 Effects: Fatiguing, Hypometabolic Thick starch noodles tossed with oil and pieces of carafi, an flavorless jelly, for extra nutrition.

lore.name: Carafi Packet
lore.description: NDR: 10 Effects: Hypermetabolic A package containing small pieces of carafi, a flavorless nutrient jelly.

lore.name: Carbide Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The rugged, all-weather Carbide jacket from DMC features diamond-quilt detailing, stretch-comfort cuffs, and numerous attachment points for versatile storage options.

lore.name: Carbon
lore.description: Owing to carbon's ability to form a variety of allotropes with vastly different properties and its sheer abundance in the universe, this element is used in a wide variety of applications.

lore.name: Carbon-Silk
lore.description: This light, flexible and incredibly strong material is woven from carbon strands collected from the secretions of specially bioengineered worms.

lore.name: Cardona Jacket Sand
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU DMC’s Cardona is a utility jacket designed for performance in cold weather environments. Featuring a high collar for better wind protection and numerous pockets to store any survival essentials.

lore.name: Caret Pants Dark Grey
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU With the fortitude of workwear and the comfort of khakis, the Caret pants are sure to become your standard go-to for tough jobs. Built with strong fabric and quality stitching so you can focus on what needs to be done.

lore.name: Cargo Barge Inverter Code
lore.description: A single use card that contains the codes for accessing the Nine Tails' Identity Friend and Foe Inverter on the Cargo Barge.

lore.name: Cargo Hat
lore.description: The front panel of this grey cadet hat features Cargo written in yellow and purple. A bright band of yellow also rings the hat to make it highly visible from a distance.

lore.name: Carinite
lore.description: A rare mineral because the extreme pressure needed for its formation is very uncommon, it is in high demand thanks to its use in advanced computer processors and other cutting-edge electronics.

lore.name: Carinite (Pure)
lore.description: Typical carinite sources feature various impurities. However, under certain extremely rare conditions, carinite veins that are more than 90% pure can form. Computing hardware that demands exacting precision will usually seek out pure carinite.

lore.name: Carmilla Nightstand
lore.description: Bring a touch of class to your bedside with this exquisitely designed table. Standing atop two curled legs resembling a heart, this luscious ruby tabletop is perfect for reminding you that love is always within reach.

It's aggressively styled with skulls and other intimidating accessories associated with those living on the edge. Wearing such a distinct look may either keep people away... or draw them to you.

lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Rooster livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a rooster.

lore.name: Carrack Citizens for Prosperity Garnet Livery
lore.description: Join the Citizens for Prosperity in their mission to bring peace to the frontier with this dark grey and burgandy livery featuring the group's signature logo.

lore.name: Carrack Copernicus Livery
lore.description: To honor the brave explorers that brought us to space and support those currently seeking new frontiers, the Interstellar Cartography Center (ICC) commissioned this special livery for the Carrack. Named in honor of famed astronomer Nicolaus Copernicus, the livery mixes two shades of blue with black highlights. All proceeds from the sale of the Copernicus livery goes directly to the ICC to support their efforts in "Charting the Way Ahead."

lore.name: Carrack De Biasio Livery
lore.description: To honor the brave explorers that brought us to space and support those currently seeking new frontiers, the Interstellar Cartography Center (ICC) commissioned this special livery for the Carrack. Named in honor of former ICC Director Loretta De Biasio, this livery mixes orange and grey with black highlights. All proceeds from the sale of the De Biasio livery goes directly to the ICC to support their efforts in "Charting the Way Ahead."

lore.name: Carrack Expedition Livery
lore.description: The base livery for Anvil's Carrack Expedition model is a civilian-modified version of the original military paint scheme.

lore.name: Carrack Frontier Fighters Camo Livery
lore.description: Be ready to battle in the untamed wilds with this green camo livery featuring the logo of the Frontier Fighters vigilante group.

lore.name: Carrack Headhunters Trauma Livery
lore.description: Show your loyalty to the Headhunters gang with this livery featuring their logo emblazoned on a dark grey hull accented with a vibrant purple.

lore.name: Carrack Kepler Livery
lore.description: To honor the brave explorers that brought us to space and support those currently seeking new frontiers, the Interstellar Cartography Center (ICC) commissioned this special livery for the Carrack. Named in honor of famed astronomer Johannes Kepler, the livery mixes dark blue and orange with black highlights. All proceeds from the sale of the Kepler livery goes directly to the ICC to support their efforts in "Charting the Way Ahead."

lore.name: Carrack Miniature
lore.description: Takuetsu has finally set their expert eye on the Carrack. Using schematics supplied by Anvil Aerospace, this intricately detailed miniature captures the look and spirit of the beloved exploration ship that's spawned countless adventures across the empire.

lore.name: Carrack Miniature "2952 Best in Show"
lore.description: This highly detailed miniature celebrates the Carrack being named Best in Show at the 2952 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. Takuetsu worked with Anvil Aerospace to get the dimensions and details precisely right so the handheld version of this beloved exploration ship can join you on adventures across the empire.

lore.name: Carrack Model "2952 Best in Show"
lore.description: This highly detailed model celebrates the Carrack being named Best in Show at the 2952 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. Takuetsu worked with Anvil Aerospace to get the dimensions and details precisely right so this beloved exploration ship could find a home on shelves across the empire.

lore.name: Carrack Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Carrack with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Carrack Plushie
lore.description: Encourage an adventurous spirit with this soft and squeezable Carrack plushie modeled after Anvil's classic exploration ship.

lore.name: Carrack Polar Livery
lore.description: Modify your Carrack with this white and grey livery specifically designed for the 2951 IAE.

lore.name: Carrack Purple Haze Livery
lore.description: Celebrate Day of the Vara in style with the Purple Haze livery, featuring a glimmering metallic purple base paint splattered in green.

lore.name: Carrack Red Alert Livery
lore.description: Explore new frontiers in style with the Red Alert livery, which gives the Carrack an audacious metallic red and black look.

lore.name: Carrack Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom Carrack livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.

lore.name: Carrack T-Shirt
lore.description: Express your passion for the unknown with this Carrack t-shirt. Celebrate the popular and iconic exploration ship with this comfortable black t-shirt that creatively combines an overhead view of the Carrack with the Anvil logo on the front and the ship's name on the back.

lore.name: Carrack XenoThreat Purge Livery
lore.description: Let Humanity know you won't bow down to alien invaders with this XenoThreat livery featuring a muted teal with bright red accents.

lore.name: Carragio Jacket Charcoal
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU This charcoal jacket is sure to turn heads with its felted, forest green accented sleeves and tails, geometric graphic inlay, and metallic collar accents. The finishing touch to complete the look is a deep burgundy pocket square. Women's sizes currently not available.

lore.name: Carragio Jacket Grey
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU This light grey jacket is sure to turn heads with its diamond accented sleeves and tails, geometric graphic inlay, and metallic collar accents. The finishing touch to complete the look is a deep burgundy pocket square. Women's sizes currently not available.

lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -50 / 80 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Forged from scavenged metals and ragged clothes, the Carrion armor is a crude concoction of repurposed materials that demonstrates you'll do anything it takes to survive.

lore.name: Cascade
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: ArcCorp Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Civilian The latest medium-sized quantum drive from ArcCorp, the Cascade will confidently carry you to your destination time and time again.

lore.name: Cassandra
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Blue Triangle Inc. Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Stealth When staying undetected is the key to operational security, the Cassandra radar features reduced emissions while still providing above average performance.

lore.name: Cassidy Shirt
lore.description: Habidash's Cassidy short-sleeved henley t-shirt features a lightweight, breathable fabric blend paired with a neck covering and separated arm sleeves for a stylish look that remains practical in dustier climates.

lore.name: Castilla Wine Glass
lore.description: Enhance your evening with this elegant stemware that is sure to make every moment feel like a special occasion.

lore.name: Castillo Jacket Formal
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Refined enough for day, but ready for night, this jacket is essential for any young professional's collection. Notched lapels and a center back seam provide a tailored look at the Spar Van Miles price. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Castra
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 0 Grade: C Class: Industrial When performance meets price for vehicle shield generators, the Castra is the clear winner. It has been a Whitley’s Guide “Best Buy” for five consecutive years.

lore.name: Cataby Backpack Lifeforce Edition
lore.description: Item Type: Light Backpack Carrying Capacity: 75K µSCU Core Compatibility: All The Cataby is a stylish backpack built by Hardin Tactical to withstand rigorous adventures. The unique rectangle shape features a hard frame fitted around a durable and expandable softshell with two zippered pockets allowing for easy access to essentials. The Lifeforce edition was designed with first responders in mind with a highly visible white, red, and grey color scheme.

lore.name: Cataby Backpack MPUV-1C Edition
lore.description: Item Type: Light Backpack Carrying Capacity: 75K µSCU Core Compatibility: All The Cataby is a stylish backpack built by Hardin Tactical to withstand rigorous adventures. The unique rectangle shape features a hard frame fitted around a durable and expandable softshell with two zippered pockets allowing for easy access to essentials. The MPUV-1C Edition also comes with a commemorative patch to celebrate the Argo Cargo's 2951 Best in Show victory.

lore.name: Caterpillar 2949 Best In Show Livery
lore.description: Customize your Caterpillar with this special 2949 Best in Show livery.

lore.name: Caterpillar ArcCorp Livery
lore.description: The ArcCorp livery for the Caterpillar features the company's logo atop a maroon base paint with black and yellow highlights.

lore.name: Caterpillar Crusader Livery
lore.description: The Crusader livery for the Caterpillar features the company's logo atop a light blue base paint with black and white highlights.

lore.name: Caterpillar Deck the Hull Livery
lore.description: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.

lore.name: Caterpillar Foundation Guide Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Caterpillar Ghoulish Green Livery
lore.description: Embrace Day of the Vara mischievousness and mayhem any time of the year with this custom Caterpillar livery. It combines metallic green and black for a striking look that highlights the holiday's classic colors.

lore.name: Caterpillar Hurston Livery
lore.description: The Hurston livery for the Caterpillar features the company's logo atop a grey base paint with yellow highlights.

lore.name: Caterpillar IceBreak Livery
lore.description: Equip your Caterpillar with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

lore.name: Caterpillar microTech Livery
lore.description: The microTech livery for the Caterpillar features the company's logo atop a white base paint with light blue and grey highlights.

lore.name: Caterpillar Mistwalker Livery
lore.description: Become one with the clouds with the Caterpillar Mistwalker livery and its grey camo pattern.

lore.name: Caterpillar Model "2949 Best in Show"
lore.description: This Caterpillar model celebrates the venerated hauler being voted Best in Show at the 2949 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. Now your hangar can display this highly detailed scale replica of the popular mercantile vessel adorned with the 2949 IAE logo and accompanying pink accent line across the top of the ship.

lore.name: Caterpillar Pirate Livery
lore.description: This fearsome Pirate livery for the Caterpillar features an intimidating finish with skull decals and an accounting of nefarious deeds.

lore.name: Caterpillar Polar Livery
lore.description: Modify your Caterpillar with this white and grey livery specifically designed for the 2950 IAE event on microTech.

lore.name: Caterpillar Schematics "2949 Best in Show"
lore.description: Explore every millimeter of Drake Interplanetary's massive Caterpillar with this schematic celebrating its victory as Best in Show at the 2949 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo.

lore.name: Caterpillar Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: This custom Caterpillar livery was created to celebrate the 2950 IAE on microTech. It blends black and electric blue with white accents to give the ship a cool new look.

lore.name: Caudillo Helmet (Modified)
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s This version of CC's Conversions' Caudillo helmet has been modified from its original form. Adept at surviving firefights in both atmosphere and in space, the Caudillo helmet provides solid head protection while offering the wearer the stylish look of classical armor thanks to its visually striking metal crest.

lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -40 / 70 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Constructed using a lightweight alloy that can withstand a fair share of damage, the CBH-3 is a field-tested combat helmet featuring a large single-piece molded faceplate to allow for an expansive field of view for increased situational awareness. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: CDF F8C Certification Pass (Gold)
lore.description: The Civilian Defense Force is working in conjunction with Anvil Aerospace to test the next generation of volunteers. This certification ticket can be redeemed at any rental kiosk to unlock an F8C rental for twenty-four (24) Standard Earth Hours and make the ship available for purchase via the web pledge store. Congratulations.

lore.name: CDF F8C Certification Pass (Platinum)
lore.description: The Civilian Defense Force is working in conjunction with Anvil Aerospace to test the next generation of volunteers. This platinum certification entitles you to a free F8C from Anvil Aerospace, if you can make it to an eligible ship sale kiosk to turn it in. Check your mobi for details. Good luck and let the hunt begin.

lore.name: CDS QuickCade
lore.description: Manufacturer: CDS Initially designed for high-risk raids for the Advocacy, CDS has finally released their QDB tech to the public. This Quick Deployment Barricade or QuikCade is mobile system capable of projecting a localized protection field capable of temporarily shielding two operators from incoming fire.

lore.name: Celestial
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian The Celestial from Sakura Sun improves upon the company’s base large power plant by redesigning the power rate and other key aspects to raise the component’s overall performance.

lore.name: Celestial Sextant
lore.description: High tech innovators microTech pay homage to the past with this sextant, an ancient Earth instrument used for celestial navigation. It was designed with modern materials that help stabilize the device and stop warping due to extreme weather conditions.

lore.name: Centennial Bloom Plant
lore.description: One of the most iconic images of the Xi’An Empire in the UEE is the unblossomed Centennial Bloom. The growth of this plant is so precarious, even the slightest deviation in atmosphere or nourishment can offset its blooming period. Under sustained optimal conditions, the bloom takes a hundred years to live up to its name, blossoming small bellflowers of striking white and crimson.

lore.name: Centurion
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Military The Centurion stands ready to power your ship. This large power plant from Aegis Dynamics has been in service for centuries and has consistently proven to supply solid performance and durability.

lore.name: Centurion Beachhead Camo Livery
lore.description: Become one with the landscape with the Beachhead Camo livery that gives the Centurion a light tan camo pattern.

lore.name: Centurion Ice Storm Camo Livery
lore.description: The Ice Storm Camo livery will break up the silhouette of your Centurion with its white and grey camo pattern.

lore.name: Centurion Sandstorm Camo Livery
lore.description: Outfit the Centurion in dark tan and green camo with the Sandstorm Camo livery. The looks allows this battlefield beast to blend into a wide variety of terrains.

lore.name: Cerrado Boots Wood
lore.description: These trail-rated Cerrado Boots from R6 Pro are comfortable, waterproof, and built to last. The tall cuff and lacing at the top provide a seamless combination of exceptional ankle support and the stability.

lore.name: CF-117 Bulldog "Hazard-Zone" Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 1 Featuring a three-barrel sequential fire design, the Klaus & Werner CF-117 Bulldog laser repeater is capable of delivering high velocity energy rounds while maintaining heat efficiency making it a favorite among new pilots who are outfitting their first ship. The Hazard-Zone edition, adorned with striking mustard yellow highlights on a black base, will have you armed and ready to fight in style.

lore.name: CF-117 Bulldog Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 1 Featuring a three-barrel sequential fire design, the Klaus & Werner CF-117 Bulldog laser repeater is capable of delivering high velocity energy rounds while maintaining heat efficiency making it a favorite among new pilots who are outfitting their first ship.

lore.name: CF-227 Badger "Hazard-Zone" Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 2 The CF-227 Badger is Klaus & Werner’s dependable size two repeating laser. Its increased output and high rate of fire make it a solid contender in any fight. The Hazard-Zone edition, adorned with striking mustard yellow highlights on a black base, will have you armed and ready to fight in style.

lore.name: CF-227 Badger Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 2 The CF-227 Badger is Klaus & Werner’s dependable size two repeating laser. Its increased output and high rate of fire make it a solid contender in any fight.

lore.name: CF-337 Panther "Hazard-Zone" Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 3 The CF-337 Panther is the size three model in Klaus & Werner's laser repeater line. The Panther is a true fire-and-forget weapon with a respectable power consumption-to-damage ratio. Pilots who outfit their ships with Panthers rarely regret the decision. The Hazard-Zone edition, adorned with striking mustard yellow highlights on a black base, will have you armed and ready to fight in style.

lore.name: CF-337 Panther Repeater

lore.name: CF-447 Rhino Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 4 When a ship comes charging at you with a CF-447 Rhino strapped on, it is an experience few pilots will ever forget. This formidable size four laser repeater from Klaus & Werner is well suited for medium-range engagements, but packs a wallop up close.

lore.name: CF-557 Galdereen Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 5 With a bite as fearsome as its fanged namesake, the Klaus & Werner CF-557 Galdereen laser repeater is a solid choice for a wide range of vehicles thanks to its high rate of fire and consistent efficacy.

lore.name: CF-667 Mammoth Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 6 This beast of a laser repeater from Klaus & Werner features three massive barrels that warn any who spot a ship bearing the CF-667 that they may want to think again before engaging.

lore.name: CF-999 "Akuma" Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Unknown Item Type: Plasma Repeater Size: 1 Featuring a three-barrel sequential fire design, this custom weapon built from a modified Klaus & Werner CF-117 Bulldog laser repeater was specially made to work with the ATLS GEO IKTI Akuma.

lore.name: CFP Hat
lore.description: A comfortable blue and black cadet hat with the CFP's logo on the front.

lore.name: Chada Collar and Panniers Sandalwood
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 400 µSCU Need extra inventory? We've got you covered. Designed for hands-free carrying, the Chada Panniers by Habidash come with an adjustable strap that lets you securely attach them around your hips. Each set of panniers comes with a fashionable steel and leather gorget.

lore.name: Chairman's Club Coin
lore.description: This collectible coin features the distinguished logo of the Chairman's Club elegantly embossed on it's surface.

lore.name: Chairman's Club Coin Display Case
lore.description: Emblazoned with the Chairman's Club signature lion, this sleek black case with gold trim allows you to tastefully display ten commemorative coins.

lore.name: Chamar Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Decades of design experience helped DMC make the Chamar pants ready for any adventure. The pants utilize a unique seam design to deliver durability while maintaining flexibility. A built-in belt ensures an ideal fit, while leather front pockets and a padded back-panel provide rugged reinforcement where needed most.

lore.name: Chamfer
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 0 Grade: B Class: Civilian You can now experience the power and performance of WillsOp in a mobile form factor. The Chamfer computing system provides all you data processing needs as you travel.

lore.name: Chance Cube
lore.description: This six-sided die houses a rotating sphere covered in blue and red lights. When rolled, one of the two colors will display on the upper face of the die, helping the user to make binary decisions.

lore.name: Charger
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Military The Aegis Charger has powered military fighters for generations. Tried and tested in the most demanding of situations, the Charger can handle sudden or sustained power draws with ease.

lore.name: Cheddar Ham Burrito
lore.description: NDR: 38 Effects: Dehydrating Torpedo Burrito crams a full payload of flavor into their Cheddar Ham burrito, featuring chunks of smoked ham and creamy sharp cheddar cheese wrapped in their signature size-4 multi-grain tortilla.

lore.name: Cheese and Tomato Pizza (Slice)
lore.description: NDR: 22 Effects: Dehydrating, Hyper-Metabolic A crisp crust topped with a fresh tomato sauce and melted cheese.

lore.name: Chernykh
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian The Chernykh is named after the famed 26th century engineer who designed some of the most prized radars of that era. This medium radar from WillsOp celebrates both the look and performance of those classic components.

lore.name: Chicken Pesto Omni Pack
lore.description: NDR: 56 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic Omni Packs use premium certified organic ingredients to create a complete balanced ready-to-eat meal with a premium taste.

lore.name: Chicken Wham
lore.description: NDR: 38 Effects: Dehydrating, Hyper-Metabolic This crisp and juicy, all dark meat chicken patty shows that Whammer's is bigger than beef. All Whams come with crisp greens, tomatoes, piccamix, and Crave Sauce.

lore.name: Chile Birria Burrito
lore.description: NDR: 34 Effects: Dehydrating This satisfying burrito features a tortilla wrapper filled with rich and spicy stewed mutton.

lore.name: Chili Dog
lore.description: NDR: 34 Effects: Dehydrating, Hyper-Metabolic A hot dog topped with well-spiced ground chili.

lore.name: Chili Mac Combat Ration
lore.description: NDR: 64 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic, Cognitive Boosting A single serving combat ration specially formulated to provide complete high-performance nutrition for UEE Army personnel.

lore.name: Chill-Max
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Industrial The Chill-Max name is as straightforward as the design on this Juno Starwerk cooler. This highly-rated industrial cooler has been a favorite of haulers for centuries.

lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -35 / 65 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Be the first on the scene with the Chiron armor. lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Saga Datasystems Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Industrial The new Saga Datasystems Chrome computational system works intelligently to improve data handling while simultaneously allowing for dynamic core processing.

lore.name: Chrome Dome Head Gear
lore.description: The Chrome Dome was designed to make hostile environments manageable. This unique head gear features a lightweight and reflective hat with a sloped brim, goggles that automatically adjust to lighting conditions, large ear flaps, and a neck gaiter to cover the face. Whether trudging through snow or sand, the Chrome Dome is ready to brave the elements with you.

lore.name: Chrome Dome Head Gear Minefield
lore.description: The Chrome Dome was designed to make hostile environments manageable. This unique head gear features a lightweight and reflective hat with a sloped brim, goggles that automatically adjust to lighting conditions, large ear flaps, and a neck gaiter to cover the face. Whether trudging through snow or sand, the Chrome Dome is ready to brave the elements with you. The Minefield edition features metal rivet detailing.

lore.name: Chrome Dome Head Gear Striker
lore.description: The Chrome Dome was designed to make hostile environments manageable. This unique head gear features a lightweight helmet with a sloped brim, goggles that automatically adjust to lighting conditions, large ear flaps, and a neck gaiter to cover the face. Whether trudging through snow or sand, the Chrome Dome is ready to brave the elements with you. The Striker edition is a rust color with silver and gold rivets.

lore.name: Cirrus
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Stealth The Cirrus is for pilots that prioritize stealth above all else. This medium power plant from Tyler Design & Tech intelligently manages its energy distribution flow and performance output to achieve that end.

lore.name: Cirrus Boots Gray
lore.description: Temp. Rating: -35 / 15 °C These rugged, high ankle boots will keep your feet warm when venturing into wintry conditions. The Cirrus also integrates steel alloy links into the sole for added traction on icy surfaces.

lore.name: Citadel
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Industrial Fortify your ship with Basilisk’s Citadel shield generator. Tailored toward industrial vessels, the component emits a robust and reliable shield.

lore.name: Citadel Arms (Modified)
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -80 / 110 °C Radiation Protection: 52800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 251.1 REM/s This version of Kastak Arms' Citadel arms has been modified from its original form. Kastak Arms' aggressive design reached its peak with the Citadel. Layers of reinforced armor plating provide maximum security while its striking angular silhouette cuts an imposing figure.

lore.name: CitizenCon '54 Coin
lore.description: Remember the 2954 CitizenCon with this collectable coin featuring the UEE logo on one side and the conference logo on the reverse.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2945 Special Edition Trophy
lore.description: A commemorative trophy celebrating CitizenCon 2945. It features a simple yet stylish design that's mainly silver with gold fluting around a central black column displaying the logo and year.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2945 Trophy
lore.description: A commemorative trophy celebrating CitizenCon 2945. It features a simple yet stylish design that's mainly silver around a central black column displaying the logo and year.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2946 Special Edition Trophy
lore.description: Memorialize the 2946 CitizenCon with a special edition of this distinct and angular trophy. Constructed with three panels, the gold front panel displays the event's logo and year and is framed by two black panels.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2946 Trophy
lore.description: Memorialize the 2946 CitizenCon with this distinct and angular trophy. Constructed with three panels, the front one displays the event's logo and year and is framed by two black and silver panels.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2947 Trophy
lore.description: Brag about attending CitizenCon 2947 with this commemorative trophy. Rounded edges and a slanted top create a distinct design that showcases the logo in teal on top and the event name and year on the right side.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2948 Special Edition Trophy
lore.description: Citizencon 2948's trophy melds the physical and digital with a curvy red and grey base projects a rotating hologram of the event's logo above it.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2948 Trophy
lore.description: The trophy for CitizenCon 2948 melds the physical and digital. A curvy red and grey base projects a hologram of the event's logo above it.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2949 Trophy
lore.description: A commemorative trophy celebrating CitizenCon 2949. It features a holographic projection of the logo and the event's name and year engraved into its metal base.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2951 Trophy
lore.description: Commemorate CitizenCon 2951 with this unique trophy. A gold and silver metallic casing holds a piece of green marble with the year and CitizenCon logo intricately etched into it.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2953 Trophy
lore.description: Commemorate CitizenCon 2953 with a trip to the dark side with this unique trophy fashioned from debris extracted from the dangerous Pyro system.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2954 Double Bed
lore.description: It's never too early to start dreaming about next year's CitizenCon with this supremely comfortable double bed with two-toned blue CitizenCon linens and duvet.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2954 Storage Chest
lore.description: Bring home too many keepsakes and memorabilia from the 2954 CitizenCon? Then this functional chest featuring the blue event logo is the perfect storage solution for your hab or hangar.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2954 Trophy
lore.description: The trophy for CitizenCon 2954 embraces the spirit of building a better empire with bold chevrons and construction-themed styling that reveals a holographic event logo.

lore.name: CitizenCon 2955 Trophy
lore.description: Constructed from a core sample of rock extracted from the asteroid Delamar in Nyx, this commemorative CitizenCon 2955 trophy features a carved center inspired by Levski's signature borehole.

lore.name: Citrus Beef Burrito
lore.description: NDR: 34 Effects: Dehydrating This satisfying burrito features a tortilla wrapper filled with tangy shredded beef.

lore.name: Citrus Blend Smoothie
lore.description: HEI: 35 NDR: 14 Effects: Immune Boosting A smoothie made with a fresh blend of citrus.

lore.name: Citrus Rush Smoothie
lore.description: HEI: 39 NDR: 15 Effects: Immune Boosting Garcia's Greens Citrus Rush Smoothie is an invigorating blend of citrus that’s a perfect combination of sweet and tart.

lore.name: CK13-GID Seed Blend
lore.description: These genetically-modified barley seeds were banned because of their aggressive growth and high-levels of cross-pollination that has frequently ravaged any neighboring plant life. However, the plant's high yield and ease of growth have continued to make it a sought-after commodity.

lore.name: Clash Arms
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -52 / 82 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Sometimes all you gotta do is put on the right piece of armor to make your message loud and clear. Clash armor first started popping up when the Dredge got strong-armed into mass-producing their armor and it's been scaring everyone stupid since. Now everybody's stealing it. Clash features a reinforced medium plating to get you a good balance of protection without giving up too much speed.

lore.name: Clash Core
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -52 / 82 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 7.5K µSCU Backpacks: Medium, Light Sometimes all you gotta do is put on the right piece of armor to make your message loud and clear. Clash features a reinforced medium plating to get you a good balance of protection without giving up too much speed.

lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp.
