Clash features a reinforced medium plating to get you a good balance of protection without giving up too much speed.

lore.name: Class 2b Mount Size 1
lore.description: Basic Class 2b turret mount

lore.name: Classic Comb Over
lore.description: The best hairstyle for impressing your grandpa.

lore.name: Classic Dog
lore.description: NDR: 34 Effects: Dehydrating, Hyper-Metabolic Nothing fancy here, just your classic hot dog in a classic bun. Simple but satisfying.

lore.name: Classic Taper
lore.description: This haircut isn't a golden ticket to UPARQ, but it helps.

lore.name: Clean and Clear Work Apron
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Don't let your clothes suffer when you're just doing your job. Designed to be waterproof, stain resistant and easy to clean, the Clean and Clear work apron is ideal protection for your clothes when your job requires getting down and dirty.

lore.name: Clempt Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Stegman's factory pants have been taken to the next level with the Clempt line. These rugged all-purpose pants come with double knees for extra comfort and protection and are made from tough composite weave fabric to last as long as the work needs.

lore.name: Clempt Pants "Voyager"
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Stegman uses a tough composite weave fabric and double knees to ensure these all-purpose pants are comfortable yet durable. The Voyager edition is black with a large red tool pocket and gold knee pads.

lore.name: Cleo Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU Elegantly simple, the intriguing design of Cleo becomes more apparent upon closer inspection thanks to a mock fall front lined with subtle diagonal pleats that provide extra texture and detail to the design.

lore.name: Cliffback T-Shirt
lore.description: Alejo Brothers' classic loop tee with a spatter pattern.

lore.name: Clipped
lore.description: Short, but not buzzed.

lore.name: Clipper Apis Livery
lore.description: Predominantly yellow with black highlights and stripes, the Apis livery gives the Clipper a distinct look worthy of its name.

lore.name: Clipper Basalt Livery
lore.description: Mainly black, the Basalt livery also brings red and cream highlights to the Clipper.

lore.name: Clipper Cerulean Livery
lore.description: Bring a beautiful blue with black and white accents to the Clipper with the Cerulean livery.

lore.name: Clipper Firewall Livery
lore.description: The Firewall livery brings a bold and brash red appearance to the Clipper.

lore.name: Clipper Holt Camo Livery
lore.description: The swirling green and khaki camo pattern of the Holt Camo livery makes it an ideal choice when you want to make the Clipper a bit more inconspicuous.

lore.name: Clipper Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Clipper with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Clipper Regatta Livery
lore.description: The dynamic stylings of the Regatta livery features a white base paint with black highlights and stripes plus bold red accents.

lore.name: Clipper Skull and Crossbones Livery
lore.description: This livery embraces classic pirate iconography by featuring several skull and crossbones symbols across the Clipper's dark hull with blood red highlights.

lore.name: ClipVest Work Harness
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Stegman's ClipVest is a multi-purpose work harness that keeps your tools handy when and where you need them. Built from industrial strength materials, this harness offers a back piece to help alleviate strain and provide counterbalance.

lore.name: Cloak
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Ascension Astro Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Stealth Discreet security is within your reach thanks to this small shield generator from Ascension Astro. With a lower signature then many other generators in its class, the Cloak provides protection without drawing unnecessary attention.

lore.name: Cloud City T-Shirt White
lore.description: Due to its unique location, Orison is known as the city above the clouds. This shirt features the phrase and a truly unique view from one of its platforms.

lore.name: CloudSprint Shoes
lore.description: Keep your feet moving and stay comfortable with the CloudSprint shoes from NorthStar. Whether working out or relaxing, you won't regret slipping on these shoes thanks to their cushioned and supportive soles.

lore.name: Coal
lore.description: A combustible sedimentary rock primarily composed of carbon. Thought to originate from ancient peat.

lore.name: Cockpit Recorder Prop
lore.description: With true-to-life crash damage and a special recorded emergency message, this realistic facsimile of an actual cockpit voice recorder looks like it was salvaged straight from a wreck and makes a fun addition to your den or hangar.

lore.name: Coconut Curry Kacho
lore.description: NDR: 30 Effects: None Big Benny's kacho is based on traditional family recipes straight from Corel, combining springy noodles and a rich, warm broth to create a taste enjoyed the 'verse over. The Coconut Curry flavor blends the sweetness of coconut milk with a secret recipe Big Benny's green curry blend.

lore.name: Coda "Ascension" Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Pistol Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 6 Rate Of Fire: 180 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) Often called the Kastak Arms "hand cannon," the Coda can end an engagement with a single.50 caliber round, although the substantial power can make the Coda's recoil hard to handle. Considering its limited magazine size and substantial kick, sustained fire is discouraged in favor of more accurate single shots. Designed in honor of IAE 2953, the Ascension edition has steel and copper accents inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.

lore.name: Coda "Big Boss" Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Pistol Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 6 Rate Of Fire: 180 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) Often called the Kastak Arms "hand cannon," the Coda can end an engagement with a single.50 caliber round, although the substantial power can make the Coda's recoil hard to handle. Considering its limited magazine size and substantial kick, sustained fire is discouraged in favor of more accurate single shots. A sleek black and shocking green color palette give the "Big Boss" edition its signature look.

lore.name: Coda "Nighthawk" Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Pistol Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 6 Rate Of Fire: 180 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) Often called the Kastak Arms "hand cannon," the Coda can end an engagement with a single.50 caliber round, although the substantial power can make the Coda's recoil hard to handle. Considering its limited magazine size and substantial kick, sustained fire is discouraged in favor of more accurate single shots. The always bold Isidro "Nighthawk" Renard imbued that energy into this purple and black tint design for the Legendary Bounty Hunter line.

lore.name: Coda "Ultraviolet" Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Pistol Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 6 Rate Of Fire: 180 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) Often called the Kastak Arms "hand cannon," the Coda can end an engagement with a single.50 caliber round, although the substantial power can make the Coda's recoil hard to handle. Considering its limited magazine size and substantial kick, sustained fire is discouraged in favor of more accurate single shots. The Ultraviolet edition features eye-catching violet and orchid coloring.

lore.name: Coda Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Pistol Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 6 Rate Of Fire: 180 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) Often called the Kastak Arms "hand cannon," the Coda can end an engagement with a single.50 caliber round, although the substantial power can make the Coda's recoil hard to handle. Considering its limited magazine size and substantial kick, sustained fire is discouraged in favor of more accurate single shots.

lore.name: Coda Pistol Magazine (6 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 6 This magazine for the Kastak Arms Coda holds six.50 caliber rounds.

lore.name: Codi the Coramor Bear
lore.description: Never fly alone with Codi the Coramor Bear. With adorable pink fur, tender faux-leather paws, and a soft belly full of love, Codi will make a faithful flight companion for your cockpit.

lore.name: Cody Gloves
lore.description: The Cody gloves are pros at keeping hands warm whether you're holding a multi-tool in a mine or an ice-cold drink at the bar. Made for frigid environments but stylish enough to be worn anywhere.

lore.name: Coffee (5 aUEC)
lore.description: HEI: 14 Effects: Cognitive Boosting, Dehydrating Brewed coffee, medium roast.

lore.name: Coin Display Case
lore.description: Proudly display your coins with this handsome case featuring a red velvet setting for up to ten coins and a pristine glass front so all can enjoy your collection.

lore.name: Col Head Cover Maroon
lore.description: Temp. Rating: -30 / 15 °C The Col is an insulated yet lightweight head cover that keeps heat from escaping. The large, chip-resistant faceplate features a cutting-edge GX coating to ensure the purest light quality for viewing the surrounding environs.

lore.name: ColdSnap
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian Well-balanced performance is the hallmark of the ColdSnap cooler from Lightning Power Ltd., thanks to its ability to easily process the extra heat your ship generates during your day-to-day travels.

lore.name: ColdSurge
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Lighting Power Ltd. Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Civilian Make no mistake, the ColdSurge may not win any awards, but this large cooler from Lighting Power Ltd provides a good entry-level option for most civilian ships without breaking the bank.

lore.name: Coloma Coat Navy and Sage
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Stuffed with water-resistant gilly down, the Coloma coat blocks wind, traps body heat, and allows the wearer to move freely, making it the perfect choice for changeable weather conditions. Additionally, its roomy pockets provide plenty of storage.

lore.name: Colossus
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Industrial Juno Starwerk makes quantum drives that can go the distance and the Colossus is no exception. Though, once you experience its dependable performance for yourself, you might just want to call it exceptional.

lore.name: Colossus Bomb
lore.description: Manufacturer: FireStorm Kinetics Item Type: Explosive Bomb Size: 10 Foes below won't stand a chance against a Colossus. FireStorm Kinetics designed this massive S10 bomb to devastate ground targets, whether they're vehicles or structures alike. Meant to be dropped from high altitude, the Colossus features patented Atmo-Xact fins that deploy to provide additional guidance en route to target.

lore.name: Combat Readiness Uniform Trousers
lore.description: Made to military specification, the Combat Readiness Uniform pants are made from tough nylon synthetics to make them durable and comfortable enough for any kind of field operations. They also feature several multi-stitched pouches to keep small items secure, but accessible.

lore.name: Combat Supplies
lore.description: A variety of items assembled to support combat forces, such as ammunition, structural repair tools and clothing.

lore.name: Combed Back
lore.description: Parted on the side and combed back.

lore.name: Comer Scraper Module
lore.description: Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Scraper Module Extraction Speed: 0.7 Radius: 1.5m Extraction Efficiency: 80% Made for RSI's Salvation, the Comer scraper module provides a focused work area with an expedited extraction rate to allow for a smooth salvaging experience.

lore.name: ComfortAir
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian Designed to be able to process atmosphere to above UEE standards, the ComfortAir life support system from Tyler Design & Tech provides you and your crew with a clean and comfortable environment.

lore.name: ComfortAir Lite
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 0 Grade: C Class: Civilian Designed to be able to process atmosphere to above UEE standards, the ComfortAir life support system from Tyler Design & Tech provides you and your crew with a clean and comfortable environment.

lore.name: ComfortAir Max
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Civilian Designed to be able to process atmosphere to above UEE standards, the ComfortAir life support system from Tyler Design & Tech provides you and your crew with a clean and comfortable environment.

lore.name: ComfortAir Plus
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian Designed to be able to process atmosphere to above UEE standards, the ComfortAir life support system from Tyler Design & Tech provides you and your crew with a clean and comfortable environment.

lore.name: Compboard
lore.description: A main processing unit used inside various computers and electronics.

lore.name: CompuWare
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Friskers Semiconductor Inc. Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian Built to meet the demands of next generation ships, Friskers’ CompuWare features proprietary technologies for smooth data processing.

lore.name: Concept Shirt
lore.description: This crisp, versatile button-front shirt from Fiore is made with cutting edge stain resistant and wrinkle-free technology, guaranteeing that you stay professional at all times.

lore.name: Concept Shirt (Modified)
lore.description: This version of Fiore's Concept shirt has been modified from its original form. This crisp, versatile button-front shirt from Fiore is made with cutting edge stain resistant and wrinkle-free technology, guaranteeing that you stay professional at all times.

lore.name: Condemnation Distortion Scattergun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Preacher Armaments Item Type: Distortion Scattergun Size: 6 The Condemnation is a massive size six scattergun from Preacher Armaments. Its high distortion damage incapacitates the electronics, though its wide spreads makes it less effective as the target gets farther away.

lore.name: Conqueror-7
lore.description: Item Type: Ballistic Cannon Turret Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Size: 7 Bring your conquest to the skies using Hurston Dynamics' Conqueror-7 ballistic cannon. Bespoke built for the Aegis Idris dorsal turret, these cannons are able to engage larger ships from a distance, finishing fights before they even begin.

lore.name: Consolidated Outland Hat
lore.description: Consolidated Outland thrives on the edge of innovation. Promote their initiative by wearing this dark grey hat with the company's branding gracing the front panel.

lore.name: Consolidated Outland Mustang Beta
lore.description: Manufacturer: Consolidated Outland Focus: Pathfinder The Mustang Beta, with its unprecedented range, is made for long duration flights. The factory standard Tarsus Leaper Jump Engine enables the Beta to travel to the galaxy’s farthest systems with ease, while the ship’s unique Com4T living quarters will make the journey feel like you never left home.

lore.name: Consolidated Outland Mustang Gamma
lore.description: Manufacturer: Consolidated Outland Focus: Racing Consolidated Outland’s design and engineering teams have managed to tweak and refine the Mustang into an admirable racer. The end result, the Mustang Gamma, has smooth acceleration, and power on demand thanks to an innovative package featuring three powerful Magma Jet engines for maximum thrust.

lore.name: Consolidated Outland T-Shirt
lore.description: Silas Koerner founded Consolidated Outland to push the boundaries of modern spacecraft design. Celebrate his ambition with this dark grey t-shirt featuring the company's logo.

lore.name: Constellation 2952 Auspicious Red Monkey Livery
lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Monkey livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a monkey's head.

lore.name: Constellation ArcCorp Livery
lore.description: The ArcCorp livery for the Constellation features the company's logo atop a maroon base paint with black and yellow highlights.

lore.name: Constellation Black Heron Livery
lore.description: Embrace the darkness of space in style with the Constellation Black Heron livery that blends grey with green and orange highlights.

lore.name: Constellation Crusader Livery
lore.description: The Crusader livery for the Constellation features the company's logo atop a light blue base paint with black and white highlights.

lore.name: Constellation Dark Green Livery
lore.description: Customize your Constellation with this stunning green livery.

lore.name: Constellation Hurston Livery
lore.description: The Hurston livery for the Constellation features the company's logo atop a grey base paint with yellow highlights.

lore.name: Constellation Invictus Blue and Gold Livery
lore.description: Show your support for the newest batch of Navy recruits by customizing your Constellation with this special Blue and Gold livery to commemorate the 2950 Invictus Launch Week.

lore.name: Constellation microTech Livery
lore.description: The microTech livery for the Constellation features the company's logo atop a white base paint with light blue and grey highlights.

lore.name: Constellation Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Constellation with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Constellation Orange Heron Livery
lore.description: Mixing orange with black and white highlights, the Orange Heron livery will help you blaze your own path through the universe.

lore.name: Constellation Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom Constellation livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.

lore.name: Constellation White And Grey Camo Livery
lore.description: Modify your Constellation with this white and grey camo livery specifically designed for the 2951 IAE.

lore.name: Constellation White Heron Livery
lore.description: The White Heron Livery combines white with dark blue and orange highlights to provide your Constellation a stylish spacefaring look.

lore.name: Construction Materials
lore.description: Various supplies used to build, repair, and maintain buildings and structures.

lore.name: Consumer Goods
lore.description: Commodities that are purchased by an individual to satisfy their wants or needs.

lore.name: Consumer Goods
lore.description: Commodities that are purchased by an individual to satisfy their wants or needs.

lore.name: CoolCore
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Industrial The name CoolCore says it all. Designed by Juno Starwerk to be as hardworking as you are, this cooler helps ensure that your entire ship operates well within desired temperature parameters.

lore.name: Copper
lore.description: A soft red-orange colored metal with high conductivity. Prone to oxidation unless properly treated.

lore.name: Copper (Ore)
lore.description: A soft red-orange colored metal with high conductivity. Prone to oxidation unless properly treated.

lore.name: Coramor '54 Coin
lore.description: Celebrate 2954's Coramor holiday with this golden coin featuring pink, hearts on one face and two spacefaring lovers on the other, promising that not even the vastness of space can keep love apart.

lore.name: Coramor '55 Loveseat
lore.description: Snuggle up this Coramor on this luxurious heart-shaped couch. Featuring a captivating crimson covering, the nano-woven fibers of this settee guarantee you'll stay comfortable all night long.

lore.name: Corbel Arms Crush
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Originally designed as a strength enhancement suit to give factory workers better lifting power, CDS found wider application in utilizing its defensive capabilities. It's triple-enforced armor plating provides extreme physical protection, with deliberate placing of materials to protect the most vulnerable parts of the body. A series of pneumatic levers offer increased flexibility in the joints, alleviating pressure and weight in key areas to create an accessible and highly protective armor despite its heavy weight. The Crush edition consists of a polished black metal with brushed bronze detailing.

lore.name: Cordimon Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 3K µSCU Stegman's classic worker's jacket has been a staple of job sites for over seventy years. This duotone pattern is cut from the toughest material meaning you can wear it anywhere, anytime. It may not be armor, but it damn sure feels like it.

lore.name: Cordimon Jacket "Voyager"
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 3K µSCU Stegman's classic worker's jacket has been a staple of job sites for over seventy years. The exclusive Voyager edition blends red and black with gold highlights to provide a stylish edge, making the Cordimon tough, durable, and perfect to wear anytime, anywhere.

lore.name: Corsair 2953 Best in Show Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the Drake Corsair being voted a Best in Show finalist for 2953 with this pearlescent purple and cyan livery.

lore.name: Corsair 2953 Ship Showdown Poster
lore.description: Congratulations to the Corsair for winning the 2953 Ship Showdown. This poster celebrates the victory of this iconic, asymmetrical Drake Interplanetary ship by capturing it mid-conflict with guns blazing.

lore.name: Corsair Commando Livery
lore.description: Primarily green with yellow accents, the Commando livery allows the Corsair to blend in with forests and verdant locations.

lore.name: Corsair Downburst Camo Livery
lore.description: The Downburst Camo livery features a black camo pattern with accents of gold that beautifully catch the sunlight.

lore.name: Corsair Dying Star Livery (Modified)
lore.description: This version of the livery has been modified from its original form with the addition of graffiti. Sold in 2943 to celebrate the 450th anniversary of Pyro's discovery, the Dying Star livery is tan with brown and black highlights. It also features branding from Pyrotechnic Amalgamated, the now defunct mining company that found and named the system.

lore.name: Corsair Eternity Livery
lore.description: Become one with the darkness of space with the Eternity livery for the Corsair, which is black with subtle red accents.

lore.name: Corsair Flashpoint Livery
lore.description: Bright red and crisp white combine in the Flashpoint livery to deliver a dynamic look to the Corsair.

lore.name: Corsair Ghoulish Green Livery
lore.description: Embrace Day of the Vara mischievousness and mayhem any time of the year with this custom Corsair livery. It combines metallic green and black for a striking look that highlights the holiday's classic colors.

lore.name: Corsair Hinterland Livery
lore.description: Style yourself to explore the far reaches of the 'verse with the Hinterland livery for the Corsair, which is sand-colored with black and grey highlights.

lore.name: Corsair Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Corsair with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Corsair Plushie
lore.description: This soft plushie is modeled after the Drake Interplanetary Corsair, a versatile explorer able to go wherever the winds of adventure steer you.

lore.name: Corsair Skullcrusher Livery
lore.description: Exude attitude with the Skullcrusher livery for the Corsair, which features a massive skull across the top.

lore.name: Corsti Boots
lore.description: Made with hardy and adaptable materials, the Corsti boots are suitable for any conditions, whether you're taking a day-long hike on a well-worn road or exploring a strange landscape on an untamed world.

lore.name: Corsti Boots CFP
lore.description: Made with hardy and adaptable materials, the Corsti boots are suitable for any conditions, whether you're taking a day-long hike on a well-worn road or exploring a strange landscape on an untamed world. The CFP edition is a deep fjord blue with black vamp detailing.

lore.name: CorticoPen (Sterogen)
lore.description: Manufacturer: CureLife Item Type: Medical Consumable From the Empire’s most trusted medical company, the CureLife CorticoPen can rapidly dispense doses of the corticosteroid Sterogen during emergency situations to help relieve symptoms associated with muscle weakness and respiratory damage. Use only as recommended.

lore.name: CorticoPen Xtra
lore.description: Manufacturer: CureLife Item Type: Medical Consumable From the Empire’s most trusted medical company, the CureLife CorticoPen Xtra dispenses the corticosteroid Sterogen with an extra boost of anticholinergic antiemetic to help relieve muscle weakness and blurred vision.

lore.name: Corundum
lore.description: The crystalline form of aluminum oxide. Used as a gem. Varieties include ruby, sapphire, and padparadscha.

lore.name: Cot
lore.description: Catch a few Z's between flights with this stylish Star Citizen cot!

lore.name: Couloir Shoes WhiteHex
lore.description: Hawksworth's timeless Couloir low ankle, slip-on shoes are perfect for both casual and formal occasions. A forward facing seam and tapered toe give the shoe a subtle but uniquely elegant shape. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Council Scrip
lore.description: Consider this scrip your reward for a job well done. While not credits, it can be traded in to certain people for certain things.

lore.name: Courser Jeans Smoke
lore.description: Made with soft yet sturdy cotton, these jeans are ripped and then "repaired" with colorful thread alongside misshapen patches that give them a touch of history.

lore.name: Covalex Cargo Plushie
lore.description: Here's a haul you can hug. This plushie shaped like a cargo container features Covalex Shipping branding with the company's logo and brown and grey color scheme.

lore.name: Covalex Container Model
lore.description: There's no need for a tractor beam to move this cargo container. This finely detailed model features Covalex Shipping branding with the company's logo and brown and grey color scheme.

lore.name: Covalex Hat
lore.description: A black cadet hat with Covalex's name and logo emblazoned across the front and back panels.

lore.name: CoverAll
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Gorgon Defender Industries Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Military Don’t sacrifice performance for durability. Get both with Gorgon Defender Industries’ CoverAll shield generator.

lore.name: CQ7 "Blacklist" Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Rifle Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 40 Rate Of Fire: 600 rpm Effective Range: 50 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S2) Designed for close quarter engagements such as boarding actions, Behring's CQ7 is a next generation bullpup battle rifle designed to dominate the rigors of the modern battlefield environment. The Blacklist edition features a dark black finish.

lore.name: CQ7 "Goldsmith" Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Rifle Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 40 Rate Of Fire: 600 rpm Effective Range: 50 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S2) Designed for close quarter engagements such as boarding actions, Behring's CQ7 is a next generation bullpup battle rifle designed to dominate the rigors of the modern battlefield environment. The Goldsmith edition was made in conjunction with Hardin Tactical and feature gold filigree on luxurious black for an extravagant look.

lore.name: CQ7 "Infantry" Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Rifle Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 40 Rate Of Fire: 600 rpm Effective Range: 50 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S2) Designed for close quarter engagements such as boarding actions, Behring's CQ7 is a next generation bullpup battle rifle designed to dominate the rigors of the modern battlefield environment. The Infantry edition features a neutral green and brown finish with black accents.

lore.name: CQ7 "Skullcap" Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Rifle Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 40 Rate Of Fire: 600 rpm Effective Range: 50 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S2) Designed for close quarter engagements such as boarding actions, Behring's CQ7 is a next generation bullpup battle rifle designed to dominate the rigors of the modern battlefield environment. The Skullcap edition features an ominous skulls along the length of the rifle atop a black base coat.

lore.name: CQ7 "Snowfire" Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Rifle Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 40 Rate Of Fire: 600 rpm Effective Range: 50 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S2) Designed for close quarter engagements such as boarding actions, Behring's CQ7 is a next generation bullpup battle rifle designed to dominate the rigors of the modern battlefield environment. The Snowfire edition features a white and light gray finish with black accents.

lore.name: CQ7 Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Rifle Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 40 Rate Of Fire: 600 rpm Effective Range: 50 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S2) Designed for close quarter engagements such as boarding actions, Behring's CQ7 is a next generation bullpup battle rifle designed to dominate the rigors of the modern battlefield environment.

lore.name: CQ7 Rifle Magazine (40 Cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 40 This magazine for the CQ7 rifle comes pre-loaded with forty rounds.

lore.name: Crab
lore.description: A crab for your fishtank

lore.name: Creese Copperhead Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Vaporwear Creese jacket features an old-Earth collar and tags around the shoulders. Armored shoulder accents and ventilated sleeves provide protection without restricting movement, allowing the jacket to be worn casually or piloting an open canopy vehicle. The special Copperhead edition features a snake enwrapping the front, back, and left arm of the jacket.

lore.name: Creese Jacket Nine Tails
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Vaporwear Creese jacket features an old-Earth collar and tags around the shoulders. Armored shoulder accents and ventilated sleeves provide protection without restricting movement, allowing the jacket to be worn casually or piloting an open canopy vehicle. The special Nine Tails edition features the symbology of the gang.

lore.name: Creese Skullsnap Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Vaporwear Creese jacket features an old-Earth collar and tags around the shoulders. Armored shoulder accents and ventilated sleeves provide protection without restricting movement, allowing the jacket to be worn casually or piloting an open canopy vehicle. The special Skullsnap edition is a slick silver with geometric stylings and a screaming skull on the back.

lore.name: Creese Toxic Fog Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Vaporwear Creese jacket features an old-Earth collar and tags around the shoulders. Armored shoulder accents and ventilated sleeves provide protection without restricting movement, allowing the jacket to be worn casually or piloting an open canopy vehicle. The special Toxic Fog edition is black with poison gas green accents and a skull on the front and back.

lore.name: Creese Yormandi Jacket
lore.description: Make a splash with this Yormandi-themed jacket. Featuring the ferocious creature erupting from water, this predator snakes around the side of the dark teal jacket to showcase Vaporwear's logo on the back.

lore.name: Crestfall Shoes
lore.description: Upsiders' Crestfall high-tops are slip-ons that blend suede and synthetic fabrics imbued with subtle patterns. They feature a deep U-cut collar, padded heel, and enlarged tongue. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Crew Cut
lore.description: Buzzed sides with a scissor cut top.

lore.name: CRLF DYNAPAK
lore.description: Manufacturer: CureLife The DYNAPAK from CureLife is a complete multi-function individual first-aid system designed and constructed for the rigors of field use. With CureLife’s proprietary serum, a single DYNAPAK will promote healing in non-serious wounds to get you back on your feet.

lore.name: Crossed Swords '56 Coin
lore.description: A worthy treasure for those who know where to look, this coin bears a menacing skull and a pair of cutlasses on one side making it the envy of many a pirate across the 'verse.

lore.name: Crossfield
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Wei-Tek Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Military Wei-Tek has marketed the Crossfield specifically to target military personnel and veteran pilots who will appreciate the stats that the mil-spec quantum drive offers.

lore.name: Crude Oil
lore.description: A compound composed of hydrocarbons and other organic molecules. Also referred to as unprocessed petroleum.

lore.name: Cruiser Dog
lore.description: NDR: 34 Effects: Dehydrating, Hyper-Metabolic A griddled hot dog topped with diced tomatoes, diced onions, sliced chilies, and a drizzle of mayonnaise.

lore.name: Crusader Accent Chair
lore.description: Styled after the seats aboard the Crusader Starlifter, this grey and white accent chair is fantastic way to show your love of space travel even when staying at home.

lore.name: Crusader Hat
lore.description: A blue, white, and gray cadet hat with Crusader Industries' name and logo emblazoned across the front panel.

lore.name: Crusader Industries Hat
lore.description: To celebrate Pax Humana 2949, Crusader Industries released this hat in the colors associated with the holiday, blue and white. Wear this hat to join the company in supporting those that focus on the greater good. All proceeds from its purchase will go to the Terra-based nonprofit Empire's Overlooked.

lore.name: Crusader Industries T-Shirt
lore.description: Crusader Industries created this striking blue shirt sporting their "sword & C" logo to further their corporate mandate to support charitable organizations. The company has promised that all proceeds from the sale of this shirt will go to the Terra-based nonprofit Empire's Overlooked.

lore.name: Crusader Industries T-Shirt White
lore.description: This shirt features the iconic Crusader Industries logo across the chest.

lore.name: Crusader White Bishop
lore.description: Included with the Mercury Star Runner from Crusader Industries, this minimalist white chess piece has a marble base.

lore.name: Crusader White Bishop
lore.description: Included with the Mercury Star Runner from Crusader Industries, this minimalist black chess piece has a marble base.

lore.name: CRUZ Dark
lore.description: HEI: 38 NDR: 30 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic Restore, refuel, and recharge with CRUZ Optimal Nutrition Drink. CRUZ Dark is a denser nutrition formula with a rich, dark flavor.

lore.name: CRUZ Flow
lore.description: HEI: 38 NDR: 30 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic Restore, refuel, and recharge with CRUZ Optimal Nutrition Drink. CRUZ Flow is the original formula that has been sustaining pilots for countless numbers of journeys.

lore.name: CRUZ Lux
lore.description: HEI: 38 NDR: 30 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic Restore, refuel, and recharge with CRUZ Optimal Nutrition Drink. CRUZ Lux lightens things up with a sweet and spicy taste sure to get you going.

lore.name: CRUZ Pulse
lore.description: HEI: 38 NDR: 30 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic Restore, refuel, and recharge with CRUZ Optimal Nutrition Drink. CRUZ Pulse features the cutting edge compounds that increase your digestive well-being.

lore.name: Cryo-Star
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: J-Span Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Civilian J-Span’s consumer-grade Cryo-Star cooler has become a common sight across the Empire thanks to its reliable heat absorption that won’t strain your ship’s power-plant.

lore.name: Cryo-Star EX
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: J-Span Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Civilian With its EX line, J-Span has brought the same reliable heat absorption of their popular Cryo-Star cooler to pilots looking to outfit larger ships.

lore.name: Cryo-Star SL
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: J-Span Size: 0 Grade: B Class: Civilian J-Span’s done it again. The Cryo-Star SL incorporates the same consumer award winning performance and durability you’ve come to expect from a Cryo-Star, but now available for smaller vehicles.

lore.name: Cryo-Star XL
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: J-Span Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian With its well-crafted design and dependable performance, the Cryo-Star XL cooler proves from the moment you use it that no one understands heat management better than J-Span.

lore.name: CryoPod (Vanduul)
lore.description: A Vanduul corpse preserved within a CryoPod.

lore.name: Crypt
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Blue Triangle Inc. Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Stealth The new Crypt from Blue Triangle Inc. is meticulously crafted to offer superior heat dissipation using advanced venting technology and premium materials, so that this computer system runs as cool as it looks.

lore.name: Crypt Keycard
lore.description: The best rewards are worth fighting for!

lore.name: CS-L Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Keep it CS-L with these soft, fleece-lined athletic pants from Escar Limited. These loose, relaxed pants provide supreme comfort whether on the move or unwinding.

lore.name: CSM-RP
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Behring Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Military The CSM-RP computer system brings Behring’s esteemed line of military-grade processors to private-sector ships.

lore.name: CSM-TL
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Behring Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Military Behring packed plenty of raw power into the CSM-TL computer system. Armed with advanced data-cores running hex-threaded processors, it’s sure to provide all the computational brute force you need.

lore.name: CSP-68H Backpack
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Backpack Carrying Capacity: 150K µSCU Core Compatibility: Heavy Be ready for any situation with the CSP-68H Backpack. Originally designed for the rigors of combat support, this heavy backpack has become popular thanks to its durability and a patented core connector that helps the CSP-68H sit comfortably and balanced on the back.

lore.name: CSP-68L Backpack
lore.description: Item Type: Light Backpack Carrying Capacity: 54K µSCU Core Compatibility: All An ideal synthesis of strength and technology, the Geist Stealth Armor has been crafted from military-grade carbon silk sourced from the same manufacturers that protect the UEE's special forces. Hair-thin filaments woven into the fabric mask the wearer's emissions, making them undetectable via radar, and specialized tubing built into the soles of the boots dampens the sound of footsteps.

lore.name: CSP-68L Backpack
lore.description: Item Type: Light Backpack Carrying Capacity: 54K µSCU Core Compatibility: All Be ready for any situation with the CSP-68L Backpack. Originally designed for the rigors of combat support, this light backpack has become popular thanks to its durability and a patented core connector that helps the CSP-68L sit comfortably and balanced on the back.

lore.name: CSP-68L Backpack Cayman
lore.description: Item Type: Light Backpack Carrying Capacity: 54K µSCU Core Compatibility: All Be ready for any situation with the CSP-68L Backpack. Originally designed for the rigors of combat support, this light backpack has become popular thanks to its durability and patented core connector that helps the CSP-68L sit comfortably and balanced on the back. The Cayman edition features a vibrant metallic green finish with geometric patterns for a color that changes slightly based on lighting conditions.

lore.name: CSP-68L Backpack Epoque
lore.description: Item Type: Light Backpack Carrying Capacity: 54K µSCU Core Compatibility: All Be ready for any situation with the CSP-68L Backpack. Originally designed for the rigors of combat support, this light backpack has become popular thanks to its durability and a patented core connector that helps the CSP-68L sit comfortably and balanced on the back. The Epoque edition features a navy and black coloring, finished with baroque gold detailing.

lore.description: Item Type: Light Backpack Carrying Capacity: 54K µSCU Core Compatibility: All Be ready for any situation with the CSP-68L Backpack. The Forest Camo edition features a special digital green camo pattern with silver highlights.

lore.name: CSP-68L Backpack Night Camo
lore.description: Item Type: Light Backpack Carrying Capacity: 54K µSCU Core Compatibility: All Be ready for any situation with the CSP-68L Backpack. Originally designed for the rigors of combat support, this light backpack has become popular thanks to its durability and patented core connector that helps the CSP-68L sit comfortably and balanced on the back. The Night Camo edition features a special textured finish and mixes black camo and silver for a subtle yet striking look.

lore.name: CSP-68M Backpack
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Backpack Carrying Capacity: 105K µSCU Core Compatibility: Medium & Heavy Be ready for any situation with the CSP-68M Backpack. Originally designed for the rigors combat support, this medium backpack has become popular thanks to its durability and a patented core connector that helps the CSP-68M sit comfortably and balanced on the back.

lore.name: CSP-68M Backpack Epoque
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Backpack Carrying Capacity: 105K µSCU Core Compatibility: Medium & Heavy Be ready for any situation with the CSP-68M Backpack. Originally designed for the rigors combat support, this medium backpack has become popular thanks to its durability and a patented core connector that helps the CSP-68M sit comfortably and balanced on the back. The Epoque edition features a navy and black coloring, finished with baroque gold detailing.

lore.name: CSR-RP
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Behring Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Military The CSR-RP from Behring provides trusted and consistent computing power in a streamlined package.

lore.name: CSR-TL
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Behring Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Military Fly with next-generation computer performance. The CSR-TL has low latency and plug-and-play compatibility with additional blade slots, all driven by Behring’s advanced operating technologies.

lore.name: CST-313 "Castillo"
lore.description: Item Type: Bomb Rack Manufacturer: Behring Size: S3 Designed to fit a wide variety of ships, the CST-313 "Castillo" bomb rack is able to store a single S3 bomb and makes for a good alternative on ships that can support a S3 missile rack.

lore.name: CSV Granite Livery
lore.description: A heavy workload deserves a livery that means business. Outfit your Argo CSV with the dark grey Granite livery and show the 'verse you're ready to get the job done.

lore.name: CSV Jolt Livery
lore.description: When you're working on building your latest settlement, be sure you stand out on even the harshest landscapes with the bright yellow Jolt livery for the Argo CSV.

lore.name: CSV Primer Livery
lore.description: A clean worksite is a point of professional pride for many in the industry, and nothing says neat and tidy like the pristine white Primer livery for the Argo CSV.

lore.name: CSV-RP
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Behring Size: 0 Grade: C Class: Military Specced to meet the high demands of the military, Behring’s CSV-RP vehicle computer has been a staple in UEE tanks and other ground vehicles for centuries.

lore.name: CSV-TL
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Behring Size: 0 Grade: B Class: Military The CSV-TL computer system is powered by Behring to deliver more processing than previous- generation systems alongside innovative new processing algorithms for improved data handling.

lore.name: Cubby Blast T-Shirt
lore.description: Show your support for local and independently owned businesses with this Cubby Blast t-shirt. From its infectious holo-jingle promising "racks of rifles, stacks of shotguns, piles of pistols" to Clor Vee, the eccentric owner with a thick Cathcart accent, Cubby Blast remains one of Area18's most unique shops, and a refreshing change of pace from the corporate-owned chain stores that dominant the Empire.

lore.name: Cuesta Shoes
lore.description: An all-season ankle boot, the Cuesta features a practical design that can stand up to all kinds of weather and terrain, while the supportive insole provides comfort to last through your shift and beyond.

lore.name: Cumulus Jacket Gray
lore.description: Temp. Rating: -35 / 10 °C Carrying Capacity: 5K µSCU Be bold and brave the cold in frigid conditions up to -35 °C with the Cumulus's special thermal lining. An oversized, insulated hood provides additional protection around the head, while the distinct quilted torso stops snow, ice, and wind from seeping in, ensuring the wearer remains warm and dry.

lore.name: Cumulus Pants Gray
lore.description: Temp. Rating: -35 / 15 °C Carrying Capacity: 3K µSCU Be bold and brave the cold with Cumulus pants. Designed with a synthetic fabric that insulates the inside and wicks away moisture from the outside, these pants provide protection against temperature drops to -35 °C.

lore.name: Curser T-Shirt
lore.description: Be crass and comfortable with this swearing skull shirt from CBD made from 100% ring-spun cotton. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Custodian "Big Boss" SMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: SMG Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 60 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 30 m The Custodian SMG from Kastak Arms focuses on a high rate of fire over damage and accuracy making it an ideal choice for sweeping through tight environments and close quarters combat. This sleek black and shocking green color palette give the "Big Boss" edition its signature look.

lore.name: Custodian "Brimstone" SMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: SMG Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 60 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 30 m The Custodian SMG from Kastak Arms focuses on a high rate of fire over damage and accuracy making it an ideal choice for sweeping through tight environments and close quarters combat. The "Brimstone" special edition features a bold red top-trim and a dark gray finish on the lower half of the weapon.

lore.name: Custodian "CitizenCon 2947" SMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: SMG Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 60 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 30 m The Custodian SMG from Kastak Arms focuses on a high rate of fire over damage and accuracy making it an ideal choice for sweeping through tight environments and close quarters combat. This special commemorative powder blue finish highlights the numerous sponsors who made the 2947 CitizenCon such a great success.

lore.name: Custodian "Foundry's Fire" SMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: SMG Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 60 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 30 m The Custodian SMG from Kastak Arms focuses on a high rate of fire over damage and accuracy making it an ideal choice for sweeping through tight environments and close quarters combat. Crafted to honor attendees of CitizenCon 2947, this smoldering orange finish proudly features the Foundry Forty-Two logo.

lore.name: Custodian "Scorched" SMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: SMG Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 60 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 30 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) The Custodian SMG from Kastak Arms focuses on a high rate of fire over damage and accuracy making it an ideal choice for sweeping through tight environments and close quarters combat. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

lore.name: Custodian SMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: SMG Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 60 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 30 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) The Custodian SMG from Kastak Arms focuses on a high rate of fire over damage and accuracy making it an ideal choice for sweeping through tight environments and close quarters combat.

lore.name: Custodian SMG (Boneyard, Citizen's Pride, Desert Shadow, Executive Edition, Midnight, Nightstalker, Warhawk)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: SMG Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 60 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 30 m The Custodian SMG from Kastak Arms focuses on a high rate of fire over damage and accuracy making it an ideal choice for sweeping through tight environments and close quarters combat.

lore.name: Custodian SMG Magazine (60 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Battery Capacity: 60 Replacement battery for the Custodian, Kastak Arms' compact energy snub rifle.

lore.name: Cutlass 2949 Best In Show Livery
lore.description: Customize your Cutlass with this special 2949 Best in Show livery.

lore.name: Cutlass 2950 Best In Show Livery
lore.description: Customize your Cutlass with this special 2950 Best in Show livery that is white with grey and gold accents.

lore.name: Cutlass Akuma Livery
lore.description: Featuring the bold inconography of the Nine Tails gang and bold splashes of pink, the Akuma livery fully embraces the Cutlass' wilder side.

lore.name: Cutlass Black Plushie
lore.description: This soft plushie is modeled after Drake Interplanetary's widely popular multifunction ship the Cutlass Black. Even the most hardened spacefarer will appreciate its gentle squish.

lore.name: Cutlass Blue Plushie
lore.description: This soft plushie is modeled after Drake Interplanetary's Cutlass Blue, a patrol ship variant designed to protect citizens and suppress dangerous outlaws.

lore.name: Cutlass Coalfire Livery
lore.description: Keep your Cutlass looking sharp with the Coalfire livery that's primarily grey with red highlights.

lore.name: Cutlass Cypress Livery
lore.description: The Cypress is a light green camo livery made for the Cutlass.

lore.name: Cutlass Destiny Livery
lore.description: Attract adventure and fortune by boldly venturing forth with the Destiny livery for the Cutlass. The livery blends a striking red base color with gold highlights.

lore.name: Cutlass Dying Star Livery (Modified)
lore.description: This version of the livery has been modified from its original form with the addition of graffiti. Sold in 2943 to celebrate the 450th anniversary of Pyro's discovery, the Dying Star livery is tan with brown and black highlights. It also features branding from Pyrotechnic Amalgamated, the now defunct mining company that found and named the system.

lore.name: Cutlass Elysium Livery
lore.description: The brash and bold Elysium livery features ornate gold detailing atop a navy blue base paint.

lore.name: Cutlass Foundation Guide Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Cutlass Ghoulish Green Livery
lore.description: Embrace Day of the Vara mischievousness and mayhem any time of the year with this custom Cutlass livery. It combines metallic green and black for a striking look that highlights the holiday's classic colors.

lore.name: Cutlass Hawthorn Livery
lore.description: The Cutlass Hawthorn livery features a black and grey camo pattern that'll make the ship blend into the vast expanse of space.

lore.name: Cutlass Mistwalker Livery
lore.description: Cover your Cutlass with grey camo with the special Mistwalker livery.

lore.name: Cutlass Poster
lore.description: The flagship of the pirate community, the Drake Cutlass, and the iconic Vanduul raider, the Scythe, circle each other on a silent battlefield of tumbling rock.

lore.name: Cutlass Red Plushie
lore.description: This soft plushie is modeled after Drake Interplanetary's Cutlass Red, a variant designed for emergency response. Whereas the real ship contains a med bay to help heal physical wounds, this plushie might just help heal emotional ones.

lore.name: Cutlass Saurian Livery
lore.description: Enwrap your Cutlass in the Saurian livery, which blends several shades of dark green.

lore.name: Cutlass Schematics "2949 Best in Show"
lore.description: Dig into the details of Drake's distinct Cutlass design with this schematic, created in conjunction with the 2949 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo to celebrate the ship being a Best in Show finalist.

lore.name: Cutlass Skull and Crossbones Livery
lore.description: Deemed by Drake's public relations team as a tongue-in-cheek reference to the overblown controversy, the Skull and Crossbones livery leans into the perception that the Cutlass is marketed toward those on the wrong side of the law. The livery embraces classic pirate iconography by featuring several skull and crossbones symbols across it grey frame with red highlights.

lore.name: Cutlass Steel Plushie
lore.description: This soft plushie is modeled after Drake Interplanetary's Cutlass Steel, a troop transport variant intended to serve as both dropship and gunship.

lore.name: Cutlass T-Shirt
lore.description: Don't judge a ship by its reputation. Show that pilots of all ilk love the Cutlass line of ships because of their versatility, affordability, and general bad-assery. The front of this black t-shirt features the iconic ship swooping before of the Drake logo and has the ship's name proudly displayed on the back.

lore.name: Cutter 2955 Auspicious Red Pig Livery
lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Pig livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a pig.

lore.name: Cutter 2955 Auspicious Red Snake Livery
lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Snake livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a snake.

lore.name: Cutter Aspire Livery
lore.description: With the Aspire livery, blue and white combine to evoke both the colors and frigid temperatures of New Babbage. In honor of the landing zone that inspired it, the livery also features a depiction of the Aspire Grand building that dominates the city's skyline.

lore.name: Cutter Caiman Livery
lore.description: Green and white with orange highlights, the Caiman livery brings a distinct and dramatic look to the Cutter.

lore.name: Cutter Carnival Livery
lore.description: The Carnival livery gives the Cutter distinctive pink stripes that stand out against the ship's grey hull.

lore.name: Cutter Central Tower Livery
lore.description: Give the Cutter a dramatic new look with the Central Tower livery. The orange and black color scheme is inspired by the furnaces of industry powering Lorville, and also features a representation of the landing zone's iconic Central Headquarters and Shared Services Center, aka Central Tower.

lore.name: Cutter Citizens for Prosperity Garnet Livery
lore.description: Join the Citizens for Prosperity in their mission to bring peace to the frontier with this dark grey and burgandy livery featuring the group's signature logo.

lore.name: Cutter Cliffhanger Livery
lore.description: Primarily beige with brown accent stripes and black highlights, the Cliffhanger livery makes the Cutter look rugged yet refined.

lore.name: Cutter Deck the Hull Livery
lore.description: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.

lore.name: Cutter Dying Star Livery (Modified)
lore.description: This version of the livery has been modified from its original form with the addition of graffiti. Sold in 2943 to celebrate the 450th anniversary of Pyro's discovery, the Dying Star livery is tan with brown and black highlights. It also features branding from Pyrotechnic Amalgamated, the now defunct mining company that found and named the system.

lore.name: Cutter Foundation Fest Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Cutter Frontier Fighters Camo Livery
lore.description: Be ready to battle in the untamed wilds with this green camo livery featuring the logo of the Frontier Fighters vigilante group.

lore.name: Cutter Ghoulish Green Livery
lore.description: Embrace Day of the Vara mischievousness and mayhem any time of the year with this custom Cutter livery. It combines metallic green and black for a striking look that highlights the holiday's classic colors.

lore.name: Cutter Groundswell Livery
lore.description: Mixing shades of green with vivid orange, the Groundswell livery embraces the spirit of the Cutter with this dynamic paint scheme.

lore.name: Cutter Headhunters Trauma Livery
lore.description: Show your loyalty to the Headhunters gang with this livery featuring their logo emblazoned on a dark grey hull accented with a vibrant purple.

lore.name: Cutter Hosanna Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the gorgeous clouds that enshroud Orison, the Hosanna livery blends red, ivory, and pink to give the Cutter a distinct appearance. It also features a silhouette of the landing zone's famous Hosanna tree complete with its pink flowers.

lore.name: Cutter IceBreak Livery
lore.description: Equip your Cutter with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

lore.name: Cutter Light Beam Livery
lore.description: Bright and bold yellow balanced by black highlights makes the Light Beam livery for the Cutter standout from the crowd.

lore.name: Cutter Nightfall Livery
lore.description: The Nightfall livery gives the Cutter a sleek black paint job with pops of cyan.

lore.name: Cutter Noble Livery
lore.description: A simple and sleek metallic finish makes the Noble livery a bold choice for the Cutter.

lore.name: Cutter Pyrite Livery
lore.description: The Pyrite livery features a matte black hull with silver highlights and bright yellow hazard stripes.

lore.name: Cutter Rockslide Livery
lore.description: Bring a unique style to the Cutter with the Rockslide livery, which adds orange stripes and brown highlights to compliment the ship's grey body.

lore.name: Cutter Tectonic Livery
lore.description: Bring a bit of personality to the Cutter with the Tectonic livery, which features vibrant pops of orange against the brown and black base paint.

lore.name: Cutter Wind Chill Livery
lore.description: The Wind Chill livery for the Cutter features crisp white paint with black highlights.

lore.name: Cutter XenoThreat Purge Livery
lore.description: Let Humanity know you won't bow down to alien invaders with this XenoThreat livery featuring a muted teal with bright red accents.

lore.name: CVSA Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Ballistic Cannon Size: 2 Behring designed the CVSA to be their Vanguard only ballistic cannon variant. This weapon features a slower rate of fire delivers a higher velocity round that is ideal for dealing major damage to targets at medium to long ranges.

lore.name: Cyan QuikFlarePro
lore.description: Manufacturer: Shubin Interstellar Illuminate the way forward or signal for help with the Cyan QuikFlarePro from Shubin Interstellar. For centuries, miners have counted on this flare as part of their core toolkit, thanks to its tried and true design and durability that ensures it stays ablaze in the various harsh weather and difficult atmospheric conditions encountered across the 'verse. The QuikFlarePro uses advanced tech to glow longer than regular flares.

lore.name: Cyclone Dust Devil Livery
lore.description: Featuring a non-reflective matte black paint, the Dust Devil livery is perfect for land-based operations that require speed and discretion.

lore.name: Cyclone Finish Line Livery
lore.description: Give the Cyclone a classic racing design with the Finish Line livery. It features a yellow stripe across the front, a white one through the middle, and a grey one on the back.

lore.name: Cyclone Frostbite Camo Livery
lore.description: Embody the winter winds with the Frostbite Camo livery for your Cyclone.

lore.name: Cyclone Invictus Blue and Gold Livery
lore.description: Featuring a vibrant blue base color and gold highlights, the Invictus Blue and Gold livery will give your Cyclone a striking style.

lore.name: Cyclone Lovestruck Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your Cyclone.

lore.name: Cyclone Overdrive Livery
lore.description: Blast past other racers in your Cyclone with the Overdrive livery, which features a stylish blend red and silver coloring.

lore.name: Cyclone Slipstream Livery
lore.description: The Slipstream livery will have your Cyclone ready and raring to race with this sleek blue and white paint scheme.

lore.name: Cyclone Timberline Livery
lore.description: Customize your Cyclone with the Timberline livery that's olive green with orange accents.

lore.name: Cyclone Turbocharged Livery
lore.description: The Turbocharged is a distinct, purple racing livery for the Cylcone that will make you stand out from the rest of the field.

lore.name: Cyclone Whirlwind Livery
lore.description: The Whirlwind livery mixes various shades of blue in a memorable animal stripe pattern to give the Cyclone a daring look.

lore.name: Cypher
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Blue Triangle Inc. Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Stealth Designed to dispel both IR and EM signatures, the Cypher from Blue Triangle Inc has quietly been making a name for itself amongst consumers that prefer stealth components.

lore.name: Dado
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Civilian The Dado ship computer from WillsOp comes standard with their proprietary targeting system software to help keep your ship safe.

lore.name: Dahlia
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian The engineers at Sakura Sun know the importance of a dependable life support system when exploring the far reaches of the empire. That's why the Dahlia line was designed to offer a no-fuss solution to your life support needs.

lore.name: Dahlia Delux
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Civilian The engineers at Sakura Sun know the importance of a dependable life support system when exploring the far reaches of the empire. That's why the Dahlia line was designed to offer a no-fuss solution to your life support needs.

lore.name: Dahlia Mini
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 0 Grade: C Class: Civilian The engineers at Sakura Sun know the importance of a dependable life support system when exploring the far reaches of the empire. That's why the Dahlia line was designed to offer a no-fuss solution to your life support needs.

lore.name: Dahlia Premium
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian The engineers at Sakura Sun know the importance of a dependable life support system when exploring the far reaches of the empire. That's why the Dahlia line was designed to offer a no-fuss solution to your life support needs.

lore.name: Dak Galbi Chicken Burrito
lore.description: NDR: 34 Effects: Dehydrating This satisfying burrito features a tortilla wrapper filled with sweet and spicy chicken.

lore.name: Daredevil Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Express your attitude with this ultramodern crash jacket from CBD. An asymmetrical front zipper, arm and shoulder straps help provide additional style for this unique piece.

lore.name: Dash Apron
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Stegman's Dash apron is made from a thick, stain-resistant polyfiber that not only protects the wearer but looks as good at the end of the shift as it does at the beginning. The practical design is embellished with a bold waistline and pocket detailing alongside a fun accent color panel on the lower skirt.

lore.name: Data Drive
lore.description: A mobile data storage device designed to transport information.

lore.name: Datapad
lore.description: A portable tablet computing device featuring a touchscreen display.

lore.name: Davin Work Gloves
lore.description: Field-tested for over fifty years, you can find Davin work gloves at numerous sites and ships around the Empire. Stegman's rugged construction and comfort lining have made them a customer favorite.

lore.name: Davin Work Gloves "Pathfinder"
lore.description: Toss out your old boring work gloves and replace them with the Davin Pathfinder edition. These special work gloves combine Stegman's classic, sturdy construction with a supremely comfortable lining and a striking silver color.

lore.name: Davlos Shirt Charcoal
lore.description: Live in comfort with MuyMuy's Davlos line of cotton-synthetic shirts. The durable, yet soft, fabric contains a patented SweatGuard technology that not only whisks away perspiration but helps prevent stains.

lore.name: Day of the Vara '54 Coin
lore.description: Featuring a skeletal handshake on one side and the emblem of the UEE on the other, this green and purple embossed coin has been struck in honor of the spookiest day of the year.

lore.name: Day One Shirt
lore.description: This Henley shirt from Stegman's is made with AirFlow technology, a stain-resistant, air-cooled fabric that keeps you comfortable and dry.

lore.name: Day One Shirt "Voyager"
lore.description: The Voyager edition of this Henley shirt is red with black trim and gold sleeves. It features Stegman's famous AirFlow technology, a stain-resistant, air-cooled fabric that keeps you comfortable and dry. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: DayBreak
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian Sakura Sun knows exactly what you need. The DayBreak is a straightforward power plant that provides parity to its performance, durability, and stealth stats.

lore.name: DCHS-01 Executive Access Protocols Comp-Board
lore.description: This discrete core hangar system comp-board is coded with executive access protocol operations.

lore.name: DCHS-02 Security Encryption Comp-Board
lore.description: This discrete core hangar system comp-board is coded with security encryption operations.

lore.name: DCHS-03 Vehicle Management Comp-Board
lore.description: This discrete core hangar system comp-board is coded with vehicle management operations.

lore.name: DCHS-04 Power Processing Comp-Board
lore.description: This discrete core hangar system comp-board is coded with power processing operations.

lore.name: DCHS-05 Orbital Positioning Comp-Board
lore.description: This discrete core hangar system comp-board is coded with orbital positioning operations.

lore.name: DCHS-06 Communication Comp-Board
lore.description: This discrete core hangar system comp-board is coded with communication operations.

lore.name: DCHS-07 Engineering Maintenance Comp-Board
lore.description: This discrete core hangar system comp-board is coded with engineering maintenance operations.

lore.name: DCHS-08 Administration Comp-Board
lore.description: This discrete core hangar system comp-board is coded with administration operations.

lore.name: DCHS-09 Atmospheric Filtration Comp-Board
lore.description: This discrete core hangar system comp-board is coded with atmospheric filtration operations.

lore.name: DCP Armor Arms Hunter Camo
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 52800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 251.1 REM/s Endure the most brutal attacks with the DCP heavy armor. This set features easy-swing joints that provide freedom of movement in the heat of battle, and was crafted with a multi-layer shock-absorbing shell that helps its wearer shake off the hardest hits.

lore.name: DCP Armor Core Hunter Camo
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 52800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 251.1 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU Backpacks: All Endure the most brutal attacks with the DCP heavy armor. This set features easy-swing joints that provide freedom of movement in the heat of battle, and was crafted with a multi-layer shock-absorbing shell that helps its wearer shake off the hardest hits.

lore.name: DCSR2
lore.description: An organically derived terpenoid lipid, dicylasterone (commonly known as DCSR2), has been banned from use in biomedical applications. Currently, it is most typically used in the manufacture of illegal narcotic 'SLAM.'

lore.name: De Leon Shoes Black
lore.description: Hawksworth's De Leon take the classic cap toed Oxford design but incorporate a laceless slip-on design to create an exciting new addition to the world of formal footwear.

lore.name: Deactivated Tephra Mine
lore.description: Aegis Dynamics decommissioned this former weapon of war and turned it into a work of art to celebrate 400 years of service for the UEE's most celebrated minelayer, the Nautilus. Now this Tephra homing mine from Firestorm Kinetics can be safely displayed in hangars across the UEE, allowing you to get up close and personal with this big, bold beast without being blown to bits.

lore.name: Deadbolt I Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Esperia Item Type: Ballistic Cannon Size: 1 Spread dread with the Deadbolt I ballistic cannon. Feared for its firepower at short range, this notorious Tevarin weapon earned its intimidating reputation during the First Tevarin War as part of the Tevarin fleet's devastating arsenal. Esperia has painstakingly recreated the Deadbolt I out of respect to the original weapon and warriors who used it so effectively.

lore.name: Deadhead Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -50 / 80 °C Remind your enemies that death is coming with the Deadhead helmet. In place of a visor, the ghastly visage of a Human skull, lit from within by an infernal glow, is sure to send any opponent running.

lore.name: Deadhead Helmet Brassy
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -50 / 80 °C Remind your enemies that death is coming with the Deadhead helmet. In place of a visor, the ghastly visage of a Human skull, lit from within by an infernal glow, is sure to send any opponent running. The Brassy version features white coloring with bronze accents.

lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -50 / 80 °C Remind your enemies that death is coming with the Deadhead helmet. lore.name: Deadrig 'Noxious' Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Unknown Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 8 Rate Of Fire: 120 rpm Effective Range: 0-10 m Attachments: N/A The Deadrig is a high powered, double-barreled shotgun with a simple design pieced together from junkyard scraps. Prioritizing power above all else, the Deadrig lacks the refinement of mass-produced weapons and suffers from heavy recoil. The Noxious variant features more green coloration due to the scrap metal used during its assembly.

lore.name: Deadrig "Smudge" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Unknown Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 8 Rate Of Fire: 120 rpm Effective Range: 0-10 m Attachments: N/A The Deadrig is a high powered, double-barreled shotgun with a simple design pieced together from junkyard scraps. Prioritizing power above all else, the Deadrig lacks the refinement of mass-produced weapons and suffers from heavy recoil. The Smudge variant features a black finish.

lore.name: Deadrig Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Unknown Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 8 Rate Of Fire: 120 rpm Effective Range: 0-10 m Attachments: N/A The Deadrig is a high powered, double-barreled shotgun with a simple design pieced together from junkyard scraps. Prioritizing power above all else, the Deadrig lacks the refinement of mass-produced weapons and suffers from heavy recoil.

lore.name: Deadrig Shotgun Magazine (8 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 8 This magazine for the Deadrig shotgun comes pre-loaded with eight 12-gauge shells.

lore.name: Death Mask '54 Coin
lore.description: Carried by outlaws as way to show their elite standing in the pirate underworld, the Death Mask coin features a fierce Human skull on one side and a defaced UEE symbol on the other.

lore.name: Death's Head Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -56 / 86 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 4.0 µSCU Built using high quality scavenge with a molded faceplate, the Death's Head is built to take an absolute beating. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Deathroll S2 Gatling
lore.description: Created from a mixture of different parts, the Deathroll gatling gun can rapidly fire across a long range. Though it requires ammunition, the explosive power each shot contains more than makes up for the cost of ammo.

lore.name: Debnam Gloves
lore.description: Named after the influential Terran tailor, Debnam gloves incorporate that famous tailor's classic design to keep your hands comfortable in colder temperatures.

lore.name: Debnam Gloves (Modified)
lore.description: This version of Derion's Debnam gloves has been modified from its original form. Named after the influential Terran tailor, Debnam gloves incorporate that famous tailor's classic design to keep your hands comfortable in colder temperatures.

lore.name: Decari Pod
lore.description: A large spore pod harvested from the decari that can be collected and used as a food source. However, the decari pod cannot be consumed directly. It must have its thick out layer and spiny filaments removed, and the fibrous hymenium cooked for a long time before it can be safely digested by Humans.

lore.name: DeconPen (Canoiodide)
lore.description: Manufacturer: CureLife Item Type: Medical Consumable The DeconPen from CureLife delivers a rapid injection of Canoiodide, a proprietary medicinal compound that treats radiation exposure.

lore.name: DeconPen Xtra
lore.description: Manufacturer: CureLife Item Type: Medical Consumable The DeconPen Xtra from CureLife delivers a rapid injection of both Canoiodide and Hemozal to not only treat radiation exposure but also improve a patient’s overall vitals, getting patients stabilized faster than ever.

lore.name: Decoy
lore.description: These countermeasures are designed to act like compact ship emulators. These specialty rounds emit high concentrations of EM and phosphorous heat to attract missile guidance systems or pilots flying by radar/scans.

lore.name: Deep-Space Undersuit
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% Confidently venture into the unknown with the Deep-Space undersuit. Smartly designed with several overlapping sections to guarantee the suit's integrity, Gyson has created an affordable and fashionable undersuit that helps make space travel more accessible to all.

lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp.
