lore.name: Defender Harmony Livery
lore.description: The Harmony livery is meant to showcase Humanity's peaceful relationship with aliens with a semi-pearlescent blue main coat marked with organic reflective red to suggest the coming together of disparate species and cultures. The Harmony livery has been designed and produced by the UEE's Diplomatic Corps and freely licensed to all spacecraft manufacturers. Now Banu Defender owners can celebrate the UEE's intentions of working toward a peaceful galaxy.

lore.name: Defender Ocellus Livery
lore.description: The Ocellus livery adapts and updates the iconic colors and design used on some Tevarin ships to bring a striking new look to the Defender. The livery gives the fuselage a prominent red section while shimmering green covers the rest of the ship. Thick grey lines swoop through both colors to provide a unique geometric pattern.

lore.name: Defender Platinum Livery
lore.description: The Platinum livery uses several shades of silver to accentuate the Defender's unique look.

lore.name: Defender Polar Livery
lore.description: Modify your Defender with this white and grey livery specifically designed for the 2951 IAE.

lore.name: Defender Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom Defender livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.

lore.name: Defender Wanderer Livery
lore.description: The Wanderer livery features crisscrossing purple and grey lines over a platinum foundation. Inspired by the sacred Xi'an gardens of R.aip?uang, famous for its trails that wander in surprising ways and encourage a focus on the journey instead of the destination.

lore.name: DefenseCon '56 Hat
lore.description: Show your appreciation for the everyday heroes of the UEE with the official DefenseCon 2956 hat.

lore.name: DefenseCon '56 Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 3K µSCU Turn up the heat and celebrate DefenseCon 2956 in style in these flame-accented cargo pants made from triple-stitched polymer weave fabric, with four easy access pockets.

lore.name: DefenseCon '56 T-Shirt
lore.description: Turn up the heat and celebrate DefenseCon 2956 in style this flame-accented t-shirt with front collar tabs and a rear quarter zip.

lore.name: Defiance Arms (Modified)
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -72 / 102 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s This version of CDS's Defiance arms has been modified from its original form. Incorporating the same manufacturing know-how and expertise that the UEE Marines have come to rely on, Clark Defense Systems has designed their civilian-line of Defiance heavy armors to stand firm in the face of even the most adverse combat scenarios with its three-star rated protective plating and fully integrated mobility framework.

lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -72 / 102 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s This version of CDS's Defiance helmet has been modified from its original form. The Defiance features a fully enclosed battle helmet constructed with two layers of composite weaves underneath armor plating, providing you maximum protection against penetrating and concussive attacks. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Defiant
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 0 Grade: B Class: Industrial In this cutthroat universe, the competition doesn’t stop when you do. That’s why you need the Defiant industrial power plant equipped in your vehicle. It’s optimized by the experts at Juno Starwerk to provide unmatched performance compared to other components in its class.

lore.name: Degnous Root
lore.description: Degnous root is a macroalgae that was discovered in the shallow coastlines of Prime on Terra. Once harvested, degnous can be utilized as an ingredient in medical and health products thanks to its unique blend of amino acids.

lore.name: Delta "Scorched" (1x Reflex)
lore.description: Manufacturer: NV-TAC Type: Reflex Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 1x - 3x Aim Time: +2.5% Aim Recoil: -10% Visual Recoil: -10% Parallax: Medium Size: 1 Ideal for civilians and professionals, the Delta non-magnifying reflex sight from NV-TAC provides a precise illuminated target marker, visible across a wide range of light levels. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

lore.name: Delta (1x Reflex)
lore.description: Manufacturer: NV-TAC Type: Reflex Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 1x Aim Time: +15% Size: 1 Ideal for civilians and professionals, the Delta non-magnifying reflex sight from NV-TAC provides a precise illuminated target marker, visible across a wide range of light levels.

lore.name: Delta LL (1x Reflex)
lore.description: Manufacturer: NV-TAC Type: Reflex Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 1x Aim Time: +15% Size: 1 Ideal for civilians and professionals, the Delta non-magnifying reflex sight from NV-TAC provides a precise illuminated target marker, visible across a wide range of light levels. This version of the scope includes low-light functionality suitable for operations in dim environments.

lore.name: DeltaMax
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Stealth Expert engineering made significant breakthroughs possible when designing the DeltaMax, resulting in a stealth signature even lower than originally estimated by the team at Tyler Design and Tech.

lore.name: Demeco "Purgatory Camo" LMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: LMG Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 100 Rate Of Fire: 400 rpm Effective Range: 40 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S3) Klaus & Werner has created an iconic weapon with tried and true Demeco laser LMG. Used extensively in military engagements, this short-to-mid-range infantry favorite has been constructed with stability and accuracy at the forefront. The Purgatory Camo edition mixes shades of gray for a sleek, no nonsense design.

lore.name: Demeco "Red Alert" LMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: LMG Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 100 Rate Of Fire: 400 rpm Effective Range: 40 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S3) Klaus & Werner has created an iconic weapon with tried and true Demeco laser LMG. Used extensively in military engagements, this short-to-mid-range infantry favorite has been constructed with stability and accuracy at the forefront. The "Red Alert" edition mixes grey and a vibrant red for a bold and dynamic design.

lore.name: Demeco "Streamline" LMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: LMG Class: Energy (Electron) Battery Size: 165 Rate of Fire: 550 rpm - 220 rpm Effective Range: 50m Attachments: Optics (S3), Underbarrel (S3) The engineers at VOLT crafted the Fresnel LMG to bring a powerful energy weapon to the frontlines, one that can initiate a fight with a rapid spray of deadly blasts. As the weapon heats up, the shots become slower and more powerful, but be careful of overheating. A weapon of this magnitude demands a strong foundation; operators are encouraged to fire from a crouching position to allow for better recoil management. The Streamline edition is a subdued white finished with strokes of deep red and metallic accents.

lore.name: Demeco "Ultraviolet" LMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: LMG Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 100 Rate Of Fire: 400 rpm Effective Range: 40 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S3) Klaus & Werner has created an iconic weapon with tried and true Demeco laser LMG. Used extensively in military engagements, this short-to-mid-range infantry favorite has been constructed with stability and accuracy at the forefront. The Ultraviolet edition features eye-catching violet and orchid coloring.

lore.name: Demeco LMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: LMG Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 100 Rate Of Fire: 400 rpm Effective Range: 40 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S3) Klaus & Werner has created an iconic weapon with tried and true Demeco laser LMG. Used extensively in military engagements, this short-to-mid-range infantry favorite has been constructed with stability and accuracy at the forefront.

lore.name: Demeco LMG Battery (100 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Battery Capacity: 100 This is a replacement battery for Klaus & Werner's iconic light machine gun, the Demeco.

lore.name: Demon Fang Combat Knife
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: 15 cm The Demon Fang is a simple yet sinister split blade knife supported by a sturdy and lightly textured handle. Vibrant red cutting edges highlight the knife's unusual and intimidating look, guaranteeing to give anyone second thoughts about getting in its way.

lore.name: Denning
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 0 Grade: C Class: Civilian With the Denning, you can now equip an award winning WillsOp radar to your vehicle.

lore.name: Deo Shirt
lore.description: Fiore's Deo is a slim cut work shirt that's as practical as it is timeless. Featuring a high collar and metal neck clasp, the Deo has been a mainstay in business attire. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Deo Shirt (Modified)
lore.description: This version of Fiore's Deo shirt has been modified from its original form. Fiore's Deo is a slim cut work shirt that's as practical as it is timeless. Featuring a high collar and metal neck clasp, the Deo has been a mainstay in business attire.

lore.name: Deri Gloves
lore.description: Maintain a tactile sense of the world while also keeping your hands safe and dry with the Deri fingerless gloves. Featuring a comfortable inner lining, lightweight plating on the back of the hand and slip resistant palm padding, the Deri gloves are an ideal choice for a wide variety of tasks.

lore.name: Desert Cat Boots
lore.description: When you walk on untamed worlds, dirt is just a part of the job. These Desert Cat Boots are coated with a thin membrane that helps repel grime while allowing heat and sweat to escape.

lore.name: Desert Quasi Grazer Egg
lore.description: A gourmet egg that is renowned for its complex flavor, it is always in demand from restauranteurs and gourmands alike. The flavor of the egg can vary depending on diet and environment. After the eggs are laid, their shells chemically bond to specialized pouches located on the Quasi grazer's belly, where they are carried until they hatch.

lore.name: Destroyer Mass Driver Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Mass Driver Cannon Size: 10 Made for the Aegis Idris utilizing railgun technology to accurately fire high damage ballistic projectiles over long distances, the Destroyer mass driver from Klaus & Werner has made it's presence known on the battlefield time and again with devastating impact.

lore.name: Detara Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity:1000 µSCU The Detara Jacket by Habidash weaves several long panels of durable fabric together to create a unique silhouette well suited to harsh environments.

lore.name: Detatrine
lore.description: Refined from the natural toxin found within the rare detatium fruit, this chemical has numerous medical applications.

lore.name: DetoxPen (Resurgera)
lore.description: Manufacturer: CureLife Item Type: Medical Consumable From the Empire’s most trusted medical company, the CureLife DetoxPen can rapidly dispense doses of the detoxicant Resurgera during emergency situations to help relieve symptoms associated with high blood drug levels (BDL) and overdoses. Use only as recommended.

lore.name: Devastator "Brimstone" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Shotgun Class: Energy (Plasma) Battery Size: 12 Rate Of Fire: 60 rpm Effective Range: 20 m Kastak Arms’ Devastator is a semi-automatic electric shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. If the situation requires a high-power presence, look no further than the Devastator. The "Brimstone" special edition features a bold red top-trim and a dark gray finish on the lower half of the weapon.

lore.name: Devastator "Pathfinder" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Shotgun Class: Energy (Plasma) Battery Size: 12 Rate Of Fire: 60 rpm Effective Range: 20 m Clear rooms in style with the Devastator Pathfinder edition semi-automatic shotgun. Its satin bronze finish features intricate etchings and "Charting the Way Ahead" across the stock. This electric shotgun delivers high-impact plasma blasts that are effective at short and medium ranges.

lore.name: Devastator "Rager" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Shotgun Class: Energy (Plasma) Battery Size: 12 Rate Of Fire: 60 rpm Effective Range: 20 m This semi-automatic electric shotgun from Kastak Arms delivers high-impact plasma blasts ideal for close combat. The Voyager edition upgrades the look with a checked metallic finish offset with blue highlights. An outrageous combination of black, cyan, and purple makes the "Rager" edition an extra good time.

lore.name: Devastator "Starchaser" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Shotgun Class: Energy (Plasma) Battery Size: 12 Rate Of Fire: 60 rpm Effective Range: 20 m Kastak Arms’ Devastator is a semi-automatic electric shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. If the situation requires a high-power presence, look no further than the Devastator. Created to celebrate the 2954 IAE, the Starchaser edition is a vivid purple with white and black highlights.

lore.name: Devastator "Voyager" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Shotgun Class: Energy (Plasma) Battery Size: 12 Rate Of Fire: 60 rpm Effective Range: 20 m This semi-automatic electric shotgun from Kastak Arms delivers high-impact plasma blasts ideal for close combat. The Voyager edition upgrades the look with a checked metallic finish offset with blue highlights. Look to make a statement of form and function with the Devastator Voyager edition.

lore.name: Devastator "Whirlwind" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Shotgun Class: Energy (Plasma) Battery Size: 12 Rate Of Fire: 60 rpm Effective Range: 20 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S3), Underbarrel (S2) Kastak Arms’ Devastator is a pump-action plasma shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. If the situation requires a high-power presence, look no further than the Devastator. This special Whirlwind edition features analogous shades of blue reminiscent of waves on a turbulent sea.

lore.name: Devastator Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Shotgun Class: Energy (Plasma) Battery Size: 12 Rate Of Fire: 60 rpm Effective Range: 20 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S3), Underbarrel (S2) Kastak Arms’ Devastator is a pump-action plasma shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. If the situation requires a high-power presence, look no further than the Devastator.

lore.name: Devastator Shotgun (Boneyard, Desert Shadow, Executive Edition, Midnight, Nightstalker, Warhawk)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Shotgun Class: Energy (Plasma) Battery Size: 12 Rate Of Fire: 60 rpm Effective Range: 20 m Kastak Arms’ Devastator is a semi-automatic electric shotgun capable of delivering sustained medium range, high-impact plasma blasts for close combat, room clearances and other combat operations. If the situation requires a high-power presence, look no further than the Devastator.

lore.name: Devastator Shotgun Battery (12 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Battery Capacity: 12 This high-voltage plasma capacitor allows the Kastak Arms Devastator shotgun to fire twelve standard shots, or fewer over-charged shots.

lore.name: Devereaux Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU From modern work environments to casual gatherings, OpalSky's Devereaux slacks have been a consistent member of everyday wardrobe.

lore.name: Devoue
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Groupe Nouveau Paradigme Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Military The Devoue radar is able to render nearby energy emissions accurately and quickly, allowing you to retain control even in the most dire situations.

lore.name: Diamond
lore.description: An allotrope of the element carbon, diamonds form over billions of years under high heat and pressure. Extremely hard and thermally conductive.

lore.name: Diamond Laminate
lore.description: One of the hardest manufactured materials today, this glass-like substance is frequently used in the construction of cockpit windows.

lore.name: Diligence
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Industrial Though the Diligence delivers high performance compared to other components in its class, this power plant’s dependability and ease of maintenance is what makes it a favorite of haulers.

lore.name: Diluthermex
lore.description: An extremely heat resistant epoxy often used in the mounting and repair of ship thrusters. It is considered very difficult to transport in its uncured state as it becomes explosively unstable when exposed to Chan-Eisen fields during quantum travel. Specialized containers must be used to safely transport the epoxy long distances. Once set and cured, the Diluthermex is no longer reactive.

lore.name: Disconnected Fade
lore.description: A bold, aerodynamic look.

lore.name: Distilled Spirits
lore.description: A purified beverage produced through the distillation of fermented substances. Possesses at least 20 percent of alcohol by volume.

lore.name: Dolivine
lore.description: A dull green gemstone that is used decoratively but also can be used for industrial purposes thanks to its resistance to weathering and high density.

lore.name: Dominance-1 Scattergun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Item Type: Laser Scattergun Size: 1 Thanks to its integration of Hurston Dynamics' laser cascade technology, the Dominance-1 scattergun is able to deliver more damage the closer the size one weapon operates to its maximum safe thermal capacity.

lore.name: Dominance-2 Scattergun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Item Type: Laser Scattergun Size: 2 The harder the fight, the harder the Dominance-2 scattergun works. As its thermal levels increase, the size two weapon from Hurston Dynamics is able utilize cascade technology to turn that thermal potential into an even deadlier close-quarters attack.

lore.name: Dominance-3 Scattergun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Item Type: Laser Scattergun Size: 3 The Dominance-3 scattergun from Hurston Dynamics showcases the weapons manufacturer's cascade technology. As the operator continues to fire the size three weapon, the better able it is to convert the heat generated into increasingly devastating attacks.

lore.name: Dominator II Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Electromagnetic Size: 2 Designed to track an opponent’s electromagnetic signature, the Dominator strike missile is a precision ordnance package designed to establish tactical battlefield dominance.

lore.name: Dominator II-G Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Electromagnetic Size: 2 Designed to track an opponent’s electromagnetic signature, the Dominator strike missile is a precision ordnance package designed to establish tactical battlefield dominance. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

lore.name: Doom Light Armor Helmet 01
lore.description: Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Dopple
lore.description: A dissociative drug that creates a strong feeling of separation. People, places, and objects familiar to the user take on a distorted and unreal quality. Some users report a detachment from emotions. Doplencyethorphine is used in small dosages medically to help with extreme emotion issues and rage management problems. Recreational users take it for the effect of resetting the mundane and everyday into something new and different. Side effects include memory loss, panic attacks, paranoia, and psychotic episodes.

lore.name: Double Dog
lore.description: NDR: 34 Effects: Dehydrating, Hyper-Metabolic Two dogs perfectly grilled before being stacked together on a bun.

lore.name: Doubleback Shoes Ultimatum
lore.description: Want to be light on your feet in comfortable trainers without compromising on style? With multi-level memory foam padding on soles built to fit and flex with your specific shape, as well as eye-catching LED highlights in the outsoles, make every step a bold one with the Doubleback shoes. The Ultimatum edition are deep blue with bold pink colors.

lore.name: Dovo Shoes
lore.description: Classic. Elegant. Spar Van Miles' low-heel slip-on shoe is reinforced for durability and comfort. Perfect for the professional on the go.

lore.name: DR Model-XJ1 Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Associated Science & Development Item Type: Distortion Repeater Size: 1 Power is the life blood of every ship, and the DR Model-XJ1 from ASD is the ideal choice to bleed hostiles dry. This cutting-edge distortion repeater allows you to disrupt power on targets, disabling threats efficiently.

lore.name: DR Model-XJ2 Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Associated Science & Development Item Type: Distortion Repeater Size: 2 Advancing the field of distortion weapons, the DR Model-XJ2 repeater from ASD provides tactical energy disruption that will severely limit any targeted ships operational capacity.

lore.name: DR Model-XJ3 Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Associated Science & Development Item Type: Distortion Repeater Size: 3 Shutdown hostile actions and target power supplies with the DR Model-XJ3, a well-ranged distortion repeater developed by the advanced weapons research labs of ASD.

lore.name: Dragon STC Blue Main Thruster
lore.description: The STC Blue by perrenial thruster manufacturer Dragon Stellar Transit Company offers high output and low emissions, great for pilots wishing to close the distance while maintaining a low profile. The smallest thruster in the STC lineup, the Blue has a thrust rating of 2.

lore.name: Dragon STC Red Main Engine
lore.description: The Dragon Stellar STC Red is a great choice for pilots of small ships. Despite its lack of fuel and power efficiency it boasts a respectable thrust output that really shines on low mass ships such as the Aurora. As an added benefit, Dragon Stellar recently developed new technology that reduces the output signature, great for pilots who don't wish to call a lot of attention to themselves. Its thrust rating of 3 gives it more thrust than the Blue, at the cost of higher power consumption and signature.

lore.name: Dragon STC Silver Main Engine
lore.description: The STC Silver from Dragon Stellar Transit Company is a TR4 engine noted for its high thrust ouput and low EM emissions. It has been rumored that Dragon Stellar has been using inferior components, but for some pilots the decreased power and fuel efficiency is worth the extra boost, especially at this price point.

lore.name: Dragonfly Coalfire Livery
lore.description: Style and speed meet with the Dragonfly Coalfire livery that blends red and grey for an alluring look.

lore.name: Dragonfly Ghoulish Green Livery
lore.description: Embrace Day of the Vara mischievousness and mayhem any time of the year with this custom Dragonfly livery. It combines metallic green and black for a striking look that highlights the holiday's classic colors.

lore.name: Dragonfly Mistwalker Livery
lore.description: Become one with the clouds with the Dragonfly Mistwalker livery and its grey camo pattern.

lore.name: Dragonfly Overdrive Livery
lore.description: Blast past other racers in style on your Dragonfly with the Overdrive livery, which blends red and silver coloring.

lore.name: Dragonfly Roustabout Livery (Modified)
lore.description: This version of the livery has been modified from its original form with the addition of graffiti. Released in 2893 to celebrate the 400th anniversary of Pyro's discovery, the Roustabout livery gets it look and name from the ship whose scans led to the discovery of the first jump point into the system. It also features the logo of Pyrotechnic Amalgamated, the now-defunct mining company that named the system.

lore.name: Dragonfly Slipstream Livery
lore.description: The Slipstream livery will have your Dragonfly ready and raring to race with this sleek blue and white paint scheme.

lore.name: Dragonfly Turbocharged Livery
lore.description: The Turbocharged is a distinct, purple racing livery for the Dragonfly that will make you stand out from the rest of the field.

lore.name: Drake Buccaneer PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Drake Buccaneer with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: Drake Buccaneer Spinal Mount
lore.description: Ward off attacks from any angle by installing this gimballed spinal mount. Designed by Drake for the Buccaneer, this S4 turret can equip two S2 weapons to keep the heat on aggressors.

lore.name: Drake Buccaneer Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Drake Interplanetary Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the Drake Buccaneer

lore.name: Drake Buccaneer TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Drake Buccaneer with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: Drake Caterpillar Schematic
lore.description: Try not to get lost in the detailed schematic for Drake’s massive cargo ship, the Caterpillar. These blueprints are a part of Esperia’s “Masters of Design” series, which shares classic ship schematics from their massive archive.

lore.name: Drake Caterpillar Schematic "Best in Show Champion 2949"
lore.description: Schematic: Drake Caterpillar 2 Description

lore.name: Drake Clipper PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Drake Clipper with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: Drake Clipper Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Drake Interplanetary Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the Drake Clipper.

lore.name: Drake Clipper TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Drake Clipper with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: Drake Corsair PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Drake Corsair with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: Drake Corsair Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Drake Interplanetary Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the Drake Corsair.

lore.name: Drake Corsair TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Drake Corsair with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: Drake Cutlass Black
lore.description: Manufacturer: Drake Interplanetary Focus: Medium Fighter / Medium Freight Drake Interplanetary claims that the Cutlass Black is a low-cost, easy-to-maintain solution for local in-system militia units. The larger-than-average cargo hold, RIO seat and dedicated tractor mount are, the company literature insists, for facilitating search and rescue operations.

lore.name: Drake Cutlass Red
lore.description: Manufacturer: Drake Interplanetary Focus: Medical The Cutlass Red converts the standard cargo hold to a well-equiped medical facility including an Autodoc. This starbound ambulance features the Nav-E7 Echo Transponder, a long range scanner, and a Secure Plus Docking Collar, making it ideal for search and rescue. This model also features a unique Red Crossbones skin.

lore.name: Drake Cutlass Schematic "Best in Show Finalist 2949"
lore.description: Schematic: Drake Cutlass Description

lore.name: Drake Cutlass Steel Remote Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Turret Manufacturer: Drake Interplanetary Size: 2 This remote-operated turret comes factory-equipped with two Klaus & Werner laser repeaters.

lore.name: Drake Double Platform
lore.description: The Double Platform fits any Drake ship to carry up to two missiles while connecting effortlessly to the ship's launch control.

lore.name: Drake Dragonfly Schematic
lore.description: Check out how Drake packed everything into the compact, open-canopy Dragonfly space bike with this schematic, which is the final entry into Esperia’s “Masters of Design” series.

lore.name: Drake Hat Red Logo
lore.description: Embody the boldness of Drake Interplanetary by wearing this black hat with the company's name in strong red lettering.

lore.name: Drake Hat Yellow Logo
lore.description: Embody the boldness of Drake Interplanetary by wearing this black hat with the company's name in strong yellow lettering.

lore.name: Drake Herald Schematic
lore.description: This schematic, faithfully restored and displayed as part of Esperia’s “Masters of Design” series, exposes the secrets that make the speedy Drake Herald an excellent data runner.

lore.name: Drake Ironclad Torpedo Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Drake Interplanetary Size: 5 Missiles: 5xS5 This bespoke rack for the Drake Ironclad can carry and deploy five S5 torpedoes.

lore.name: Drake Pitbull Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Drake Interplanetary Size: 1 Missiles: 6xS1 Designed to turn the tide in combat, Drake developed this missile rack to carry a relatively large amount of firepower for the ship's size.

lore.name: Drake T-Shirt Red Logo
lore.description: Drake Interplanetary's designs have caught the public's imagination. From the Kraken to the Cutlass, share your love for their ships with this comfortable black and red shirt, featuring the company's logo.

lore.name: Drake T-Shirt Yellow Logo
lore.description: The success of Drake Interplanetary has gone a long way to bring legitimate business back to the Magnus system. Support the scrappy manufacturer of affordable, utilitarian ships with this black shirt emblazoned with the company name in yellow.

lore.name: Drake Trireme S-1
lore.description: Drake's proprietary Trireme S Series of maneuvering thrusters is a low emission propulsion system to give pilots absolute control of their ship while minimizing your profile on outside scanners.

lore.name: Drake Trireme S-3
lore.description: Drake's proprietary Trireme S Series of maneuvering thrusters is a low emission propulsion system to give pilots absolute control of their ship while minimizing your profile on outside scanners.

lore.name: Drake Trireme Thruster
lore.description: Drake's proprietary Trieme S Series of maneuvering thrusters is a low emission propulsion system to give pilots absolute control of their ship while minimizing your profile on outside scanners.

lore.name: Drassik
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Military The Drassik is a military-grade power plant from Aegis Dynamics. The large component is known for providing decent durability but unremarkable performance.

lore.name: Draug
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Wen/Cassel Propulsion Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Civilian The Draug balances performance, durability, and stealth. Making this large Wen/Cassel cooler ready to respond to any situation you find yourself in.

lore.name: Draugar Gatling
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Ballistic Gatling Size: 6 Reminiscent of a bygone era of space combat, this brutal size six ballistic Gatling from Apocalypse Arms is a very deliberate weapon. Take a moment as the Draugar's drum spins up to speed to savor the ruin and destruction that you are about unleash.

lore.name: Dream Wishes T-Shirt
lore.description: The Dream Wishes t-shirt was proudly produced by a Banu souli to celebrate the magical world of Human dreams.

lore.name: Drema Injector
lore.description: Manufacturer: Roussimoff Rehabilitation Systems Item Type: Medical Consumable Designed by RRS for field applications, this single-use device injects a fast-acting sedative into the target's body that will incapacitate the subject for a short duration preventing them from hurting themselves or others.

lore.name: Drema Injector
lore.description: Manufacturer: Roussimoff Rehabilitation Systems Item Type: Medical Consumable Designed by RRS for field applications, this single-use device injects a fast-acting sedative into the target's body that will incapacitate the subject for a short duration preventing them from hurting themselves or others.

lore.name: Drift
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RAMP Corporation Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Stealth Built to keep heat and signature levels low, the Drift quantum drive from RAMP Corporation helps to minimize emissions generated while spooling.

lore.name: Drifter
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Civilian Balancing craftsmanship and cost, the Drifter provides renowned Tarsus performance at an affordable price.

lore.name: Drifter
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Civilian Balancing craftsmanship and cost, the Drifter provides renowned Tarsus performance at an affordable price.

lore.name: Drink
lore.description: Liquids intended for consumption.

lore.name: DS-12 Force Propulsion Grenade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Grenade Damage Type: Non-Lethal The Behring DS-12 is the latest in pacification technology, delivering a non-lethal force push intended to displace opponents in low or zero gravity situations.

lore.name: Duck Sword T-Shirt
lore.description: Stories abound of Human's love of space adventures with Drake Cutlass, so a Banu souli enthusiastically designed this shirt.

lore.name: Dumper's Depot T-Shirt
lore.description: Be sure to keep this shirt off the scrap heap. Made from ring-spun cotton for an ultra-comfortable fit, this Dumper's Depot shirt features an animated spinning gear in the logo that's bound to get people's attention.

lore.name: Duotone Duster
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU A modern update of CBD's classic duster, this full-length coat features two-tone coloring and inlaid accents to make a bold statement whatever environment you're in.

lore.name: DuraJet
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 0 Grade: D Class: Civilian The DuraJet is Lightning Power Ltd.’s base vehicle power plant. Not only does its design catch the eye, but its reliable construction and affordable price point make it a prime option to keep power flowing through your vehicle.

lore.name: Durango
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Industrial The Durango is the peak of large power plants produced by Juno Starwerk. This top-of-the-line industrial component provides unmatched energy dispersion that minimizes fluctuations and surges during heavy demand.

lore.name: DuraWork Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2000 µSCU Made of a durable synthetic material, Stegman's designed the DuraWork to provide a comfortable and reliable clothing option to workers around the 'verse.

lore.name: Durus Tractor Beam
lore.description: Manufacturer: Argo Astronautics Item Type: Tractor Beam Max Angle: 60° Max Range: 150 m Full Strength Distance: 75 m Made specifically for the ATLS power suit, the Durus tractor beam from Argo Astronautics has been carefully tuned for loading and unloading cargo.

lore.name: Dust Devil
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -77 / 107 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s The Overlord armor lets your foes know that you mean business. This heavy armor set is constructed with durable composite plating strategically placed to disperse the force of impacts and a high, reinforced collar that provides additional protection for your neck and back of head. The suit also layers in high-strength synthetic fabrics around the joints to ensure ease of moment without sacrificing safety.

lore.name: Dust Devil Armor Arms
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -85 / 115 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Salvaged pieces of disused protective gear were welded together to make this intimidating armor set.

lore.name: Dust Devil Armor Core
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -85 / 115 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU Backpacks: All Salvaged pieces of disused protective gear were welded together to make this intimidating armor set. The cape, made from an old Banu wall-hanging, adds an elegant finishing touch.

lore.name: Dust Devil Armor Legs
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -85 / 115 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU Salvaged ship parts and pieces of disused protective gear were welded together to make this intimidating armor set. Paired with a decorated leather belt.

lore.name: Dust Devil Arms Epoque
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -85 / 115 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Reinforced alloys are carefully layered to recreate the appearance of warriors from Humanity's past to create an armor that's intimidating and functional. The Epoque edition features a navy and black coloring, finished with baroque gold detailing.

lore.name: Dust Devil Core Epoque
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -85 / 115 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU Backpacks: All Reinforced alloys are carefully layered to recreate the appearance of warriors from Humanity's past to create an armor that's intimidating and functional. The cape adds an elegant finishing touch. The Epoque edition features a navy and black coloring, finished with baroque gold detailing.

lore.name: Dust Devil Legs Epoque
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -85 / 115 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU Reinforced alloys are carefully layered to recreate the appearance of warriors from Humanity's past to create an armor that's intimidating and fuctional. A decorative leather belt completes the look. The Epoque edition features a navy and black coloring, finished with baroque gold detailing.

lore.name: DustUp Arms Tactical
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -60 / 90 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s The DustUp has your back if you’re looking to get into some trouble. The body plating is built off of the same CDS undersuit used by the UEE Marines, it adds reconstructed Omni-Role mkII pieces to give you solid protection against incoming fire, but the real gem is the modified helmet. That thing was built to withstand explosions, so it should totally protect you against some shots. The whole thing’s been reasonably tested against vacuum too, so you can feel free to EVA all you want without worrying about dying.

lore.name: DustUp Arms Ultimatum
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -60 / 90 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s The DustUp has your back if you’re looking to get into some trouble. The body plating is built off of the same CDS undersuit used by the UEE Marines, it adds reconstructed Omni-Role mkII pieces to give you solid protection against incoming fire. The whole thing’s been reasonably tested against vacuum too, so you can feel free to EVA all you want without worrying about dying. The Ultimatum edition features the signature neon pink iconography of the Nine Tails gang.

lore.name: DustUp Core Ultimatum
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -60 / 90 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 7.5K µSCU Backpacks: Medium, Light The DustUp has your back if you’re looking to get into some trouble. The body plating is built off of the same CDS undersuit used by the UEE Marines, it adds reconstructed Omni-Role mkII pieces to give you solid protection against incoming fire. The whole thing’s been reasonably tested against vacuum too, so you can feel free to EVA all you want without worrying about dying. The Ultimatum edition features the signature neon pink iconography of the Nine Tails gang.

lore.name: DustUp Helmet Star Kitten Custom
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Celebrate your love of the timeless Star Kitten cartoon with this commemorative variant of Kastak Arms' classic DustUp helmet. Sure to be a collectible, this custom molding also features embedded lighting to create a stunning silhouette without sacrificing any of the defensive capabilities of this medium helmet. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: DustUp Helmet Ultimatum
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -60 / 90 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s The DustUp has your back if you’re looking to get into some trouble. Originally built to withstand explosions, it should totally protect you against some shots. The whole thing’s been reasonably tested against vacuum too, so you can feel free to EVA all you want without worrying about dying. The Ultimatum edition features the signature neon pink iconography of the Nine Tails gang.

lore.name: DustUp Legs Ultimatum
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -60 / 90 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 4.5K µSCU The DustUp has your back if you’re looking to get into some trouble. The body plating is built off of the same CDS undersuit used by the UEE Marines, it adds reconstructed Omni-Role mkII pieces to give you solid protection against incoming fire. The whole thing’s been reasonably tested against vacuum too, so you can feel free to EVA all you want without worrying about dying. The Ultimatum edition features the signature neon pink iconography of the Nine Tails gang.

lore.name: Dymantium
lore.description: One of the toughest known metal alloys that can be forged. It is extremely difficult to manufacture and must be used with care in order to avoid accidentally weakening the material during application.

lore.name: DynaFlex
lore.description: Developed for use by the military, this absorptive material can withstand severe stress owing to its flexibility.

lore.name: DynaFlux
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Military The DynaFlux was one of the first components A&R Co. built when they expanded their product line to more than energy weapons. Their years of experience manufacturing military-grade equipment went a long way to making the DynaFlux power plant a standout right from the beginning.

lore.name: dynaSys
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: microTech Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian From trusted computer expert microTech, the dynaSys onboard system handles rapid data processing in a streamlined designed frame.

lore.name: E'tam
lore.description: Created from the leaves of indigenous plants, E'tam is an organic hallucinogenic drug used by the Xi'an to slow body function and focus in order to achieve a deeper meditative state. For Humans, the effects are much more severe. E'tam causes hyper awareness, cognitive enhancement and improved focus. Users can be so engrossed in tasks that they neglect to eat, sleep or take care of other body functions.

lore.name: Echion Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Robert Space Industries Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 5 Designed to overwhelm shields with a barrage of laserfire, this custom-made RSI Echion laser repeater will strip enemies of their defenses leaving them vulnerable to more devastating attacks.

lore.name: Echo
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: ArcCorp Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Civilian ArcCorp carefully crafted and calibrated the Echo into an affordable yet effective quantum drive.

lore.name: Echo
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: ArcCorp Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Civilian ArcCorp careful crafted and calibrated the Echo into an affordable yet effective quantum drive.

lore.name: Eclipse
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Stealth Competing medium power plants struggle to match the heat and signature reduction of the Eclipse. Tyler Design & Tech’s mastery of stealth tech makes this component a must own by those who prefer to go unnoticed.

lore.name: Eclipse 2950 Best In Show Livery
lore.description: Customize your Eclipse with this special 2950 Best in Show livery that is primarily white with gold accents.

lore.name: Eclipse Ambush Camo Livery
lore.description: Make the Eclipse harder to spot with the Ambush Camo livery, featuring a camouflage pattern to help break up the visual perception.

lore.name: Eclipse Knockout Livery
lore.description: The Knockout livery gives the Eclipse a green tint to make it less visible when in verdant landscapes.

lore.name: Eclipse Meridian Livery
lore.description: The Meridian livery gives the Eclipse a simple yet stylish metallic silver finish.

lore.name: Eclipse Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Eclipse with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Eclipse T-Shirt
lore.description: An Eclipse silhouetted against a planet is a rare sight, considering that this high-tech, stealth bomber is notorious for striking targets before it's even spotted. After years of military service, Aegis Dynamics, whose logo appears the back of the t-shirt, brought the ship to the civilian market in 2947 to rave review and stellar sales.

lore.name: EcoFlow
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Industrial A standard for centuries, Juno Starwerk’s industrial Eco-Flow cooler is a favorite of haulers for being easy to maintain even when carrying the heaviest cargo loads.

lore.name: Ecosphere Replica
lore.description: Though simple looking, Conner’s Beard moss holds the notable distinction of being considered the first plant subspecies to have naturally evolved on a spacestation. Tied intrinsically with its unique place of birth, the bryophyte can only survive in the specific conditions that the aging station’s life support systems created. The sculpture featured in the Ecosphere is a replica of the gift shop souvenir the moss was originally discovered on by a waylaid botanist.

lore.name: Ecouter
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: GNP Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Military Space is vast and unknowable, that’s why discerning pilots rely on the Ecouter small radar from GNP to keep them in the know about what’s around them.

lore.name: Ectio Glasses
lore.description: Fashion and function merge with the Ectio glasses from Fiore. Adjustable temple arms provide the perfect fit to sit snugly in the ear, while crystal-tempered lenses guarantee a clear view under almost any atmospheric condition.

lore.name: Edgeriders Shoes
lore.description: Nothing will take you back to the golden era club scene of Prime in the 2920s like Upsiders' new Edgerider sneakers. These slip-on sneakers feature daz patterning and modern impact cushioning to keep you up and active for days on end.

lore.name: Edgewear Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 4K µSCU Stegman's Edgewear utility clothes are made from reinforced nylon weaves and lined with temperature-rated quilted technology to provide you with a little extra protection while on the jobsite. Double knees, reinforced joint pads and extra pockets add comfort and durability to this field-tested and worker-approved clothing line.

lore.name: Edgewear Pants "Pathfinder"
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 4K µSCU A reinforced nylon weave and temperature-rated quilted technology make Edgewear pants ideal for any jobsite. This staple of Stegman's line of utility clothes comes with double knees, reinforced joint pads, and extra pockets. The exclusive Pathfinder edition comes in purple with black and silver accents.

lore.name: EE04 (4x Telescopic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Type: Telescopic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 4x Zoom: 4x-5.5x Aim Time: +25% Size: S2 Get a clear view of your target from afar with the EE04. Behring craftsmanship produced a 4x scope that's lightweight, durable, and deadly accurate. A rigorous 22-step testing process ensures the EE04 can deliver precision targeting even after encountering extreme weather or surviving battlefield wear and tear.

lore.name: EE08 (8x Telescopic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Type: Telescopic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 8x Aim Time: +0% Size: S3 Get a clear view of your target from afar with the EE08. Behring craftsmanship produced a 8x scope that's lightweight, durable, and deadly accurate. A rigorous 22-step testing process ensures the EE08 can deliver precision targeting even after encountering extreme weather or surviving battlefield wear and tear.

lore.name: EE16 (16x Telescopic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Type: Telescopic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 16x Aim Time: +0% Size: S3 Get a clear view of your target from afar with the EE16. Behring craftsmanship produced a 16x scope that's lightweight, durable, and deadly accurate. A rigorous 22-step testing process ensures the EE16 can deliver precision targeting even after encountering extreme weather or surviving battlefield wear and tear.

lore.name: Ejection Rejection T-Shirt
lore.description: Commiserate with other Captains whose chair won't go anywhere. The Ejection Rejection shirt features a smoldering Cutlass while wondering why anyone would ever need an ejection seat.

lore.name: Elespo
lore.description: A brand name of a light sponge-like material that has exceptional electrical absorption properties.

lore.name: Elsen
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Wen/Cassel Propulsion Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian Wen/Cassel engineers used many of the same parts found in the Draug, only fine tuned to deliver improved performance and durability without greatly enhancing its signature. That makes the Elsen large cooler a worthy upgrade for those that can handle the extra heat.

lore.name: Ember Pants
lore.description: These two-tone pants from Derion are the perfect blend of modern and classic, the Ember's dual polymer weave provides a durable, professional look guaranteed to strike a commanding presence wherever you go.

lore.name: Emilion Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU Derion has done it again. The Emilion pants deliver a simple silhouette that reveals strikingly stylish details upon closer inspection. Made from a subtly textured stain-resistant fabric, the pants feature micropleats on the front and back that converge into a single decorative seam at the knees before splitting off again near the ankles, giving the Emilion pants an artful geometric design down the length of the leg.

lore.name: Emod "Scorched" Stabilizer1
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Energy Stabilizer Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 1 Spread: -20% Projectile Speed: -12.5% Aim Recoil: +40% Visual Recoil: +40% ArmaMod designed the Emod Stabilizer1 attachment to improve spread for a slower but more precise shot. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

lore.name: Emod "Tweaker" Stabilizer2
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Energy Stabilizer Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 2 Heat: -80% Aim Recoil: +40% Visual Recoil: -15% Damage: +12.5% Ammo Consumption: +100% ArmaMod designed the Emod Stabilizer2 attachment to improve heat distribution and visual stability allowing for a more precise shot. This "Tweaker" version has been unofficially modified to do more damage at the cost of expending more energy.

lore.name: Emod Stabilizer1
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Energy Stabilizer Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 1 Visual Recoil: -30% ArmaMod designed the Emod Stabilizer1 attachment to improve visual stability allowing for a more precise shot.

lore.name: Emod Stabilizer2
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Energy Stabilizer Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 2 Visual Recoil: -30% ArmaMod designed the Emod Stabilizer2 attachment to improve visual stability allowing for a more precise shot.

lore.name: Emod Stabilizer3
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Energy Stabilizer Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 3 Visual Recoil: -30% Reduce energy weapon recoil with the Emod Stabilizer3. ArmaMod designed the attachment to improve both horizontal and vertical recoil to ensure a more precise shot.

lore.name: Emoto Dashbot
lore.description: Made to sit neatly on your dashboard, this companion Dashbot reacts during your travels with a large range of humorous facial expressions. Whether it's happy to see you or silently judging your piloting skills, the Emoto Dashbot is sure to make your next flight a little more fun.

lore.name: Endo
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Wen/Cassel Propulsion Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Civilian A cooler for discerning ship-owners who are looking to push their craft further, Wen/Cassel’s Endo features above average cooling performance and thoughtful design.

lore.name: Endurance
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Industrial Juno Starwerk’s Endurance has been in service since the 26th century. This industrial strength, utilitarian power plant is a favorite of mechanics since spare parts are easily acquired.

lore.name: Endurance
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Industrial Juno Starwerk’s Endurance has been in service since the 26th century. This industrial strength, utilitarian power plant is a favorite of mechanics since spare parts are easily acquired.

lore.name: Enemy of the Empire Statue
lore.description: Based on the original model used as military propaganda after the UEE's first encounter with the Vanduul in 2681, this towering figure serves as a sombre reminder of the unrelenting destructive nature of the Vanduul species.

lore.name: Enkel Shirt
lore.description: Habidash's Enkel is a simple, no-frills shirt designed to be comfortable, first and foremost.

lore.name: Enkel Shirt Primrose
lore.description: Habidash's Enkel is a simple, no-frills shirt designed to be comfortable, first and foremost.

lore.name: Enkel Shirt Saddle
lore.description: Habidash's Enkel is a simple, no-frills shirt designed to be comfortable, first and foremost.

lore.name: Enkel Shirt Valencia
lore.description: Habidash's Enkel is a simple, no-frills shirt designed to be comfortable, first and foremost.

lore.name: Enter Atmosphere 2956 Poster
lore.description: Show your pride for the 2956 Enter Atmosphere competition with this wall display featuring an Aegis Gladius flying against the event's colors.

lore.name: Eos
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RSI Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian The Eos quantum drive has been a staple in the RSI product line for centuries. Its original design was so perfectly fine-tuned that it has remained basically unchanged since.

lore.name: EP-5 EMP Grenade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Grenade Area of Effect: 20 m Damage Type: Non-Lethal (EMP) Behring’s EP5 grenade produces a controlled electromagnetic burst to disrupt unshielded electronics for a short time, making it an invaluable addition to the loadout of military and law enforcement operators.

lore.name: Epier
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: GNP Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Military GNP’s finely tuned Epier medium radar delivers military grade stats for advanced signature detection wherever your mission takes you.

lore.name: EQ-B Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU Keep it easy with EQ athletic pants from Escar Limited. Made with a sweat-wicking microweave and a subtle pleated design, the EQ are a comfortable and stylish choice for those days when you're looking to keep it cool. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Erebos
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RSI Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Civilian The Erebos exemplifies RSI's commitment to excellence. This high quality quantum drive constantly ranks atop "Best of" lists for both critics and consumers.

lore.name: Erebos
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RSI Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Civilian The Erebos exemplifies RSI's commitment to excellence. This high quality quantum drive constantly ranks atop "Best of" lists for both critics and consumers.

lore.name: Eriesium
lore.description: An actinide element that is extremely rare in the UEE, eriesium is theorized to be an incredible power source if harnessed properly, but can also be deadly in its refined state.

lore.name: Ermer Family Farms Chibanzoo Ice Cream
lore.description: NDR: 10 Effects: Energizing, Hyper-Metabolic This premium 100% real dairy ice cream blended with all natural chunks of Chibanzoo fruit is handcrafted by the skilled artisans at Ermer Family Farms.

lore.name: Ermer Family Farms Chocolate Ice Cream
lore.description: NDR: 10 Effects: Energizing, Hyper-Metabolic This premium 100% real dairy ice cream blended with rich creamy chocolate is handcrafted by the skilled artisans at Ermer Family Farms.

lore.name: Ermer Family Farms Chocolate Milk
lore.description: HEI: 30 NDR: 09 Effects: Energizing, Hyper-Metabolic This premium 100% real dairy milk blended with rich chocolate is bottled fresh at Ermer Family Farms.

lore.name: Ermer Family Farms Coffee Ice Cream
lore.description: NDR: 10 Effects: Energizing, Hyper-Metabolic This premium 100% real dairy ice cream blended with freshly brewed medium-roast coffee is handcrafted by the skilled artisans at Ermer Family Farms.

lore.name: Ermer Family Farms Fat Free Ice Cream
lore.description: NDR: 10 Effects: Energizing, Hyper-Metabolic This premium 100% fat free, real dairy ice cream blended with natural vanilla is handcrafted by the skilled artisans at Ermer Family Farms.

lore.name: Ermer Family Farms Lunes Ice Cream
lore.description: NDR: 10 Effects: Energizing, Hyper-Metabolic This premium 100% real dairy ice cream blended with all natural Lunes fruit puree is handcrafted by the skilled artisans at Ermer Family Farms.

lore.name: Escalate Stabilizer1
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Energy Stabilizer Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 1 Aim Recoil: +50% Visual Recoil: +50% Fire Rate: +30% Damage: -10% Additional Burst Shots: +1 ArmaMod's enhanced circuitry in the Escalate Stabilizer1 boosts the output of handheld weapons substantially, trading control for power.

lore.name: Escalate Stabilizer2
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Energy Stabilizer Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 2 Spread per Shot: +30% Aim Recoil: +30% Visual Recoil: +30% Fire Rate: +10% Damage: -5% Charge Time: -30% Unleash the full destructive potential of your weapon with the Escalate Stabilizer2, increasing the fire rate and shot spread at the cost of accuracy.

lore.name: Escalate Stabilizer3
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Energy Stabilizer Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 3 Damage: +10% Charge Time: -50% Ammo Consumption: +100% By allowing for increased energy consumption, the Escalate Stabilizer3 can overclock your weapon to significantly reduce charge time and increase damage output.

lore.name: Esperia Prowler Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Turret Manufacturer: Esperia This faithful recreation of the original Tevarin design features modern mounts for precise target acquisition.

lore.name: Esperia Stinger Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Esperia Size: 5 Missiles: 8xS2 This S5 missile rack can be equipped with eight S2 missiles.

lore.name: Esteril Lab Coat ASD Edition
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU The Esteril Lab Coat from luxury brand Fiore dares to answer the question, "Should laboratory clothing be fashionable?" with a resounding, "Yes." Based on the bestselling Ati Jacket, this coat features slim tailoring, a high collar, and striking asymmetrical design.

lore.name: Europium
lore.description: The most reactive of the rare earth metals. Europium compounds are often phosphorescent.

lore.name: Eventide Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Ballistic Repeater Size: 5 When you need to send a message loud and clear, you'd be hard pressed to find a more intimidating courier than the Eventide. This size five ballistic repeater from Apocalypse Arms provides sustained, accurate fire with enough stopping power to equalize any fight.

lore.name: Evidence
lore.description: This box is specifically designed for use with evidence in order to help prevent tampering and properly ensure the chain of custody.

lore.name: EVSD Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Distortion Cannon Size: 2 Disable ships without hurting their crew or cargo with the EVSD from Behring. This distortion cannon features much of the same industry-leading technology used in other Behring weapons, but is specifically designed to be mounted on the nose of an Aegis Vanguard.

lore.name: EX-T10-CS "Executor" Torpedo
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Tracking Signal: Cross Section Size: 10 Behring prides itself on crafting ordnance that is as dependable as it is powerful and the EX-T10 "Executor" is no exception. Designed as an anti-ship and anti-installation weapon, Behring engineers worked tirelessly to ensure this torpedo was a bold strategic statement.

lore.name: Exalt
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Industrial No matter the job, you need to be sure that you're life support system is going to do its part - day in, day out. That's why Juno Starwerk built the Exalt life support system to be tough enough so you could breath easy.

lore.name: Excelsior
lore.description: Item Type: Jump Module Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian Journey across the ‘verse with Tarsus’ Excelsior jump module, offering greater reliability to help take your wanderlust to new heights.

lore.name: Exfiltrate
lore.description: Item Type: Jump Module Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 4 This capital-class jump module was designed specifically for the Idris frigate.

lore.name: Exo-8 Helmet (Used)
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -60 / 90 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Featuring a large face shield and torches on each side, the Exo-8 helmet lets you keep your eyes on the prize. Gyson designers smartly integrated space-safe fabrics into the helmet, so it can provide the protection you deserve at a price that won't break the bank. This used helmet has been certified space-safe but may contain cosmetic defects not seen on the standard model.

lore.name: Exodus
lore.description: Item Type: Jump Module Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Civilian Journey across the ‘verse with Tarsus’ Exodus jump module, offering greater reliability to help take your wanderlust to new heights.

lore.name: Exodus-10 Laser Beam
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Type: Laser Beam Size: 10 Built in conjunction with the engineers at Aegis, this bespoke laser beam weapon from Hurston Dynamics is highly accurate, giving the Idris-K a devastating weapon in its arsenal.

lore.name: ExoGen
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Military Simple and direct, the ExoGen generates power in traditional A&R style: no fuss, just solid craftsmanship.

lore.name: Expedition
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian Cruise through space confident that your perfectly balanced Expedition quantum drive from Tarsus will get you exactly where you’re going.

lore.name: Expired Quantanium Fuel Canister
lore.description: This container from the QV Extraction Facility's operational days contains quantanium fuel that has been improperly stored causing a chemical anomaly in the fuel.

lore.name: Explorer
lore.description: Item Type: Jump Module Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian Journey across the ‘verse with Tarsus’ Explorer jump module, offering greater reliability to help take your wanderlust to new heights.

lore.name: Eyaja Knife
lore.description: Manufacturer: Banu Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: 16 cm Worthy of any celebration, this Banu-crafted knife features a subtle s-curve along its length with a layered hand-forged blade, a central spine finger-hole, and a golden-hued handle. Intricate filigree is woven throughout the piece and a vibrant blue gemstone adorns the pommel.

lore.name: F&V Blend Smoothie
lore.description: HEI: 35 NDR: 14 Effects: Immune Boosting A smoothie made with a fresh blend of fruits and vegetables.

lore.name: F1M-Fireshot
lore.description: Designed to attach to most medium combat armor sets, the Fireshot is an EVA upgrade system that provides a little more thrust and control than usual. The understated components are designed to maintain your profile, so you don't sacrifice mobility or combat effectiveness.

lore.name: F1S-Fireshot
lore.description: Designed to attach to most light combat armor sets, the Fireshot is an EVA upgrade system that provides added control in vacuum while the understated components maintain your profile, so you don't sacrifice mobility or combat effectiveness.

lore.name: F55 "Alpine Sunset" LMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Item Type: LMG Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 150 Rate Of Fire: 1000 rpm Effective Range: 30 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S3) Featuring an explosive rate of fire that tops at a 1000 rpm and Gemini's sleek and professional styling, the F55 is a light machine gun for discerning clientele who want the 'verse to know that they are not to be trifled with. This special green and red Alpine Sunset edition is sure to make a great Luminalia gift for your loved ones.

lore.name: F55 LMG Magazine (150 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 150 This magazine for the Gemini F55 LMG holds one hundred and fifty 5mm rounds.

lore.name: F8 Lightning 2956 Auspicious Red Rat Livery
lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Rat livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a rat.

lore.name: F8 Lightning Auspicious Red Livery
lore.description: The Auspicious Red livery brings a bold red base paint and striking gold accents to the F8 Lightning.

lore.name: F8 Lightning Nightweaver Livery
lore.description: Bring a distinct look to the F8 Lightning with the Nightweaver livery. It features a black fuselage intersected by green highlights in a unique and irregular pattern.

lore.name: F8C Lightning 2954 Best in Show Livery
lore.description: This purple and white 2954 Best in Show Livery celebrates the F8C Lightning winning the 2954 Ship Showdown.

lore.name: F8C Lightning 2954 Ship Showdown Holographic Flag
lore.description: Though the 2954 Ship Showdown may be over, your memories of the F8C Lightning taking the top spot can last thanks to this large holographic standing flag honoring the winner.

lore.name: F8C Lightning 2954 Ship Showdown Poster
lore.description: Congratulations to the F8C Lightning for winning the 2954 Ship Showdown. This poster honors the Lightning, a ship that has protected Humanity countless times from countless threats at home and far from civilization.

lore.name: F8C Lightning Shock Wave Livery
lore.description: Turn heads and the tides of battle with the Shock Wave livery for the F8C Lightning. Featuring a striking green color with black highlights, the livery provides a dramatic and distinct look to a ship that's both a beauty and a beast.

lore.name: F8C Lightning Stormfire Livery
lore.description: Cut a classic profile through any battlefield with the Stormfire livery for Anvil's new F8C Lightning. Featuring a triple-coat of Kalding paint rated for a variety of atmospheres and conditions, this sleek platinum look will keep you looking good for years to come.

lore.name: Fabian
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 0 Grade: A Class: Civilian Utilizing best-in-class scanning technology, the Fabian radar ensures you won't be caught unaware.

lore.name: Face Melter T-Shirt
lore.description: This shirt from CBD features an athletic cut and an eye-catching dripping skull graphic. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Faction Jacket Purple
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Whether you're coasting through outdoor adventures or cruising to exclusive afterparties, the Faction coat is sure to turn heads. Fusing sections of ultra-insulated brick quilting with 987's DuraBull ripstop reinforced fabric, you'll stay warm while still looking cool.

lore.name: Fade with Braids
lore.description: A high fade with braids and a bun to top it all off.

lore.name: Falco
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: YORM Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Competition Falco is the perfect shield generator for those always on the go. Its lightweight build won’t hurt your top speed, while still being able to absorb enough damage for you to make your escape.

lore.name: Falston Jumpsuit
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Falston jumpsuit has a high collar to guard against the elements, triple-reinforced stitching, and an extra soft interior lining because everyone deserves a bit of comfort.

lore.name: Falston Jumpsuit "ASD Edition"
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Falston jumpsuit has a high collar to guard against the elements, triple-reinforced stitching, and an extra soft interior lining because everyone deserves a bit of comfort. The ASD Edition features the deep greens and reds associated with research company.

lore.name: Falston Jumpsuit "ASD Technician"
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Falston jumpsuit has a high collar to guard against the elements, triple-reinforced stitching, and an extra soft interior lining because everyone deserves a bit of comfort. The ASD Technician version is white with green detailing.

lore.name: Falston Jumpsuit "People's Alliance Edition"
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Falston jumpsuit has a high collar to guard against the elements, triple-reinforced stitching, and an extra soft interior lining because everyone deserves a bit of comfort. The People's Alliance edition features a dark green color with the People's Alliance logo on the back.

lore.name: FarSight "Darkwave" (8x Telescopic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: VOLT Type: Telescopic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 8x Aim Time: +0% Size: 3 Designed for long distance precision shooting, the FarSight is carefully crafted to provide unparalleled fidelity of targets. VOLT's TruePicture lens technology provides high levels of light transmission, ensuring easy target acquisition and daylight illumination so you always get your mark. This Darkwave edition draws attention to the sharp contours and edges of the rifle's design.

lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Civilian The Fawad entry-level radar from WillsOp is the perfect choice for someone who is looking for a no-frills signature detection system perfect for everyday use.

lore.name: FBL-8a Arms (Modified)
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -35 / 65 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Based on CDS' FBL-8a combat armor, this set has been modified from its original form. This light armor will keep you fast on your feet with its strategic mix of protective plating and reinforced nano-weave fabrics. While the armor works with any undersuit, it was specifically designed to match the FBL-8u undersuit with special attention given to how the two fit together to make the set as streamlined and responsive as possible.

lore.name: FBL-8u Undersuit SecondWind
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% The FBL-8u is the first CDS undersuit to utilize the manufacturers new orb-weave technology that produces an impressively light yet strong material that can withstand the rigors of space travel. Originally developed to pair perfectly with CDS's FBL-8a light armor, it remains compatible with other armor sets. To honor those who came to Orison's aid in its time of need, the SecondWind edition compliments the undersuit with a navy blue base adorned with a sleek, gray accents.

lore.name: Ferric
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Saga Datasystems Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Industrial Innovation never ends at Saga Datasystems. The Ferric computer was specifically refined to suit industrial ships and all their processing needs.

lore.name: Festive Kopion Display
lore.description: This festive light display brings a bit of mirth to your holiday decorations with its charming depiction of a fierce kopion. Perfect for the wildlife appreciator in your life.

lore.name: Feynmaline
lore.description: The paramorphic crystalline structure of this mineral is extremely volatile. When extra energy is introduced, as is typical with modern mining, the ore will often explosively degrade into the more stably structured Janalite. This instability makes Feynamline very dangerous to acquire but also extremely valuable as an industrial anti-matter precursor if it can be properly harvested.

lore.name: Fhaal Fire Kacho
lore.description: NDR: 30 Effects: None Big Benny's kacho is based on traditional family recipes straight from Corel, combining springy noodles and a rich, warm broth to create a taste enjoyed the 'verse over. The Fhaal Fire flavor takes heat to another level with its bold spice blend.

lore.name: Fidele
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Groupe Nouveau Paradigme Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Military Focusing on the core features of a radar, the Fidele operates efficiently even in battle conditions.

lore.name: Field Medic Kit
lore.description: Medical emergencies can happen any time, any place. Be prepared with this Field Medic Kit from Curelife which provides convenient and portable storage for a ParaMed Medical Device, Pancea MedGel refills, and additional medicine injectors.

lore.name: Field Medic Kit
lore.description: Medical emergencies can happen any time, any place. Be prepared with this Field Medic Kit from Curelife which provides convenient and portable storage for a ParaMed Medical Device, Pancea MedGel refills, and additional medicine injectors.

lore.name: Field Recon Suit Arms
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -35 / 65 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s CDS’ Field Recon Suit is the perfect solution for the combat operator who wants a little extra protection without compromising any of their situational agility. EdgeCore composite plating is strategically sewn into the nano-weave suit to cover vital organs while keeping the suit flexible.

lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp.
