lore.name: FieldLite "Scorched" Flashlight
lore.description: Manufacturer: NV-TAC Type: Flashlight Attachment Point: Underbarrel Size: 1 The FieldLite is a tough and tactical underbarrel flashlight. Featuring a corrosion-proof body and impact resistant lens, NV-TAC tested the attachment across a variety of environments and conditions to ensure it works when needed most. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

lore.name: FieldLite Flashlight
lore.description: Manufacturer: NV-TAC Type: Flashlight Attachment Point: Underbarrel Size: 1 The FieldLite is a tough and tactical underbarrel flashlight. Featuring a corrosion-proof body and impact resistant lens, NV-TAC tested the attachment across a variety of environments and conditions to ensure it works when needed most.

lore.name: FieldLite Flashlight Blue
lore.description: Manufacturer: NV-TAC Type: Flashlight Attachment Point: Underbarrel Size: 1 The FieldLite Blue is a tough and tactical underbarrel flashlight. Featuring a corrosion-proof body and impact resistant lens, NV-TAC tested the attachment across a variety of environments and conditions to ensure it works when needed most. This special Blue edition projects a focused blue light in the shape of a square. The molded lens keeps falloff to a minimum, making it perfect for illuminating targets at distance.

lore.name: FieldLite Flashlight Red
lore.description: Manufacturer: NV-TAC Type: Flashlight Attachment Point: Underbarrel Size: 1 The FieldLite Red is a tough and tactical underbarrel flashlight. Featuring a corrosion-proof body and impact resistant lens, NV-TAC tested the attachment across a variety of environments and conditions to ensure it works when needed most. This special Red edition projects a red light in the shape of a circle. Ideal for situations when illumination on close range targets is essential without projecting a bright light that could be easily spotted.

lore.name: FieldLite Flashlight Yellow
lore.description: Manufacturer: NV-TAC Type: Flashlight Attachment Point: Underbarrel Size: 1 The FieldLite Yellow is a tough and tactical underbarrel flashlight. Featuring a corrosion-proof body and impact resistant lens, NV-TAC tested the attachment across a variety of environments and conditions to ensure it works when needed most. This special Yellow edition projects a scattered yellow starlike pattern making it preferable for target acquisition at medium distance.

lore.name: Fieldsbury Dark Bear Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Helmet Damage Reduction: 10% Temp. Rating: -40 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Celebrate Day of the Vara in sinister style with this officially licensed Fieldsbury Dark Bear helmet. This twisted version of the Fieldsbury Bear mascot launched a seasonal soda flavor before being co-opted into a series of high-profile pranks. Ever since, the bear's big, toothy grin and off-set flickering eyes have become a standard sight at Day of the Vara celebrations. Now CC's Conversions has designed and delivered an official, high quality reproduction of this iconic mascot, available in six striking colors.

lore.name: Fierell Cascade
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Military Rely on Aegis’ expertise to power your ship. The Fierell Cascade is a military-grade power plant that prioritizes performance over everything else.

lore.name: Finley Mascot Costume
lore.description: A large, soft plush costume of Crusader's beloved mascot Finley the Stormwal. Made exclusively for Crusader Industries to greet and welcome visitors to the floating city of Orison.

lore.name: Finley the Stormwal Bath Float
lore.description: Space isn't the only place for Finley the Stormwal anymore. Crusader's cute mascot can now also surf the suds in your bathtub with this fun bath float.

lore.name: Finley the Stormwal Large Luminalia Plushie
lore.description: Finley the Stormwal loves Luminalia so much they even gets dressed up for the occasion. This festive and large Finley plushie is decked out in red and green, making them an excellent guest for any Luminalia celebration.

lore.name: Finley the Stormwal Large Plushie
lore.description: Finley the Stormwal loves sailing through the clouds in Crusader's atmosphere. Much like Crusader's ships, Finley is big, graceful, and quite the sight to behold. Now this majestic blue stormwal can accompany you on a journey through the stars with this large, soft, and squeezable plushie.

lore.name: Finley the Stormwal Luminalia Plushie
lore.description: Finley the Stormwal loves Luminalia so much they even gets dressed up for the occasion. This festive Finley plushie is decked out in red and green, making them an excellent guest for any Luminalia celebration.

lore.name: Finley the Stormwal Mug
lore.description: Made from durable stoneware, the Finley the Stormwal mug features the mascot's iconic grin and inquisitive eyes. This fun mug will keep beverages warm and bring a smile to your face.

lore.name: Finley the Stormwal Plushie
lore.description: Finley the Stormwal loves sailing through the clouds in Crusader's atmosphere. Much like Crusader's ships, Finley is big, graceful, and quite the sight to behold. Now this majestic creature can accompany you on a journey through the stars with this soft and squeezable plushie.

lore.name: Firestorm Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Cannon Class: Energy (Microwave) Battery Size: 50 Rate Of Fire: N / A (Beam) Effective Range: 30 m Attachments: Optics (N/A), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (N/A) The Firestorm from Kastak Arms is a portable heavy microwave cannon. This long range weapon system fires a continuous beam, capable of eliminating hostiles without damaging the environment.

lore.name: Fireworks
lore.description: Colorful pyrotechnic devices used at celebrations and special events.

lore.name: FirmWear Hard Hat
lore.description: The FirmWear helmet is ready to go to work with you. Stegman's use of armor-rated plastic will keep it light on your head while still delivering top-of-the-line protection.

lore.name: FirmWear SoundGuard Hard Hat
lore.description: The FirmWear SoundGuard helmet is ready to go to work with you. Stegman's use of armor-rated plastic alloys keeps it light on your head while still delivering top-of-the-line protection. The SoundGuard edition includes earcups that you can comfortably wear all day when noise reduction is essential.

lore.name: First Contact Day ’54 Coin
lore.description: Celebrate the diversity of our universe with this special coin commissioned for the 2954 anniversary of First Contact Day. One side of the coin features “First Contact” written in Xi’an while the opposing side displays the same escribed in Banu.

lore.name: Fish Tank
lore.description: This beautifully decorated tank comes from the Ten Thousand Seas Corporation. Stock it with exotic fish from across the 'verse to build a collection that will be the envy of all your friends.

lore.name: Fissure
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: ArcCorp Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Civilian Spool up the Fissure and speed through space with the component ArcCorp claims has successfully completed billions of quantum travels over the centuries.

lore.name: Fissure
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: ArcCorp Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Civilian Spool up the Fissure and speed through space with the component ArcCorp claims has successfully completed billions of quantum travels over the centuries.

lore.name: Fizzz Cola
lore.description: HEI: 16 Effects: Energizing, Hyper-Metabolic A refreshing burst of fizzzy cola flavor!

lore.name: Fizzz Muscat
lore.description: HEI: 16 Effects: Energizing, Hyper-Metabolic A refreshing burst of fizzzy muscat flavor!

lore.name: Fizzz Peach
lore.description: HEI: 16 Effects: Energizing, Hyper-Metabolic A refreshing burst of fizzzy peach flavor!

lore.name: Fizzz Soursop
lore.description: HEI: 16 Effects: Energizing, Hyper-Metabolic A refreshing burst of fizzzy soursop flavor!

lore.name: Fizzz Triple Berry
lore.description: HEI: 16 Effects: Energizing, Hyper-Metabolic A refreshing burst of fizzzy triple berry flavor!

lore.name: FL-11 Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kroneg Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 1 Deliver massive damage from a distance with Kroneg's FL line of laser cannons. The FL-11 might shoot slow but provides considerable firepower for a size one weapon.

lore.name: FL-22 Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kroneg Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 2 Deliver massive damage from a distance with Kroneg's FL line of laser cannons. The size two FL-22 shines at medium and long ranges thanks to a design that minimizes damage falloff.

lore.name: FL-33 Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kroneg Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 4 With a steady hand and a sharp eye, there are few similarly classed laser autocannons that can out perform Kroneg's FL-33. This versatile, high-yield weapon was constructed with newly designed compensators to deliver damage at long ranges.

lore.name: FL-33 Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kroneg Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 3 Deliver massive damage from a distance with Kroneg's FL line of laser cannons. Embodying Kroneg's practical design philosophy, the FL-33 remains one of the most reliable and destructive size three laser cannons currently available.

lore.name: Flareweed Stalk
lore.description: Flareweed is a hearty plant that can survive in harsh environments. With a natural ability to filter out harmful elements from its water supply, flareweed stalks are frequently harvested to be used in filtration systems.

lore.name: Flash
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: ArcCorp Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Civilian With improved spooling and calibration, the new ArcCorp Flash drive can get you in and out of quantum easier and faster.

lore.name: FlashFreeze
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Civilian With the FlashFreeze, Lightning Power makes sure that no matter how hot things get, you can rely on its proven cooling technology to keep you flying.

lore.name: Flatcat Fail T-Shirt
lore.description: A Banu souli used special vid-capable fabric when designing this shirt so it loops the Flatcat Fail vid Humans find so funny at a super high resolution!

lore.name: Fleming
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Civilian The Fleming is WillsOp’s base small radar. What it lacks in bells and whistles, it makes up for with consistent performance.

lore.name: Flood
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: ArcCorp Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Civilian Experience the true joy of the journey with the Flood. This small quantum drive from ArcCorp has been a staple around the Empire for years.

lore.name: Flood Energy
lore.description: HEI: 18 Effects: Dehydrating, Cognitive Boosting Release a Flood of stimulants throughout your body with each swallow of this scientifically crafted formula of enhancing ingredients and energizing flavors designed to take you 'Beyond Normal.'

lore.name: Fluorine
lore.description: A toxic and highly reactive gas that appears pale yellow in its natural state. Very easily forms compounds with almost all other elements.

lore.name: FocalWave-10 (1x Holographic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: VOLT Type: Holographic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 1x Aim Time: +8% Parallax: Very Low Size: 1 Manufactured to provide crucial combat information in real-time, the FocalWave-10 features a precise targeting reticle, as well as an enhanced visual display that tracks the heat and charge of your weapon.

lore.name: FocalWave-20 (2x Holographic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: VOLT Type: Holographic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 2x Aim Time: +8% Parallax: Low Size: 1 Providing increased magnification than its previous counterpart, the FocalWave-20 features a down-the-sight visual that tracks the heat and charge of your weapon.

lore.name: FocalWave-30 (3x Holographic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: VOLT Type: Holographic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 3x Aim Time: +8% Parallax: Low Size: 1 The FocalWave-30 provides enhanced vision to engage targets at close and medium distances. In addition, your weapon's heat and charge is displayed in the lens optics offering enhanced combat awareness.

lore.name: Food
lore.description: Any substance that can be safely consumed by a living organism for the purpose of nutritional support.

lore.name: ForceFlex Undersuit Black/Gold
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% Virgil's ForceFlex is the next generation in undersuit technology. Rated for combat as well as industrial work, you can rest assured that the comboweave will keep you protected in whatever situation you put it through.

lore.name: ForceFlex Undersuit Skeleton
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% Virgil's ForceFlex is the next generation in undersuit technology. Rated for combat as well as industrial work, you can rest assured that the comboweave will keep you protected in whatever situation you put it through. Indulge in Day of the Vara hijinks with the Skeleton edition, featuring a double-sided skeleton graphic atop a black base.

lore.name: ForceWall
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Gorgon Defender Industries Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Military Want to stay in the thick of battle a bit longer? Gorgon’s ForceWall is a military-grade shield generator that’s able to absorb more damage, providing a notable uptick to your shield’s durability.

lore.name: Forgiveness Sweater
lore.description: This Luminalia, don't just strengthen your bonds with physical presents. Remember to offer your friends and family the most important thing you can: the gift of forgiveness. Featuring a cheeky member of the Nine Tails gang that has been causing havoc in the Stanton system, this collab from MuyMuy and Vaporwear shows that during the holiday season, anyone can turn over a new leaf.

lore.name: Fortifier Helmet Maroon
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -80 / 110 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Protect your most valuable asset with the Fortifier. Intended for extremely hostile environments, this heavy helmet makes up for its limited visibility with extra plating that protects the neck and back of the head.

lore.name: Fortifier Helmet Neoni Mod
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -80 / 110 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Show that you serve no master with the Neoni modification for the Fortifier helmet. Drawing inspiration from the myths of old, this menacing variant of the Kastak Arms Fortifier features a devilish paint job, fang-filled grin, and pointed horns. Providing protection and intimidation in one memorable helmet. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Fortitude
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Industrial Beloved by haulers for centuries, the Fortitude lives up to its name by reliably producing power when needed most.

lore.name: Fortune 2955 Auspicious Red Pig Livery
lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Pig livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a pig.

lore.name: Fortune 2955 Auspicious Red Snake Livery
lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Snake livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a snake.

lore.name: Fortune Highlander Livery
lore.description: A deep, earthen green dominates the Fortune Highlander livery, accompanied by a unique copper tinted cockpit.

lore.name: Fortune Hightide Livery
lore.description: Oceanic blues drench the Hightide livery, with strong blacks and greys deepening the Fortune's impact further.

lore.name: Fortune Iceberg Livery
lore.description: Black and white paints juxtapose each other across the Iceberg livery, with a sleek blue finish around the Fortune's more shapely areas.

lore.name: Fortune Lovestruck Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a iridescent pink and black look for your Fortune.

lore.name: Fortune Luminance Livery
lore.description: The cool white of the Fortune Luminance livery are offset by metallic greys and bright dashes of yellow.

lore.name: Fortune Outcast Livery (Modified)
lore.description: This version of the livery has been modified from its original form with the addition of graffiti. Embrace chaos with the Outcast livery. It features rough splashes of neon green against black to give the Fortune an aggressively chaotic appearance.

lore.name: Fortune Reserve Livery
lore.description: A subtle tan accent cuts through an otherwise all black appearance in the Fortune Reserve livery.

lore.name: Fortune Sunspot Livery
lore.description: The deep contrast of the warm orange against the cold black of the Sunspot livery highlights the distinctive profile of the Fortune.

lore.name: Fortune Windfall Livery
lore.description: Make a lasting impression while sailing the stars in your Fortune with the Windfall livery's stunning copper finish.

lore.name: Fotia Seedpod
lore.description: The fotia scrub relies on solar flares for its reproduction. Rather than having traditional stamen and pollen, it allows radiation from flares to mutate its genetics before releasing its seedpod. Some enterprising individuals seek out and collect the seedpods because of their natural radiological properties that can be utilized in various ways.

lore.name: Foundation Festival '54 Coin
lore.description: This 2954 Foundation Festival coin honors those volunteers who endeavor to strengthen their community through charitable acts and features the program's distinct winged torch logo.

lore.name: Foundation Festival Beanie Teal
lore.description: Show your solidarity and commitment to forging a brighter future for the UEE with this Foundation Festival beanie. Made from high-quality cashmere spun on Angeli, this double layer beanie is ultrasoft, warm, and features the Foundation Festival logo on the front.

lore.name: Foundation Festival Hat Grey
lore.description: Celebrate the nations of Earth joining together to explore the stars with this special Foundation Festival hat featuring the logo across the front panel.

lore.name: Foundation Pants (Modified)
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU This version of DMC's Foundation pants has been modified from its original form. DMC's Foundation line is just that; the foundation for your work wear. Featuring a simple, elegant cut with easy-access pockets, the Foundation is both professional and functional.

lore.name: Foundation Pants Grey
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU DMC's Foundation line is just that; the foundation for your work wear. Featuring a simple, elegant cut with easy-access pockets, the Foundation is both professional and functional. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Foundation Undersuit
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 10% Greycat's Foundation is just that, their long-standing industrial undersuit has been tested in every kind of worksite imaginable. It's basic, functional and dependable. While that might not sound like much to a marketing team, it makes all the difference to the workers trusting their lives to it day in and day out.

lore.name: FoxFire
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Ace Astrogation Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Competition The FoxFire won't leave a burning trail in your wake, but this quantum drive’s strong performance leaves an equal impression. Making it another elegant and powerful component from the folks at Ace Astrogation.

lore.name: FR-66
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Gorgon Defender Industries Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Military The FR-66 is one of the most versatile small shield generator currently on the market. Get military strength protection and performance from Gorgon Defender Industries to ensure your ship can survive any onslaught.

lore.name: FR-76
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Gorgon Defender Industries Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Military Refined by years of extensive, real world testing by the military, Gorgon Defender Industries FR-76 is the ultimate shield generator. Perfect for everyone from folks defending the frontline to those exploring the frontier.

lore.name: FR-86
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Gorgon Defender Industries Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Military Gorgon’s FR-86 is tried, tested, and trusted. No other large shield generator delivers both exceptional performance and durability to this degree.

lore.name: Fractus Gloves Maroon
lore.description: Developed for work sites, but refined enough for everyday use, the Fractus gloves layer StretchStrong fabric for a tight yet breathable fit. Reinforced knuckle plating and scaled fingertips provide extra durability and a stylish flourish.

lore.name: Francis the Party Animal Plushie
lore.description: There's only one thing Francis the Stormwal loves more than sailing through the clouds in Crusader's atmosphere and that's a good party. Make Francis the featured guest at your next event with this soft and squeezable plushie that's already wearing a hat fit for the occasion.

lore.name: Francis the Stormwal Large Plushie
lore.description: Francis the Stormwal loves sailing through the clouds in Crusader's atmosphere. Much like Crusader's ships, Francis is big, graceful, and quite the sight to behold. Now this majestic purple stormwal can accompany you on a journey through the stars with this large, soft, and squeezable plushie.

lore.name: Francis the Stormwal Plushie
lore.description: Francis the Stormwal loves sailing through the clouds in Crusader's atmosphere. Much like Crusader's ships, Francis is big, graceful, and quite the sight to behold. Now this majestic creature can accompany you on a journey through the stars with this soft and squeezable plushie.

lore.name: Franz Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 4K µSCU The Franz monochrome striped pants from CBD are elevated with the addition of bold black brush strokes applied freehand. Men's sizes currently not available.

lore.name: Freelancer 2951 Auspicious Red Ram Livery
lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the 2951 Auspicious Red Ram livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complimented by gold accents and a silhouette of a ram's head.

lore.name: Freelancer ArcCorp Livery
lore.description: The ArcCorp livery for the Freelancer features the company's logo atop a maroon base paint with black and yellow highlights.

lore.name: Freelancer Big Benny's Livery
lore.description: Let Big Benny spice up the look of your Freelancer with this orange and brown livery featuring the famous smiling bowl of kacho and Benny's motto "Grab Eat!"

lore.name: Freelancer Black Livery
lore.description: Customize your Freelancer with this black chrome livery.

lore.name: Freelancer Crusader Livery
lore.description: The Crusader livery for the Freelancer features the company's logo atop a light blue base paint with black and white highlights.

lore.name: Freelancer Deck the Hull Livery
lore.description: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.

lore.name: Freelancer Ellroy's Livery
lore.description: Ready to give your Freelancer a jolt of energy? The iconic, coffee serving mascot pops on the Ellroy's livery, which is primarily crisp white with red and black highlights.

lore.name: Freelancer Foundation Guide Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Freelancer Hurston Livery
lore.description: The Hurston livery for the Freelancer features the company's logo atop a grey base paint with yellow highlights.

lore.name: Freelancer IceBreak Livery
lore.description: Equip your Freelancer with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

lore.name: Freelancer microTech Livery
lore.description: The microTech livery for the Freelancer features the company's logo atop a white base paint with light blue and grey highlights.

lore.name: Freelancer Poster
lore.description: Got the itch to live a life of freedom among the stars? This MISC Freelancer poster will showcase your adventurous spirit!

lore.name: Freelancer Star Kitten Livery
lore.description: Bring joy and a pastel palette to the Freelancer with the Star Kitten livery, which features bright pink and pale blue alongside images of the famous cartoon space cat Sally.

lore.name: Freelancer Storm Surge Livery
lore.description: Customize your Freelancer with this fragmented blue livery.

lore.name: Freelancer Whammer's Livery
lore.description: Cravin' a special look for your Freelancer? Then equip this Whammer's branded black and red paint scheme and have yourself a good time.

lore.name: Freelancer Woodland Livery
lore.description: Customize your Freelancer with this fragmented light green livery.

lore.name: Freeze
lore.description: A synthetic tranquilizer used for muscle therapy that causes very heavy sedation in the user while also activating the nerve endings in their muscles. Originally created as a way to rebuild damaged/rebuilt muscle tissue, it found another use as a sedative weight-loss supplement, and when in a concentrated form, as a party drug.

lore.name: Fresh Food
lore.description: Various meats, grains and produce that have not yet been cooked, dried, salted, frozen, pickled, or otherwise preserved.

lore.name: Fresh Garden Smoothie
lore.description: HEI: 39 NDR: 15 Effects: Immune Boosting Garcia's Greens Fresh Garden Smoothie is a tasty rainbow picked from nature’s finest and freshest ingredients.

lore.name: Fresnel "Deepwater" Energy LMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: LMG Class: Energy (Electron) Battery Size: 165 Rate of Fire: 550 rpm - 220 rpm Effective Range: 50m Attachments: Optics (S3), Underbarrel (S3) The engineers at VOLT crafted the Fresnel LMG to bring a powerful energy weapon to the frontlines, one that can initiate a fight with a rapid spray of deadly blasts. As the weapon heats up, the shots become slower and more powerful, but be careful of overheating. A weapon of this magnitude demands a strong foundation; operators are encouraged to fire from a crouching position to allow for better recoil management. The Deepwater edition combines a weathered blue with profound black features.

lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: LMG Class: Energy (Electron) Battery Size: 165 Rate of Fire: 550 rpm - 220 rpm Effective Range: 50m Attachments: Optics (S3), Underbarrel (S3) The engineers at VOLT crafted the Fresnel LMG to bring a powerful energy weapon to the frontlines, one that can initiate a fight with a rapid spray of deadly blasts. lore.name: Fresnel Energy LMG Battery (165 Cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Battery Capacity: 165 This battery for the Fresnel Energy LMG holds enough energy for 165 shots.

lore.name: Fridan
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Wen/Cassel Propulsion Size: 0 Grade: C Class: Civilian The Fridan is Wen/Cassel Propulsion’s entry-level vehicle cooler. It has proven time and again that it can withstand even the worst environmental conditions, making it an ideal component for your vehicle.

lore.name: Fried Seanut
lore.description: NDR: 15 Effects: Dehydrating Easy to grow and care for, these tubular sea creatures have become a popular food in the outer reaches of systems. This seanut has been fried and has a salty, roasted flavor.

lore.name: Fried Seanut with Sauce
lore.description: NDR: 15 Effects: Dehydrating Easy to grow and care for, these tubular sea creatures have become a popular food in the outer reaches of systems. This seanut has been fried and topped with a vinegar-based sauce for a salty, roasted and tangy taste.

lore.name: Fringe Up
lore.description: Professional, yet stylish.

lore.name: Frontier 05 Pants Classic
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU DMC's Frontier collection has been a staple of frontier living for centuries. These heavy denim workpants have double-stitched reinforcement and stainguard technology, making them dependable pants for any environment day in and day out.

lore.name: Frontier 11 Classic Sand
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2k µSCU Constructed with large pockets and made from durable synth-cloth, the Frontier 11 Classic pants from DMC are a rugged garment designed to handle whatever life might throw your way.

lore.name: Frontier Pants (Modified)
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU This version of DMC's Frontier pants has been modified from its original form. DMC's Frontier collection has been a staple of frontier living for centuries. These heavy denim workpants have double-stitched reinforcement and stainguard technology, making them dependable pants for any environment day in and day out.

lore.name: Frontline
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 4 This capital-class quantum drive was designed specifically for the Idris frigate.

lore.name: Frost-Star
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: J-Span Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian Noted for its consistent performance, the Frost-Star cooler from J-Span has many admirers for its well-balanced power to heat ratio.

lore.name: Frost-Star EX
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: J-Span Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian The Frost-Star EX cooler comes to you from J-Span, a manufacturer with a well deserved reputation among ship owners for constructing coolers that can reliably handle heat exchange wherever you may fly.

lore.name: Frost-Star SL
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: J-Span Size: 0 Grade: C Class: Civilian Whether cruising across the ground or sailing through space, there’s a J-Span cooler perfect for you. The Frost-Star SL is a mid-tier cooler designed to bring the line’s reliability to ground and open-canopy vehicles.

lore.name: Frost-Star XL
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: J-Span Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Civilian As your ship flies, components generate heat that can be damaging and even lead to system failures unless properly dealt with by a dependable and properly designed cooler like the Frost-Star XL from J-Span.

lore.name: FrostBite
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian Keep your ship running smoothly with the Lightning Power FrostBite handling your thermal management needs. This consumer-grade cooler can process extra-heat and help maintain optimal running temperatures for all your components.

lore.name: FrostBurn
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Civilian Lightning Power Ltd. has put its years of design expertise and manufacturing know-how to craft the FrostBurn, an effective cooler that can handle the large scale heat management needs of a wide variety of ships on the market.

lore.name: FS-9 "Blacklist" LMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: LMG Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 75 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 40 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S3) Behring designed the FS-9 to be an overwhelming battlefield force. This light machine gun features a full auto mode that makes it ideal for laying down covering fire or holding back advancing enemies. The FS-9 is also acclaimed for its ability to maintain accuracy while unleashing sustained fire. The Blacklist edition features a dark black finish.

lore.name: FS-9 "Evergreen" LMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: LMG Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 75 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 40 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S3) Behring designed the FS-9 to be an overwhelming battlefield force. This light machine gun features a full auto mode that makes it ideal for laying down covering fire or holding back advancing enemies. The FS-9 is also acclaimed for its ability to maintain accuracy while unleashing sustained fire. The Evergreen edition embraces the Luminalia spirit by using a tradition holiday color with its vibrant green tint.

lore.name: FS-9 "Finish Line" LMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: LMG Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 75 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 40 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S3) Behring designed the FS-9 to be an overwhelming battlefield force. This light machine gun features a full auto mode that makes it ideal for laying down covering fire or holding back advancing enemies. The FS-9 is also acclaimed for its ability to maintain accuracy while unleashing sustained fire. Updated with new yellow and grey coloring, this special Finish Line edition is an homage to starship racing.

lore.name: FS-9 "Stoneface" LMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: LMG Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 75 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 40 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S3) Behring designed the FS-9 to be an overwhelming battlefield force. The FS-9 is also acclaimed for its ability to maintain accuracy while unleashing sustained fire. This entry in the Legendary Bounty Hunters line had famed tracker Farook 'Stoneface' Norris design a look for his beloved FS-9 LMG featuring striking pops of red against a grey base tint.

lore.name: FS-9 LMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: LMG Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 75 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 40 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S3) Behring designed the FS-9 to be an overwhelming battlefield force. lore.name: FS-9 Magazine (75 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 75 This magazine for the Behring FS-9 LMG holds seventy five 5mm rounds.

lore.name: FS-9H HMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: HMG Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 80 Rate Of Fire: 400 rpm Effective Range: 60 m Attachments: Optics (N/A), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S4) Behring's vaunted craftsmanship and use of precision parts means the FS-9H heavy machine gun can withstand the heat of battle while still packing a potent punch. With a slow and steady rate of automatic fire, the FS-9H blasts 7mm ballistic shells that remain effective at distances up to 60 meters.

lore.name: FS-9H Magazine (80 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 80 This magazine for the Behring FS-9H HMG holds eighty 7mm rounds.

lore.name: FSK-8 "Bloodline" Combat Knife
lore.description: Manufacturer: UltiFlex Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: 16 cm The FSK-8 Combat Knife from UltiFlex is as sparse a weapon as you can get. While many become enamored with dazzling tech of modern weaponry, UltiFlex has focused on making a simple effective combat tool. Featuring a balanced 1055 carbon steel blade honed to a razor's edge, this knife is capable of handling all the abuse you can throw at it.

lore.name: FSK-8 "Ghost" Combat Knife
lore.description: Manufacturer: UltiFlex Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: 16 cm The FSK-8 Combat Knife from UltiFlex is as sparse a weapon as you can get. lore.description: Manufacturer: UltiFlex Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: 16 cm The FSK-8 Combat Knife from UltiFlex is as sparse a weapon as you can get. While many become enamored with dazzling tech of modern weaponry, UltiFlex has focused on making a simple effective combat tool. Featuring a balanced 1055 carbon steel blade honed to a razor's edge, this knife is capable of handling all the abuse you can throw at it.

lore.name: FSK-8 Combat Knife
lore.description: Manufacturer: UltiFlex Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: 16 cm The FSK-8 Combat Knife from UltiFlex is as sparse a weapon as you can get. lore.name: Fuel Intake
lore.description: This Fuel Intake replenishes the hydrogen fuel stores for the Mauler to keep its tanks full during combat maneuvers.

lore.name: Fulgur
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Military Tried and tested by the UEE Navy on the Vanduul front, the Fulgur large power plant from Aegis Dynamics is now available for all to put to use protecting what’s important.

lore.name: FullBlock
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Gorgon Defender Industries Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Military Crafted by former residents of Caliban, Gorgon’s FullBlock large shield generator has been repeatedly put to the test by members of the military and public. That means you can count on it regardless of what you come up against.

lore.name: FullForce
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian This power plant from Lightning Power Ltd. delivers balanced performance, durability and emissions, providing consumers with a “FullForce” of options as to how to use it.

lore.name: FullForce
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian This power plant from Lightning Power Ltd. delivers balanced performance, durability and emissions, providing consumers with a “FullForce” of options as to how to use it.

lore.name: FullForce Pro
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Civilian Even though Lightning Power Ltd has updated the look of the FullForce Pro power plant, it still delivers that same balanced performance people have come to expect.

lore.name: FullFrost
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Civilian Proper thermal management and heat distribution is a concern for any pilot who cares about the longevity and performance of their ship. Now you can fly easy knowing you have the advanced FullFrost cooler by Lightning Power aboard.

lore.name: FullSpec
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Chimera Communications Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Industrial The FullSpec radar is considered by many to be one of the most dependable radar systems you can equip your rig with on the market today. Chimera Communications has worked hard to reduce false positives while improving consistency over range and the results speak for themselves.

lore.name: FullSpec-Go
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Chimera Communications Size: 0 Grade: A Class: Industrial Chimera Communications knows that for a high quality radar, consistency is key. The FullSpec-Go, specifically designed to offer clarity in the most hazardous of terrain, guarantees you'll get where you need to go without any surprises.

lore.name: FullSpec-Max
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Chimera Communications Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Industrial Keep your targets in your sights with the FullSpec-Max radar featuring advanced hard-working systems that excel at identifying potential threats.

lore.name: FullStop
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Gorgon Defender Industries Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Military Featuring proprietary recoil tech, the FullStop shield generator was built to better absorb attacks from a multitude of damage types.

lore.name: FUNT
lore.description: This powerful cryptokey is considered to be one of the highest caliber hacking tools available. Long rumored to have been originally designed for Advocacy use, these difficult to acquire devices have only recently been making its way into the hands of criminals. Most who have used them say they are worth the effort to acquire. With the cryptokey's official Advocacy designation unknown, the name FUNT is a shortening of the device's common descriptor - 'fast and untraceable.'

lore.name: Furtimo Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 500 µSCU The Furtimo pants are sleek, elegant, and under-stated, suitable to both a busy day at the office or a fancy night out. Soft beyond the measure, these pants will make you feel as good as you look.

lore.name: Fury Black Star Livery
lore.description: The Black Star livery gives the Fury a classic black finish with bold brand decals in silver.

lore.name: Fury Cloudburst Livery
lore.description: Go with the flow in your Fury with the Cloudburst livery, which blends blue and light grey for a distinct finish evoking the harmony between water and sky.

lore.name: Fury Fortuna Livery
lore.description: Make luck your co-pilot. Boldly set your sights on the stars and adventure forth in style with the Fortuna livery. This Stella Fortuna themed paint scheme is primarily green with grey accents.

lore.name: Fury Goldsmith Livery
lore.description: The Goldsmith livery features a floral pattern against an luxurious black and gold hull for an extravagant look.

lore.name: Fury Leatherback Livery
lore.description: Primarily green with red highlights, the Leatherback livery delivers style along with the intimidating payload of the Fury.

lore.name: Fury Nightwatch Livery
lore.description: Embrace the darkness of space with the Nightwatch livery for the Fury, which is grey and black with subtle gold highlights.

lore.name: Fury Racing Livery
lore.description: Pull away from the pack with this daring Racing livery for the Fury. Combining coral reds with an undercurrent of teal, you're guaranteed to grab the attention of those you overtake when racing in these bold colors.

lore.name: Fury Sunrise Livery
lore.description: Primarily white with red accents streaking across the ship, the design of the Sunrise livery gives the Fury an exciting, aerodynamic look.

lore.name: Fury Templar Livery
lore.description: Mirai made the Templar livery a stark white with red and black highlights to give the Fury a look that would be at home among the clouds.

lore.name: Fury Tengu Livery
lore.description: Announce the presence of the Fury with the Tengu livery, featuring a bold red look with black highlights.

lore.name: Fury Wasteland Camo Livery
lore.description: Outfit the Fury in tan camo with the Wasteland Camo livery.

lore.name: Fury Waverider Livery
lore.description: The Waverider livery gives the Fury a distinct blue finish with black highlights.

lore.name: Fuse
lore.description: This safety device provides protection to relays and other power systems from excessive current. Once tripped, fuses need to be replaced before normal operation can resume.

lore.name: Future Navy Pilot T-Shirt
lore.description: Are you ready to shoot for the stars? Show the 'verse that you're on the way to being the best of the best: a pilot of the UEE Navy. In addition to the message emblazoned on the front, this show-stopping t-shirt features an all-over image of a blue and white nebula, the seal of the UEE Navy, and the Invictus logo.

lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -55 / 85 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s The G-2 provides protection and an uninhibited field of view without being bulky. Clark Defense Systems designed the helmet to withstand a wide variety of impact types without compromising its integrity. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.description: Temp. Rating: -30 / 15 °C Protect your head from the wind and cold with the Gale. Code Blue Apparel paired a wide-view visor with a dynamic synthetic fabric to create an excellent thermal barrier to keep heat from escaping without sacrificing your visibility.

lore.name: Galen Surgical Scrub Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.4K µSCU You can count on Code Blue Apparel to deliver professional and comfortable medical clothing. The Galen Surgical Scrub Pants feature ribbing around the knees, and are made with a special anti-bacterial fabric that's 99% effective while also being lightweight and wrinkle free.

lore.name: Galen Surgical Scrub Top
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.4K µSCU You can count on Code Blue Apparel to deliver professional and comfortable medical clothing. The Galen Surgical Scrub Top features a large pocket and a wide wrap across the mid-section for a secure fit. Made with a special anti-bacterial fabric that's 99% effective while also being lightweight and wrinkle free.

lore.name: Galinstan
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Military The Galinstan is an older model cooler originally developed for the UEE Navy. Its specs won’t knock your socks off but it remains a solid entry level, large cooler.

lore.name: Gallant "Conviction Camo" Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Assault Rifle Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 45 Rate Of Fire: 450 rpm Effective Range: 50 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S2) Dependable assault weapons never go out of style. Klaus & Werner maintains that tradition by unveiling the Gallant. This energy-based assault rifle is capable of providing accurate and sustained fire at targets up to medium range, while its high-capacity power system allows operators to fire considerably more shots per battery. The Conviction Camo edition utilizes a diffuse selection of grays to help blend in with more urban environments.

lore.name: Gamescom 2943 Trophy
lore.description: The Gamescom 2943 trophy features a silver central column enwrapped by bands of gold. Atop is a hologram of the Star Citizen logo with the year carved into a gold band above the base.

lore.name: Gamescom 2944 Trophy
lore.description: A gold and silver trophy commemorating Gamescom. The Star Citizen logo is engraved near the top and the year at the bottom.

lore.name: Gamescom 2945 Special Edition Trophy
lore.description: A special edition silver and black trophy celebrating Gamescom. Its unique design features a teal dividing line between its two sides, with the Star Citizen logo engraved on the front of the base and flanked on each side by the year.

lore.name: Gamescom 2945 Trophy
lore.description: A silver and black trophy celebrating Gamescom. Its unique design features a teal dividing line between its two sides, with the Star Citizen logo engraved on the front of the base and flanked on each side by the year.

lore.name: Gamescom 2946 Special Edition Trophy
lore.description: A special edition silver trophy celebrating Gamescom with a solid central column flanked by fluting. Etched into the central column is the Star Citizen logo and year.

lore.name: Gamescom 2946 Trophy
lore.description: A silver trophy celebrating Gamescom with a solid central column flanked by fluting. Etched into the central column is the Star Citizen logo and year.

lore.description: Manufacturer: NV-TAC Type: Projection Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 1x Aim Time: +15% Size: 1 Whether under the blazing sun or on the dark side of a moon, the NV-TAC Gamma projects an easy to see reticle to help ensure your shot finds its mark. The "Black Op" scope variant is black.

lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Stealth A complete overhaul of the materials in the heatsinks dramatically decreased the emission level of the GammaMax. Few medium power plants run as quiet at the same price point of this one from Tyler Design & Tech.

lore.name: Gas
lore.description: A substance that when under standard pressure has vast distance between particles with weaker intermolecular bonds than other phases of matter.

lore.name: Gasping Weevil Eggs
lore.description: The eggs of this small beetle are commonly held to be an aphrodisiac, but when allowed to hatch the weevils themselves will eat through sealants used in space station construction. Transport of the insect or its eggs is banned in the UEE.

lore.name: Gatac Missile Rack 2xS2
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Gatac Manufacture Size: 3 Missiles: 2xS2 Designed by Gatac, this missile rack is capable of storing two S2 missiles.

lore.name: Gatac Missile Rack 8xS1
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Gatac Manufacture Size: 4 Missiles: 8xS1 Designed by Gatac, this missile rack is capable of storing eight S1 missiles.

lore.name: Gauntlet Gloves
lore.description: DMC's Gauntlet gloves feel like a hard day's work. Built with resilient GranTec composite weaves, these Gauntlets live up to their name, providing maximum protection against environments and impacts so you can work another day.

lore.name: GCD-Army Arms
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -61 / 91 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s In honor of the soldiers who protect the Empire, CDS has crafted this limited-edition armor that proudly displays the seal of the UEE Army. Its shell is composed of a durable composite on the outside and a soft core on the inside, designed to absorb the types of impacts associated with on-the-ground combat. The matching helmet features a UV-blocking faceplate that protects the wearer's eye sight as they fight on the front lines under strange suns.

lore.name: GCD-Army Backpack
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Backpack Carrying Capacity: 105K µSCU Core Compatibility: Medium & Heavy Headed to the front lines? Bring everything you need and more with the GCD-Army Backpack. With an impressive carrying capacity and an outer shell made from an impact-resistant composite, it's the perfect way to ensure your valuables stay safe during the heat of combat.

lore.name: Geist Armor Arms
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -35 / 65 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s An ideal synthesis of strength and technology, the Geist Stealth Armor has been crafted from military-grade carbon silk sourced from the same manufacturers that protect the UEE's special forces. Hair-thin filaments woven into the fabric mask the wearer's emissions, making them undetectable via radar, and specialized tubing built into the soles of the boots dampens the sound of footsteps.

lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Carrying Capacity: 8k µSCU Temp. Rating: -35 / 65 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Backpacks: Light An ideal synthesis of strength and technology, the Geist Stealth Armor has been crafted from military-grade carbon silk sourced from the same manufacturers that protect the UEE's special forces. Hair-thin filaments woven into the fabric mask the wearer's emissions, making them harder to detect, and specialized tubing built into the soles of the boots dampens the sound of footsteps. The Epoque edition features a navy and black coloring, finished with baroque gold detailing.
