lore.name: Gelid
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Wen/Cassel Propulsion Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Civilian Allowing for greater thermo-dispersal and improved performance output, the top-of-the-line Gelid cooler from Wen/Cassel is an all-inclusive heat management system ideal for a variety of ships.

lore.name: Gen Liberty Ale (Bottle)
lore.description: HEI: 23 Effects: Cognitive Impairment, Dehydrating Liberty Lake beer has been brewed by families on Terra for generations to provide a crisp, clean ale perfect to partake when you arrive at those little moments made to be spent enjoying life. Gen Liberty is a tart lactic ale perfect for warm nights.

lore.name: Genoa
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Industrial According to Juno Starwerk, good industrial design is meant to go unnoticed, yet it’s hard not to marvel at the Genoa medium power plant, as its outstanding performance and noted durability make it a first-rate component.

lore.name: GEO Resource Pod
lore.description: Capacity: 10 cSCU Lightweight yet durable, the GEO Resource Pod was constructed to extend the function of your ATLS by providing additional storage for mined ores as well as a convenient way to transport resources to their final destination.

lore.name: Geodusk Boots
lore.description: A classic workman's boot. This rubber-toed shoe is both sturdy and lightweight, with extra padding in the sole for easy movement and reduced pressure on Battaglia's remaining foot.

lore.name: Geodusk Jacket
lore.description: Simple, practical, and gets the job done without a fuss - much like Battaglia herself. The look features a sleeveless dark green military-style jacket, complete with plenty of pocket space, over her signature yellow undershirt and white vest.

lore.name: Geodusk Pants
lore.description: The ultimate cargo pants for someone who isn't afraid to put in the work, but wants to be comfortable doing it. These dark brown pants feature large pockets on the upper legs, as well as cropping at the right knee that Battaglia shortened herself to make room for her prosthetic leg.

lore.name: Geoffrey Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Stay stylishly protected from the elements with the Geoffrey. Escar Limited's casual jacket features a durable water-repellent finish with a slick brushed look, alongside sleeves featuring an articulated elbow.

lore.name: Get Up Coffee (Black)
lore.description: HEI: 15 Effects: Dehydrating, Cognitive Boosting Get Up Coffee is roasted with care to ensure a smooth blend of rich coffee flavor brewed to perfection. Served black and unsweetened, enjoy coffee in its purest expression.

lore.name: Get Up Coffee (Cinnamon)
lore.description: HEI: 15 Effects: Dehydrating, Cognitive Boosting Get Up Coffee is roasted with care to ensure a smooth blend of rich coffee flavor brewed to perfection. A touch of cinnamon is the perfect accent to awaken your taste buds even more.

lore.name: Get Up Coffee (Decaf)
lore.description: HEI: 15 Effects: Dehydrating, Cognitive Boosting Get Up Coffee is roasted with care to ensure a smooth blend of rich coffee flavor brewed to perfection. Our decaf replaces the caffeine typically found in coffee with other natural and gentle stimulants.

lore.name: Get Up Coffee (Milk)
lore.description: HEI: 15 Effects: Dehydrating, Cognitive Boosting Get Up Coffee is roasted with care to ensure a smooth blend of rich coffee flavor brewed to perfection. A splash of milk rounds out the flavor and emphasizes its natural sweetness.

lore.name: Get Up Coffee (Mocha)
lore.description: HEI: 15 Effects: Dehydrating, Cognitive Boosting Get Up Coffee is roasted with care to ensure a smooth blend of rich coffee flavor brewed to perfection. Enjoy your break even more with Mocha, our coffee enhanced with a swirl of chocolate and milk.

lore.name: Gilick Boots
lore.description: Gain the Octagon advantage with the Gilick boots. Whether on a work site or exploring the wilds, these boots will provide the comfort and support you crave. They feature an all-terrain tread, a supportive inner sole, and adjustable gaiters to cover your ankles and lower legs from the elements.

lore.name: Gin & Tonic
lore.description: HEI: 07 Effects: Cognitive Impairment, Dehydrating Bitter and sweet quinine-infused, sparkling tonic water mixed with herbal gin.

lore.name: Ginger Five-Spice Kacho
lore.description: NDR: 30 Effects: None Big Benny's kacho is based on traditional family recipes straight from Corel, combining springy noodles and a rich, warm broth to create a taste enjoyed the 'verse over. The Ginger Five-Spice flavor is bright and zesty with a sweet and spicy edge.

lore.name: Ginzel
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Industrial The unique name for this stalwart industrial power plant was inspired by the nickname of a Juno Starwerk junior engineer who helped design it.

lore.name: Giocoso Racing Helmet Ivory
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -55 / 85 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Inspired by the sleek stylings of the 100 series, the Giocoso is a helmet worthy of Origin Jumpworks. It features a wide face shield to provide excellent peripheral vision and a special internal air flow system to dissipate heat and humidity. In a nod to the 100 series, the back of the helmet slyly integrates the iconic shape language of the ship's tail into the form.

lore.name: Giotto Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Fiore elevates the typical suit jacket with the Giotto. Subtle and stylish flourishes include light lines running down the left lapel and a strip of accent fabric along the arm seams that connect across the back of the jacket. The end result is an elegant and inspired addition to any wardrobe.

lore.name: Giotto Jacket Crusader Edition
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Fiore elevates the typical suit jacket with the Giotto. Subtle and stylish flourishes include light lines running down the left lapel and a strip of accent fabric along the arm seams that connect across the back of the jacket. The end result is an elegant and inspired addition to any wardrobe. The Crusader Edition was made specifically for employees of Crusader Industries.

lore.name: Glacier
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Military Your weapons, your shields, your thrusters. All vital during combat, all generating heat. Enter the Glacier cooler from Aegis Dynamics. A best-in-class heat management system designed to keep you cool as the pressure mounts.

lore.name: Glacier
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Military Your weapons, your shields, your thrusters. All vital during combat, all generating heat. Enter the Glacier cooler from Aegis Dynamics. A best-in-class heat management system designed to keep you cool as the pressure mounts.

lore.name: Glacis
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 4 Grade: Bespoke Class: Industrial Origin turned to the experts at Basilisk to build a bespoke shield generator for the 890 Jump. The Glacis blends centuries of cutting edge innovation to produce a strong and stable shield capable of defending the valuable ship and passengers aboard.

lore.name: Glacosite
lore.description: As glaciers form, heavier mineral contents sink over time and are then crushed by the weight above as the ice deforms and flows. When the glacier recedes, Glacosite deposits are left behind. White and blue in color, the crystals form in long shiny strands that almost are cotton-like in appearance. Glacosite has found specialized commercial use since it is an extremely light and durable insulator.

lore.name: Gladiator 2955 Ship Showdown Poster
lore.description: A poster commemorating the Gladiator making the final four of the 2955 Ship Showdown. A stalwart of fighter squadrons, this versatile ship walks the line between fighter and bomber.

lore.name: Gladiator Best in Show 2955 Livery
lore.description: Commemorate the Gladiator making the final four of the 2955 Ship Showdown with this striking metallic orange and black Best in Show livery.

lore.name: Gladiator Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Gladiator with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Gladius Deck the Hull Livery
lore.description: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.

lore.name: Gladius Disrupt Camo Livery
lore.description: The Disrupt Camo livery utilizes carbon fiber grays and blacks printed in a disruptive pattern to keep your enemies guessing.

lore.name: Gladius Dunlevy
lore.description: Honor the famed Captain who shaped the course of the UEE Navy's elite fighter squadron with the Dunlevy livery for the Aegis Gladius. It pays to tribute to Captain Alexandra Dunlevy and Squadron 42 with red highlights against a grey base paint.

lore.name: Gladius Dunlevy Model
lore.description: This exquisitely detailed Gladius model honors the light fighter that's been protecting the UEE for centuries. Soaring above a stand featuring the UEE logo and ship's name, the Dunlevy variant of the Gladius was crafted to honor Captain Alexandra Dunlevy, who shaped the course of the Navy's elite Squadron 42.

lore.name: Gladius Foundation Guide Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Gladius Frostbite Camo Livery
lore.description: Soar like the winter winds with the Frostbite Camo livery for your Gladius.

lore.name: Gladius IceBreak Livery
lore.description: Equip your Gladius with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

lore.name: Gladius Invictus Blue and Gold Livery
lore.description: Featuring a vibrant blue base color and gold highlights, the Invictus Blue and Gold livery will give your Gladius a striking style.

lore.name: Gladius Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Gladius with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Gladius PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Aegis Gladius with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: Gladius Pirate Livery
lore.description: Red and black with white highlights this special edition Gladius livery was created to celebrate those unafraid to engage pirate forces.

lore.name: Gladius Solar Winds Livery
lore.description: Fly in style with the Solar Winds livery that gives the Gladius a metallic silver finish with maroon highlights.

lore.name: Gladius Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the Aegis Gladius.

lore.name: Gladius Timberline Livery
lore.description: Customize your Gladius with the Timberline livery that's olive green with orange accents.

lore.name: Gladius TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Aegis Gladius with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: Gladius Valiant Livery
lore.description: Part of the ?Masters of Flight? series, this special edition livery honors the look of the Gladius used by famed defense pilot Condi Hillard who became the first Human on record to defeat a Vanduul in combat.

lore.name: Glass
lore.description: A drinking vessel made from tempered glassware.

lore.name: Glow
lore.description: A variant of the street drug known as "Neon," Glow is formulated to create more euphoric feelings and less hallucinations than are normally associated with other members of its chemical family. The telltale sign of a user is that swallowing the capsule often leaves glowing residue on the tongue. Some people microdose Glow to help them maintain a more positive attitude (being careful to drip the dose directly onto the back of their throat). The main risk is that once the effect wears off people can become suicidally depressed for a short while before their brain chemistry normalizes.

lore.name: GME 240-15 Patient Slippers
lore.description: The standard GME 240-15 Patient Slippers offer necessary foot protection and comfort during a patient's visit to a medical facility. Constructed from the same antibacterial fabric as the GME 338-10 Medical Gown, the slippers feature an easy on/off design and an anti-slip coating on the sole.

lore.name: GME 338-10 Medical Gown
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.4K µSCU The GME 338-10 Medical Gown is the de facto medical gown assigned to in-patients at hospitals and other care facilities across the Empire. This standard gown was designed so that patients could be dressed or undressed easily, and made with antibacterial fabric to help facilitate keeping wounds clean, lowering the risk of infection.

lore.name: Godmother Sandwich
lore.description: NDR: 41 Effects: None Layers of cured meats and salami are stacked high with tangy fosso cheese, tomatoes, lettuce, roasted peppers and our famous house dressing on rice bread. At Twyn's, it's what's inside that counts.

lore.name: Gold
lore.description: A commonly found ductile metal favored for its conductivity. Though it falls in and out of fashion, it is often used for decorative purposes as well.

lore.name: Gold (Ore)
lore.description: A commonly found ductile metal favored for its conductivity. Though it falls in and out of fashion, it is often used for decorative purposes as well.

lore.name: Golden Medmon
lore.description: NDR: 39 HEI: 19 Effects: Energizing, Hydrating Grown in temperate climates on the Maru Ebony Tree, Golden Medmons are left to fall off the tree when ripe and collected. The fruit at that stage is extremely firm and astringent. They only become edible after being 'bletted' or softened through ethylene ripening.

lore.name: Goldenrod
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Civilian The engineers at Sakura Sun know the importance of a dependable life support system when exploring the far reaches of the empire. That's why the Goldenrod line of life supports was designed to work when you need it most.

lore.name: Goldenrod Delux
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian The engineers at Sakura Sun know the importance of a dependable life support system when exploring the far reaches of the empire. That's why the Goldenrod line of life supports was designed to work when you need it most.

lore.name: Goldenrod Mini
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 0 Grade: B Class: Civilian The engineers at Sakura Sun know the importance of a dependable life support system when exploring the far reaches of the empire. That's why the Goldenrod line of life supports was designed to work when you need it most.

lore.name: Goldenrod Premium
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Civilian The engineers at Sakura Sun know the importance of a dependable life support system when exploring the far reaches of the empire. That's why the Goldenrod line of life supports was designed to work when you need it most.

lore.name: Golem Coalheart Livery
lore.description: Mine and make yourself less visible against the dark expanse of space with the black and grey Coalheart livery for the Golem.

lore.name: Golem Cypher Livery
lore.description: Striking green and blue highlights elevate the black base paint of the Cypher livery.

lore.name: Golem Deck the Hull Livery
lore.description: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.

lore.name: Golem Faultline Livery
lore.description: The Golem gets a distinct look with the Faultline livery with strategically placed yellow and orange stripes making the ship more visible.

lore.name: Golem Flashpoint Livery
lore.description: Prominent use of orange offset against white makes the Golem Flashpoint livery highly visible on busy and dangerous work sites.

lore.name: Golem Foundation Fest Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Golem Greysteel Livery
lore.description: The Greysteel livery artfully deploys various shades of grey across the Golem for a subtle yet captivating look.

lore.name: Golem IceBreak Livery
lore.description: Equip your Golem with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

lore.name: Golem Keystone Livery
lore.description: Crisp white with blue accents, the Keystone livery celebrates the workers whose mining, refining, hauling, salvaging, and more have made the empire what it is today.

lore.name: Golem Rockfall Livery
lore.description: The Rockfall livery blends green and grey earth tones with black to give the Golem a look fitting for a ship made to rip apart rocks.

lore.name: Golem Strongheart Livery
lore.description: The Strongheart livery for the Golem is a bright and bold red with black highlights.

lore.name: Golem Sunstruck Livery
lore.description: Yellow and white highlights atop a grey base paint gives the Golem a distinct look thanks to the Sunstruck livery.

lore.name: Goliath
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Industrial The Goliath was designed to be more durable than other quantum drives in its class. That’s made it a staple of industrial ship since Humanity first started to explore the stars.

lore.name: Good Boot
lore.description: The Vaporwear Good Boot is the result of a design collaboration between seven up-and-coming designers who were each tasked to answer one question: what makes a good boot? The result is a fusion of supreme comfort with supergrip rubber soles, reinforced toe safeguards, and a variety of decorative zippers and buckles around the top quarter.

lore.name: Good Enough Shirt Brown
lore.description: This shirt from an unknown manufacturer has been mended and refashioned to give it a second life. Half of the right sleeve was beyond repair, so the rest of it was turned into an elbow cuff.

lore.name: Good Gift Gloves
lore.description: The Good Gift gloves are made to match the festive sweater of the same name. These comfortable holiday hand warmers not only look good but are fingerless to make interacting with items a breeze.

lore.name: Good Gift Sweater
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU This Banu-made mock turtleneck lets you celebrate Luminalia in comfort and style. Cozy up around the lamp with this luxurious red and green fabric blend with an asymmetrical front and three adjustable straps that guarantee the perfect fit. Banu phrases calling for merriment and a prosperous future adorn the front and back in golden script.

lore.name: Good Gift Sweater Blue
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU This Banu-made mock turtleneck lets you celebrate Luminalia in comfort and style. Cozy up around the lamp with this luxurious blue and grey fabric blend with an asymmetrical front and three adjustable straps that guarantee the perfect fit. Banu phrases calling for merriment and a prosperous future adorn the front and back in white script.

lore.name: Government Cartography Agency Medal (Damaged)
lore.description: This medal was awarded by United Planets of Earth (UPE) to members of the Government Cartography Agency who flew or supported missions involving the discovery, exploration, or scanning of new systems. It features a star woven with one large and three smaller interlocking circles that was the central symbol on the UPE flag. The tattered ribbon and broken and corroded metal has left this one in poor condition.

lore.name: Government Cartography Agency Medal (Pristine)
lore.description: This medal was awarded by United Planets of Earth (UPE) to members of the Government Cartography Agency who flew or supported missions involving the discovery, exploration, or scanning of new systems. It features a star woven with one large and three smaller interlocking circles that was the central symbol on the UPE flag. The exquisite state of the ribbon and metal has left this one in pristine condition.

lore.name: Government Cartography Agency Medal (Worn)
lore.description: This medal was awarded by United Planets of Earth (UPE) to members of the Government Cartography Agency who flew or supported missions involving the discovery, exploration, or scanning of new systems. It features a star woven with one large and three smaller interlocking circles that was the central symbol on the UPE flag. The aged ribbon and corroded metal has left this one in worn condition.

lore.name: GP-33 MOD "Ashfall" Grenade Launcher
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Grenade Launcher Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 6 Rate Of Fire: 40 rpm Effective Range: Variable (80m) Attachments: Optics (S1), Underbarrel (S1) The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact. The Ashfall edition mixes dark blue, grey, and black for a subtle yet stylish look.

lore.name: GP-33 MOD "Copperhead" Grenade Launcher
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Grenade Launcher Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 6 Rate Of Fire: 40 rpm Effective Range: Variable (80m) Attachments: Optics (S1), Underbarrel (S1) The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact. A light, metallic finish applied to the barrel and stock catches the eye and makes the Copperhead edition stand out from other versions.

lore.name: GP-33 MOD "Quite Useful" Grenade Launcher
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Grenade Launcher Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 6 Rate Of Fire: 40 rpm Effective Range: Variable (80m) Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S1) The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact. One of the many items Wikelo has acquired in his travels, the 'Quite Useful' edition is a must have for any serious collector.

lore.name: GP-33 MOD "Thunderclap" Grenade Launcher
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Grenade Launcher Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 6 Rate Of Fire: 40 rpm Effective Range: Variable (80m) Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S1) The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact. A black and grey color combination gives the Thunderclap edition a subtle look suitable for any security professional.

lore.name: GP-33 MOD "Umber" Grenade Launcher
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Grenade Launcher Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 6 Rate Of Fire: 40 rpm Effective Range: Variable (80m) Attachments: Optics (S1), Underbarrel (S1) The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact. The Umber edition is finished in rust and orange.

lore.name: GP-33 MOD Grenade Launcher
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Grenade Launcher Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 6 Rate Of Fire: 40 rpm Effective Range: Variable (80m) Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S1) The military-grade GP-33 MOD launcher fires 40mm grenades to clear rooms and flush out enemies behind cover thanks to Behring's precision design that primes each grenade to explode on impact.

lore.name: GP-33 MOD Grenade Launcher Magazine (6 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 6 This magazine for the GP-33 MOD holds six 40mm grenades.

lore.name: GP-88 Undersuit
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 10% The GP-88 is a general protection suit, providing basic impact resistance, EVA upgrades and a sealed helmet mount so users can work in toxic atmospheres.

lore.name: GP-XP Industrial Battery
lore.description: An extremely powerful battery used in industrial processes, like powering mining lasers. Its proprietary design generates significantly more energy than other batteries of its size but makes the GP-XP extremely heavy and unwieldy. Please use caution when attempting to move.

lore.name: Grammercy Food Service Cover
lore.description: The Grammercy Food Service Cover is a standard food service accessory produced by Code Blue Apparel's professional division. Featuring a flexible one-size-fits-all form that expands or contracts firmly to the wearer's head, the hat design is both sleek and efficient.

lore.name: Grammercy Food Service Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Grammercy Food Service Jacket is a standard food service accessory produced by Code Blue Apparel's professional division. The jacket, first adapted from one of the company's bespoke surgeons coats, is the modern standard for chefs and line cooks. The jacket is constructed from a patented stain-resistant material that can be quickly cleaned.

lore.name: Grammercy Food Service Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU The Grammercy Food Service Pants are a standard food service accessory produced by Code Blue Apparel's professional division. Designed to merge style and functionality, the pants offer support for all members of a food service team and are constructed from a patented stain-resistant material that can be quickly cleaned.

lore.name: Grappler Gloves
lore.description: Originally made for open-canopy racers, the Grappler gloves became beloved for their versatility and durability. Their mix of leather and synthetic fabrics make for a lightweight and warm wear. They also feature an adjustable strap to guarantee the perfect fit, and a special tactile fingertip design so wearers don't have to remove the gloves to interact with screens.

lore.name: Grappler Gloves Veritas
lore.description: Originally made for open-canopy racers, the Grappler gloves became beloved for their versatility and durability. Their mix of leather and synthetic fabrics make for a lightweight and warm wear. They also feature an adjustable strap to guarantee the perfect fit, and a special tactile fingertip design so wearers don't have to remove the gloves to interact with screens. The Veritas edition is a bloody red, with black belts and leather straps.

lore.name: Graupel
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Wen/Cassel Propulsion Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian The Graupel not only provides the top of the line cooling technology that larger ships need to maintain optimal performance, it does it with Wen/Cassel’s signature craftsmanship.

lore.name: Green Blend Smoothie
lore.description: HEI: 35 NDR: 14 Effects: Immune Boosting A smoothie made with a fresh blend of healthy greens.

lore.name: Green Curry Primavera
lore.description: NDR: 48 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic Creamy green curry with a hint of heat is the ideal match for garlicy vegetables and pasta.

lore.name: Green QuikFlarePro
lore.description: Manufacturer: Shubin Interstellar Illuminate the way forward or signal for help with the Green QuikFlarePro from Shubin Interstellar. For centuries, miners have counted on this flare as part of their core toolkit, thanks to its tried and true design and durability that ensures it stays ablaze in the various harsh weather and difficult atmospheric conditions encountered across the 'verse. The QuikFlarePro uses advanced tech to glow longer than regular flares.

lore.name: Green Vitality Smoothie
lore.description: HEI: 39 NDR: 15 Effects: Immune Boosting Garcia's Greens Green Vitality Smoothie is a blend of vital nutrients densely packed into this bright combination of leafy greens.

lore.name: Greenwater Shirt Walnut
lore.description: The Greenwater is a long-sleeved shirt tailor-made to be worn underneath most standard sets of armor. Crafted with a durable mix of natural and synthetic fibers, it stands up to daily wear and tear without sacrificing comfort.

This "Q" model includes a special quick placement mode to assist with the transfer of cargo. lore.name: Grilled Chicken Roll Omni Pack
lore.description: NDR: 70 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic Omni Packs use premium certified organic ingredients to create a complete balanced ready-to-eat meal with a premium taste.

lore.name: Grin Tractor Beam 002 Shared Ut2
lore.description: Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Max Angle: 80° Max Range: 130 m Full Strength Distance: 55 m This precision variant of Greycat’s SureGrip tractor beam sacrifices some of the power and range of the base model in exchange for a wider angle of manipulation and greater tether grip, allowing for careful handling of more delicate goods.

lore.name: Grin Tractor Beam 002 Shared Ut2 Cargo
lore.description: Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Max Angle: 80° Max Range: 130 m Full Strength Distance: 55 m This precision variant of Greycat’s SureGrip tractor beam sacrifices some of the power and range of the base model in exchange for a wider angle of manipulation and greater tether grip, allowing for careful handling of more delicate goods. This "Q" model includes a special quick placement mode to assist with the transfer of cargo.

lore.name: GRX Prototype
lore.description: Developed by ASD scientists, this experimental power core showed promise thanks to its exceptional output rates, but suffered from energy fluctuations and gravity anomalies that proved to be insurmountable issues which rendered it unusable. ASD has ceased all future development of this technology.

lore.name: GUARD
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Civilian Don’t be afraid to go up against the unknown with Seal Corp’s GUARD. This shield generator balances performance, durability, and stealth to allow the user to utilize the shield in whatever way suits them best.

lore.name: Guardian
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Industrial Upgrade to the Guardian for increased absorption of ballistic, energy, and distortion damage. Making this industrial shield generator one of the most durable in its class.

lore.name: Guardian Black Magic Livery
lore.description: The Black Magic livery for the Guardian mixes a macabre black with glowing orange highlights for a look inspired by the sinister spirit of Day of the Vara.

lore.name: Guardian Blackout Livery
lore.description: Fly under the cover of darkness with the Blackout livery, coating the Guardian in a deep, matte black.

lore.name: Guardian Burnout Livery
lore.description: Predominately a piercing red, the Burnout livery is adorned with deep black highlights and Mirai's signature branding.

lore.name: Guardian Desert Dusk Livery
lore.description: Bold and adventurous, the Desert Dusk Guardian livery creates a gritty sense of sandblasted stone and darkened desert storms.

lore.name: Guardian Downpour Livery
lore.description: A bold blue and grey combination that bellows with the power of a storm, the Downpour livery demands attention.

lore.name: Guardian Eventide Livery
lore.description: The white lettering of the Mirai name and logo pop against the midnight blue and crimson red of the Eventide livery.

lore.name: Guardian Harlequin Livery
lore.description: Primarily a sharp green with black accents, the Harlequin livery proudly displays the Mirai name and logo.

lore.name: Guardian MX Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Mirai Size: 2 Missiles: 12x S02 Bespoke missile rack for the Mirai Guardian MX that fires twelve S2 missiles.

lore.name: Guardian Peninsula Livery
lore.description: Shades of stony tans and earthen browns create a grounded look for the Peninsula livery.

lore.name: Guardian Red Skies Livery
lore.description: Soar into the setting sun with this sharp collection of reds and whites in the Guardian Red Skies livery.

lore.name: Guardian Shadow Gild Livery
lore.description: For those Guardian pilots who prefer to subtly show their ostentatious side, the Shadow Gild livery variant features a dark gray and black camo hull and stylish gold highlights.

lore.name: Guardian Sovereign Livery
lore.description: An austere blend of tan and grey offset by an imperial gold highlight brings a sense of authority to the Sovereign livery.

lore.name: Guardian Stormburst Livery
lore.description: A new twist on a understated color combination, the silver of this palette adds a subtle majesty to the more earthen tans and greys of the Stormburst livery.

lore.name: Guardian Undersuit
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 10% Virgil's Guardian is a multi-purpose combat undersuit that features basic reinforced plates for impact protection as well as natural integration with compatible armor sets.

lore.name: Guardian Vector Livery
lore.description: Contrasting whites, reds, and blacks create strikingly angular design on the Vector livery.

lore.name: Guardian Whiteout Livery
lore.description: Featuring a dramatically stark all-white finish, the Whiteout livery highlights the powerful form of the Guardian.

lore.name: Guerra Pants
lore.description: The Guerra pants by Alejo Brothers are a staple for daily wear. The synthetic fabric ensures adequate protection from the general wear and tear of frontier life while remaining easy to patch up if the need arises.

lore.name: Guri Pants Lime
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Step up the style with these bold pants from City Lights. Six zipper pockets and a slanted fly will bring a bit of attitude to your wardrobe. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: GVSR Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 2 Aegis commissioned Behring to design a laser repeater specifically for their Vanguard line-up. The result was the GVSR, which met Aegis exacting standards by delivering a steady rate of fire without overtaxing the ship's power plant.

lore.name: H4-PBF Ammo Carrier
lore.description: Item Type: Ammo Carrier Core Compatibility: Medium & Heavy Carrying Capacity: 150K µSCU Custom built to store additional ammo for heavy machine guns, this carrier connects directly to your weapon via an ammo belt, ensuring prolonged continuous fire without impairment.

lore.name: H4-PBF Ammo Carrier
lore.description: PH - Description for cds_combat_superheavy_backpack_01_01_02

lore.name: H4-PBF Ammo Carrier Snow Camo
lore.description: Item Type: Ammo Carrier Core Compatibility: Medium & Heavy Carrying Capacity: 150K µSCU Custom built to store additional ammo for heavy machine guns, this carrier connects directly to your weapon via an ammo belt, ensuring prolonged continuous fire without impairment. Featuring a white digital camo pattern, the Snow Camo edition is perfect for stalking prey in frozen environments.

lore.name: H4-PBF Ammo Carrier SteelTek
lore.description: Item Type: Ammo Carrier Core Compatibility: Medium & Heavy Carrying Capacity: 150K µSCU Custom built to store additional ammo for heavy machine guns, this carrier connects directly to your weapon via an ammo belt, ensuring prolonged continuous fire without impairment. The SteelTek edition features a shining metallic coating with a Damascus pattern that runs across the surface.

lore.name: Hadanite
lore.description: A crystal oscillator sought out for its extremely high frequency of vibration which makes it useful in various applications.

lore.name: Halcyon F10
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: RSI Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Military Operating to the exacting standards expected of RSI, the Halcyon life support system provides consistent performance across a wide variety of scenarios.

lore.name: Halcyon F20
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: RSI Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Military Operating to the exacting standards expected of RSI, the Halcyon life support system provides consistent performance across a wide variety of scenarios.

lore.name: Halcyon F30
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: RSI Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Military Operating to the exacting standards expected of RSI, the Halcyon life support system provides consistent performance across a wide variety of scenarios.

lore.name: Halcyon FV
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: RSI Size: 0 Grade: D Class: Military Operating to the exacting standards expected of RSI, the Halcyon life support system provides consistent performance across a wide variety of scenarios.

lore.name: Haltur
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Yorm Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Competition Strong shield health and an exceptional generation rate gives the Haltur the best performance ranking of any shield in its class. Beloved by racers and those who prefer to navigate away from danger instead of soaking it up.

lore.name: Ham and Cheese Sandwich
lore.description: NDR: 38 Effects: None Smoked ham and sharp cheddar on white bread.

lore.name: Hammer Propulsion HE 5.3
lore.description: The Hammer Propulsion HE5.3 features a high output, fuel efficient design. Its thrust output and low fuel consumption make it ideal for long hauls though it has been reported to be somewhat of a missile magnet on occasions where owners have been subject to pirate activity.

lore.name: Hammer Propulsion HE 5.3
lore.description: The Hammer Propulsion HE5.3 features a high output, fuel efficient design. Its thrust output and low fuel consumption make it ideal for long hauls though it has been reported to be somewhat of a missile magnet on occasions where owners have been subject to pirate activity.

lore.name: Hammer Propulsion HE 5.5
lore.description: Hammer Propulsion's HE 5.5 offers the same high quality, high output design that you find in the 5.3 but amplified to handle larger class vessels. the 5.5 is one of the most durable and robust thrusters on the market for commercial and shipping vehicles.

lore.name: Hammer Propulsion HL 2.4 (TR4)
lore.description: Hammer Propulsion's HL 2.4 utilizes award-winning Gated 4 Grid Iron technology to provide a high output thrust with minimal emissions.

lore.name: Hammer Propulsion HM 4.2
lore.description: Hammer Propulsion's HM 4.2 thrusters are built with Electrostatic Ion technology, tuned for maximum thrust at the expense of signature profile and fuel efficiency. Making this an ideal option for racers or anyone who doesn't mind making an impression.

lore.name: Hammer Propulsion HM 4.3
lore.description: The Hammer Propulsion Twin HM4.3 is notable for the fact that it utilizes 2 high-performance TR3 thrusters in a small package. An unusual application, the original design was a joint collaboration between Hammer Propulsion and the Origin Jumpworks racing team. With the additional thrust provided by a second thruster the Twin HM4.3 is ideal for applications where speed is the goal. Speed comes at a cost, however; this configuration has a thirst for fuel that rivals much larger single thruster systems, and with all of its available space being taken up by the thruster internals not much space is left for durability reinforcement. This makes the HM4.3 ideal for most racing pilots, but less suitable for combat-oriented missions.

lore.name: Hammer Propulsion HM 4.3
lore.description: If speed is what you're after, the HM4.3 engine can give it to you. Built under supervision of the Racing Division at Hammer Propulsion, the 4.3 is a single-thruster system iteration of the award-winning Twin HM4.3 propulsion units made famous by the Origin 350r racers. The 4.3 has been specifically crafted down to the smallest pinion to give you the most boost possible in a single engine system.

lore.name: Hammer Propulsion HM 4.4
lore.description: Capable of powering a medium class vessel, the HM4.4 is all speed and no caution. It's main selling point, the heavy output, becomes its biggest detriment as the engine flash will make conventional countermeasures useless when attempting to distract missiles. But, like the ad says, if it's speed you want...

lore.name: Hammer Propulsion Twin HM 4.3
lore.description: The luxury version of the HM4.3, Hammer Propulsion's HMX4.3 engine system features customized racing parts from some of the league's top engineers to help weather corrosion and general part decay.

lore.name: Hammerhead 2949 Best In Show Livery
lore.description: Customize your Hammerhead with this special 2949 Best in Show livery.

lore.name: Hammerhead Fortuna Livery
lore.description: Make luck your co-pilot. Boldly set your sights on the stars and adventure forth in style with the Fortuna livery. This Stella Fortuna themed paint scheme is primarily green with grey accents.

lore.name: Hammerhead Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Hammerhead with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Hammerhead PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Aegis Hammerhead with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: Hammerhead Polar Camo Livery
lore.description: Modify your Hammerhead with this white and grey camo livery specifically designed for the 2951 IAE.

lore.name: Hammerhead Schematics "2949 Best in Show"
lore.description: This schematic allows you to count every turret aboard the intimidating Aegis Hammerhead. It was released to commemorate the ship being a Best in Show finalist at the 2949 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo.

lore.name: Hammerhead Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the Aegis Hammerhead.

lore.name: Hammerhead Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom Hammerhead livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.

lore.name: Hammerhead TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Aegis Hammerhead with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: Handmade Glazed Mug
lore.description: This slab-built pottery mug with ridged detailing was crafted by hand and finished with a speckled glaze.

lore.name: Hannu Shirt
lore.description: Be bold. Be you. Escar LImited's Hannu line of ultra-cas shirts features a fading asymmetrical cut and patchweave material that feels both rustic and thoroughly modern. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Hannu Shirt
