lore.name: Hardean Jacket and Shirt Ash
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU This gray and brown collarless synth-leather jacket from Escar Limited features quilted detailing around the opening and down the sleeves, and pairs effortlessly with a bold button-down, tropical-print shirt in light blue.

lore.name: Hardean Jacket and Shirt Croon
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU This maroon and brown collarless synth-leather jacket from Escar Limited features quilted detailing around the opening and down the sleeves, and pairs effortlessly with a bold button-down, tropical-print shirt in light brown.

lore.name: Hardean Jacket and Shirt Dallas
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU This blue and brown collarless synth-leather jacket from Escar Limited features quilted detailing around the opening and down the sleeves, and pairs effortlessly with a bold button-down, tropical-print shirt in pale yellow.

lore.name: Hardean Jacket and Shirt Parker
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU This grey and blue collarless synth-leather jacket from Escar Limited features quilted detailing around the opening and down the sleeves, and pairs effortlessly with a bold button-down, tropical-print shirt in orange.

lore.name: Hardean Jacket and Shirt Sunday
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU This olive green and brown collarless synth-leather jacket from Escar Limited features quilted detailing around the opening and down the sleeves, and pairs effortlessly with a bold button-down, tropical-print shirt in light pink.

lore.name: Hardline Hard Hat Black
lore.description: Stegman's Hardline 7800 is the latest in a proud line of safety wear. The Hardline is constructed from the same high-density plastics used in some body armor.

lore.name: Hardy Boots
lore.description: Walk to the ends of the earth with DMC's Hardy line of rugged all-terrain boots. Featuring increased ankle support and waterproof materials, you can trudge through desert or mountain in comfort.

lore.name: Harlowe Shirt
lore.description: Capable as being worn on its own or as a base for layers, this long-sleeve henley style shirt from Alejo Brothers keeps you stylish and comfortable.

lore.name: Harlowe Shirt microTech
lore.description: Capable as being worn on its own or as a base for layers, this long-sleeve henley style shirt decked out in microTech colors and branding keeps you stylish but comfortable.

lore.name: Hart Scraper Module
lore.description: Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Scraper Module Extraction Speed: 0.8 Radius: 1.0m Extraction Efficiency: 100% Made for RSI's Salvation, the efficient Hart scraper module allows salvagers to work quickly to harvest a claim.

lore.name: Hartmoore Inverter Code
lore.description: A single use card that contains the codes for accessing the Nine Tails' Identity Friend and Foe Inverter on the Hartmoore platform.

lore.name: Hartwell Music Sentinel 88G
lore.description: The Sentinel 88G from Hartwell Music features a full 88-key digital piano in a molded grand piano frame. The 88G features fully responsive, real hammer weighted action on the keys with a variety of customizable sounds based on actual recordings of classic instruments creating a classical experience for the modern age.

lore.name: Haruspec Goggles
lore.description: Supremely comfortable yet light as a feather, the Haruspec goggles also provide excellent protection against the elements thanks to their sturdy side shields. Stegman's fitted the goggles with polycarbonate performance lenses and a special slip-resistant nose pad to ensure they stay in place.

lore.name: Haruspec Goggles (Modified)
lore.description: This version of Stegman's Haruspec goggles has been modified from its original form. Supremely comfortable yet light as a feather, the Haruspec goggles also provide excellent protection against the elements thanks to their sturdy side shields. Stegman's fitted the goggles with polycarbonate performance lenses and a special slip-resistant nose pad to ensure they stay in place.

lore.name: Hat and Monocle
lore.description: As part of their Dafne collection, commissioned in honor of the Port Retanus Metropolitan Opera House Quincentennial, Derion is proud to present their Jacopo line of accessories. Perfect for an elegant night on the town, this diamond-laminate monocle with tungsten chain and gossamer-lined top hat feature the latest upgradable optiVis interface for unmatched comfort.

lore.name: HAVEN
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Civilian The HAVEN is an admired shield generator for large ships. Seal Corp’s simple, clean design makes repairing the component an easy and affordable task, and has only increased its popularity over the years.

lore.name: Havoc Scattergun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Ballistic Scattergun Size: 1 Sow dread across the battlefield with the Havoc from Apocalypse Arms. This size one scattergun deals massive damage at close range, making it the perfect weapon for finishing a fight.

lore.name: Havoc Scattergun Sharkmouth Edition
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Ballistic Scattergun Size: 1 With its devastating effectiveness at close range, the exclusive Sharkmouth Edition Havoc Scattergun from Apocalypse Arms features aggressive styling that is sure to make a lasting impression on your enemies as you unleash fire and hell.

lore.name: Hawk Aspire Livery
lore.description: With the Aspire livery, blue and white combine to evoke both the colors and frigid temperatures of New Babbage. In honor of the landing zone that inspired it, the livery also features a depiction of the Aspire Grand building that dominates the city's skyline.

lore.name: Hawk Central Tower Livery
lore.description: Give the Hawk a dramatic new look with the Central Tower livery. The orange and black color scheme is inspired by the furnaces of industry powering Lorville, and also features a representation of the landing zone's iconic Central Headquarters and Shared Services Center, aka Central Tower.

lore.name: Hawk Frostbite Camo Livery
lore.description: Soar like the winter winds with the Frostbite Camo livery for your Hawk.

lore.name: Hawk Hosanna Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the gorgeous clouds that enshroud Orison, the Hosanna livery blends red, ivory, and pink to give the Hawk a distinct appearance. It also features a silhouette of the landing zone's famous Hosanna tree complete with its pink flowers.

lore.name: Hawk Invictus Blue and Gold Livery
lore.description: Featuring a vibrant blue base color and gold highlights, the Invictus Blue and Gold livery will give your Hawk a striking style.

lore.name: Hawk Timberline Livery
lore.description: Customize your Hawk with the Timberline livery that's olive green with orange accents.

lore.name: Hazardous Cargo Chair
lore.description: Ready to rest your weary legs after a long day of hauling dangerous materials? Look no further than this unique chair upcycled from a repurposed hazardous cargo box.

lore.name: Haze Smoke Grenade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Roussimoff Rehabilitation Systems (RRS) Item Type: Grenade Area of Effect: 15 m Damage Type: None Duration: 3s The Haze smoke grenade is a perennial bestseller in RRS's line of non-lethal armaments. The device is designed to hinder enemy sight and sound by spreading smoke over a large area that will gradually dissipate over a few seconds.

lore.name: Headhunter Head Lamp
lore.description: Light your way with this reproduction of the iconic Headhunter seal of authority. Crafted at the promotion of a new Chief, this lamp is constructed using four skulls, one provided by each of the Chief's four Counselors as a sign of their loyalty, and serves as a symbol of the Chief's new authority.

lore.name: Heart of the Woods
lore.description: NDR: 31 Effects: Toxic This fungus produces fleshy deep-red caps that grow in a pattern resembling a internal structure of a heart. Found in cold climates, it typically grows on trees and decaying logs. Not yet successfully cultivated commercially, this deep flavored mushroom is prized by epicureans across the 'verse and can fetch a high price in the right markets. It does contain a mild toxin that is destroyed when cooked, so consuming raw should be avoided.

lore.name: Heartseeker Double Bed
lore.description: With a luxurious bedspread featuring the iconic image of a spacesuit clad pilot that can be found on the Anvil Hornet Heartseeker, this opulent bed is framed by a red velvet, heart-shaped headboard that is sure to make every night a bit more pleasurable.

lore.name: Heartseeker Poster
lore.description: A poster featuring the iconic image of a spacesuit clad pilot sitting amidst a heart that can be found on the F7C-M Hornet Heartseeker. Evoking the imagery and language of the historic holiday Valentine's Day, the image is intentionally faded to replicate the wear and tear it experiences on ships.

lore.name: HeartStone PDS
lore.description: This single-use mobile defibrillator unit is perfect for military and law enforcement field applications, simply place the electrodes and press the button.

lore.name: HeatSafe
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Stealth Pilots looking to keep their IR signature low rely on Tyler Design & Tech. As an entry level cooler, the HeatSafe not only limits emissions, it is built with Tyler’s satisfaction guarantee.

lore.name: HeatSink
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Stealth The HeatSink produces low signatures without sacrificing too much performance or durability, making it a reliable stealth component.

lore.name: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU Backpacks: All When there's a difficult job at hand, you want to ensure that you can see it through to the end. Clark Defense Systems' ADP-mk4 heavy armor allows Marines to remain in active combat situations for a longer duration with more loadout options, while its powered frame provides near unfettered movement despite the protection it offers. This executive edition features a brushed chrome finish with an inlaid hexagonal pattern.
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU Backpacks: All When there's a difficult job at hand, you want to ensure that you can see it through to the end. Clark Defense Systems' ADP-mk4 heavy armor allows Marines to remain in active combat situations for a longer duration with more loadout options, while its powered frame provides near unfettered movement despite the protection it offers. This executive edition features a brushed chrome finish with an inlaid hexagonal pattern.

lore.name: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU When there's a difficult job at hand, you want to ensure that you can see it through to the end. Clark Defense Systems' ADP-mk4 heavy armor allows Marines to remain in active combat situations for a longer duration with more loadout options, while its powered frame provides near unfettered movement despite the protection it offers. This executive edition features a brushed chrome finish with an inlaid hexagonal pattern.
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU When there's a difficult job at hand, you want to ensure that you can see it through to the end. Clark Defense Systems' ADP-mk4 heavy armor allows Marines to remain in active combat situations for a longer duration with more loadout options, while its powered frame provides near unfettered movement despite the protection it offers. This executive edition features a brushed chrome finish with an inlaid hexagonal pattern.

lore.name: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -77 / 107 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 7.5 µSCU The Overlord armor lets your foes know that you mean business. This heavy armor set is constructed with durable composite plating strategically placed to disperse the force of impacts and a high, reinforced collar that provides additional protection for your neck and back of head. The suit also layers in high-strength synthetic fabrics around the joints to ensure ease of moment without sacrificing safety.
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -77 / 107 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 7.5 µSCU The Overlord armor lets your foes know that you mean business. This heavy armor set is constructed with durable composite plating strategically placed to disperse the force of impacts and a high, reinforced collar that provides additional protection for your neck and back of head. The suit also layers in high-strength synthetic fabrics around the joints to ensure ease of moment without sacrificing safety.

lore.name: Helium
lore.description: An inert noble gas that is colorless, tasteless, and non-toxic. The second most abundant element in the universe. Produced within stars during the nuclear fusion of hydrogen.

lore.name: Hell’s Heart
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Vanduul Size: 1 Grade: N/A Class: Military The military designation for this Vanduul power plant is thought to have originated as a reference made by a well-educated pilot that the Vanduul fighters seem to be “stabbing at us from hell's heart.”

lore.name: Hellion Scattergun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Ballistic Scattergun Size: 2 Apocalypse Arms' Hellion is a size two scattergun that saturates targets with ballistic ammo in close quarters. The gun's smart ammo functionality allows it to switch between standard and specialty rounds.

lore.name: Hellion Scattergun Sharkmouth Edition
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Ballistic Scattergun Size: 2 With its devastating effectiveness at close range, the exclusive Sharkmouth Edition Hellion Scattergun from Apocalypse Arms features aggressive styling that is sure to make a lasting impression on your enemies as you unleash fire and hell.

lore.name: Hellion VII Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 7 Carrying a sizable payload and an advanced heat-seeking sensor suite, the Hellion missile from Talon can be effective against aggressors of all sizes.

lore.name: Hellion VII-G Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 7 Carrying a sizable payload and an advanced heat-seeking sensor suite, the Hellion missile from Talon can be effective against aggressors of all sizes. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

lore.name: Hello Sunshine Cheeky Planter
lore.description: Bring a little life to your decor with the Hello Sunshine Planter from Sakura Sun. Available in a number of colors and unique facial expressions, this charming ceramic container makes for a cheerful place for your plant to call home.

lore.name: Hello Sunshine Happy Planter
lore.description: Bring a little life to your decor with the Hello Sunshine Planter from Sakura Sun. Available in a number of colors and unique facial expressions, this charming ceramic container makes for a cheerful place for your plant to call home.

lore.name: Hello Sunshine Luminalia Planter
lore.description: Bring a little life to your Luminalia decor with the Hello Sunshine Planter from Sakura Sun. Featuring a red and green pot with a Banu season greeting and a charming facial expression, this festive tree is decorated with ornaments and spinning stars.

lore.name: Hello Sunshine Surprised Planter
lore.description: Bring a little life to your decor with the Hello Sunshine Planter from Sakura Sun. Available in a number of colors and unique facial expressions, this charming ceramic container makes for a cheerful place for your plant to call home.

lore.name: Hemera
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RSI Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Civilian Designing the Hemera quantum drive has allowed the technicians at Robert Space Industries to push the boundaries of quantum travel technology even further, and allow you to go even farther.

lore.name: Hemera
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RSI Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Civilian Designing the Hemera quantum drive has allowed the technicians at Robert Space Industries to push the boundaries of quantum travel technology even further, and allow you to go even farther.

lore.name: Hephaestanite
lore.description: Found often near volcanic outcroppings, this mineral is commonly used for a thermal insulator.

lore.name: Herald Ghoulish Green Livery
lore.description: Embrace Day of the Vara mischievousness and mayhem any time of the year with this custom Herald livery. It combines metallic green and black for a striking look that highlights the holiday's classic colors.

lore.name: Herald Polar Livery
lore.description: Modify your Herald with this white and grey livery specifically designed for the 2951 IAE.

lore.name: Herald Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom Herald livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter 2951 Best in Show Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the Starlifter being voted a Best in Show finalist for 2951 with this special blue and black livery.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter ArcCorp Livery
lore.description: The ArcCorp livery for the Starlifter features the company's logo atop a maroon base paint with black and yellow highlights.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Argent Livery
lore.description: A metallic silver finish makes the Argent livery a striking choice for the Hercules Starlifter.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Cerberus Livery
lore.description: Let your Hercules Starlifter become one with the vast, black expanse of space with the Cerberus livery.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Crusader Livery
lore.description: The Crusader livery for the Starlifter features the company's logo atop a light blue base paint with black and white highlights.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Deadlock Camo Livery
lore.description: Disguise the silhouette of the Hercules Starlifter with the Deadlock Camo livery, featuring a grey camo pattern with yellow highlights.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Draco Livery
lore.description: Customize your Hercules Starlifter with the exquisite Draco livery that's gold with black highlights.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Dryad Livery
lore.description: A woodland camo inspired design distinguishes the Dryad livery from other options for the Hercules Starlifter.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Flight Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU A flight jacket dedicated to the Hercules Starlifter and its ability to handle more than twelve labors. Made from synthetic leather, the jacket is styled with two front pockets, a ribbed waistband and cuffs to guarantee a good fit. The front features a Crusader logo while the back sports the ship serenely soaring through the clouds.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Fortuna Livery
lore.description: Make luck your co-pilot. Boldly set your sights on the stars and adventure forth in style with the Fortuna livery. This Stella Fortuna themed paint scheme is primarily green with grey accents.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Frostbite Camo Livery
lore.description: Soar like the winter winds with the Frostbite Camo livery for your Hercules Starlifter.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Hurston Livery
lore.description: The Hurston livery for the Starlifter features the company's logo atop a grey base paint with yellow highlights.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Invictus Blue and Gold Livery
lore.description: Featuring a vibrant blue base color and gold highlights, the Invictus Blue and Gold livery will give your Starlifter a striking style.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Meridian Livery
lore.description: The Meridian livery gives the Hercules Starlifter a simple yet stylish metallic silver finish.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter microTech Livery
lore.description: The microTech livery for the Starlifter features the company's logo atop a white base paint with light blue and grey highlights.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Sylvan Livery
lore.description: The Sylvan livery for the Hercules Starlifter is a distinct, no-nonsense matte green with light grey accents.

lore.name: Hercules Starlifter Timberline Livery
lore.description: Customize your Hercules Starlifter with the Timberline livery that's olive green with orange accents.

lore.name: Hermes Disco Livery
lore.description: Equip the ship livery used by ace pilot Disco in the classic children's cartoon Rory Nova. While it turns the Hermes metallic dark blue, black, and red, whether you turn into the 'dynamic, instinctive spacecraft operator' that inspired the livery's name is up to you.

lore.name: Hermes Disco Livery
lore.description: Carve a path through the unknown with the Dauntless livery. Featuring a deep, slate blue and striking red details, this color palette is for the bold and the brave.

lore.name: Hermes Earthfall Livery
lore.description: Black, beige, and red come together to create a grounded color scheme for the Earthfall livery.

lore.name: Hermes Honorbound Livery
lore.description: Fight for glory with the Honorbound livery, consisting of a muted military green accompanied by a subtle bronze.

lore.name: Hermes Keystone Livery
lore.description: Crisp white with blue accents, the Keystone livery celebrates the workers whose mining, refining, hauling, salvaging, and more have made the empire what it is today.

lore.name: Hermes Lockdown Livery
lore.description: Featuring yellow highlights that pops against a rich black hull, the Lockdown livery is sure to make a statement.

lore.name: Hermes Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Roberts Space Industries Size: 2 Missiles: 8xS2 Bespoke missile rack for the RSI Hermes that fires eight S2 missiles.

lore.name: Hermes Navarra Livery
lore.description: Evoking the sandy browns of an arid savanna, the Navarra livery is offset with a splash of bright blue.

lore.name: Hermes Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Hermes with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Hermes Paragon Livery
lore.description: The Paragon livery consists of a cool, crisp white, with regal blue and gold accents worthy of admiration.

lore.name: Hermes Pulsar Livery
lore.description: Primarily a brilliant purple offset by a vivid orange, the Pulsar livery blends these contrasting colors into an interstellar mix.

lore.name: Hermes Tripline Livery
lore.description: Sharp, silver accents cuts through the stark black of the Tripline livery's metallic color scheme.

lore.name: HEX
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Civilian Prepare your ship for any circumstance by installing a HEX from Seal Corporation. Balanced performance and durability make this an ideal, versatile choice for those who don’t know where their next adventure may take them.

lore.name: HexaPolyMesh Coating
lore.description: This liquid hexagonal lattice bonds readily to surfaces when electrically charged, solidifying almost instantaneously to create an incredibly strong and durable polymer mesh that maintains integrity at a range of temperatures and pressures.

lore.name: HG-15 Jaeger (1.5x Holographic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Type: Holographic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 1.5x - 3x Aim Time: +5% Parallax: Low Size: 1 HG-15 Jaeger's features a low power variable magnification providing flexibility when engaging hostiles at close and longer ranges.

lore.name: HG-2 Jaeger (2x Holographic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Type: Holographic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 2x - 4x Aim Time: +5% Parallax: Low Size: 1 Specializing in medium distance combat, the HG-2 Jaeger excels in situations where you want to keep your distance from hostiles.

lore.name: HG-3 Jaeger (3x Holographic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Type: Holographic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 3x Aim Time: +5% Parallax: Low Size: 1 Featuring KLWE's proprietary NocturnaLite hardware, the HG-3 Jaeger provides enhanced vision in low-light situations.

lore.name: Hi&Tight Shoes
lore.description: Take your next step in these versatile high-tops from NorthStar. The Hi&Tight's cut an intriguing profile by blending nylon and microweave fabric with a vulcanized rubber soul, padded collar, and cross foot fastening strap.

lore.name: Hide
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Vanduul Size: 1 Grade: N/A Class: Military The Vanduul’s aggressive dog fighting tactics are possible because this shield generator provides them the protection to do so.

lore.name: High Taper Fade
lore.description: An agressively tight taper.

lore.name: Highball Glass
lore.description: A tall and narrow drinking vessel made from tempered glassware.

lore.name: Hill Horror Reborn Poster
lore.description: A poster for the horror sequel vid “The Hill Horror Reborn” that tells the continuing story of rampaging masked killer Neville Lott.

lore.name: Hillcrest Boots
lore.description: Spend all day in your Hillcrest boots. Rugged yet refined, the boots feature a stylish and waterproof brown synthetic leather with red inlays and yellow stitching. A comfortable, odor absorbing insole and slip resistant outer sole will keep you comfortable and on your feet.

lore.name: HLX99 Hyperprocessors
lore.description: Commonly known as "Helixes" these Banu manufactured processing chips were designed for fullcore crypto-cracking and are used in the manufacture of computer system infiltration devices.

lore.name: HMF-T12 "Hammerfall" Torpedo Launcher
lore.description: Item Type: Torpedo Launcher Manufacturer: Behring Size: 10 Torpedoes: 20xS12 Offering an alternative to the stock Aegis Idris nose gun, this set of four torpedo launchers are able to store twenty S12 torpedoes, four in each launcher and four in reserve.

lore.name: Hoffdor (Bottle)
lore.description: HEI: 18 Effects: Cognitive Impairment, Dehydrating The same original 2788 recipe for an unfiltered brown ale that is still brewed to perfection.

lore.name: Holdstrong
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 4 This capital-class shield generator was designed specifically for the Idris frigate.

lore.name: Holiday Butcher Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -56 / 86 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 4.0 µSCU Celebrate the season with the festive Holiday Butcher helmet. Doomsday designed this twisted bit of armor to withstand a firefight, raucous holiday party, and everything in between. The snout's custom armor plating provides protection while remaining lightweight, and the synthetic spiral horns are more durable than the real deal. The Holiday Butcher adds to Doomsday's reputation as the universe's premiere engineer of warped gear. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Holographic Vanduul Skull
lore.description: Based on a real Vanduul killed during the Battle of Vega II, this hologram serves as a reminder of the horrors Humanity faced on that harrowing day.

lore.name: Horde Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Complementary pieces come together to form the Horde. This striking jacket from 987 features a strong asymmetrical design with a high-lo hem and aggressive detailing on the sleeves. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Horizon Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -37 / 67 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s RSI's Horizon helmet is a durable and robust environmental enclosed work helmet. The single sheet laminate dome gives you an extremely wide field of view. A pair of side-mounted LED light modules provide additional illumination to make sure you can see what you're doing.

lore.name: Horizon Helmet "Rust Society"
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -37 / 67 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s RSI's Horizon helmet is a durable and robust environmental enclosed work helmet. The single sheet laminate dome gives you an extremely wide field of view. A pair of side-mounted LED light modules provide additional illumination to make sure you can see what you're doing. The Rust Society edition celebrates blue-collar workers with an exclusive red and tan coloration that hides dirt and wear and tear well.

lore.name: Hornet Corin Camo Livery
lore.description: Show your support for the UEE's most elite fighting force with the Corin Camo livery for the Hornet Mk I. Commissioned in 2860 to celebrate the 300th anniversary of the Marines becoming their own branch of the military, the livery is a classic green camo with red highlights and the UEE logo.

lore.name: Hornet Frostbite Camo Livery
lore.description: Soar like the winter winds with the Frostbite Camo livery for your Hornet.

lore.name: Hornet Icebound Livery
lore.description: The Icebound livery covers the Hornet Mk2 in crisp white with light blue highlights.

lore.name: Hornet Invictus Blue and Gold Livery
lore.description: Featuring a vibrant blue base color and gold highlights, the Invictus Blue and Gold livery will give your Hornet a striking style.

lore.name: Hornet Ironheart Livery
lore.description: The Ironheart is a special livery for the Hornet Mk I. This unique livery was previously used by the Navy on Hornets escorting diplomats before being retired and released to the public. It is primarily grey with yellow and orange highlights and the UEE logo.

lore.name: Hornet Ironscale Livery
lore.description: Primarily black with bronze highlights, the Ironscale livery gives the Hornet Mk2 a subtle yet elegant style.

lore.name: Hornet Kilian Blue Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the deep blue skies frequently seen in the Navy's home system, the Kilian Blue livery was designed in 2880 to celebrate the 500th anniversary of Pax Humana and the formation of the Navy. Made specifically for the Hornet Mk I, the livery is dark blue with grey highlights and crisp white UEE logos.

lore.name: Hornet Mk II Blacksmith Livery
lore.description: While few would describe the Hornet Mk II as understated, the sleek two-tone black and grey finish of the Blacksmith livery comes close.

lore.name: Hornet Mk II Bracken Livery
lore.description: Mark the occasion with a splash of color thanks to the Bracken livery featuring a sage green hull paired with deep orange accents.

lore.name: Hornet Mk II Canopy Camo Livery
lore.description: Get in close for the kill with the Canopy Camo livery. It utilizes a digital camo pattern consisting of tan, olive, and green to help disguise the Hornet Mk II.

lore.name: Hornet Mk II Fortitude Livery
lore.description: Primarily dark grey, the Fortitude livery uses vibrant blue highlights to accentuate the silhouette of the iconic Hornet Mk II.

lore.name: Hornet Mk II Heartseeker Livery
lore.description: Made for pilots whose true love is the thrill of a harrowing dogfight, the Heartseeker livery for the Hornet Mk II features a white base paint, red highlights, and a heart decal near the cockpit.

lore.name: Hornet Mk II Lovestruck Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your Hornet Mk II.

lore.name: Hornet Mk II Quicksand Livery
lore.description: Bring to bear the incredible firepower of the Hornet Mk II in distinct style with the tan and black Quicksand livery.

lore.name: Hornet Mk II Regalia Livery
lore.description: Not every pilot was meant to fly a Hornet Mk II. Mark your distinction with the Regalia livery's emerald green hull paired with eye-catching gold accents.

lore.name: Hornet Mk II Shikari Livery
lore.description: The Shikari livery gives the Hornet Mk II a unique silver and blue camo design.

lore.name: Hornet Mk II Silva Livery
lore.description: Featuring various shades of green, the Silva livery brings a bold and distinct look to the Hornet Mk II.

lore.name: Hornet Mk II Tigerveil Livery
lore.description: The dynamic Hornet Mk II deserves a livery to match. The Tigerveil livery consists of a steely blue with bold orange and subtle black highlights.

lore.name: Hornet Poster
lore.description: The F7A Hornet is one of the most iconic space superiority fighters ever developed. Celebrate its heritage with this fantastic poster!

lore.name: Hornet Simoom Livery
lore.description: Gain an advantage when patrolling or exploring deserts in the Hornet F7A Mk2 with the Simoom livery, which mixes tan camo with black highlights.

lore.name: Hornet Timberline Livery
lore.description: Customize your Hornet with the Timberline livery that's olive green with orange accents.

lore.name: HoverQuad Copperhead Livery
lore.description: Speed across picturesque landscapes in this sublime HoverQuad Copperhead livery, which is white, bronze, and black.

lore.name: HoverQuad Lightspeed Livery
lore.description: Speed across picturesque landscapes in this sublime HoverQuad Lightspeed livery, which is orange with yellow flourishes.

lore.name: HoverQuad Lovestruck Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your HoverQuad.

lore.name: HoverQuad Overdrive Livery
lore.description: Blast past other racers in your HoverQuad with the Overdrive livery, which features a stylish blend red and silver coloring.

lore.name: HoverQuad Slipstream Livery
lore.description: The Slipstream livery will have your HoverQuad ready and raring to race with this sleek blue and white paint scheme.

lore.name: HoverQuad Terminus Livery
lore.description: Speed across picturesque landscapes in this sublime HoverQuad Terminus livery, which is black with red flourishes.

lore.name: HoverQuad Turbocharged Livery
lore.description: The Turbocharged is a distinct, purple racing livery for the HoverQuad that will make you stand out from the rest of the field.

lore.name: HP-284 Rocket Launcher
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Launcher Class: Rocket Magazine Size: 2 Rate Of Fire: 20 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Attachments: Optics (N/A), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (N/A) Deliver a one-two punch with the HP-284 rocket launcher from Behring. Designed to blast two dumbfire rockets in quick succession, the weapon can have a quick and devastating impact on adversaries and is effective against vehicles.

lore.name: Hui’a Puzzle
lore.description: Half toy and half meditation device, this small trinket showcases the Xi’an’s mastery of gravity and is meant to inspire the user to contemplate the forces that bind us together.

lore.name: Hull A Bombora Livery
lore.description: Featuring a color scheme that's vibrant blue on the top and a vivid orange on the bottom, the Bombora livery gives that Hull A a strikingly distinct look.

lore.name: Hull A Dusk Livery
lore.description: For the long haul cargo captains who prefer to make a subtle statement when it comes to their freighter, MISC offers the distinguished Hull A Dusk Livery. A complete grey hull highlights the ship's classic silhouette with tasteful gold trim.

lore.name: Hull A Empyrean Livery
lore.description: Cargo hauling takes on a bold new look with the Hull A Empyrean Livery which features a dynamic tricolor design. Yellow highlights divide a white nose from a grey engineering section lending the appearance of speed to the freighter.

lore.name: Hull A Horizon Livery
lore.description: Even a hard working spacecraft deserves to look its best. The Hull A Horizon Livery offers a stylish two-tone grey-and-white color scheme that's ideal for turning heads at the spaceport.

lore.name: Hull A Trailblazer Livery
lore.description: The Trailblazer livery creates a cool, understated style for your Hull A with grey on top and dark red on the bottom.

lore.name: Hull B Dusk Livery
lore.description: For the long haul cargo captains who prefer to make a subtle statement when it comes to their freighter, MISC offers the distinguished Hull B Dusk Livery. A complete grey hull highlights the ship's classic silhouette with tasteful gold trim.

lore.name: Hull B Empyrean Livery
lore.description: Cargo hauling takes on a bold new look with the Hull B Empyrean Livery which features a dynamic tricolor design. Yellow highlights divide a white nose from a grey engineering section lending the appearance of speed to the freighter.

lore.name: Hull B First Light Livery
lore.description: Haulers looking to create buzz about the look of their Hull B should equip the First Light livery with its black front and yellow back sections.

lore.name: Hull B Horizon Livery
lore.description: Even a hard working spacecraft deserves to look its best. The Hull B Horizon Livery offers a stylish two-tone grey-and-white color scheme that's ideal for turning heads at the spaceport.

lore.name: Hull B Keystone Livery
lore.description: Crisp white with blue accents, the Keystone livery celebrates the workers whose mining, refining, hauling, salvaging, and more have made the empire what it is today.

lore.name: Hull B Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: MISC Size: 6 Missiles: 8xS3 Bespoke missile rack for the MISC Hull B that fires eight S3 missiles.

lore.name: Hull C Bombora Livery
lore.description: Featuring a color scheme that's vibrant blue on the top and a vivid orange on the bottom, the Bombora livery gives that Hull C a strikingly distinct look.

lore.name: Hull C Dusk Livery
lore.description: For the long haul cargo captains who prefer to make a subtle statement when it comes to their freighter, MISC offers the distinguished Hull C Dusk Livery. A complete grey hull highlights the ship's classic silhouette with tasteful gold trim.

lore.name: Hull C Empyrean Livery
lore.description: Cargo hauling takes on a bold new look with the Hull C Empyrean Livery which features a dynamic tricolor layout. Yellow highlights divide a white front from a grey back section lending the appearance of speed to the freighter.

lore.name: Hull C Horizon Livery
lore.description: Even a hard working spacecraft deserves to look its best. The Hull C Horizon Livery offers a stylish two-tone grey-and-white color scheme that's ideal for turning heads at the spaceport.

lore.name: Hull C Miniature
lore.description: Hold an iconic hauling ship in the palm of your hand with this Hull C miniature. Takuetsu carefully recreated the Hull C with exacting detail to honor what is believed to be the most common ship in the galaxy.

lore.name: Hull C Model "Collapsed"
lore.description: Celebrate the workhorse of the hauling world with this finely detailed Hull C model. It's been expertly crafted by Takuetsu with help from MISC to make sure every last detail matches and honors the original.

lore.name: Hull C Model "Extended"
lore.description: Celebrate the workhorse of the hauling world with this finely detailed Hull C model. It's been expertly crafted by Takuetsu with help from MISC to make sure every last detail matches and honors the original. The "Extended" edition features the ship with its iconic spindles exposed and ready to receive cargo.

lore.name: Hull C Model Box
lore.description: A collector's edition box for Takuetsu's Hull C Model, featuring an image of the iconic ship on the front along with details about the model.

lore.name: Hull C Poster
lore.description: Honor an industrial workhorse with this unique and visually stunning poster of the MISC Hull C. Featuring the ship's silhouette set against a colorful swirling spacescape, the poster highlights the Hull C's iconic design by having its spindle extended.

lore.name: Hull C Trailblazer Livery
lore.description: The Trailblazer livery creates a cool, understated style for your Hull C with grey on top and dark red on the bottom.

lore.name: Human Food Bars
lore.description: Despite what the label on the packaging declares, the Banu manufactured "Human Food Bars" have been shown to contain multiple additives deemed unsafe for Human consumption.

lore.name: Human Food Bars T-Shirt
lore.description: Eat, Humans! A Banu souli made this shirt to promote Human Food Bars, an all-around excellent energy source for hungry Humans. Be sure to track down these yummy, Human friendly treats when visiting Banu space.

lore.name: Hunter
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Blue Triangle Inc. Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Stealth When a low signature is of the utmost importance, the Hunter stealth radar will keep you aware of what’s around without getting you found.

lore.name: Huracan
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Industrial Juno Starwerk understands that your most important job is to keep your cargo safe. That’s why their Huracan quantum drive prioritizes interdiction shielding, stability, and damage efficiency above everything else.

lore.name: Hurricane Flashfire Livery
lore.description: Metallic red and crisp white stylings combine for the bright and bold Flashfire livery for the Hurricane.

lore.name: Hurricane Polar Camo Livery
lore.description: Modify your Hurricane with this white and grey camo livery specifically designed for the 2950 IAE event on microTech.

lore.name: Hurricane Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: This custom Hurricane livery was created to celebrate the 2950 IAE on microTech. It blends black and electric blue to give the ship a cool new look.

lore.name: Hurricane Waylay Camo Livery
lore.description: Equip your Hurricane in classic camo colors and stylings with the Waylay Camo livery.

lore.name: Hurston Hat
lore.description: A brown and gray cadet hat with Hurston Dynamics' name and logo emblazoned across the front panel.

lore.name: Hydrocel
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Industrial Keep your ship working harder for longer with the durable Hydrocel, an entry-level industrial cooler from respected manufacturer Juno Starwerk.

lore.name: Hydrogen
lore.description: The most abundant element in the universe. The building block of stars. Highly flammable in its pure form.

lore.name: Hydrogen Fuel
lore.description: Hydrogen that is energized and then used by thrusters to propel vehicles.

lore.name: Hydrogen Fuel Tank
lore.description: The Vanduul Mauler's Hydrogen Fuel Tank stores fuel to power the Mauler conventional engines and thrusters.

lore.name: HydroJet
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Industrial When your ship overheats, it makes just about any task not only more difficult, but potentially dangerous for you and your crew. With the entry-level HydroJet from Juno Starwerk installed, you can be confident that your heat levels are being controlled by a cooler designed by one of the most trustworthy names in the industry.

lore.name: Hydropulse
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Industrial An entry level option to Juno Starwerk’s brand of coolers, the Hydropulse sacrifices some durability and utilizes some design tricks to make this large industrial cooler an option for those unable to afford one of their top of the line models.

lore.name: Hyper Vanguard Force T-Shirt
lore.description: The battle against pirate captain Balthazar jumps from the arcade to this animated t-shirt. Special fabric scrolls graphics from 'Hyper Vanguard Force IV' to celebrate this arcade classic from Original System.

lore.name: HyperGen
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Military The HyperGen power plant is popular among both civilians and the military for its high quality. As a bonus, the manufacture, Amon & Reese, is famous for its stellar customer service.

lore.name: Hyperion
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RSI Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Civilian In honor of the name, the first test flight destination for this popular RSI quantum drive was the similarly named satellite of Saturn.

lore.name: Hyperion Brass Bishop
lore.description: This brass chess piece is a part of the classic Hyperion set that has been imitated multiple times since its 25th century debut.

lore.name: Hyperion Brass Bishop
lore.description: This revenant wood chess piece is a part of the classic Hyperion set that has been imitated multiple times since its 25th century debut.

lore.name: I'rhal Missile Launcher
lore.description: Manufacturer: Torral Aggregate Item Type: Launcher Class: Missile Magazine Size: 3 round of 10 small rockets Rate Of Fire: 10 rpm Effective Range: 200 m Attachments: Optics (N/A), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (N/A) Designed by the Xi'an manufacturing collective, Torral Aggregate, the I'rhal requires a skilled operator to unleash the full destructive potential of this weapon's high-powered energy missile barrage.

lore.name: IAE 2950 Hat
lore.description: Boast about attending the UEE's most prominent ship showcase with the official hat of the 2950 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. This grey cadet hat has the logo across the front panel and as a pop of color on the back.

lore.name: IAE 2950 T-Shirt
lore.description: When Audrey Timmerman and friends gathered in 2670 to test her ship's experimental thrusters no one could have predicted the event would evolve into the Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. Nearly three centuries later, this grey t-shirt with white ribbing commemorates the 2950 IAE. Featuring the event's logo on the front and back, all proceeds from the shirt's sale will go to Simpods Pals, a charity founded by Timmerman to help underprivileged children learn to fly.

lore.name: IAE 2951 Hat Blue
lore.description: The official hat of the 2951 IAE carries the logo for the event on the front and a smaller version of it on the back right panel.

lore.name: IAE 2951 Hat White
lore.description: The official hat of the 2951 IAE carries the logo for the event on the front and a smaller version of it on the back right panel.

lore.name: IAE 2951 T-Shirt Blue
lore.description: Commemorate the UEE's ultimate ship celebration with this blue ringer t-shirt that features a large version of the 2951 logo on the front and a smaller version across the back.

lore.name: IAE 2951 T-Shirt White
lore.description: Commemorate the UEE's ultimate ship celebration with this white ringer t-shirt that features a large version of the 2951 logo on the front and a smaller version across the back.

lore.name: IAE 2952 Hat Black
lore.description: A black cadet hat celebrating the 2952 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo featuring the event's logo across the front.

lore.name: IAE 2952 Hat Red
lore.description: A red cadet hat celebrating the 2952 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo featuring the event's logo across the front.

lore.name: IAE 2952 T-shirt Black
lore.description: Commemorate the 2952 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo with this black t-shirt featuring the event's logo across the front.

lore.name: IAE 2952 T-shirt Red
lore.description: Commemorate the 2952 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo with this red t-shirt featuring the event's logo across the front.

lore.name: IAE 2953 Hat Purple
lore.description: Celebrate the UEE's premier ship expo with the official hat of the 2953 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. This purple hat displays the IAE logo on the front and back.

lore.name: IAE 2953 Hat White
lore.description: Celebrate the UEE's premier ship expo with the official hat of the 2953 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. This white hat displays the IAE logo on the front and back.

lore.name: IAE 2953 Shirt Purple
lore.description: Commemorate the UEE's foremost celebration of ships with the official shirt of the 2953 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. This purple shirt features the IAE logo on the front, with a smaller version on the back.

lore.name: IAE 2953 Shirt White
lore.description: Commemorate the UEE's foremost celebration of ships with the official shirt of the 2953 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. This white shirt features the IAE logo on the front, with a smaller version on the back.

lore.name: IAE 2954 Hat Purple
lore.description: The official hat of the 2954 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo is a vibrant purple with the logo across the front.

lore.name: IAE 2954 Hat White
lore.description: The official hat of the 2954 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo is a crisp white with the logo across the front.

lore.name: IAE 2954 T-Shirt Purple
lore.description: The official shirt of the 2954 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. This soft and supremely comfortable cotton t-shirt is a vibrant purple with the IAE logo on the front, "The Next Frontier" tagline across the back, and the year on the right sleeve.

lore.name: IAE 2954 T-Shirt White
lore.description: The official shirt of the 2954 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. This soft and supremely comfortable cotton t-shirt is a crisp white with the IAE logo on the front, "The Next Frontier" tagline across the back, and the year on the right sleeve.

lore.name: IAE 2955 Hat Black
lore.description: The official hat of the 2955 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo features black fabric with the logo across the front.

lore.name: IAE 2955 Hat Gray
lore.description: The official hat of the 2955 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo features gray fabric with the logo across the front.

lore.name: IAE 2955 T-Shirt Black
lore.description: The official shirt of the 2955 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. This soft and supremely comfortable cotton t-shirt is black with the IAE logo on the front, the event's tagline across the back, and the year on the right sleeve.

lore.name: IAE 2955 T-Shirt Gray
lore.description: The official shirt of the 2955 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. This soft and supremely comfortable cotton t-shirt is gray with the IAE logo on the front, the event's tagline across the back, and the year on the right sleeve.

lore.name: Ice-Flush
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Industrial The Juno Starwerk Ice-Flush cooler is built to withstand the heat demands and thermal strains that many industrial ships deal with as part of their average workday.

lore.name: IceBox
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Stealth The IceBox is an upgrade to the company’s standard medium cooler, as the team at Tyler Design & Tech made a number of subtle modifications and material upgrades that lowered the component’s signatures without greatly affecting its durability.

lore.name: IceDive
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: ACOM Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Competition The IceDive delivers peak performance over other medium coolers of its grade, though it does come at the cost of generating high IR and EM signatures.

lore.name: icePick
lore.description: Initially made to allow microTech customer support technicians to access and diagnose security-locked systems, the icePick cryptokey was named by the team for its ability to "quickly break through frozen code-blocks." Today, the powerful enterprise-level cryptokey has become available for direct purchase, allowing users and private IT professionals to problem solve issues themselves when they cannot be serviced by microTech technician.

lore.name: IcePlunge
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: ACOM Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Competition When you’re pushing your ship to the limit during that frantic last lap, you’ll be glad you have ACOM’s IcePlunge to keep things cool.

lore.name: Idris Beachhead Livery
lore.description: Proclaim your presence with the Beachhead livery for the Idris. It uses various shades of beige and brown for a look that stands out against the dark of space.

lore.name: Idris Commando Camo Livery
lore.description: The Commando Camo livery brings a classic green and tan camo look to the Idris.

lore.name: Idris Ironcore Livery
lore.description: The chrome and black colors of the Ironcore livery helps the Idris obscure itself against the dark expanse of space.

lore.name: Idris Marauder Livery
lore.description: Designed for the Idris-K aftermarket kit, the Marauder livery is primarily black with subtle red highlights.

lore.name: Idris Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Idris with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Idris Sea Serpent Livery
lore.description: Cool blues and black combine for this subdued Idris Sea Serpent livery.

lore.name: Idris Sharktooth Livery
lore.description: Charge into battle in stylish and dramatic fashion with the Sharktooth livery. It gives the Idris a distinct look using beige and black for a disruptive coloration pattern that helps break up the silhouette of the ship.

lore.name: Idris Triton Camo Livery
lore.description: Conceal the shape of the Idris with the blue camo pattern of the Triton Camo livery.

lore.name: Idris-P T-Shirt
lore.description: When a civilian version of the long-admired Idris-M frigate debuted in 2875, it caught the imagination of countless pilots and quickly became one of Aegis' most popular capital ships. Celebrate 80 years of the Idris-P with this limited-edition T-Shirt, featuring a schematic-style image of the capital ship on the front and the logo of Aegis Dynamics on the back.

lore.name: IFR-532 Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 5 Missiles: 3x32 Designed to bolster the offensive capabilities of the Idris, this missile rack was made by Aegis Dynamics specifically for the famed frigate.

lore.name: IFR-810 Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 8 Missiles: 5x10 Designed to bolster the offensive capabilities of the Idris, this missile rack was made by Aegis Dynamics specifically for the famed frigate.

lore.name: IFR-A77 Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Manned Turret Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 7 This manned turret, designed by Aegis to be equipped with two size 7 weapons, is bespoke to the Idris frigate.

lore.name: IFR-BC7 Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Turret Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 7 This manned turret, designed by Aegis to be used with ballistic cannons, is bespoke to the Idris frigate.

lore.name: IFR-MS7 Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Turret Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 7 This manned turret, designed by Aegis to be used in tandem with the IFR-532 missile rack, is bespoke to the Idris frigate.

lore.name: IFR-W57 Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Turret Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 7 This manned turret, designed by Aegis to be equipped with two size 5 weapons, is bespoke to the Idris frigate.

lore.name: Ignaz Surgical Gloves
lore.description: The Ignaz surgical gloves are sterile and strong without sacrifice the manual dexterity necessary for delicate surgeries. Made with a special anti-puncture material and featuring a beaded cuff that guarantees a snug fit, the inside of the glove is also coated with a special gel to keep your hands from drying and cracking.

lore.name: Ignite II Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Firestorm Kinetics Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 2 The Ignite is Firestorm's premier brand of heat-seeking strike missile that is the definition of Fire and Forget. Simply let it fly and enjoy the show.

lore.name: Ignite II-G Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Firestorm Kinetics Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 2 The Ignite is Firestorm's premier brand of heat-seeking strike missile that is the definition of Fire and Forget. Simply let it fly and enjoy the show. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

lore.name: Imperial Trio Kacho
lore.description: NDR: 30 Effects: None Big Benny's kacho is based on traditional family recipes straight from Corel, combining springy noodles and a rich, warm broth to create a taste enjoyed the 'verse over. The Imperial Trio flavor features three different and delicious savory proteins lightly seasoned to perfection.

lore.name: Impulse
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: ArcCorp Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian Legend claims an inaccurate lathe cut materials thinner than expected on the Impulse prototype. When its test performance exceeded expectations, engineers adopted the changes, and ArcCorp's premiere size three quantum drive was born.

lore.name: Impulse
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: ArcCorp Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian Legend claims an inaccurate lathe cut materials thinner than expected on the Impulse prototype. When its test performance exceeded expectations, engineers adopted the changes, and ArcCorp's premiere size three quantum drive was born.

lore.name: IndVest Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 5K µSCU Keep your tools within easy reach with Stegman's IndVest. Made from industrial strength materials, this is a rare jacket that's both stylish and sensible.

lore.name: IndVest Jacket "Pathfinder"
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 5K µSCU Keep your tools within easy reach with Stegman's IndVest. The exclusive Pathfinder edition is made from black industrial strength materials that includes both purple and silver highlights. A rare jacket that's both stylish and sensible. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Inert Materials
lore.description: Non-valuable materials collected during the mining process.

lore.name: INK
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Civilian When you’re looking for a dependable shield, why not trust the company that’s been doing it longer than anyone else? Seal Corporation’s original INK shield generator has been a staple around the Empire for generations.

lore.name: INK
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Civilian When you’re looking for a dependable shield, why not trust the company that’s been doing it longer than anyone else? Seal Corporation’s original INK shield generator has been a staple around the Empire for generations.

lore.name: INK-Mark 104-ID
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Civilian By bolstering the direct fire absorption of their all-purpose shield generator line, Seal Corporation’s INK-Mark generator sacrifices some resistance to splash damage to allow a ship to better weather a focused attack.

lore.description: Manufacturer: Seal Corporation By bolstering the direct fire absorption of their all-purpose shield generator line, Seal Corporation’s INK-Mark generator sacrifices some resistance to splash damage to allow a ship to better weather a focused attack.

lore.description: Manufacturer: Seal Corporation By focusing on improving the splash damage absorption of their all-purpose shield generator line, Seal Corporation’s INK-Splash generator exchanges some protection from direct fire for extra strength against missiles.

lore.description: Manufacturer: Seal Corporation By focusing on improving the splash damage absorption of their all-purpose shield generator line, Seal Corporation’s INK-Splash generator exchanges some protection from direct fire for extra strength against missiles.

lore.name: Inmate Work Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Worksuit Helmet Damage Reduction: 10% Temp. Rating: -75 / 75 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s The Inmate Work Helmet features a highly visible design for easy visual tracking, alongside an anti-fogging, crack resistant faceplate sealed into reinforced plating that's rated to withstand falling debris, which helps minimize costly accidents to your labor pool.

lore.name: Inmate Workpack
lore.description: Item Type: Light Backpack Carrying Capacity: 50K µSCU Core Compatibility: All This sturdy Inmate Workpack provides ample storage capacity and evenly distributes weight across the wearer's back allowing them to carry more during every shift. It also features secure bottom straps to allow you to determine oxygen tank size on a per inmate basis, minimizing escape risk.

lore.name: Inmate Worksuit
lore.description: Item Type: Worksuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -75 / 75 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU The Inmate Worksuit is a durable and highly visible worksuit designed to survive harsh conditions often faced by inmates during work release programs. The worksuit integrated reinforced padding for protection with a strong synthetic weave that meets the minimal government standard for thermal insulation while keeping costs low. The sturdy workpack provides ample storage capacity and evenly distributes weight across the wearer's back allowing them to carry more during every shift. It also features secure bottom straps to allow you to determine oxygen tank size on a per inmate basis, minimizing escape risk.

lore.name: Inox
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Saga Datasystems Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Industrial Before founding Saga Datasystem, Lavinia Kilo was an industrial engineer. Her love of versatile yet utilitarian components is reflected in the Inox — a computer system designed with the hauler in mind.

lore.name: Inquisitor Arms Neon Pink
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -56 / 86 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Strength and speed combine with the new Inquisitor armor set. Strong yet lightweight alloy plating works alongside reinforced polyfiber weaving to save your skin, but not slow you down. When combined with Kastak Arms' intimidating aesthetic, it's easy to see why this medium armor has become infamous across the Empire.

lore.name: Inquisitor Core Neon Pink
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -56 / 86 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 6.4 µSCU Backpacks: Medium, Light Strength and speed combine with the new Inquisitor armor set. lore.name: Inspire
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Industrial No matter the job, you need to be sure that you're life support system is going to do its part - day in, day out. That's why Juno Starwerk built the Inspire life support system to be tough enough so you could breath easy.

lore.name: Inspire Advanced
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Industrial No matter the job, you need to be sure that you're life support system is going to do its part - day in, day out. That's why Juno Starwerk built the Inspire life support system to be tough enough so you could breath easy.
