lore.name: Insta-Friends Radar Scatter Grenade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Joker Engineering Item Type: Grenade Damage Type: Non-Lethal Joker’s Insta-Friends grenade brings a party to your adversaries when they least need it. Enemy radars caught within the grenade’s radius get flooded with enough fake signals to make their heads spin. Allowing you the advantage to either attack or escape.

lore.name: Insulated Cup
lore.description: Used to hold warm beverages, this drinking vessel has a layer of insulation to prevent scalding your hand while holding.

lore.name: Intergalactic Aerospace Expo T-Shirt
lore.description: The logo for the Intergalactic Aerospace Expo graces this magenta shirt made from 100% cotton.

lore.name: Interstellar Transport Guild Cargo Plushie
lore.description: Here's a haul you can hug. This plushie shaped like a cargo container features Interstellar Transport Guild branding with the guild's logo and blue and grey color scheme.

lore.name: Interstellar Transport Guild Container Model
lore.description: There's no need for a tractor beam to move this cargo container. This finely detailed model features Interstellar Transport Guild branding with the guild's logo and black and grey color scheme.

lore.name: Intrepid Altair Livery
lore.description: The Altair livery is primarily a crisp white with black and red highlights.

lore.name: Intrepid Epoque Livery
lore.description: The Epoque livery features a navy and black coloring and is finished with gold detailing.

lore.name: Intrepid Foundation Fest Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Intrepid Fusion Livery
lore.description: Sporting two distinct and vibrant shades of green with black highlights, the Fusion livery gives the Intrepid an utterly unique look.

lore.name: Intrepid Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Crusader Industries Size: 1 Missiles: 1xS1 Made to defend the Intrepid from unexpected trouble, Crusader developed this bespoke missile rack to carry and deploy an S1 missile.

lore.name: Intrepid Nocturne Livery
lore.description: Bold blue highlights pop against the black base paint of the Nocturne livery.

lore.name: Intrepid Oblivion Livery
lore.description: The Oblivion livery cloaks the Intrepid in black with subtle but striking gold highlights.

lore.name: Intrepid Wavefront Livery
lore.description: Featuring decorative white markings across a bluish-green base paint, the Wavefront livery brings a dynamic and distinct look to the Intrepid.

lore.name: Intrepid-OS
lore.description: RSI's Intrepid has been a reliable name in flight suit components for decades. The focused nozzle system provides consistent thrust for precise control in zero gravity.

lore.name: Invictus 2953 T-Shirt Blue
lore.description: Celebrate Invictus Launch Week 2953 with this blue t-shirt made from a comfortable cotton blend and featuring the silhouette of a ship across the front.

lore.name: Invictus 2953 T-Shirt Grey
lore.description: Celebrate Invictus Launch Week 2953 with this grey t-shirt made from a comfortable cotton blend and featuring the silhouette of a ship across the front.

lore.name: Invictus Cadet Hat
lore.description: A classic cadet hat commemorating Invictus Launch Week. It features the Invictus logo across the front and back.

lore.name: Invictus Flight Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Celebrate launch week in iconic style with this commemorative flight jacket featuring a Navy patch on the front and a large Invictus patch on the back. This synthetic leather jacket comes with two front pockets and ribbed waistband and cuffs that guarantee a good fit.

lore.name: Invictus Flight Jacket Steel
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Celebrate Launch Week in iconic style with this commemorative flight jacket featuring a Navy patch on the front and a large Invictus patch on the back. This synthetic leather jacket comes with two front pockets and ribbed waistband and cuffs that guarantee a good fit.

lore.name: Invictus Flyby Hat Blue
lore.description: A classic blue cadet hat commemorating Invictus Launch Week and featuring the silhouette of a ship across the front.

lore.name: Invictus Flyby Hat Grey
lore.description: A classic grey cadet hat commemorating Invictus Launch Week and featuring the silhouette of a ship across the front.

lore.name: Invictus Flyby T-Shirt Blue
lore.description: Few things are as awe-inspiring as a UEE Navy fleet flyby. This comfortable, cotton blend Invictus Launch Week t-shirt celebrates that memorable sight.

lore.name: Invictus Flyby T-Shirt Olive Green
lore.description: Few things are as awe-inspiring as a UEE Navy fleet flyby. This comfortable, cotton blend Invictus Launch Week t-shirt celebrates that memorable sight.

lore.name: Invictus Hat Blue
lore.description: Show your support for the Navy and the brave souls that serve the Empire with this classic cadet hat commemorating Invictus Launch Week.

lore.name: Invictus Hat Olive Green
lore.description: Show your support for the Navy and the brave souls that serve the Empire with this classic cadet hat commemorating Invictus Launch Week.

lore.name: Invictus Launch Week Coin
lore.description: This collectible coin features the UEE logo emblazoned on one face and the Invictus Launch Week logo on the reverse.

lore.name: Invictus Patch Collection
lore.description: Mounted inside a beautiful display case, this collection features three patches honoring the naval bases used over the centuries to train recruits into the brave starmen who dedicate their lives to defending Humanity.

lore.name: Invictus T-Shirt Blue
lore.description: Commemorate the biggest fleet flyby of the year with this comfortable t-shirt, featuring the seal of the UEE Navy on the front and the Invictus Launch Week logo on the back.

lore.name: Iodine
lore.description: The heaviest stable halogen. Sublimes from a purple-black metallic solid into a violet gas.

lore.name: IonBurst
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Civilian The IonBurst is touted by Lightning Power as being a best-in-class power plant, providing unequaled performance for the price.

lore.name: IonSurge
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Lighting Power Ltd. Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Civilian Lightning Power Ltd.’s line of medium power plants reach their pinnacle with the IonSurge. Design innovation and higher quality materials push this component's performance higher than others in its class.

lore.name: IonSurge Pro
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian Power plants from Lightning Power Ltd. don’t get much bigger or better than the IonSurge Pro. This top-of-the-line large power plant focuses on delivering solid results to keep your ship working longer.

lore.name: IonWave
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 0 Grade: B Class: Civilian The IonWave vehicle power plant can help you confidently summit the heights of most peaks without overheating thanks to the incredible technology inside designed by the folks at Lightning Power Ltd.

lore.name: Iron
lore.description: Element Fe, strong, malleable, highly susceptible to rust and found in large volume across most star systems.

lore.name: Iron (Ore)
lore.description: Element Fe, strong, malleable, highly susceptible to rust and found in large volume across most star systems.

lore.name: IronBand Hard Hat
lore.description: The IronBand is another in Stegman's award-winning line of safety wear. Built from top-grade impact resistant materials, the IronBand has undergone rigorous safety testing to provide maximum protection in the worst of conditions.

lore.name: Ironclad Aquamarine Livery
lore.description: The Aquamarine livery for the Ironclad gives a metallic teal base with subtle yellow accents to make a statement, before you throw a punch.

lore.name: Ironclad Commando Livery
lore.description: Primarily green with yellow accents, the Commando livery allows the Ironclad to blend in with forests and verdant locations.

lore.name: Ironclad Dauntless Livery
lore.description: Make the Ironclad even more imposing and impressive with the Dauntless livery, which is primarily black with striking silver highlight.

lore.name: Ironclad Sediment Livery
lore.description: When the job takes you to the back end of nowhere and back again, there's the Sediment livery which coats the Ironclad in a robust shade of brown.

lore.name: Ironclad Skull and Crossbones Livery
lore.description: This livery embraces classic pirate iconography by featuring several skull and crossbones symbols across the Ironclad's dark hull with blood red highlights.

lore.name: Ironclad Wind Chill Livery
lore.description: The Wind Chill livery for the Ironclad features crisp white paint with black highlights and silver accents.

lore.name: Irradiated Kopion Horn
lore.description: The horn of the kopion is made of a unique combination of bone and naturally-occurring carbon nanomaterials. This horn was exposed to radiation over a long period of time and has developed unusual coloration.

lore.name: Irradiated Valakkar Hide
lore.description: Thick skin that the grows over a forming valakkar pearl.

lore.name: Irradiated Valakkar Statue
lore.description: Face down the dangerous valakkar without risking your life with this exquisite statue. Irradiated by the toxic storms of Pyro I, this apex predator bursts forth from the ground ready to defend its young.

lore.name: ITG Hat
lore.description: A blue and black cadet hat with the Interstellar Transport Guild's name and logo emblazoned across the front and back panels.

lore.name: Ivers Boots Blue
lore.description: OpalSky imbued these ankle boots with their iconic panache. The Ivers are thoroughly fashionable but not flashy, and fitted with special KindSole insoles that provide exceptional comfort.

lore.name: Ixonia Armor Desert Camo
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -80 / 110 °C Radiation Protection: 52800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 251.1 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU Backpacks: All Tehachapi knows that you can never have too much storage. This lightweight protective gear comes with a sturdy tool belt, reinforced pouches, and hidden pockets so you can be sure your cargo will stay in place even when you're at your most active. An optional hood and adorned cape provide protection from the wind when worn with the matching helmet.

lore.name: Ixonia Gloves Green
lore.description: When you're preparing for the tough day ahead, don't leave your hands ungarded. These gloves feature built-in knuckle plates, secured to the durable synthetic leather and cotton fabric with a strong polymer-reinforced thread.

lore.name: Ixonia Helmet Desert Camo
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -80 / 110 °C Radiation Protection: 52800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 251.1 REM/s Made to withstand the heaviest hits, the Ixonia helmet was crafted with the needs of on-the-ground combat in mind. It features a hybrid composite shell and foam inner core that work in tandem to ensure stability and high impact-reisistance. An optional hood and camo cape provide protection from the wind when worn with the matching jacket. Please note that this mask is not space-rated and should only be worn in naturally breathable environs.

lore.name: Ixonia Pants Desert Camo
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -56 / 86 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 4.0 µSCU Designed in partnership with Grindstone Boots, the Ixonia pants are designed to keep you safe from hard knocks. The shin guards fits seamlessly over the Trekker boots, and are made from Tehachapi's proprietary polymer weave to provide a high level of protection.

lore.name: J-5 Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Light Helmet Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -25 / 65 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Gyson delivers another unique softshell helmet with the J-5. Large optic sensors and an oversized breathing apparatus deliver a striking visage. The distinct design is space-rated and provides a modicum of protection, while keeping the helmet lightweight and affordable.

lore.name: J-5 Helmet Pyrotechnic
lore.description: Item Type: Light Helmet Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -25 / 65 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Gyson delivers another unique softshell helmet with the J-5. Large optic sensors and an oversized breathing apparatus deliver a striking visage. The distinct design is space-rated and provides a modicum of protection, while keeping the helmet lightweight and affordable. This edition features the colors and logo of the now defunct Pyrotechnic Amalgamated.

lore.name: Jaclium
lore.description: A naturally occurring rare metal form of jahlium, it is used in the production of extremely strong alloys with incredible tensile strength. Originally confused with common jahlium when first discovered, the above average results when used lead to researchers to realize its value.

lore.name: Jaclium (Ore)
lore.description: A naturally occurring rare metal form of jahlium, it is used in the production of extremely strong alloys with incredible tensile strength. Originally confused with common jahlium when first discovered, the above average results when used lead to researchers to realize its value.

lore.name: Jacopo Monocle
lore.description: As part of their Dafne collection, Derion is proud to present the Jacopo monocle. This diamond-laminate accessory features a tungsten chain and features the latest upgradable optiVis interface for unmatched comfort.

lore.name: Jacopo Tophat
lore.description: As part of their Dafne collection, Derion is proud to present the Jacopo tophat. Perfect for an elegant night on the town, this gossamer-lined top hat was commissioned in honor of the Port Renatus Metropolitan Opera House Quincentennial.

lore.name: Jaghte
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Yorm Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Competition Built with performance in mind, Yorm’s Jaghte competition shield generator prioritizes shield health and generation rate over strength and stealth.

lore.name: Jahlium
lore.description: This naturally occurring metal has found use in several industrial applications and in the production of steel alloys that were favored during 28th century space station construction.

lore.name: Janalite
lore.description: This rare mineral is valued as an industrial anti-matter precursor. While more stable than other precursors like Feynmaline, it's tougher structure and energy resistance makes it much more difficult to utilize as well as collect.

lore.name: Jennet
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 0 Grade: D Class: Industrial Juno Starwerk’s foray into vehicle power plants begins with the Jennet. While not as highly-rated as similar components, the company’s reputation for dependability and ease of maintenance still make it a favorite in some circles.

lore.name: Jericho
lore.description: Item Type: Rocket Pod Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Size: 1 Rockets: 6xS1 The Jericho rocket pod from Hurston Dynamics is compatible with any size one hardpoint and capable of carrying six S1 rockets.

lore.name: Jericho X
lore.description: Item Type: Rocket Pod Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Size: 2 Rockets: 12xS1 The Jericho X rocket pod from Hurston Dynamics is compatible with any size two hardpoint and capable of carrying twelve S1 rockets.

lore.name: Jericho XL
lore.description: Item Type: Rocket Pod Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Size: 3 Rockets: 18xS1 The Jericho XL rocket pod from Hurston Dynamics is compatible with any size three hardpoint and capable of carrying eighteen S1 rockets.

lore.name: JOKR Doubletime Hologram
lore.description: Manufacturer: Joker Enterprises The Doubletime system from Joker Engineering projects a holographic reproduction of the user in an effort to confuse and distract hostile forces and allow the operator to change the dynamic of the battle.

lore.name: JS-300
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Military This high-end, military-grade component from A&R delivers excellent performance and solid durability at the expense of slightly increased emission levels. However with the JS-300 pedigree, it’s easy to see why this small power plant has many fans in the military.

lore.name: JS-400
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Military As the UEE’s oldest energy weapon manufacturer, A&R expanded into power plants to interface more efficiently with their weapons. The JS-400 was their first attempt at a medium power plant, and it’s a testament to the quality of this military-grade component that it’s still around.

lore.name: JS-500
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Military The JS-500 is A&R’s best performing large power plant. This military-grade component receives consistent praise from users both in the military and civilian market.

lore.name: Judge Stun Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Preacher Armaments Item Type: Pistol Class: Energy (Electron) Battery Size: TBD Rate of Fire: Beam Effective Range: 10m Attachments: Optics (S1), Underbarrel (S1) Designed to stun and eventually incapacitate targets in close quarters, the Preacher Armaments Judge Stun Pistol is lightweight, functional, and effective.

lore.name: Jumping Limes
lore.description: NDR: 09 HEI: 06 Effects: Dehydrating Grows on a cactus in the deserts of Yar (Centauri II). A local variant that developed naturally after terraformation was complete, the spiny fruit start off purple and turn green when they are ripe. They acquired their name because of the ease in which they fall off the cactus and attach themselves to clothing and skin, as if they "jumped" there. The leathery, barbed skin must be peeled back to reveal the juicy flesh of the interior. The taste is sweet, extremely tart and astringent. Locals warn that if you become lost in the dessert you should be careful using jumping limes for hydration as they can make you feel even more thirsty.

lore.name: K7 Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 3K µSCU DMC's K7 are an all-purpose cargo pants. Four easy access pockets provide extra storage while the triple-stitched polymer weave fabric is designed to withstand all kinds of weather conditions.

lore.name: Kagi RTD
lore.description: Klaus & Werner’s Kagi RTD (Rapid Traversal Device) is an add-on for their popular Arclight II laser pistol. The Kagi generates a highly focused field for the rapid traversal of a zero-g environment and features a range sensor that dynamically shifts polarity to insure safe velocities during movement.

lore.name: Kahix M-Launcher Missile
lore.description: Item Type: Ammo Missile ammo for the Kahix missile launcher.

lore.name: Kahix Missile Launcher
lore.description: Manufacturer: Torral Aggregate Item Type: Launcher Class: Missile Magazine Size: 1 Rate Of Fire: 6 rpm Effective Range: 2 km Attachments: Optics (N/A), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (N/A) A powerful and portable large caliber projectile launcher from Torral Aggregate, the Kahix features two fire modes, dumbfire and targeted, and can utilize a variety of special missiles. This versatile Xi'an weapon is a perfect battlefield equalizer for ground troops, effective in a multitude of engagement scenarios and capable of dealing massive damage to ships and vehicles.

lore.name: Kai Habitats
lore.description: The galaxy’s leader in habitat design and construction, Kai offers a variety of prebuilt environments for your home, office, hangar or business as well as custom tanks. Our talented sales associates work directly with biological consultants to provide you with the ideal living conditions for your organisms.

lore.name: Kama
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Industrial The Kama from Juno Starwerk has won more “Fan Favorite” reader’s poll from ‘Long Haul Quarterly’ than any other industrial quantum drive in its class.

lore.name: Kamar Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Kamar is a modern update on a classic style featuring a truly unique design and silhouette. Centered around an ultra-soft velvet front panel, it features a fitted collar, wide pleated waistband, and bishop sleeves cinched by extra long cuffs. The result is a formal top that's bold yet timeless.

lore.name: Karna "Alpine Sunset" Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Assault Rifle Class: Energy (Plasma) Battery Size: 35 Rate Of Fire: 500 rpm Effective Range: 50 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S2) The Karna is a classic Kastak Arms plasma assault rifle. This mid-range mauler features charged and full-auto fire modes to allow for quick and easy situational adjustments. Besides its renowned firepower, the Karna's rugged looks and reliability have made it one of Kastak Arms' most popular weapons. This special green and red Alpine Sunset edition is sure to make a great Luminalia gift for your loved ones.

lore.description: Item Type: Battery Capacity: 35 This is a replacement battery for Kastak Arms' plasma assault rifle, the Karna.

lore.name: Karoby Energy Bar (Cranberry, Green Tea & Carob)
lore.description: NDR: 18 Effects: Energizing Made with nutritious, wholesome ingredients, this great tasting bar is formulated to provide sustained energy to help you maintain your best performance.

lore.name: Karoby Energy Bar (Tahini & Carob)
lore.description: NDR: 18 Effects: Energizing Made with nutritious, wholesome ingredients, this great tasting bar is formulated to provide sustained energy to help you maintain your best performance.

lore.name: Kaswal Jacket Taupe
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU DMC’s Kaswal is a cold-weather jacket designed with additional lining throughout the chest and sleeves for added warmth and comfort.

lore.name: Katla Mask
lore.description: The Katla mask provides full face coverage from the elements or prying eyes. Oversized eyes provide a wide field of vision and a built-in air filter helps you breathe easy. Please note that this mask is not space-rated and should only be worn in naturally breathable environs.

lore.name: Katsu Karē Kacho
lore.description: NDR: 30 Effects: None Big Benny's kacho is based on traditional family recipes straight from Corel, combining springy noodles and a rich, warm broth to create a taste enjoyed the 'verse over. The Katsu Karē flavor marries crispy fried protein pieces with a harmoniously mellow curry sauce.

lore.name: Kavir Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.4K µSCU Blending Habidash style and ingenuity, the Kavir pants feature fashionable flourishes alongside practical perks ideal for managing extreme environments. Several fabric pieces are sewn directly into a thick, integrated belt that divides the pants between a large elastic waistband and looser, breathable cotton blend fabric through the legs. There are also two bands of fabric that ring the shins to keep dirt and other elements out.

lore.name: Kavische Columnar
lore.description: Capable of growing anywhere up to 5 meters in height, the Kavische is a columnar cactus hybrid that developed on Yar shortly after the introduction of floral into the newly terraformed ecosystem. Adapting the hue of the red sand, the Kavische quickly became one of the predominant plants on the planet.

lore.name: KDK TM-4 Roller Thruster
lore.description: The TM Series thrusters from Kosmicheskie Dvigateli Kunayeva (KDK) are high-power maneuvering thrusters built around cutting-edge Electrostatic ion technology to provide a heavy output without sacrificing precision.

lore.name: KDK TM-4 Slider Thruster
lore.description: The TM Series thrusters from Kosmicheskie Dvigateli Kunayeva (KDK) are high-power maneuvering thrusters built around cutting-edge Electrostatic ion technology to provide a heavy output without sacrificing precision.

lore.name: Keldur Hat and Indigo Goggles
lore.description: Blowing winds and blazing sun won't be an issue when wearing the Keldur hat and goggles. Insulated flaps keep the sun and elements off your neck, while a lightweight metal brim and scratch resistant, industrial-grade goggles protect your eyes.

lore.name: Kelvid
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Wen/Cassel Propulsion Size: 0 Grade: B Class: Civilian The Kelvid is a high performance, rough and tumble cooler system designed to keep your vehicle humming for longer, rather than catching its breath.

lore.name: Ketchum Beanie
lore.description: Complete your cool-weather wardrobe with the classic Ketchum beanie from Alejo Brothers.

lore.name: Keystone Jacket Taupe
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU DMC’s Keystone is a two-layer jacket that puts utility first. The top-most vest layer ensures the Keystone jacket remains warm and durable, while the underlayer is designed to avoid restricting your range of motion. Various pockets adorn the jacket to provide convenient storage options.

lore.name: Khaos
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RSI Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian RSI's Khaos has been tuned to provide dependable performance with reliable construction. Once you've got this strapped in, you'll appreciate the order this quantum drive brings to the chaos of travel.

lore.name: Khartu-al Harmony Livery
lore.description: The Harmony livery is meant to showcase Humanity's peaceful relationship with alien species with a semi-pearlescent blue main coat marked with organic reflective red to suggest the coming together of disparate species and cultures. The Harmony livery has been designed and produced by the UEE's Diplomatic Corps and freely licensed to all spacecraft manufacturers. Now Khartu-al owners can celebrate the UEE's intentions of working toward a peaceful galaxy.

lore.name: Khartu-al Ocellus Livery
lore.description: The Ocellus livery adapts and updates the iconic colors and design used on some Tevarin ships to bring a striking new look to the Khartu-al. The livery gives the fuselage a prominent red ridge while shimmering green covers the rest of the ship. Thick grey lines swoop through both colors to provide a unique geometric element.

lore.name: Khartu-al Polar Livery
lore.description: Modify your Khartu-al with this white and grey livery specifically designed for the 2951 IAE.

lore.name: Khartu-al Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom Khartu-al livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.

lore.name: Kiba Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Inspired by ancient Human folklore, the Kiba helmet features a demonic face with long fangs. The use of high-end treated metals creates an ornamental aesthetic, whilst still providing substantial protection from all angles. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Kiba Mask
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -5 / 50 °C Inspired by ancient Human folklore, the Kiba mask features a demonic face with long fangs and still offers some protection thanks to the use of treated metals. This intimidating visage is enough to transform any warrior into a terrifying presence on the battlefield.

lore.name: Kiba Mask Avarice
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -5 / 50 °C Inspired by ancient Human folklore, the Kiba mask features a demonic face with long fangs and still offers some protection thanks to the use of treated metals. This intimidating visage is enough to transform any warrior into a terrifying presence on the battlefield. The Avarice edition is a listless black with sharp golden teeth.

This intimidating visage is enough to transform any warrior into a terrifying presence on the battlefield. The Passion edition consists of a shocking pink with gray teeth.

lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. This intimidating visage is enough to transform any warrior into a terrifying presence on the battlefield. The Raku edition is a metallic gray with shining golden teeth.

lore.description: Manufacturer: Unknown Item Type: Assault Rifle Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 45 Rate Of Fire: 525 rpm Effective Range: 50 m Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, and if you aim just right, so will a round from the Killshot assault rifle. What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm. The Bleach version features a white paintjob.

What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm. The Bloody version features a red paintjob.

What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm. The Dominion Camo edition adds a dark green camo pattern to the rifle.

What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm. The Goodnight version features a deep navy paintjob.

What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm. The Payback version is sprayed with red paint and anointed with bone fragments.

What it lacks in grace, this classic design has its own scrappy charm.

lore.name: Killshot Rifle Magazine (45 Cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 45 This magazine for the Killshot rifle comes pre-loaded with forty-five rounds.

lore.name: Kingship Tachyon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Vanduul Item Type: Tachyon Cannon

lore.name: Kino Shoes
lore.description: These two-tone slip-on shoes are comfortable enough for casual wear, but stylish enough for the workplace.

lore.name: Kinolo Shoes
lore.description: The Kinolo shoes deliver a subtle yet striking look. Made from grey synthetic leather punctuated with gold highlights, these slip-on shoes feature a heel cushion for extra support and a special non-slip sole.

lore.name: Klaus & Werner Mass Driver S10 Ammo Box
lore.description: Ammunition case for Klaus & Werner's Mass Driver S10 Ammo Box

lore.name: KnightBridge Arms Ballistic Autocannon S1 Ammo Box
lore.description: Ammunition case for the KnightBridge Arms Ballistic Autocannon S1.

lore.name: KnightBridge Arms Ballistic Autocannon S3 Ammo Box
lore.description: Ammunition case for the KnightBridge Arms Ballistic Autocannon S3.

lore.name: Koal Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 3K µSCU Dyna Lei updates an old classic with the Koal black leather pants that feature metallic trim along each leg for a thoroughly modern, dynamic look. Men's sizes currently not available.

lore.name: Kombu Laser Beam
lore.description: Manufacturer: Trident Attack Systems Item Type: Laser Beam Size: 5 Trident Attack Systems’ successful transition from hard ammo producer to energy weapon specialist continues with the Kombu. Its laser beam can deliver reliable, sustained damage, though users must use it strategically to not overheat the weapon.

lore.name: Kopion Horn
lore.description: The horn of the kopion is made of a unique combination of bone and naturally-occurring carbon nanomaterials. When properly processed, it can be used to aid in bone regeneration with a far greater rate of success than lab-grown materials. This application has made it a valuable commodity.

lore.name: Koya Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Koya are stylish slim cut pants featuring color accents on the pockets and cuffs. Made from a special stain resistant, soft fabric blend, they are paired with a brown belt featuring a gold buckle.

lore.name: Kragen
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Wen/Cassel Propulsion Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Civilian When you go big, get nothing but the best. The Kragen from Wen/Cassel Propulsion has consistently been rated among the best large, commercial coolers available on the market.

lore.name: Kruger Intergalactic Ammo Box Ballistic 25mm
lore.description: Ammunition box for the Kruger Intergalactic 25mm Ballistic.

lore.name: Kruger Intergalactic Ballistic Gatling S2 Ammo Box
lore.description: Ammunition case for the Kruger Intergalactic Ballistic Gatling S2

lore.name: Kruger L-21 Wolf PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Kruger L-21 Wolf with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: Kruger L-21 Wolf Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kruger Intergalactic Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the Kruger L-21 Wolf.

lore.name: Kruger L-21 Wolf TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Kruger L-21 Wolf with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: Kruger L-22 AlphaWolf PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Kruger L-22 AlphaWolf with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: Kruger L-22 AlphaWolf Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kruger Intergalactic Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the Kruger L-22 AlphaWolf.

lore.name: Kruger L-22 AlphaWolf TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Kruger L-22 AlphaWolf with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: Kruger Stingray S4 Missile Rack - Left
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Kruger Intergalactic Size: 4 Missiles: 4xS2 Bespoke missile rack for the Stingray that fires four S2 missiles.

lore.name: Kruger Stingray S4 Missile Rack - Right
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Kruger Intergalactic Size: 4 Missiles: 4xS2 Bespoke missile rack for the Stingray that fires four S2 missiles.

lore.name: Krypton
lore.description: A colorless, tasteless noble gas that appears white in a discharge tube. One of the products of uranium fission.

lore.name: Kutty Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Rambler's Kutty two-tone jacket features a racer-strap collar and an asymmetrical button design to bring a vintage look into the modern era. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Kutty Jacket (Modified)
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU This version of Rambler's Kutty jacket has been modified from its original form. Rambler's Kutty two-tone jacket features a racer-strap collar and an asymmetrical button design to bring a vintage look into the modern era.

lore.name: Lamarr
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Competition The eccentric upstarts behind Broad & Rabiee cheekily named their competition-grade computer Lamarr in honor of a 28th century cult vid about an alien CPU that single-handedly overthrows the UEE government.

lore.name: Lamb Tagine Combat Ration
lore.description: NDR: 80 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic, Cognitive Boosting A full meal combat ration specially formulated to provide complete high-performance nutrition for UEE Army personnel.

lore.name: Lamont Undersuit
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% The Lamont looks so good you won't want to wear armor over it. Seamlessly blending lightweight plating with durable synthetic weaves, the Lamont will be as comfortable in the cockpit as it is stylish in the streets. Embrace personal protection gear suitable for both work and play, and gain the Hardin Tactical advantage.

lore.name: Lamont Xy'kara Undersuit
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% The Lamont looks so good you won't want to wear armor over it. Seamlessly blending lightweight plating with durable synthetic weaves, the Lamont will be as comfortable in the cockpit as it is stylish in the streets. Embrace personal protection gear suitable for both work and play, and gain the Hardin Tactical advantage. The Xy'kara undersuit draws inspiration from the millennia-long heritage of the Xi'an.

lore.name: Lamp
lore.description: Get your own Lamp from the original 24 hour livestream!

lore.name: Landlite Boots
lore.description: Who says work boots can't be comfortable? Grindstone's Landlite boots are built with a breathable synth-leather material to keep your feet dry, a contoured, memory footbed, and a slip-resistant outsole, making it perfect for whatever worksite you throw at it.

lore.name: Landlite Boots "Voyager"
lore.description: Who says work boots can't be comfortable? Grindstone's Landlite boots are built with a breathable synth-leather material to keep your feet dry, a contoured, memory footbed, and a slip-resistant outsole. The exclusive Voyager edition comes in black with red soles to provide a pop of color.

lore.name: Lanxi Jacket Gray
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU This simple knit jacket from City Lights features a classic cut and chic microseam technology to create a thoroughly modern addition to any wardrobe. It also features a stand collar to help keep you warm. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Laranite
lore.description: A somewhat radioactive, crystalline gemstone. Black with streaks of dark red, it can only be used as jewelry if shielded.

lore.name: Large Artifact Fragment (Damaged)
lore.description: A large artifact fragment of unknown origin and made of an unidentified material. Broken and considered damaged, intricate etchings that subtly glow can still be seen on the fragment, though the gold-colored metallic banding is in poor condition.

lore.name: Large Artifact Fragment (Flawed)
lore.description: A large artifact fragment of unknown origin and made of an unidentified material. Broken and considered in flawed condition, the fragment features intricate etchings that subtly glow green and is overlaid with gold-colored metallic banding.

lore.name: Large Artifact Fragment (Pristine)
lore.description: A large artifact fragment of unknown origin and made of an unidentified material. Though broken, it's otherwise considered in pristine condition. The fragment features intricate etchings that subtly glow green and is overlaid with gold-colored metallic banding.

lore.name: Laser Activation Keycard
lore.description: This encoded keycard is required to activate an orbital mining laser. Security protocols require this single-use keycard be stored at orbital laser platforms until all pre-firing procedures have been met. The keycard must then be inserted into a terminal at a ground-based Laser Activation Bunker to activate the mining laser.

lore.name: Lasing Catalyst
lore.description: A dense matrix of absorptive meta-materials that acts as a gain amplifier for high-powered industrial laser beams.

lore.name: Laska Shoes
lore.description: The Laska are two-toned dress shoes that deliver both comfort and style. A dynamic diagonal color separation makes the shoes black in front and white in the back and accentuates the slight rise to the heel. An ideal complement to any outfit, Laska shoes also features supremely comfortable padded insoles and can be easily slipped off and on thanks to side zippers.

lore.name: Last Resort Keycard
lore.description: The best rewards are worth fighting for!

lore.name: Lastaprene
lore.description: An advanced synthetic polymer designed with optimal properties for several commercial applications. It has greater viscoelasticity than most commonly produced rubbers.

lore.name: Lattice
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 0 Grade: C Class: Civilian This vehicle computer from WillsOp was designed to withstand the many harsh conditions you and your vehicle could find yourselves in as you explore the universe.

lore.name: Lavelle Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU Part of the OpalSky Essentials collection, the Lavelle are classic dress pants with a timeless cut and look that make them an indispensable part of any wardrobe.

lore.name: Lavelle Pants (Modified)
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU This version of OpalSky's Lavelle pants has been modified from its original form. Part of the OpalSky Essentials collection, the Lavelle are classic dress pants with a timeless cut and look that make them an indispensable part of any wardrobe.

lore.name: Lawson Mining Laser
lore.description: Manufacturer: Argo Astronautics Item Type: Mining Laser Size: S0 Grade: C Optimal Range: 25 m Maximum Range: 25 m Gather Radius: 1 m Extraction Throughput: 4 cSCU/s Power Transfer: 35 Instability: +30 % Resistance: -40 % Optimal Charge Window Size: +40 % Optimal Charge Window Rate: 0% Throttle min: 20% The Lawson mining laser was developed by Argo Astronautics and specifically tuned for the ATLS GEO to make mining resources from the power suit as intuitive as possible.

lore.name: Layer Cut
lore.description: For that casual, yet professional look.

lore.name: Layered Pixie
lore.description: A longer pixie with layers.

lore.name: Legion Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Crafted from a slick, high-shine weave, the Legion was conceived by 987 and famed Terran underground designer, Jieto, to shock the status quo of hooded jackets and usher in a new era of aesthetic functionality. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: LeMarque Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU Classic cuts never go out of style. A staple of any wardrobe, Derion's LeMarque are built for work or play and feature microseam pleats and wrinkle-free material that will guarantee that you'll get years out of this classic. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Lengua Sandwich
lore.description: NDR: 38 Effects: None Pickled, smoked tongue and mustard on rye bread.

lore.name: Leonids Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Item Type: Ballistic Cannon Size: 5 Built specifically for the Meteor, the Leonids ballistic cannon provides formidable firepower designed to overwhelm aggressors that dare get within range. RSI expertly incorporated the cannon atop both sides of the ship to seamlessly integrate with the ship's components and provide full forward coverage.

lore.name: Levin Undersuit (Refurbished)
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% Featuring flexible gaskets for greater comfort and more natural movement, along with a convenient range of chest connector port options, the Levin from Caldera has been a practical choice for explorers everywhere. This particular undersuit has been repaired for extended use.

lore.name: Levski Coin
lore.description: This collectible coin features the message "Welcome to Levski" on one face and the symbol of the People's Alliance and their motto "Stronger Together" on the reverse.

lore.name: Leyland's Tortoise
lore.description: Leyland’s tortoise is a species of tortoise indigenous to Earth (Sol III). Extremely docile, they are kept as pets by Humans, especially long-haul spacers. Over-collection and habitat destruction have made them nearly extinct in the wild.

lore.name: Leyland's Tortoise
lore.description: Leyland’s tortoise is a species of tortoise indigenous to Earth (Sol III). Extremely docile, they are kept as pets by Humans, especially long-haul spacers. Over-collection and habitat destruction have made them nearly extinct in the wild.

lore.name: LH86 "Luckbringer" Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Item Type: Pistol Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 25 Rate Of Fire: 1200 rpm Effective Range: 30 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) The LH86 from Gemini is a compact kinetic handgun designed for personal defense and close-quarter combat. A keen eye on ergonomics and balance coupled with hardy construction makes this pistol a natural fit for any shooter in any number of hostile conditions. The LH86 also comes with Tritium low-light sight and a twenty-five round magazine. This special green and grey Luckbringer edition released for Stella Fortuna 2954 is a great way to get luck on your side.

lore.name: LH86 "Pathfinder" Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Item Type: Pistol Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 25 Rate Of Fire: 1200 rpm Effective Range: 30 m An eye-catching bronze barrel and trigger adds elegance to the LH86 Pathfinder edition. This beautiful and balanced handgun from Gemini makes an ideal weapon for personal defense and close-quarter combat. It also features a Tritium low-light sight and a twenty-five round magazine.

lore.name: LH86 "Permafrost" Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Item Type: Pistol Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 25 Rate Of Fire: 1200 rpm Effective Range: 30 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) The LH86 from Gemini is a compact kinetic handgun designed for personal defense and close-quarter combat. The LH86 also comes with Tritium low-light sight and a twenty-five round magazine. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

lore.name: LH86 "Takahashi Racing" Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Item Type: Pistol Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 25 Rate Of Fire: 1200 rpm Effective Range: 30 m The LH86 from Gemini is a compact kinetic handgun designed for personal defense and close-quarter combat. A keen eye on ergonomics and balance coupled with hardy construction makes this pistol a natural fit for any shooter in any number of hostile conditions. The LH86 also comes with Tritium low-light sight and a twenty-five round magazine. Inspired by Team Takahashi racers and their Star Kitten mascot, this special edition pistol is primarily pink with teal highlights.

lore.name: LH86 "Voyager" Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Item Type: Pistol Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 25 Rate Of Fire: 1200 rpm Effective Range: 30 m The LH86 Voyager edition adds a slick look to this classic compact handgun from Gemini. The barrel features a checkered metallic finish atop a blue and black ergonomic handle that's a natural fit for any shooter. Orange accents highlight the Tritium low-light sight.

lore.name: LH86 Akuma Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Item Type: Pistol Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 25 Rate Of Fire: 1200 rpm Effective Range: 30 m The LH86 from Gemini is a compact kinetic handgun designed for personal defense and close-quarter combat. A keen eye on ergonomics and balance coupled with hardy construction makes this pistol a natural fit for any shooter in any number of hostile conditions. The LH86 also comes with Tritium low-light sight and a twenty-five round magazine. The Akuma edition features eye-catching decals with splashes of bright pink to match the style of the Nine Tails gang.

lore.name: Li-Tok Boots
lore.description: Stylish yet rugged, NorthStar's Li-Tok boots are made from a composite nylon fabric, vulcanized rubber grips that hold fast to a variety of surfaces, and reinforced ankle support making these perfect for hanging out or on the job. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Liar T-Shirt
lore.description: Most may believe in Admiral Bishop, but you're not most people. You prefer to address him as Admiral Bullsh*t, so flaunt your intellectual independence with this shirt from CBD. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Liberator
lore.description: Item Type: Rocket Pod Manufacturer: Thermyte Concern Size: 1 Rockets: 4xS2 Thermyte Concern's Liberator rocket pod carries four S2 rockets and can be attached to any size one hardpoint.

lore.name: Liberator Prime
lore.description: Item Type: Rocket Pod Manufacturer: Thermyte Concern Size: 2 Rockets: 8xS2 Thermyte Concern's Liberator Prime rocket pod carries eight S2 rockets and can be attached to any size two hardpoint.

lore.name: Liberator Ultra
lore.description: Item Type: Rocket Pod Manufacturer: Thermyte Concern Size: 3 Rockets: 12xS2 Thermyte Concern's Liberator Ultra rocket pod carries twelve S2 rockets and can be attached to any size three hardpoint.

lore.name: Libio Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU One of OpalSky's classic pullovers, the Libio features a two-tone asymmetrical pattern and polyweave blend to keep it elegant and striking every time you wear it. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Libo Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU This tailored, single-button jacket from Spar Van Miles features a chic, retro collar with a reinforced lining to keep you professional, but fun.

lore.name: LifeCore Boots
lore.description: These all-purpose, all-terrain workboots from Grindstone feature full ankle support, molded heel counter and a waterproof, abrasion resistant material.

lore.name: LifeCure Medsticks
lore.description: The use of these imitation CureLife Medpens has resulted in numerous deaths.

lore.name: LifeGuard Medical Attachment
lore.description: MUST BUY BASE MULTI-TOOL TO USE: "Pyro RYT Multi-Tool" Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial / CureLife Item Type: Multi-Tool Attachment Class: Medical Crafted as a joint effort between Greycat Industrial and leading medical device manufacturer CureLife, the LifeGuard attachment is a compact and light-weight emergency medical treatment option powered by the Pyro RYT Multi-Tool. It is perfect for handling jobsite emergencies and temporarily alleviating symptoms until professional medical care can be sought.

lore.name: LifeGuard Refill
lore.description: Item Type: MedGel Refill This vial is used to refill the LifeGuard medical multi-tool attachment with CureLife Pancea MedGel.

This EVA-rated protection system features an undersuit built from a durable polymer weave that's designed to withstand extreme environmental conditions and features component armor pieces to protect you against impacts and particulates. The Rust Society edition adds a red and tan color scheme so you look good while working hard.

lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian Featuring stylish design and strong performance, the LightBlossom is a worthy addition to Sakura Sun’s line-up, continuing the reputation the conglomerate has for making everything and making it well.

lore.name: LightFire
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Ace Astrogation Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Competition Ace Astrogation built the LightFire for pilots who like to push the edge, but not break the bank. Its focused design provides solid performance at the expense of the component’s durability and stealth.

lore.name: Lightning Power LTD Powerbolt
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian Lightning Power Ltd's Powerbolt makes its living by offering the perfect blend of performance and signature masking. Lightning's proprietary Superfluid Quantum Vortex technology keeps energy emissions low while providing better output than typical stealth-oriented plants.

lore.name: Lightstrike I Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Esperia Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 1 The Lightstrike I takes the attack to distant targets by delivering focused, high damage blasts that will make any aggressor think twice before coming too close. Capable of providing powerful overwatch options during troop deployments or engaging targets in outer space, it's easy to see why the Lightstrike I was feared by UPE forces during the First Tevarin War.

lore.name: Lillo Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU These slim cut pants from Fiore give you a tailored feel at a fraction of the cost. Built from space-age weaves, the Lillo are a low maintenance, high impact addition to your office wardrobe.

lore.name: Lindinium
lore.description: A versatile metal that has been successfully alloyed with numerous other elements, miners in the Nyx system have been known to go to great lengths to procure it.

lore.name: Lindinium (Ore)
lore.description: A versatile metal that has been successfully alloyed with numerous other elements, miners in the Nyx system have been known to go to great lengths to procure this ore.

lore.name: Ling Family Cargo Plushie
lore.description: Here's a haul you can hug. This plushie shaped like a cargo container features Ling Family Hauling branding with the company's logo and red, blue, and white color scheme.

lore.name: Ling Family Container Model
lore.description: There's no need for a tractor beam to move this cargo container. This finely detailed model features Ling Family Hauling branding with the company's logo and red and blue color scheme.

lore.name: Ling Hat
lore.description: A red and white cadet hat with Ling Family Hauling's name and logo emblazoned across the front and back panels.

lore.name: Lister Surgical Shoes
lore.description: The Lister surgical shoes are designed to provide comfort and support even after hours on your feet. Made out of a crisp white material for easy identification of contamination, the shoes feature padded insoles and are made from a proprietary material that's both breathable and antibacterial.

lore.name: Lithium
lore.description: A soft metal with a silvery-white hue. In its natural state, it is highly reactive. Tarnishes quickly when exposed to air.

lore.name: Livia Shirt
lore.description: MuyMuy's loose hooded shirt is an ultra-modern take on a classic look. The Livia features a soft knit blend, designed for comfort and elegance.

lore.name: Livia Shirt (Modified)
lore.description: This version of MuyMuy's Livia shirt has been modified from its original form. MuyMuy's loose hooded shirt is an ultra-modern take on a classic look. The Livia features a soft knit blend, designed for comfort and elegance.

lore.name: Lo Classic Kacho
lore.description: NDR: 30 Effects: None Big Benny's kacho is based on traditional family recipes straight from Corel, combining springy noodles and a rich, warm broth to create a taste enjoyed the 'verse over. The Lo Classic flavor is the unique blend of spices that got the 'Kacho Kraze' started!

lore.name: LOC
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 0 Grade: B Class: Civilian The LOC adapts Seal Corp’s revolutionary ship energy shield for vehicles. It provides premiere protection against oppressive forces found on the ground or hovering above.

lore.name: Locked-on Lentil Burrito
lore.description: NDR: 49 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hyper-Metabolic Torpedo Burrito crams a full payload of flavor into their hearty and healthy Locked-On Lentil burrito, featuring a blend of lentils and vegetables wrapped in their signature size-4 multi-grain tortilla.

lore.name: Long Choppy Bob
lore.description: Not technically a bob, but definitely a nice look.

lore.name: Long Undercut
lore.description: Long on top and buzzed on the sides.

lore.name: Lorber Shoes
lore.description: The Lorber shoes feature classic style with modern flourishes. Constructed with dark brown synthetic leather, the shoes also feature a light brown toe box with gold colored metallic accents to catch the eye, a magnetic closure that ensures a snug fit, and a soft faux-sheepskin footbed for supreme comfort.

lore.name: Lorville Blues T-Shirt
lore.description: Lorville, come for the low wages and leave with a lethal respiratory condition. The Lorville Blues shirt celebrates the iconic, corporate-owned landing zone best seen with a plastic bag over your head.

lore.name: Loscha Work Vest
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 400 µSCU The heavy-duty Loscha Work Vest by Alejo Brothers is designed for people who want to be prepared for anything at any time.

lore.name: Lost Plague Helmet Biohazard Blue
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Helmet Damage Reduction: 10% Temp. Rating: -40 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Infect your friends with your Day of the Vara spirit when you wear this helmet inspired by the hit vid Lost Plague. The helmet perfectly replicates the horrific death of xenoarchaeologist Diane Wu, first victim of the ancient alien virus she unwittingly unleashes on an unsuspecting galaxy. CC's Conversions utilized a proprietary lightweight yet sturdy rubber to accurately reproduce the deadly plague's signature spines so you can enjoy hours of wear without straining your neck.

lore.name: Lost Wallet T-Shirt
lore.description: Scoundrels, scalawags, and scum gather at Grim HEX, so show that you're part of such illustrious company with the Lost Wallet shirt made from comfortable, synthetic cotton.

lore.name: Lotus
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Civilian When it comes to medium sized, civilian power plants Whitley’s Guide continues to rate the Lotus highly. Few can touch this Sakura Sun component when it comes to both performance and durability.

lore.name: Loudmouth T-Shirt
lore.description: CBD's proud to introduce this graphic tee featuring the album artwork from The Leedos' classic debut album Never Silent. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Low Ponytail
lore.description: Straight hair pulled back into a low ponytail.

lore.name: Lula's Pitambu Fruit Juice
lore.description: HEI: 35 NDR: 14 Effects: Immune Boosting Experience the flavor of freshly picked whenever you want with Lula's Pitambu Juice.

lore.name: LumaCore
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: ACOM Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Competition Among small power plants, ACOM’s LumaCore consistently ranks among the best for its power rate, cool rate, and high overheat temperature. That’s why if you value your ship’s performance over anything else, this competition-grade component is perfect for you.

lore.name: Lumin V "SecondWind" SMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: SMG Class: Laser Battery Size: 45 Rate Of Fire: 562.5 rpm Effective Range: 25m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) Klaus & Werner's expert craftsmanship is once again on full display to make the Lumin V laser compact energy rifle even more deadly and dependable. A new "interval autofire" mode blasts five-round barrages when the trigger is held down, utilizing the target saturation that comes with autofire while providing breaks to recompensate aim. Even when constantly on the attack, the gun's excellent design provides low recoil and a tight spread. To honor those who came to Orison's aid in its time of need, the SecondWind edition compliments the weapon with a rich blue base adorned with a sleek, flowing air design along the length of the gun.

lore.name: Lumin V "Valor" SMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: SMG Class: Laser Battery Size: 45 Rate Of Fire: 562.5 rpm Effective Range: 25m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) Klaus & Werner's expert craftsmanship is once again on full display to make the Lumin V laser compact energy rifle even more deadly and dependable. lore.name: Lumin V SMG Battery (45 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Battery Capacity: 45 Replacement battery for Klaus & Werner's Lumin V SMG.

lore.name: Luminalia '55 Coin
lore.description: Have an extra happy Luminalia celebration with this green and red tinted coin featuring season greetings in both common and Banu on one side, while the other features the year.

lore.name: Luminalia Cookie Jar
lore.description: The perfect place to stash all your favorite holiday treats, this cookie jar features Luminalia greetings along with red and green trim.

lore.name: Luminalia Gift
lore.description: A small, wrapped package meant to get you in the Luminalia spirit. Banu merchants celebrating the holiday used to hide small gifts aboard their ship to encourage revelers to explore all their wares. As the holiday grew in popularity within the UEE, Human merchants modified this tradition by hiding empty gift-wrapped packages around a space station or landing zone that could be exchanged for credits if returned unopened. The increased foot traffic into their stores spurned holiday sales and became a tradition in its own right. Stow this gift for sentimental value, or sell it at a commodities terminal and spend the credits on a holiday gift for yourself.

lore.name: Luminalia Gift Box
lore.description: Wrapped in elegant sky blue paper adorned in stars and topped with a smart silk ribbon, this large gift box makes the ideal festive storage solution.

lore.name: Luminalia Light Stick
lore.description: Put the glow into "Glow Festival" with this festive Luminalia light stick. Turn it on and watch any room magically transform into a holiday wonderland.

lore.name: Luminalia Mug
lore.description: Ready to spread some Luminalia "cheers?" Cozy up with this festive red and white patterned mug decorated with Banu messages of celebration and understanding.

lore.name: Luminalia Sextant
lore.description: Set your sights on holiday cheer with this Luminalia sextant. This ancient Earth instrument used for celestial navigation was designed with modern materials that help stabilize the device and stop warping due to extreme weather conditions. Making it an eye-catching and ideal gift to give at any Luminalia celebration.

lore.name: Lunes (Spiral Fruit)
lore.description: NDR: 23 HEI: 10 Effects: Hydrating The Lunes is a deciduous tree native to the warmer areas of Osha in Kilian system. It bears an edible fruit known as a Lunes fruit or a Spiral Fruit based on the circular ridges that can form once the fruit begins to ripen. The fruit’s skin is covered with a short fuzz that is generally removed before consumption. When ripe, the Lunes is a very sweet and juicy flavor and have become a very popular summer delicacy, commonly found in ice cream and other desserts.

lore.name: Lux Flashlight
lore.description: Manufacturer: VOLT Type: Flashlight Attachment Point: Underbarrel Size: 1 Constructed using a reinforced metallic casing and fracture-less glass, VOLT's Lux Flashlight gives you light when you need it most. Once equipped, it is able to communicate with the weapon's own sensors to activate automatically when the weapon is in use.

lore.name: Lux Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Lux are elegant pinstripe pants infused with a modern edge. Fiore elevates these classic slacks with a stylish blue and grey geometric pattern along the outer seam to create a look that would work in any era.

lore.name: LuxCore
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: ACOM Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Competition Famous for performance that laps the competition, the LuxCore provides all the speed your ship needs. You'll leave other medium power plants in the dust with this first-class component from the racing experts at ACOM.

lore.name: Lycara
lore.description: A extremely light and strong carbon composite material first developed for racing ship rudders.

The suit's striking look became famous after being worn by the Seeker in the widely popular "Fire and Fury" vids of the mid-2800s.

lore.name: M2 Hercules Starlifter Plushie

lore.name: M2C "Swarm"
lore.description: Item Type: Laser Turret Manufacturer: Behring The latest generation of point-defense technology, the M2C "Swarm" utilizes advanced search, detection, and tracking software to unleash a swift barrage of laserfire, protecting ships from incoming missiles, torpedoes, and other high-speed threats.

lore.name: M3A Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 1 The M3A is Behring's entry level laser autocannon. The autocannon configuration offers modest damage per projectile and a fairly low rate of fire. As the most basic offering in Behring's weapons lineup, it features low power consumption, but poor power efficiency. It makes up ground for its shortcomings by being cheap, a feature many pilots are looking for when outfitting their ships on a budget.

lore.name: M4A Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 2 The M4A is Behring's second tier laser autocannon. Its bigger size means more power consumption in exchange for packing a bigger punch. Fire rate and power efficiency are comparable to the M3A model.

lore.name: M50 Polar Livery
lore.description: Modify your M50 with this white and grey livery specifically designed for the 2950 IAE event on microTech.

lore.name: M50 Skullcrusher Livery
lore.description: Exude attitude with the Skullcrusher livery for the M50, which features a massive skull across the top.

lore.name: M50 Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: This custom M50 livery was created to celebrate the 2950 IAE on microTech. It blends black, electric blue, and white to give the ship a cool new look.

lore.name: M5A Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 3 When energy autocannons are designed, Behring's M5A provides the standard to which they are measured against, owing to its long range of engagement and low damage fallout.

lore.name: M6A Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 4 Behring's M6A is a versatile high velocity energy autocannon, designed to provide to keep your enemy at range without sacrificing your stopping power.

lore.name: M7A Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 5 This versatile long distance energy autocannon is the latest in Behring’s M-Series. The M7A is designed to act as a high impact deterrent effective at medium to long range. The new AC8 Lens system minimizes stopping power loss over distance, making each shot equally effective at longer ranges.

lore.name: M80 "Beauty Is Power" Poster
lore.description: Take in the majesty of the M80 with this exclusive poster showing off the ship's streamlined, monochromatic structure with the Beauty Is Power slogan on top.

lore.name: M80 Afterglow Livery
lore.description: Black envelopes most of the Afterglow livery for the M80 while orange accent lines provide a pop of color.

lore.name: M80 Blaze Livery
lore.description: Featuring a brilliant red that produces a radiant shine, the Blaze livery transforms the M80's nose with an inky black, pale blue accents, and dark gray wings.

lore.name: M80 Dynasty Livery
lore.description: Soar through the sky in style with the Dynasty livery, predominantly featuring a crisp white with soft accents of black and blue.

lore.name: M80 Slate Camo Livery
lore.description: Customize your M80 ship with this gray camo livery.

lore.name: M80 Tetra Livery
lore.description: Turn heads with the Tetra livery, featuring a shimmering teal, light green accents, and a sharp black nose.

lore.name: M8A Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 6 The M8A laser autocannon exemplifies Behring's extensive history designing and constructing ship armaments. The result is a dependable and effective energy weapon capable of handling large skirmishes or precise defensive maneuvers.

lore.name: M9A Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 7 Strike at the very heart of your enemies with the devastating impact of Behring's M9A energy autocannon. When fully charged, the massive stopping power of this laser weapon has the potential to halt even capital ships in their tracks.

lore.name: MacFlex "Rucksack" Backpack

Whether bringing extra supplies on a long excursion or filling it with ore after a successful mining run, the MacFlex Backpack will be there to carry the load.

lore.name: Madras Asada Burrito
lore.description: NDR: 38 Effects: Dehydrating Torpedo Burrito crams a full payload of flavor into their signature size-4 multi-grain tortilla wrapped Madras Asada burrito that delivers mouthfuls of spicy grilled beef into every bite.

lore.name: Maelstrom
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Military This military-grade component has been put through the paces by the UEE Navy, so you know the Maelstrom can handle the havoc of battle.

lore.name: Magma Jet (Center Engine)
lore.description: With an emphasis on strength through efficiency, Consolidated Outland’s design team went back to the drawing board when creating their Magma Jet line of thrusters to really focus on propulsion fundamentals. Burning clean and hot, like the core of a planet, the Magma Jet’s proprietary molten-state injectors provide a surprising amount of power.

lore.name: Magma Jet (Outer Engines)
lore.description: With an emphasis on strength through efficiency, Consolidated Outland’s design team went back to the drawing board when creating their Magma Jet line of thrusters to really focus on propulsion fundamentals. Burning clean and hot, like the core of a planet, the Magma Jet’s proprietary molten-state injectors provide a surprising amount of power.

lore.name: MagnaBloom
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Civilian The MagnaBloom power plant achieves above average performance and durability with minimal excess emissions, making it another exquisitely designed component from Sakura Sun.

lore.name: Magnesium
lore.description: An alkaline earth metal with a low melting point. Produced within giant, aging stars, it is ninth most abundant element in the universe.

lore.name: Magnus IV Water Bottle
lore.description: Boast about your trip to the UEE's most exclusive and elusive destination, Magnus IV. While some still question if the planet actually exists, this refillable water bottle is irrefutable proof that you've totally been there.

lore.name: Magstrand EMP Generator
lore.description: Item Type: Burst Generator Manufacturer: RSI Size: 4 The Magstrand from RSI is an EMP burst generator designed specifically for the Scorpius Antares. When fully charged, the device creates a powerful wave of distortion damage that can disable electric components within its blast radius.

lore.name: Mahoney Nurse Scrub Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU The Mahoney Nurse Scrub Pants are made for medical professionals looking for a comfortable but durable fit. They feature two front pockets and a stretch waistband. Moisture wicking and anti-stain fabric makes these pants ready to withstand long shifts and repeated washing.

lore.name: Mahoney Nurse Scrub Top
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.4K µSCU The Mahoney Nurse Scrub shirt is made for medical professionals looking an accommodating and comfortable fit. This top has a pocket and strips of fabric forming subtle geometric patterns on the right shoulder. It's also made with moisture wicking and anti-stain fabric ready to withstand long shifts and repeated washing.

lore.name: Mainframe Access Card
lore.description: This electronic card is an authentication device used to control access to secure systems. To ensure stolen cards cannot lead to ongoing security issues, each card must be reauthorized at regular intervals to remain active.

lore.name: Mala
lore.description: Digestion of the unique toxins found in the Mala fly causes confusion of the congnitive pathways of the brain and results in synesthesia where different sensory experiences cross and mix. Effects described by users range widely; from being able to see music to tasting colors. Since pain does not register the same way while under the influence of the toxin, many people of have been severely injured while "sense swapping." For example, one user lost their arm after perceiving the heat from a thruster engine as pleasurable.

lore.name: Malenky T-Shirt Skullsplitter
lore.description: "Inspired" by classic military designs with CBD's own twist, the Malenky t-shirt features collar accents on both sides, a rear quarter-zip, and is made out of premium recycled materials to ensure just the right fit. The gray and red Skullsplitter version showcases a red Vanduul skull shattered by a bloody streak.

lore.name: Man-made
lore.description: Commodities manufactured or constructed through industrial processes rather as opposed to being naturally occurring.

lore.name: Manaslu Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 5K µSCU The Manaslu from EvaLight's asymmetrical design is only one of its unique attributes. Made from a patented blend of fabrics, this jacket's surprisingly lightweight insulation will keep you warm in the coldest corners of the universe. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Manaslu Jacket Rust Society
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 5K µSCU The Rust Society edition adds eye-catching colors to this jacket's unique asymmetrical design. Made from a patented blend of fabrics, the Manaslu's surprisingly lightweight insulation will keep you warm in the coldest corners of the universe. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

Lightweight plating provides protection while metal fangs protrude from the front for an intimidating insectoid shape that walks the line between fun and frightening.

Crafted with a durable polymer weave for maximum protection, this fully enclosed combat helmet is enhanced with pointed horns that create a foreboding silhouette.

lore.name: Mantis GT-220 Gatling
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gallenson Tactical Systems Item Type: Ballistic Gatling Size: 3 The Mantis GT-220 is a hydraulically-driven Gatling-type rotary cannon designed to deliver smaller rounds at a very high rate of fire. The Mantis is designed to shred armor on very fast targets, sacrificing power for absolute saturation of the target area.

lore.name: Mantis Polar Camo Livery

lore.name: Mantis Skullcrusher Livery

lore.name: Mantis Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: This custom Mantis livery was created to celebrate the 2950 IAE on microTech. It blends black and electric blue to give the ship a cool new look.

lore.name: Marhsal Sleeveless Vest Copper
lore.description: The durable Marshal sleeveless vest by Alejo Brothers is made to endure life on the frontier while distinct stylings like shoulder straps, bold cross-chest placket, and a high-collar make sure the wearer stands out on any far flung world.

The Marias suit features a stylishly cropped white suit coat with gold accents. Underneath the jacket sits a grey shirt secured at the collar by two golden circular clasps and featuring an elongated, decorated front panel meant to be tucked under the unique lace waistband of the suit's black pants.

lore.name: Marigold

That's why they designed the Marigold line to be the last thing you and your crew have to worry about.

lore.name: Markanda Undersuit (Refurbished)
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% Built for adventure but comfortable enough for everyday, the Markanda undersuit has become beloved by explorers. A unique patchwork design creates a flexible yet resilient undersuit, while an odor resistant SureSoft inner lining will keep you from wanting to take it off. This particular undersuit has been repaired for extended use.

This edition features the colors and logo of the now defunct Pyrotechnic Amalgamated.

lore.name: Marksman I Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 1 Behring's Marksman series of proximity missiles has earned as much of a reputation for its ability to track a wide range of heat signatures as it has for its area-effect proximity damage.

lore.name: Marksman I-G Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 1 Behring's Marksman series of proximity missiles has earned as much of a reputation for its ability to track a wide range of heat signatures as it has for its area-effect proximity damage. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

lore.name: Marok Gem
lore.description: The marok has a gizzard, which takes food that has been previously swallowed from the stomach and "chews" it before passing it back into the stomach to be digested. To help this process, the marok's body secretes a substance that hardens into a large crystalline stone that stays in the gizzard and helps food get pulverized more efficiently. The stone has unique conductive properties that make it sought-after for use in computer chips.

lore.name: Marshal Sleeveless Vest

lore.description: The durable Marshal sleeveless vest by Alejo Brothers is made to endure life on the frontier while distinct stylings like shoulder straps, bold cross-chest placket, and a high-collar make sure the wearer stands out on any far flung world.

lore.name: Martel Dress
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU This open-front grey dress from Dyna Lei reveals a draped, checkered layer offset by gold trim beneath its wide cinched belt. The finished look is paired with black bodysuit and a fetching handkerchief to complete the ensemble. Men's sizes currently not available.

lore.name: Matiese Shoes
lore.description: Embody timeless elegance with the Matiese shoes from Hawksworth's. Made with fine artificial leather, the detailed upper design gives the shoes a clean, sleek profile suited to any occasion.

lore.name: Mauler Cooler
lore.description: This Vanduul cooler processes the excessive heat generated by the Mauler during intense combat.

lore.name: Mauler Power Plant
lore.description: The Vanduul Mauler's built-in Power Plant generates enough energy for the operation of essential systems, even in heavy combat.

lore.name: Mauler Quantum Drive
lore.description: This Quantum Drive has been calibrated to allow for the Mauler to undertake long and short quantum travel as well as access jump points.

lore.name: Mauler Radar
lore.description: The Radar system for the Vanduul Mauler allowing it to detect objects large and small for navigational and combat data.

lore.name: Mauler Shield Generator
lore.description: The Mauler's shield generator provides defensive coverage against incoming fire and other threats to the ship.

lore.name: MaxLift AA Support Tractor Beam
lore.description: Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Tractor Beam Class: Gadget Magazine Size: Integrated Battery Rate of Fire: N / A (Beam) Effective Range: 10-20 m Greycat's heavy duty tractor beam boasts industrial performance at a consumer-friendly price. With its longer-lasting battery and wider beam emitter, the MaxLift can easily manipulate heavier and bulkier items making it the perfect tool for long days of hauling cargo. The AA Support edition features a sharp red coloring and is intended for those who assisted Levski during their time of need.
