With its longer-lasting battery and wider beam emitter, the MaxLift can easily manipulate heavier and bulkier items making it the perfect tool for long days of hauling cargo. The Keystone edition features a white, gray and blue finish with URW logos.

lore.name: Maze
lore.description: Street name for a tranquilizer and knock-out hallucinogen that's Tevarin in origin. Dosing up is like taking a massive journey into your own mind. To the outside world, you’re nearly comatose, but to you, it’s a wild trip. A handful of religions have been started after a user took a trip into the maze. Aside from the toxic element, there’s a chance you won’t come down from the high. They call this ‘getting disconnected.’ Users stay locked in their own head until their brain decays. Maze was originally used as a near religious experience for Tevarin warriors to find their path in life. Since the fall of the Tevarin empire, it's become corrupted into a purely recreational drug. The Tevarin who once treated this drug with reverence and ritual, now make boatloads of credits selling it to anyone who wants to risk a potentially dangerous trip.

lore.description: This military cadet hat from CBD blends lightweight fabric and leather for a striking design. Featuring a white skull offset on the front and "Death From Above" on the side. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: MC-Pinhead Hat

lore.name: MC-Pinhead Hat "Voyager"
lore.description: The MC-Pinhead military cadet hat from CBD features metal bullet studs embedded into its panels. The special Voyager edition comes in red with a gold band. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Medical Supplies
lore.description: A variety of items produced primarily to treat injury or illness.

lore.name: Medical Supply
lore.description: A variety of items produced primarily to treat injury or illness.

lore.name: Medium Artifact Fragment (Damaged)

lore.description: A medium-sized artifact fragment of unknown origin and made of an unidentified material. Broken and considered in flawed condition, the fragment features intricate etchings that subtly glow green and is overlaid with dark-colored metallic banding.

lore.description: A medium-sized artifact fragment of unknown origin and made of an unidentified material. Though broken, it's otherwise considered in pristine condition. The fragment features intricate etchings that subtly glow green and is overlaid with dark-colored metallic banding.

lore.name: Medivac Rescue Light
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Utilizing multiple vibrant lights housed in a compact durable frame, the Rescue Light is capable at being seen from all directions in all kinds of hazardous atmospheric conditions, letting rescue teams know exactly where you are.

lore.name: MedPen (Hemozal)
lore.description: Manufacturer: CureLife Item Type: Medical Consumable From the Empire’s most trusted medical company, the CureLife MedPen can rapidly dispense doses of the coagulant Hemozal during emergency situations to help relieve bleeding and improve a patient’s overall vitals. Use only as recommended.

lore.name: MedPens
lore.description: The MedPen from CureLife is a complete multi-function individual first-aid system designed and constructed for the rigors of field use.

lore.name: MegaFlux
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Military Repeated requests from military veterans to make the MegaFlux commercially available convinced A&R Co. to release this large power plant to the public.

lore.name: Melty Dog
lore.description: NDR: 34 Effects: Dehydrating, Hyper-Metabolic A hefty dousing in melted 'cheese' takes this hot dog to the next level.

lore.name: Menarik
lore.description: A striking kingfish that’s capable of adapting to many types of environments. It was ‘presented’ to Humanity by the Xi’An from their preserves in Ealus System.

lore.name: Mercury
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Military In combat situations, even the smallest advantage can lead to big gains. With Aegis’ Mercury cooling system onboard, you’ll be able to push your ship hotter for longer when you need it most.

lore.name: Mercury Dual S3 Nose Mount
lore.description: Item Type: Weapon Mount Manufacturer: Crusader Industries Size: 3 This pilot-controlled, dual-linked weapon mount is bespoke to the Mercury Star Runner and outfitted with two size-3 laser repeaters ready to help keep your flight path clear.

lore.name: Mercury Gloves
lore.description: Designed to provide warmth to your hands while still allowing you to precisely manipulate things, the Mercury gloves from DMC are perfect for outdoor activities or colder work environments.

lore.name: Mercury Gloves "Voyager"
lore.description: Keep your hands warm and fingers nimble with Mercury gloves from DMC. Ideal for outdoor activities or colder work environments, the special Voyager edition comes in red with gold trim.

lore.name: Mercury Gloves (Modified)
lore.description: This version of DMC's Mercury gloves has been modified from its original form. Keep your hands warm and fingers nimble with Mercury gloves from DMC. Ideal for outdoor activities or colder work environments.

lore.name: Mercury Star Runner 2951 Best in Show Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the Star Runner being voted a Best in Show finalist for 2951 with this special blue and black livery.

lore.name: Mercury Star Runner Blackguard Livery
lore.description: Featuring a blue left wing and highlights, the Blackguard livery will make your Mercury Star Runner stand out from the crowd.

lore.name: Mercury Star Runner Equinox Livery
lore.description: The Mercury Star Runner Equinox livery blends orange and black for a paint scheme highlighting the unique look of this asymmetrical ship.

lore.name: Mercury Star Runner Flight Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU The Mercury Star Runner is more than a memorable silhouette. Crusader's beloved asymmetrical ship gets it own comfortable flight jacket made of high quality synthetic leather. Complete with Crusader's logo on the front and a patch with the ship mid-flight on the back.

lore.name: Mercury Star Runner Fortuna Livery
lore.description: Make luck your co-pilot. Boldly set your sights on the stars and adventure forth in style with the Fortuna livery. This Stella Fortuna themed paint scheme is primarily green with grey accents.

lore.name: Mercury Star Runner Foundation Guide Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Mercury Star Runner Meridian Livery
lore.description: The Meridian livery gives the Mercury Star Runner a simple yet stylish metallic silver finish.

lore.name: Mercury Star Runner Nightrunner Livery
lore.description: Meld into the pitch-dark expanse of space with this livery featuring a black paint scheme with gold accents for your Mercury Star Runner.

lore.name: Mercury Star Runner Polar Camo Livery
lore.description: Modify your Star Runner with this white and grey camo livery specifically designed for the 2950 IAE event on microTech.

lore.name: Mercury Star Runner Red Alert Livery
lore.description: Stand out from the crowd of conventional courier ships with the Red Alert livery, which makes the Mercury Star Runner metallic red and black.

lore.name: Mercury Star Runner Silver Spark Livery
lore.description: Emphasize the special shape of the Mercury Star Runner with the Silver Spark livery featuring yellow highlights expertly integrated into the grey and black paint scheme.

lore.name: Mercury Star Runner Skyrider Livery
lore.description: Stylishly stay ahead of schedule, trouble, and the competition with this custom livery featuring a smoky blue and black paint scheme with bright blue accents for the Mercury Star Runner.

lore.name: Merguez Sandwich
lore.description: NDR: 41 Effects: None Crunchy Bremen-style bread is topped with bright torshi liteh, pickled pink onions, and richly spiced lamb sausage. At Twyn's, it's what's inside that counts.

lore.name: Messy Twists
lore.description: A style for chill dudes.

lore.name: Metal
lore.description: A solid material that typically shiny and opaque and possesses good electrical and thermal conductivity.

lore.name: Metamaterial Test #146
lore.description: This is a test for new metamaterial with special design by Wikelo. It will be light and strong but maybe not! Good to test.

lore.name: Metamaterial Test #152
lore.description: This a new metamaterial test with design by Wikelo. I think one will this help make things go faster. Last two tests not so good, but maybe this one works.

lore.name: Meteor Bolide Livery
lore.description: Make the Meteor a striking metallic red and black with the Bolide livery.

lore.name: Meteor Disco Livery
lore.description: Equip the ship livery used by ace pilot Disco in the classic children's cartoon Rory Nova. While it turns the Meteor metallic dark blue, black, and red, whether you turn into the 'dynamic, instinctive spacecraft operator' that inspired the livery's name is up to you.

lore.name: Meteor Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Meteor with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Meteor Shimmer Livery
lore.description: The eye-catching Shimmer livery brings a beautiful luster to the Meteor with a paint that shifts between gold and dark blue depending on the lighting and viewing angle.

lore.name: Meteor Skylark Livery
lore.description: The Skylark livery for the Meteor is primarily black and teal.

lore.name: Methane
lore.description: A highly flammable gas composed of carbon and hydrogen. It is colorless and odorless in its natural state.

lore.name: Metis

lore.name: Midas Fish
lore.description: Found in the rivers on Cassel in the Goss System, the Midas fish's golden color and nocturnal schedule make it a highly sought after addition to aquariums around the universe.

lore.name: Midas Salvage Claw
lore.description: Item Type: Manipulator Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Class: Industrial This heavy-duty claw allows an onboard technician to manipulate and collect salvage.

lore.name: Military Supply
lore.description: A variety of items assembled to support combat forces, including ammunition, structural repair tools and clothing.

lore.name: Millrun Waders
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 400 µSCU A combination of waterproof and weather-resistant pants and boots, the Millrun Waders are a comfortable option for uncomfortable work.

lore.name: Mineral
lore.description: Naturally occurring abiogenic compounds that are typically crystalline in nature with an ordered atomic arrangement.

lore.name: Mirage
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Ascension Astro Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Stealth By boasting a signature so faint most won’t believe it’s there, Ascension Astro’s top of the line small shield generator lives up to its name — Mirage. It’s the ultimate component for those who want to go unnoticed.

lore.name: Mirai Fury 1xS2 Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Mirai Size: 2 Missiles: 1xS2 To make the Fury a threat despite its small size, Mirai developed this bespoke missile rack, which can carry and deploy one S2 missile without undermining the ship's compact profile.

lore.name: Mirai Fury MX 2xS1 Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Mirai Size: 2 Missiles: 2xS1 To make the Fury a threat despite its small size, Mirai developed this bespoke missile rack, which can carry and deploy two S1 missiles without undermining the ship's compact profile.

lore.name: Mirai Fury MX 2xS2 Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Mirai Size: 3 Missiles: 2xS2 To make the Fury a threat despite its small size, Mirai developed this bespoke missile rack, which can carry and deploy two S2 missiles without undermining the ship's compact profile.

lore.name: Mirai Razor Schematic
lore.description: The schematic for this endurance racer shows off the distinctly Xi’an engines and thrusters used by the Mirai Razor. It’s a welcome addition to Esperia’s “Masters of Design” series, as the ship beautifully blends both Human and Xi’an technology.

lore.name: MISC Freelancer
lore.description: Manufacturer: MISC Focus: Medium Freight Freelancers are used as long haul merchant ships by major corporations, but they are just as frequently repurposed as dedicated exploration vessels by independent captains who want to operate on the fringes of the galaxy.

lore.name: MISC Freelancer DUR
lore.description: Manufacturer: MISC Focus: Expedition The Freelancer DUR variant specializes in exploration. Sacrificing 25% cargo capacity of the standard Freelancer for an enhanced jump drive, a more advanced scanner, and an expanded fuel tank may seem like a bad call to some, but those who value discovery over profit will find it to be their ship of choice.

lore.name: MISC Freelancer MAX
lore.description: Manufacturer: MISC Focus: Medium Freight Freelancer variant with additional cargo capacity at the expense of weapons. The Freelancer MAX variant sacrifices weaponry for an increased cargo capacity making it ideal for equipment or raw materials transport.

lore.name: MISC Hat
lore.description: Evoke the industrial spirit of MISC by sporting this tan hat featuring the company's emblem.

lore.name: MISC Hat Blue and White
lore.description: This blue and white cadet hat features a minimalistic version of MISC's logo on the front.

lore.name: MISC Prospector Schematic
lore.description: Dig behind the hull of the MISC Prospector, one of the UEE’s preeminent solo mining vessels, with this detailed schematic. Esperia’s “Masters of Design” official blueprint, faithfully reproduced from the original MISC archive, goes under the panels to show all the systems of this durable worker.

lore.name: MISC T-Shirt
lore.description: This tan shirt sports the MISC name and logo. Perfect for those with an affinity for reliable industrial ships imbued with a slight Xi'an influence.

lore.name: MISC T-Shirt White
lore.description: Proclaim your admiration for MISC's cutting-edge ships with this high-quality white t-shirt, featuring the company's logo on the front and back.

lore.name: Misfit Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Embody the hardcore attitude with the Misfit jacket. Durable synthetic leather combines with anarchic stylings for a jacket meant to send a message. Its distinct look includes spikes across the shoulder and right arm, two buckled straps on the left arm, and a badass image on the back highlighted by three lights powered via electronic boxes affixed to the front.

lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Embody the hardcore attitude with the Misfit jacket. Durable synthetic leather combines with anarchic stylings for a jacket meant to send a message. Its distinct look includes spikes across the shoulder and right arm, two buckled straps on the left arm, and a badass image on the back highlighted by three lights powered via electronic boxes affixed to the front. Favored by members of the infamous Headhunters gang, the Bonefire edition features a stylized image of skulls and spines surrounded by red streaks on the back.

lore.name: Misfit Jacket Striker
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Embody the hardcore attitude with the Misfit jacket. Durable synthetic leather combines with anarchic stylings for a jacket meant to send a message. Its distinct look includes spikes across the shoulder and right arm, two buckled straps on the left arm, and a badass image on the back highlighted by three lights powered via electronic boxes affixed to the front. The Striker edition is a green camo with a white bone pattern on the back.

lore.name: Misfit Jacket Veritas
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Embody the hardcore attitude with the Misfit jacket. Durable synthetic leather combines with anarchic stylings for a jacket meant to send a message. Its distinct look includes spikes across the shoulder and right arm, two buckled straps on the left arm, and a badass image on the back highlighted by three lights powered via electronic boxes affixed to the front. The Veritas edition is a bloody red, with a kopion's spine and ribcage printed along the back.

lore.name: Mitre
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Civilian The Mitre computing system is truly unique. Designed and built by WillsOp and crafted with premium materials and components, it is cooled by an advanced radial vapor exchanged for improved performance in most environments.

lore.name: Mivaldi Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU Cut to a narrow fit, OpalSky's Mivaldi pants feature bold asymmetrical design with smart yet casual dual material styling, making it the perfect addition to any wardrobe.

lore.name: Mivaldi Pants (Modified)
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU This version of OpalSky's Mivaldi pants has been modified from its original form. Cut to a narrow fit, OpalSky's Mivaldi pants feature bold asymmetrical design with smart yet casual dual material styling, making it the perfect addition to any wardrobe.

lore.name: Mixed Mining
lore.description: A mixed collection of commodities obtained by mining

lore.name: MK-4 Frag Grenade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Grenade Area of Effect: 20 m Damage Type: Frag A continuation of the iconic hand grenade first produced by Behring in 2894, the MK-4 is an anti-personnel fragmentation grenade capable of saturating the kill-zone with lethal projectiles and a devastating concussive blast.

lore.name: mobiGlas Original Casing
lore.description: Apply your own style to your mobiGlas with this custom paint casing.

lore.name: mobyGlass Personal Computers
lore.description: These knock-off mobiGlas use pirated software and are often infected with spyware and malicious programming.

lore.name: MOLE Aphorite Livery
lore.description: Decorate your MOLE with the Aphorite livery, which gets its name and color from the precious purple gemstone prized for its multi-hued tones.

lore.name: MOLE Carbon Livery
lore.description: The Carbon livery offers the MOLE's revered mining ability with a distinctive all-black finish.

lore.name: MOLE Dolivine Livery
lore.description: Sharing the name with a gemstone prized for its beauty and industrial applications, the Dolivine livery blends shades of light green to give your MOLE a unique look.

lore.name: MOLE Greycat Livery
lore.description: Proudly display your appreciation for one of Sol's most celebrated manufacturers with the Greycat livery, featuring the chrome yellows and industrial grays associated with the company's logo.

lore.name: MOLE Hadanite Livery
lore.description: The Hadanite livery for your MOLE gives the ship a distinct pink hue that mirrors the look of the gemstone of the same name.

lore.name: Mole Keystone Livery
lore.description: Crisp white with blue accents, the Keystone livery celebrates the workers whose mining, refining, hauling, salvaging, and more have made the empire what it is today.

lore.name: MOLE Lovestruck Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your MOLE.

lore.name: MOLE Pyrotechnic Livery
lore.description: Commemorating the ambitious but ultimately ruinous mining company, the Pyrotechnic livery displays the lively yellows and cooling blues that represented the business while it was still operational.

lore.name: MOLE Shubin Livery
lore.description: Showcasing the bold colors of bronze alloy and deep obsidian, the Shubin livery embodies the spirit of the powerful planetary mining conglomerate.

lore.name: MOLE Talus Livery
lore.description: The MOLE Talus livery delivers a discreet gray look for the ship.

lore.name: Molina Mold Samples
lore.description: Samples of the deadly Molina Mold securely sealed in biohazard containers to ensure its toxic fungal spores can't get airborne.

lore.name: Molina Mold Treatment
lore.description: A lifesaving treatment for those suffering from exposure to Molina Mold.

lore.name: Molina Ventilation Filters
lore.description: Special filters developed by Gyson to replace faulty units and purify the air of Molina Mold spores.

Rating: -90 / 115 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Featuring fortified armor plating, special anti-rip protective padding and ample storage, the Morozov-SH is ready to overcome all kinds of adversity. After consulting with security professionals, RRS added a unique high protective collar and a lightweight inner lining based on their recommendation; making the Morozov-SH both comfortable and a battlefield stalwart. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: MOTH Dolomite Livery
lore.description: The Dolomite livery turns the MOTH white and grey with orange highlights.

lore.name: MOTH Juniper Livery
lore.description: Make the MOTH green with grey and orange highlights by equipping the Juniper livery.

lore.name: MOTH Lovestruck Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish iridescent pink and black look for your MOTH.

lore.name: MOTH Rockwell Livery
lore.description: Maintain a low profile with the Rockwell livery, which covers the MOTH in subtle shades of grey.

lore.name: MOTH Sundial Livery
lore.description: With an orange front and black back section, the Sundial livery divides the MOTH in two.

lore.name: MOTH Tide Pool Livery
lore.description: The colorful Tide Pool livery makes the MOTH blue with grey and green highlights.

lore.name: Mountaintop Jacket Multitone
lore.description: Temp. Rating: -20 / 10 °C Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU These insulated, water-resistant jackets are perfect for any jobsite where temperature can be a factor. The Mountaintop from DMC features secure pockets and is made with a vinyl-weave exterior, guaranteeing that rough environments won't compromise your warmth. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: MPUV 2951 Best in Show Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the MPUV being voted a Best in Show finalist for 2951 with this special blue and black livery.

lore.name: MPUV Lovestruck Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your MPUV.

lore.name: MPUV Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the MPUV with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: MPUV-1C Flight Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Show how far you'll go for the Argo Cargo. This flight jacket celebrates the ship that changed the cargo game and became ubiquitous at spaceports across the empire. Made from synthetic leather, it features two front pockets, a ribbed waistband, and cuffs that guarantees a good fit. There's also an Argo logo on the front and a stylish silhouette of the ship across the back.

lore.name: MPUV-1C PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Argo MPUV-1C with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: MPUV-1C Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Argo Astronautics Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the Argo MPUV-1C.

lore.name: MPUV-1C TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Argo MPUV-1C with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Argo MPUV-1P with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: MPUV-1T Firebrand Livery
lore.description: Vibrant red and black, the Firebrand livery brings a bold look to the MPUV-1T.

lore.name: MPUV-1T Storm Grey Livery
lore.description: The Storm Grey is an all grey livery for the MPUV-1T. Its subtle style is an ideal choice for those not wanting to draw too much attention.

lore.name: MPUV-1T Sunlight Livery
lore.description: Announce your arrival with the Sunlight livery for the MPUV-1T. Featuring a bold yellow base color, the livery makes it easier to see the ship during recovery operations.

lore.name: MPUV-1T TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Argo MPUV-1T with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: MRX "Torrent"
lore.description: Item Type: Ballistic Gatling Turret Manufacturer: Behring The latest generation of point-defense technology, the MRX "Torrent" utilizes advanced search, detection, and tracking software to unleash a swift barrage of ballistic fire, protecting ships from incoming missiles, torpedoes, and other high-speed threats.

lore.name: MTC Baracus Livery
lore.description: Bold red highlights add a bit of color and break up the black base paint of the MTC Baracus livery, which can also be applied to other Greycat M-Series vehicles.

lore.name: MTC Boreal Livery
lore.description: The Boreal livery brings a mix of metallic light grey, grey, and orange highlights to the MTC. It's also compatible with other Greycat M-series vehicles.

lore.name: MTC Brushwood Camo Livery
lore.description: The Brushwood Camo livery for the MTC features a digital green and grey camo pattern with a red line cutting through each side. It's also compatible with other Greycat M-series vehicles.

lore.name: MTC Citizens for Prosperity Liberation Livery
lore.description: Be a beacon of hope by equipping the Citizens for Prosperity Liberation livery, which features the group's name and symbol atop a green, black, and grey paint job. Compatible with all Greycat M-series vehicles.

lore.name: MTC Filament Livery
lore.description: Equip the Filament livery to make the MTC grey with black and yellow highlights. It's also compatible with other Greycat M-series vehicles.

lore.name: MTC Headhunters Reaper Livery
lore.description: The Headhunters Reaper livery lets you proudly proclaim your allegiance to the gang. It features the gang's name and highlights in red on a beige and grey paint scheme. Compatible with all Greycat M-series vehicles.

lore.name: MTC Moonstone Livery
lore.description: Crisp, metallic blue with grey and black highlights provide the Moonstone livery a spirited look for the MTC, which can also be applied to other Greycat M-Series vehicles.

lore.name: Mug
lore.description: A small, handled drinking vessel made from insulating ceramic to help keep bevarages warm.

lore.name: Mule Bushwhacker Livery
lore.description: When the job calls for crossing forests and grasslands, outfit your Drake Mule with the Bushwhacker livery, which mixes shades of green and grey.

lore.name: Mule Ghoulish Green Livery
lore.description: Embrace Day of the Vara mischievousness and mayhem any time of the year with this custom Mule livery. It combines metallic green and black for a striking look that highlights the holiday's classic colors.

lore.name: Mule Reburn Livery
lore.description: Who says you can't have a bit of fun while on the job? The Reburn livery for the Drake Mule brings a red tint to the cockpit glass and cargo cover.

lore.name: Mule Silverback Livery
lore.description: The Silverback livery adds a white cargo cover and highlights to contrast the sleek grey frame of the Drake Mule.

lore.name: Mule Smokestack Livery
lore.description: The Mule Smokestack livery features various shades of grey for a sleek and subtle look that's sure to impress while on cargo runs.

lore.name: Musaka Burrito
lore.description: NDR: 34 Effects: Dehydrating This satisfying burrito features a tortilla wrapper filled with spiced vegetables and lentils in a creamy sauce.

lore.name: Mushroom Pad Thai
lore.description: NDR: 48 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic Roasted mushrooms pair with vegetables and rice noodles in a sweet and tangy tamarind sauce. Light, but filling.

lore.name: Mustang Alpha
lore.description: Manufacturer: Consolidated Outland Focus: Cargo Inspired by Consolidated Outland CEO Silas Koerner’s cutting edge vision, the Mustang Alpha is a sleek, stylish spacecraft that uses ultralight alloys to push power ratios to the limits, albeit sometimes unsafely. And now, with the optional Cargo Carrier, you can have the Alpha’s advantages without sacrificing carrying capacity.

lore.name: Mustang Beta Livery
lore.description: Standard livery for the C.O. Mustang Beta.

lore.name: Mustang Delta Livery
lore.description: Standard livery for the C.O. Mustang Delta.

lore.name: Mustang Fortuna Livery
lore.description: Make luck your co-pilot. Boldly set your sights on the stars and adventure forth in style with the Fortuna livery. This Stella Fortuna themed paint scheme is primarily green with gray accents.

lore.name: Mustang Gamma Livery
lore.description: Standard livery for the C.O. Mustang Gamma.

lore.name: Mustang Guardian Livery
lore.description: A unique ship deserves an equally bold look, so outfit your Mustang in yellow with the Guardian livery.

lore.name: Mustang IceBreak Livery
lore.description: Equip your Mustang with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

lore.name: Mustang Murray Cup Livery
lore.description: With a deep blue base and a bright yellow finish with chevron accents, this lively Murray Cup livery shows spectators that you've got a true competitor's spirit.

lore.name: Mustang Omega Livery
lore.description: Standard livery for the C.O. Mustang Omega.

lore.name: Mustang Polar Livery
lore.description: Modify your Mustang with this white and grey livery specifically designed for the 2951 IAE.

lore.name: Mustang Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom Mustang livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.

lore.name: Mustang Vindicator Livery
lore.description: Standard livery for the C.O. Mustang Alpha Vindicator.

lore.name: MVSA Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 2 The classic M4A has been specially retooled by Behring to create the VS (Vanguard Special), a laser weapon designed to meet the Aegis' unique requirements. The default nose-mounted weapon on the Vanguard Warden, the MVSA can only be loaded onto other Vanguard variants.

lore.name: mX-SR Ammo
lore.description: The mX-Shatter rocket from Badger Bad scatters small explosives on impact or after a very brief period of time. Whenever the rocket shoots out, smaller explosives fire off in random directions making it excellent for clearing out areas. Every mX-Shatter rocket has a cluster of about 8 small explosives that when combined are about equal in force to a frag grenade.

lore.name: MXC Cadet Livery
lore.description: Make the MXC light grey with red highlights by equipping the Cadet livery, which can also be applied to other Greycat M-Series vehicles.

lore.name: MXC Icefront Camo Livery
lore.description: Disguise the silhouette of the MXC with the white and grey digital camo of the Icefront Camo livery, which is also compatible with other Greycat M-series vehicles.

lore.name: MXC Perdition Livery
lore.description: The Perdition livery envelops the MXC, and other Greycat M-Series vehicles, in dark black with gold highlights.

lore.name: MXC Timberwolf Camo Livery
lore.description: An ideal choice for cloaking the MXC in woodland environs, the Timberwolf Camo livery features a brown camo pattern and subtle red highlights. It's also compatible with other Greycat M-series vehicles.

lore.name: Myers (4x Telescopic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hedeby Gunworks Type: Telescopic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 1.5x - 4x Aim Time: +25% Size: 2 Exquisitely crafted by the gunsmiths at Hedeby Gunworks, the Myers scope was designed to pair with the graceful lines of their stately Arlington rifle.

lore.name: Myondo Knife
lore.description: Manufacturer: Banu Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: N/A The Myondo is a distinct, curved blade with a notched finger-well and bejeweled pommel. The texture on both the blade and handle come from the unique forging process used by the Banu craftsmen who make them.

lore.name: Myuda Knife
lore.description: Manufacturer: Banu Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: 16 cm A brutally effective product of Banu engineering, the Myuda knife is a vicious weapon designed for leaving wounds that won't heal easily. The proprietary metal alloy used in the construction of the blade is rust-resistant and remains ultra-sharp even after extensive use. The intricately detailed handle gives it a distinctly Banu style and provides texture to ensure a tight grip.

lore.name: N4-160f Turret
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Every combat pilot knows that the difference between a miss and a hit can be a couple of degrees. Broad & Rabiee’s N4-160f turret system is designed to put those degrees of precision in your hands by allowing canard mounted Size 1 and 2 weapons to accurately and effectively track mobile targets without changing the path of your ship.

lore.name: Natural Materials
lore.description: Materials that are naturally occurring and can be extracted directly from the environment.

lore.name: Nav-E7 Echo Scanner
lore.description: Item Type: Turret Manufacturer: Nav-E7 Size: 4 The Echo scanner from Nav-E7 utilizes enhanced long-range sensor capabilities and the manual precision of a remote turret mount to become an indispensable tool during search operations.

lore.name: Navoi Boot and Pants Striker
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.4K µSCU Be ready to take on whatever the day brings when wearing the Navoi. This unique piece integrates the pants perfectly into knee high boots. Made from a combination of synthetic materials to be tough yet comfortable, the Navoi also comes with shin pads and pouches strapped onto each leg. The Striker edition is a green camo with rust colored boots.

lore.name: Navoi Boots and Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.4K µSCU Be ready to take on whatever the day brings when wearing the Navoi. This unique piece integrates the pants perfectly into knee high boots. Made from a combination of synthetic materials to be tough yet comfortable, the Navoi also comes with shin pads and pouches strapped onto each leg.

lore.name: Navoi Boots and Pants Veritas
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.4K µSCU Be ready to take on whatever the day brings when wearing the Navoi. This unique piece integrates the pants perfectly into knee high boots. Made from a combination of synthetic materials to be tough yet comfortable, the Navoi also comes with shin pads and pouches strapped onto each leg. The Veritas edition is a bloody red, with black belts and leather straps.

lore.name: NDB-26 Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: MaxOx Item Type: Neutron Repeater Size: 1 The NDB-26 uses a twin barrel system to fire neutron projectiles at a rapid rate. Devastating at close range, this neutron repeater still packs enough of a wallop at medium range to persuade any attackers to reconsider their assault.

lore.name: NDB-28 Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: MaxOx Item Type: Neutron Repeater Size: 2 Featuring a sleek, scientific design, the MaxOx NDB-28 is the next step in serious stopping power. Twin barrels overlap blasts for sustained neutron fire that remains effective at short to medium range.

lore.name: NDB-30 Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: MaxOx Item Type: Neutron Repeater Size: 3 Decades of design work went into perfecting the NDB line of neutron repeaters. The S3 NDB-30 rapidly fires powerful and precise neutron projectiles that will quickly deter anyone foolish enough to get too close.

lore.name: Neodymium
lore.description: A reactive lanthanide that quickly oxidizes in air, forming layers of tarnish that can be readily peeled.

lore.name: Neograph
lore.description: A recently discovered form of graphene, this complicated lattice structure of carbon molecules produces an extremely light and strong material.

lore.name: Neon
lore.description: A psychoactive designer drug known for increased energy, euphoria, and mild hallucinations (particularly how the body processes light). Due to its chemical complexity, it's much more expensive than other street drugs, but is very popular in club culture.

lore.name: Neoni Tengubi Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -80 / 110 °C Radiation Protection: 52800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 251.1 REM/s Show that you serve no master with the Neoni helmet. Drawing inspiration from monster myths and warrior cultures of old, this menacing visage courtesy of CC's Conversions features a dramatic paint job, fang-filled grin, and pointed holographic horns, providing protection and intimidation in one memorable helmet. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Nereus
lore.description: Utilizing the dense mineral content of the soil on Pyro II, the nereus coats its spiral shaped seed pods with a shiny metallic-like outer coat. This extremely durable coat protects the seed from damage and ensures that it doesn't sprout until conditions are right.

lore.name: Neutrino Racing Boots Mirai
lore.description: The Neutrino Racing Boots use synthetic fabrics sourced from Xi’an artisans to create a comfortable pair of boots that are durable enough to endure the stresses of high-velocity racing. Taking inspiration from traditional Saisei culture and aesthetics, the design of these special Mirai edition boots are striking but elegant.

lore.name: Neutrino Racing Flight Suit BlackFire
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Suit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +100% Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU A racing flight suit that fits like a second skin without skimping on style, the Neutrino BlackFire edition has a sleek monochrome profile enhanced by pale gray accents and offers a low-key combination of looks and protection, allowing you to concentrate on what matters most: winning.

lore.name: Neutrino Racing Flight Suit BlueFlame
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Flight Suit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +100% Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU Cut a dashing figure in this Neutrino racing flight suit. Fitting like a second skin without skimping on style, this special BlueFlame edition sports a dark blue profile enhanced by red and white accents offers a combination of eye-catching style and function, allowing you to concentrate on what matters most: winning.

Sakura Sun's exclusive Fortuna edition of the Neutrino Racing Flight Suit in green with shimmering accents may be just the thing to turn your fortune around.

lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Sakura Sun utilises advanced Xi’an materials to create a comfortable, lightweight helmet durable enough to handle the stresses of high-velocity racing. The Neutrino BlackFire edition helmet features a dark gray finish paired with a sleek, minimalist aesthetic.

lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. lore.name: Neutrino Racing Helmet Murray Cup
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s This special edition Neutrino racing helmet was made to pay homage to Murray Cup racers. Neon yellow, blue, and packed full of logos from official race sponsors, the helmet is both lightweight and supremely comfortable.

lore.name: Neutrino Racing Helmet Origin
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Plunge headlong into extreme speed in comfort and style with this special edition Origin-inspired Neutrino racing helmet. Primarily white with black and blue highlights, the helmet features a wide visor for unobstructed views as you speed by.

lore.name: Neutrino Racing Helmet Star Kitten
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Sakura Sun's take on the iconic racing helmet worn by Team Takahashi racers can now be yours. This special edition Neutrino helmet features vibrant pink with Star Kitten iconography on the front and back, plus playful teal whiskers across the faceplate.

lore.name: Neutrino Racing Helmet WhiteHot
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s The Neutrino racing helmet utilises advanced Xi’an materials to create a comfortable, lightweight design durable enough to handle the stresses of high-velocity racing. The WhiteHot edition features a bright white and red finish paired with a sleek, minimalist aesthetic.

lore.name: NewDawn
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Civilian The NewDawn was appropriately named, as it was the first large power plant built by Sakura Sun. Following its commercial success, the company decided to expand and improve upon their line of large power plants.

lore.name: NightFall
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Stealth Run silent and safe with the NightFall from Tyler Design & Tech. Few coolers can match the way this component manages your ship's heat while also keeping its signatures low.

lore.name: Nightfall Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Ballistic Repeater Size: 6 Rain down devastation with Apocalypse Arms' Nightfall ballistic repeater. This massive size six gun offers punishment at distance and up close, unleashing higher caliber rounds than other repeaters of its size.

lore.name: Nightfire Dress
lore.description: Republic of One dares to blur the line between power and pleasure with Nightfire, the new dress from famed designer, Callista. Featuring a form-fitting knit black microweave with bold gold trim, the high, buckled collar features striking cutouts on the chest, shoulders and arms to keep you as evocative as what you're wearing.

lore.name: Nitrogen
lore.description: A low-density, diatomic gas with no color or odor in its natural state. A necessary element in human respiration.

lore.name: Nivala Shoes
lore.description: The Alejo Brothers expertly engineered the Nivala shoes to provide high ankle support while remaining lightweight. The shoes mix the company's patented FullFlex rubber with synthetic nubuck leather for flexible yet strategic support, and feature cushioning on the heels and balls of the feet for supreme comfort.

lore.name: Njakte Knife
lore.description: Manufacturer: Banu Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: 16 cm Banu engineering and ingenuity combine in the Njakte knife. Its distinct curved blade and serrated edge is rust resistant and remains ultra-sharp even after extensive use thanks to a proprietary metal alloy that's a trade secret of the souli that manufacturers it. The intricately detailed handle gives it a distinctly Banu visual style and provides texture to ensure a great grip.

lore.name: NN-13 Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: MaxOx Item Type: Neutron Cannon Size: 1 MaxOx’s NN-13 neutron cannon offers a massive energy payload at the expense of speed and energy efficiency. One could argue the virtues of speed, rate of fire and distance over damage, but the argument becomes irrelevant if you only need to hit them once.

lore.name: NN-14 Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: MaxOx Item Type: Neutron Cannon Size: 2 Building on the technology of the NN-13, MaxOx’s NN-14 offers a significant increase in power for the neutron autocannon to give each shot a devastating punch. With that increased damage however, comes a heavier draw on your power plant.

lore.name: NN-15 Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: MaxOx Item Type: Neutron Cannon Size: 3 Building on the technology of the successful NN-series, MaxOx’s NN-15 offers a significant increase in power for the neutron autocannon to give each shot a devastating punch. With that increased damage however, comes a heavier draw on your power plant.

lore.name: Noise
lore.description: This area effect countermeasure consists of a grapeshot canister that when launched explodes and scatters hundreds of smaller explosions that scatter and detonate, creating a wide dispersal volume of electrically charged metal and glass particles that can disrupt electromagnetic, infrared, and cross-section scanners. Ships and missiles will lose targeting on any ships that are inside of or obscured by the field.

lore.name: Nomad 2951 Auspicious Red Ram Livery
lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the 2951 Auspicious Red Ram livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complimented by gold accents and a silhouette of a ram's head.

lore.name: Nomad Cherry Blossom Livery
lore.description: Upgrade your Nomad with the Cherry Blossom livery featuring a bold black and white styling with pink highlights.

lore.name: Nomad Conifer Livery
lore.description: Complete deliveries in style with the Conifer livery that's primarily green with yellow highlights.

lore.name: Nomad Deck the Hull Livery
lore.description: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.

lore.name: Nomad Foundation Fest Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Nomad IceBreak Livery
lore.description: Equip your Nomad with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

lore.name: Nomad Jackal Livery
lore.description: Discreetly roam the stars with this custom Nomad livery featuring a jet black paint scheme with red accents.

lore.name: Nomad Lovestruck Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your Nomad.

lore.name: Nomad Polar Camo Livery
lore.description: Modify your Nomad with this white and grey camo livery specifically designed for the 2950 IAE event on microTech.

lore.name: Nomad Sandstone Livery
lore.description: Make your Nomad stick out among the stars with the Sandstone livery featuring a metallic orange finish with black and white highlights.

lore.name: Nomo Grub Packet
lore.description: NDR: 15 Effects: Energizing, Hypermetabolic A package of dried, protein rich nomo grubs that have a savory and slightly bitter taste.

lore.name: Nonmetals
lore.description: These elements do not display the properties of a metal and are generally poor conductors of heat and electricity.

lore.name: Normstar T-Shirt
lore.description: Normstar knows the secret to making Human shoes that are comfortable on the feet and pleasing to the eye. A Banu souli created this shirt in honor of that great accomplishment.

lore.name: Nova
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RAMP Corporation Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Stealth Don't draw attention to yourself with the Nova, which is RAMP Corporation’s base, medium-sized stealth quantum drive.

lore.name: Nova Badlands Livery
lore.description: Featuring a tan paint scheme ideal for desert environments, the Nova Badlands livery offers a devastating combination of weaponry to eliminate threats on the ground and in the air.

lore.name: Nova Ember Storm Livery
lore.description: Featuring a tan, red and black camo paint scheme ideal for desert environments, the Nova Ember Storm livery offers a devastating combination of weaponry to eliminate threats on the ground and in the air.

lore.name: Nova Gunmetal Livery
lore.description: Featuring a metallic silver paint scheme, the Nova Gunmetal livery offers a devastating combination of weaponry to eliminate threats on the ground and in the air.

lore.name: Nova Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly traverse under the night sky in the Nova with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Nova Shifting Sands Livery
lore.description: Featuring a tan and white paint scheme for desert environments, the Nova Shifting Sands livery offers a devastating combination of weaponry to eliminate threats on the ground and in the air.

lore.name: Nova Snowblind Livery
lore.description: Featuring a grey, black and white camo paint scheme ideal for arctic environments, the Nova Snowblind livery offers a devastating combination of weaponry to eliminate threats on the ground and in the air.

lore.name: Nova Timberline Livery
lore.description: Customize your Nova with the Timberline livery that's olive green with orange accents.

lore.name: Novian "Ghostmaker" Crossbow
lore.description: Manufacturer: UltiFlex Item Type: Crossbow Magazine Size: 5 Rate Of Fire: 60 rpm Effective Range: 50 m Attachments: Optics (S3), Underbarrel (S3) The craftsman at UltiFlex went through hundreds of prototypes to discover the perfect lightweight material with the right combination of strength and flexibility for its Novian crossbow, an ideal companion on everything from frontier expeditions to tactical infiltrations. With a pull of its firing action, the Novian near-silently launches a heavy bolt that shatters on impact causing devastating damage to close-range targets. The Ghostmaker edition sports smoke gray accents on a metallic body.

lore.name: Novian Bolt Magazine (5 Cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 5 This magazine for the Novian crossbow comes preloaded with five bolts.

lore.name: Novian Crossbow
lore.description: Manufacturer: UltiFlex Item Type: Crossbow Magazine Size: 5 Rate Of Fire: 60 rpm Effective Range: 50 m Attachments: Optics (S3), Underbarrel (S3) The craftsman at UltiFlex went through hundreds of prototypes to discover the perfect lightweight material with the right combination of strength and flexibility for its Novian crossbow, an ideal companion on everything from frontier expeditions to tactical infiltrations. lore.name: Novikov "Ascension" Backpack
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Backpack Carrying Capacity: 180K µSCU Core Compatibility: Heavy Confidently explore cold environments while wearing the Novikov. Caldera designed a spacious backpack to complement this advanced exploration suit, so those venturing across unknown terrain can bring enough supplies to survive the journey. This special IAE 2953 edition is decorated with a copper and white damascus pattern inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.

lore.name: Novikov "Ascension" Exploration Suit
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Utility Damage Reduction: 25% Temp. Rating: -225 / 75 °C Radiation Protection: 33600 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 147.42 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU Backpacks: All In order to confidently explore cold environments, Caldera built the Novikov exploration suit with an advanced sensor suite that intelligently adjusts to environmental conditions so the wearer's body temperature remains stable. Also featuring a cutting edge life support system, those venturing across unknown terrain can count on the Novikov to help them survive the journey. This special IAE 2953 edition is decorated with a copper and white pattern inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.

lore.name: Novikov "Ascension" Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Utility Damage Reduction: 25% Temp. Rating: -225 / 75 °C Radiation Protection: 33600 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 147.42 REM/s In order to confidently explore cold environments, Caldera built the Novikov exploration suit with an advanced sensor suite that intelligently adjusts to environmental conditions so the wearer's body temperature remains stable. Also featuring a bespoke helmet that integrates with the cutting edge life support system, those venturing across unknown terrain can count on the Novikov to help them survive the journey. This special IAE 2953 edition is decorated with a copper and white pattern inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.

lore.name: Novikov "Expo" Arms
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 25% Temp. Rating: -225 / 75 °C Radiation Protection: 33600 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 147.42 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU Confidently explore cold environments while wearing the Novikov "Expo". Caldera built the exploration suit with an advanced sensor suite that intelligently adjusts to environmental conditions so the wearer's body temperature remains stable. Also featuring a cutting edge life support system and spacious carryall, those venturing across unknown terrain can count on the Novikov to help them survive the journey. The "Expo" edition celebrates CitizenCon 2949 by blending orange and purple for an eye catching look that's highly visible against the elements.

lore.name: Nox Finish Line Livery
lore.description: Give the Nox a classic racing design with the Finish Line livery. It features a yellow stripe across the front, a white one through the middle, and a grey one on the back.

lore.name: Nox Harmony Livery
lore.description: The Harmony livery is meant to showcase Humanity's peaceful relationship with alien species with a semi-pearlescent blue main coat marked with organic reflective red to suggest the coming together of disparate species and cultures. The Harmony livery has been designed and produced by the UEE's Diplomatic Corps and freely licensed to all spacecraft manufacturers. Now Aopoa Nox owners can celebrate the UEE's intentions of working toward a peaceful galaxy.

lore.name: Nox Ocellus Livery
lore.description: The Ocellus livery adapts and updates the iconic colors and design used on some Tevarin ships to bring a striking new look to the Nox. The livery gives the top of the fuselage a prominent red ridge while shimmering green covers the rest of the ship. Thick grey lines swoop through both colors to provide a unique geometric element.

lore.name: Nox Overdrive Livery
lore.description: Blast past other racers in your Nox with the Overdrive livery, which features a stylish blend red and silver coloring.

lore.name: Nox Slipstream Livery
lore.description: The Slipstream livery will have your Nox ready and raring to race with this sleek blue and white paint scheme.

lore.name: Nox Star Kitten Livery
lore.description: Embody Sally the Star Kitten's racing spirit with this custom Nox livery. Combining the bright pink, vibrant blue, and crisp white of the beloved cartoon mascot, this livery brings a playfulness your competitors are sure to enjoy.

lore.name: Nox Thli Livery
lore.description: Speed and style combine with the Nox Thli livery that artfully blends silver and black across this open-canopy racer.

lore.name: Nox Turbocharged Livery
lore.description: The Turbocharged is a distinct, purple racing livery for the Nox that will make you stand out from the rest of the field.

lore.name: Nox Wanderer Livery
lore.description: The Wanderer livery features crisscrossing purple and grey lines over a platinum foundation. Inspired by the sacred Xi'an gardens of R.aip?uang, famous for its trails that wander in surprising ways and encourage a focus on the journey instead of the destination.

lore.name: Nox Whirlwind Livery
lore.description: The Whirlwind livery mixes various shades of blue in a memorable animal stripe pattern to give the Nox a daring look.

lore.name: NV57 Ballistic Gatling
lore.description: Item Type: Ballistic Gatling Gun Manufacturer: Behring Size: S5 Break the ranks with the NV57 Ballistic Gatling Gun designed to replace the standard Tumbril Nova tank canon. Be ready to face overwhelming ground forces head on using this high powered weapon with superior damage output and a devastating rate of fire.

lore.name: Nyman Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU OpalSky's Nyman light pullover is perfect to have on hand when lounging poolside or on those chilly nights.

lore.name: Obscura
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Ascension Astro Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Stealth Respected for its lower emissions, the Obscura shield generator uses an advanced signature dispersal system to help give your ship a quieter signature while still remaining shielded.

lore.name: Obscura
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Ascension Astro Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Stealth Respected for its lower emissions, the Obscura shield generator uses an advanced signature dispersal system to help give your ship a quieter signature while still remaining shielded.

lore.name: Observer
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Chimera Communications Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Industrial Using formerly classified military technology, this now publically available radar is designed to offer key information to the user.

lore.name: Observer-Go
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Chimera Communications Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Industrial Designed to be as accessible as possible, the Observer-Go is a strong entry-level radar for those that want to keep themselves informed without breaking the bank.

lore.name: Observer-Lite
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Chimera Communications Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Industrial The Observer-Lite is a no-frills radar ready for those long hauls. Trust the brand that focuses on how good a radar works and not just how it looks.

lore.name: Observer-Max
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Chimera Communications Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Industrial Dependable and built to last, the Observer-Max offers standard radar detection.

lore.name: Ochelo
lore.description: Inspired by Human-made instruments which were the Banu's first introduction to music, this ornately decorated Ochelo features four strings on a raised fret and a leather-skinned drum base. Some of the most popular practitioners of the instrument have risen to fame performing as buskers in markets and city squares.

lore.name: ODOK Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU A plain jacket covered by a thick apron, shoulder pauldrons, dust flaps, and a reinforced metal collar complete with tether. Women's sizes currently not available.

lore.name: Odyssey
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian Adventure amidst the stars awaits with the Odyssey quantum drive. Careful and continued refinement from the Tarsus team has kept this component on the cutting edge for centuries.

lore.name: Odyssey Helmet Tan
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s RSI's Odyssey helmet is so light and unobtrusive, you'll almost forget you're wearing it. The durable impact-resistant carbon fiber construction with shock-absorbing foam inserts and a single piece molded laminate visor that provides maximum field of view horizontally and vertically.

lore.name: Odyssey II Racing Helmet Alpha
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Continuing RSI's legacy of rugged and reliable helmets, the Odyssey II streamlines the original design into a lighter frame without sacrificing durability. This omni-purpose helmet was extensively field-tested in a variety of conditions and environments to keep you safe every time you suit up.

lore.name: Odyssey II Racing Helmet Envy
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Continuing RSI's legacy of rugged and reliable helmets, the Odyssey II streamlines the original design into a lighter frame without sacrificing durability. This omni-purpose helmet was extensively field-tested in a variety of conditions and environments to keep you safe every time you suit up. This special Envy edition inspired by the Coramor festival features a vibrant pink and purple color scheme for the most enthusiastic of lovers.

lore.name: Odyssey II Racing Helmet Lovestruck
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Continuing RSI's legacy of rugged and reliable helmets, the Odyssey II streamlines the original design into a lighter frame without sacrificing durability. This omni-purpose helmet was extensively field-tested in a variety of conditions and environments to keep you safe every time you suit up. This special Lovestruck edition features a stylish metallic pink and black color scheme inspired by the colors of the Coramor festival.

lore.name: Odyssey II Racing Helmet Obsidian
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Continuing RSI's legacy of rugged and reliable helmets, the Odyssey II streamlines the original design into a lighter frame without sacrificing durability. This omni-purpose helmet was extensively field-tested in a variety of conditions and environments to keep you safe every time you suit up. This special Obsidian variant features a darkened visor for anyone looking to maintain their anonymity.

lore.name: Odyssey II Racing Helmet Starcrossed
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Continuing RSI's legacy of rugged and reliable helmets, the Odyssey II streamlines the original design into a lighter frame without sacrificing durability. This omni-purpose helmet was extensively field-tested in a variety of conditions and environments to keep you safe every time you suit up. This special Starcrossed edition is modeled after the armor worn by Yuri Ilyin in the famous 25th century vid, Coramor, which inspired the eponymous lovers' festival.

lore.name: Odyssey II Undersuit Alpha
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% The latest generation of RSI's classic Odyssey undersuit features a new rugged design capable of withstanding the harshest of conditions in space or planetside. Built using the latest microweave technology, the Odyssey II undersuit provides hours of comfort in locations that are anything but comfortable.

lore.name: OKB Voskhod Energia IV
lore.description: OKB Voskhod has been in the thruster game for decades and recently unveiled the Energia IV at the thruster manufacturer trade show in Prime. Benchmarks show that this thruster mostly lives up to the marketing hype from the show floor: it has good fuel efficiency, and the extra shielding OKB Voskhod has added results in minimal heat signature. It lags a bit in the performance tests but the manufacturer maintains it not a marketed as a solution where maximum thrust is required.

lore.name: OKB Voskhod Silent IV Advanced (TR4)
lore.description: The Silent IV Advanced from OKB Voskhod is a field emission ion engine optimized to provide a decreased heat signature, making the ship more difficult to track via conventional scans.

lore.name: OLP Storage Keycard
lore.description: A single-use keycard that grants Orbital Laser Platform employees access to storage areas.

lore.name: OLP Supervisor Keycard
lore.description: A single-use keycard used by Supervisors at Orbital Laser Platforms to access secured storage. To ensure restricted access to the area, this card loses its admin permissions after one use and cannot be reproduced.

lore.name: Omarof (16x Telescopic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Lightning Bolt Company Type: Telescopic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 16x Aim Time: +0% Size: 3 Get a crystal clear view of distant targets with this powerful telescopic scope from Lightning Bolt Company. Designed specifically for the Atzkav Sniper Rifle, the Omarof uses ultra-precise laser etched lenses that are then multi-coated to allow for high light transmission, wide sight picture and crisp colors, providing strikingly sharp images across significant distances.

lore.name: Omnapoxy
lore.description: Durable and resistant, this resin quickly sets when applied to form a hardened polymer.

lore.name: Omni Mav Thruster
lore.description: Aegis Winnowing D1 Omni Thruster

lore.name: OMNI-AFS-Sapphire Armored Flight Suit
lore.description: Item Type: Armored Flight Suit Damage Reduction: 15% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +97.5% Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU Inspired by the armored flight suit worn by UEE Navy pilots, the OMNI-AFS-Sapphire has been battle tested and refined for centuries to become the ultimate wear for any pilot. Its sturdy yet comfortable construction can not only withstand hostile environments, but comes with integrated arm, core, and leg armor for combat encounters. The only way a pilot can get closer to the real thing is by enlisting.

lore.name: OMNI-AFS-Sapphire Flight Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Helmet Damage Reduction: 15% Temp. Rating: -35 / 65 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Similar to the helmet worn by UEE Navy pilots, the OMNI-AFS-Sapphire helmet delivers excellent protection and visibility. Multilayered plating protects against impacts while its wide faceplate ensures clear, unobstructed views whether in the cockpit or on foot.

lore.name: OMNI-CFS-Diamond Flight Suit
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Suit Damage Reduction: 10% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +97.5% Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU The Navy has spent centuries refining the flight suits that their combat pilots wear. The OMNI-CFS Diamond is the culmination of this long and battle-tested military. The Omni features reinforced construction to withstand a variety of hostile environments and integrates flawlessly with appropriately classic armor systems.

lore.name: Omnisky III Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 1 The Omnisky III is the base model in A&R's line of laser autocannons for small ships and has a comparable rate of fire, damage output and range to other weapons in its size class. It uses mid-grade components in its design, offering a marked increase in power efficiency over some of its less expensive competitors.

lore.name: Omnisky IX Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 3 The Omnisky IX is the size three version of Amon & Reese's popular laser autocannon. The weapon's low rate of fire is offset by its effective range, which allows it to deliver a powerful shot from afar.

lore.name: Omnisky VI Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 2 The Omnisky VI is the mid-sized laser autocannon from manufacturer A&R. It boasts increased damage and range and power consumption over its smaller brother, the Omnisky III, and utilizes many of the same components resulting in middle-of-the-road power efficiency.

lore.name: Omnisky XII Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 4 Amon & Reese's dependable line of laser autocannons continues with the Omnisky XII. Though slow firing, this size four laser is able to efficiently deliver devastating laser beam blasts from a considerable range.

lore.name: Omnisky XV Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 5 Amon & Reese's reputation for making powerful and reliable weapons is embodied by their Omnisky line of laser autocannons. The Omnisky XV is the size five version of the weapon that's helped defend the Empire for centuries.

lore.name: Omnisky XVIII Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 6 Nicknamed 'Augustus' by Amon & Reese engineers after the Roman Emperor who founded the notable 'Eighteenth Legion,' this massive size six laser autocannon hits hard over great distances, making the Omnisky XVIII an effective way to keep enemies at bay.

lore.name: Omnitrek Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Be ready for anything with DMC’s Omnitrek, the survival jacket designed for maximal performance in adverse weather conditions with the addition of the water-resistant collapsible collar. The Omnitrek also provides numerous storage options across both sleeve and chest pockets.

lore.name: One Empire 200th Anniversary Coin
lore.description: A coin commemorating the 200th anniversary for One Empire, a community-based government initiative.

lore.name: One Light Cap Blue
lore.description: Are you looking for the perfect Luminalia gift? City Lights has you covered with this soft and snug woven cap that not only keeps your head warm but shows off your holiday spirit.

lore.name: One Light Shirt Blue
lore.description: During Luminalia, we're all one family. Celebrate with your loved ones in immense joy with this festive shirt from City Lights, crafted with high-quality, ultra soft fabric that's made to last.

lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% Featuring durable poly-fiber fabric, a comfortable fit, and a special holiday design, this undersuit is the perfect thing to wear to any Luminalia party.

lore.name: OneClick
lore.description: CureLife's OneClick is a first-line treatment system capable of providing temporary relief against a variety of medical conditions.

lore.name: OneMeal Nutrition Bar (Fried Tofu)
lore.description: NDR: 21 Effects: Hypo-Metabolic OneMeal optimal nutrition bars are a scientifically balanced and complete meal replacement that's "ready when you are."

lore.name: OneMeal Nutrition Bar (Grilled Steak)
lore.description: NDR: 21 Effects: Hypo-Metabolic OneMeal optimal nutrition bars are a scientifically balanced and complete meal replacement that's "ready when you are."

lore.name: OneMeal Nutrition Bar (Roast Chicken)
lore.description: NDR: 21 Effects: Hypo-Metabolic OneMeal optimal nutrition bars are a scientifically balanced and complete meal replacement that's "ready when you are."

lore.name: OneMeal Nutrition Bar (Spicy Salmon)
lore.description: NDR: 21 Effects: Hypo-Metabolic OneMeal optimal nutrition bars are a scientifically balanced and complete meal replacement that's "ready when you are."

lore.name: Oni Kiba Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Inspired by ancient Human folklore, the Oni Kiba helmet features a demonic face with long fangs and sharp horns. The use of high-end treated metals creates an ornamental aesthetic, whilst still providing substantial protection from all angles. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Ophelia Vine Plant
lore.description: Similar to how the plant’s fictional namesake drowned in the ancient Earth play Hamlet, the bioluminescent Ophelia vine is submerged regularly by the tide that rises over the brackish sands it grows upon. The plants bright radiance is owing to the high quantity of luciferin it naturally absorbs from the heavy bacteria content found in its homemoon’s oceans.

lore.name: OpioPen (Roxaphen)
lore.description: Manufacturer: CureLife Item Type: Medical Consumable From the Empire’s most trusted medical company, the CureLife OpioPen can rapidly dispense doses of the pain reliever Roxaphen during emergency situations to help relieve symptoms associated with impaired mobility and partial paralysis. Use only as recommended.

lore.name: Opus Gloves
lore.description: Give any outfit that final elegant touch with the Opus opera gloves from Dyna Lei. Contrasting black velvet and rich leather impeccably trimmed with gold satin to create an understated impact that's sure to liven any evening. Men sizes are currently unavailable.

lore.name: Oracle Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -31 / 61 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Kastak Arms' Oracle provides an enclosed reinforced plating helmet with integrated diamond laminate over the eyes. It allows for maximum situational awareness while keeping the wearer safe in space and on the battlefield. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Oracle Helmet (Modified)
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -31 / 61 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s This version of Kastak Arms' Oracle helmet has been modified from its original form. Kastak Arms' Oracle provides an enclosed reinforced plating helmet with integrated diamond laminate over the eyes. It allows for maximum situational awareness while keeping the wearer safe in space and on the battlefield. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Orange QuikFlarePro
lore.description: Manufacturer: Shubin Interstellar Illuminate the way forward or signal for help with the Orange QuikFlarePro from Shubin Interstellar. For centuries, miners have counted on this flare as part of their core toolkit, thanks to its tried and true design and durability that ensures it stays ablaze in the various harsh weather and difficult atmospheric conditions encountered across the 'verse. The QuikFlarePro uses advanced tech to glow longer than regular flares.

Rating: -55 / 85 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Dependable and durable armor never goes out of style.
