lore.name: OreBit Mining Attachment
lore.description: MUST BUY BASE MULTI-TOOL TO USE: "Pyro RYT Multi-Tool" Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Multi-Tool Attachment Class: Mining The OreBit attachment turns Greycat's Pyro RYT Multi-Tool into a handheld mining machine. It can scan rocks to find worthwhile deposits and then liberate the lode with its powerful mining laser. Next time you're planetside, be sure you bring this attachment or risk leaving easy credits behind.

lore.name: Organics
lore.description: PH - Organics are formerly living organisms that have been prepared for other purposes. This includes meat, plant and animal parts, biofuel, and other such items.

lore.name: Origin 100i Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Origin Jumpworks Size: 2 Missiles: 2xS2 Bespoke missile rack for the 100i that fires two S2 missiles.

lore.name: Origin 125a Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Origin Jumpworks Size: 2 Missiles: 4xS2 Bespoke missile rack for the 125a that fires four S2 missiles.

lore.name: Origin 350r Racing Flight Suit
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Flight Suit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +100% Carrying Capacity: 8.0 µSCU Embody luxury, style, and speed by stepping into this official flight suit worn by the Origin racing team. This gray and yellow flight suit features the Origin and 350r logo in several prominent places.

lore.name: Origin 350r Racing Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Racing Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Plunge headlong into extreme speed in comfort and style with the Origin racing helmet. This gray and yellow helmet sports the Origin logo and features a wide visor for unobstructed views as you speed by.

lore.name: Origin 85X Schematic
lore.description: PH Schematic: Get to know every inch of the Origin 85X with the schematics for this agile and luxurious racer from Origin.

lore.name: Origin Jumpworks 300i
lore.description: Manufacturer: Origin Jumpworks Focus: Touring If you're going to travel the stars... why not do it in style? The 300i is Origin Jumpworks' premiere luxury spacecraft. It is a sleek, silver killer that sends as much of a message with its silhouette as it does with its particle cannons.

lore.name: Origin Jumpworks 315p
lore.description: Manufacturer: Origin Jumpworks Focus: Pathfinder Exploration is man's highest calling. Prepare to chart distant horizons with man's most sophisticated piece of technology, the Origin 315p. Featuring a more robust power plant and a custom scanning package, exclusively designed by Chimera Communications.

lore.name: Origin Jumpworks 325a
lore.description: Manufacturer: Origin Jumpworks Focus: Interdiction Just because it's a rough galaxy doesn't mean you need to sacrifice your comfort: the 325a can come out on top in any dogfight. The 325a features an advanced weapon payload as well as a custom targeting system designed especially for the 325a by WillsOp.

lore.name: Origin Jumpworks 350r
lore.description: Manufacturer: Origin Jumpworks Focus: Racing The combination of a Gangleri BP 707 Standard powerplant with a 300i fuselage re-engineered to accommodate twin Hammer Propulsion HM 4.3 thrusters makes the 350r the fastest personal craft you'll ever call your own.

lore.name: Origin Jumpworks Hat
lore.description: This light grey hat featuring Origin's name and signature logo is a perennial best seller at their showroom in New Austin.

lore.name: Origin Jumpworks M50 Interceptor
lore.description: Manufacturer: Origin Jumpworks Focus: Racing If you want to get from point A to point B as quickly as possible and with as much style as possible then Origin's M50 is for you. Featuring supercharged engines that counter a tiny weapons loadout, the M50 is a ship for going FAST.

lore.name: Origin Jumpworks T-Shirt
lore.description: Origin Jumpworks ships have been described as a symphony in motion. That elegant aesthetic extends to the circular logo gracing the front of this light grey t-shirt.

lore.name: Origin White Bishop
lore.description: Made exclusively for Origin Jumpworks and included with the 890 Jump, this white chess piece is a modern version of a classic set.

lore.name: Origin White Bishop
lore.description: Made exclusively for Origin Jumpworks and included with the 890 Jump, this black chess piece is a modern version of a classic set.

lore.name: Orison Mug
lore.description: A small, handled drinking vessel made from insulating ceramic to help keep bevarages warm. Features a unique Orison theme.

lore.name: Orison Shipyards T-Shirt White
lore.description: The massive Orison shipyards are a sight unlike any other in the UEE. This shirt features a floating ring platform flanked by blossoms from the Hosanna tree, which was specifically cultivated to grow in the gardens of Orison.

lore.name: Orison T-Shirt White
lore.description: Named after an old word for "prayer," the city of Orison is unlike any other in the empire. Commemorate this special locale with the image of one of the city's iconic cloud vistas framed inside the name.

lore.name: Ornate Drinking Gourd
lore.description: Made from a calabash gourd, this spherical drinking vessel fits warmly in the hand and features intricate metal latticework detailing.

lore.name: Orsen Officer Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU These practical, no-nonsense trousers provide the support and durability that those working in the defensive services would expect.

lore.name: Oshi
lore.description: A smaller cousin of a deep-sea bioluminescent species, the Oshi have only recently adapted to the lighter pressure closer to the surface of the vast oceans.

lore.name: Osion Hides
lore.description: The tanned skins from Osoians, a Fair Chance protected species from Oso II.

lore.name: OT4-RF "Scorched" (4x Telescopic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Type: Telescopic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 2x - 4x Aim Time: +5% Visual Recoil: -10% Parallax: Medium Size: 2 Combining a premium 4x telescopic sight with Gemini's innovative echoburst rangefinder, the OT4-RF model allows you to accurately gauge the distance to your target; vital for effective precision shooting. When paired with the Gemini S71 or other compatible weapon, the OT4-RF is engineered to impress in a variety of situations and engagements. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

lore.name: OT4-RF (4x Telescopic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Type: Telescopic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 4x Aim Time: +25% Size: 2 Combining a premium 4x telescopic sight with Gemini's innovative echoburst rangefinder, the OT4-RF model allows you to accurately gauge the distance to your target; vital for effective precision shooting. When paired with the Gemini S71 or other compatible weapon, the OT4-RF is engineered to impress in a variety of situations and engagements.

lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Military Amon & Reese knows from years of experience just how hard the military can push their ships. lore.name: Overlord Arms Cardinal
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -77 / 107 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s The Overlord armor lets your foes know that you mean business. This heavy armor set is constructed with durable composite plating strategically placed to disperse the force of impacts and a high, reinforced collar that provides additional protection for your neck and back of head. The suit also layers in high-strength synthetic fabrics around the joints to ensure ease of moment without sacrificing safety. The Cardinal edition is a vibrant red with purple and white accents.

lore.description: A favored piece by many serving aboard drafty starships, this military-green InterSec sweater is designed to provide comfort, insulation, and instill a sense of professionalism. lore.name: Oxygen
lore.description: The third most abundant element in the universe, oxygen is a highly reactive chalcogen gas that readily forms oxides with other materials.

lore.name: OxyPen
lore.description: Manufacturer: CureLife This easy-to-carry disposable first-aid system is designed to refill pressure suit oxygen reserves in emergency situations. Compatible with most standard suits, the Curelife OxyPen is an ideal solution for preventing hypoxia and providing immediate access to lifesaving oxygen.

lore.name: OxyPens
lore.description: The OxyPen is an easy-to-carry disposable first-aid system designed by CureLife to refill pressure suit oxygen reserves in emergency situations.

lore.name: OxyTorch Cutter Attachment
lore.description: MUST BUY BASE MULTI-TOOL TO USE: "Pyro RYT Multi-Tool" Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Multi-Tool Attachment Class: Cutter Transform Greycat's Pyro RYT Multi-Tool into a precision cutter with the OxyTorch attachment. Built to quickly and easily slice through appropriate materials, the OxyTorch harnesses the power of the multi-tool to deliver accurate cuts with clean edges, making it a convenient attachment ideal for both professionals and hobbyists.

lore.name: Oza
lore.description: NDR: 09 HEI: 07 Effects: Hydrating A hybrid citrus first grown in Croshaw, it's hardiness, ease of transport, and juice yield has seen it rapidly spread across the Empire. It features thick, bumpy dark green skin, bright orange flesh ribbed with heavy pithing, and no seeds. Tart, sweet and bitter, the taste of Oza often described as being a combination of all the other citrus types rolled into one fruit. Difficult to peel and fibrous, its pulp is not often eaten. Typically it is split open and sucked on, its flesh being discarded. It is also popularly used in many cocktail recipes.

lore.description: A single-use keycard that grants Platform Alignment Facility employees access to maintenance doors.

lore.name: Paladin Alliance Aid Camo Livery
lore.description: Showcase your dedication to helping Alliance Aid assist the people of Levski during their time of need with this grey camo livery.

lore.name: Paladin Carmine Livery
lore.description: Equip the Carmine livery with its bold red highlights atop a grey base paint to make the Paladin easier to spot amidst the fog the war.

lore.name: Paladin Downstream Livery
lore.description: The Downstream livery features subtle shades of blue and black to help the Paladin discreetly reach drop zones.

lore.name: Paladin Galahad Livery
lore.description: Blend into the clouds until ready to strike with the Galahad livery for the Paladin, which features a white base paint with black and grey highlights.

lore.name: Paladin Helmet Black/Silver
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -61 / 91 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s The Paladin came out of Virgil's industrial division as a prototype helmet for salvage and repair operations. Yet its striking design so impressed company executives that they integrated it into their personal armor line. While the helmet's look stayed the same, Virgil reworked the design to use a combat rated, durable alloy for its distinct frame and reinforced the plating protecting the back of the head.

lore.name: Paladin Shadowfall Livery
lore.description: Slip under the radar using this foreboding collection of blacks and greys, featured in the Shadowfall livery.

lore.name: Paladin Solaris Livery
lore.description: Showcasing the Paladin's powerful design, the wild greens, beige, and yellow of the Solaris livery demonstrate that this is not a ship to be trifled with.

lore.name: Paladin Steadfast Livery
lore.description: Bring a grey base paint with green highlights to the Paladin with the Steadfast livery.

lore.name: Palatino Arms
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Elegant design meets innovation with the Palatino armor from Quirinus Tech. This armor set masterfully mixes reinforced plating with patented new materials that are light-weight and flexible, yet rated to withstand heavy damage allowing the wearer to be fashionable, light on their feet, and able to withstand serious firepower.

lore.name: Palisade
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Industrial No other small shield generator can match the durability of the Basilisk Palisade. This top-of-the-line industrial component forfeits stealth for the ability to absorb an unrivaled amount of damage.

lore.name: Pambada Knife
lore.description: Manufacturer: Banu Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: 16 cm Honed to a razor-fine edge, the Pambada knife has a wide range of applications. The serrated edge is great for cutting through soft and flexible materials like ropes or fabrics while the gut hook can be used to overcome materials with a tougher resistance. The sharpened angular point of the blade ensures the Pambada can still pierce, rounding out the weapon's versatile toolset. It is made with the same rust-resistant, ultra-sharp metal alloy found in other Banu knives and features an intricately detailed handle of distinctively Banu origin.

lore.name: Pampero Boots Maroon
lore.description: The Pampero are sleek ankle high boots feature lightweight yet durable soles to make it feel like you're walking on clouds even when trekking across the most unforgiving terrain.

lore.name: Pancea MedGel Canister
lore.description: This Pancea canister from CureLife is used to refill the MedGel supply of medical beds.

lore.name: Paradan Boots
lore.description: Built to last, the Paradan boots from Habidash are simple, sturdy, and reliable. The outer layer of the boots is made from a thick synthetic material that will protect the wearer from water, sand, or snow, while the inside features a pliable foam that ensures the boots will remain comfortable for years to come.

lore.name: Parallax "ArcCorp" Energy Assault Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: Assault Rifle Class: Energy (Electron) Battery Size: 80 Rate of Fire: 200 rpm - Beam Effective Range: 30 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Underbarrel (S2) With the Parallax, VOLT offers consumers a rugged assault rifle design with features like a larger-than-average battery and a unique actuator that enables the weapon to scale up into a persistent beam as it fires. This special edition features ArcCorp branding.

lore.name: Parapet
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Industrial As the peak of Basilisk’s large industrial shield generators, it’s easy to see why the Parapet is so beloved. With one of the industry’s best shield generation to damage ratio, it’s difficult to degrade the shield and expose the hull.

lore.name: Parasite Replica Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Helmet Damage Reduction: 10% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s The original Parasite vid established a new face of fear and terrified the Empire. This iconic look can now be yours with the Parasite Replica helmet from CC's Conversions. Digital scans of the original prop helped to reproduce every gruesome detail. Despite its distinct design, the Parasite Replica helmet is space-rated and fully functional. It can be safely worn both in and out of atmosphere, or wherever you're looking to scare someone.

lore.name: Parasite Special Edition Poster
lore.description: A poster for the special edition re-release of the body horror classic vid “Parasite” that tells the story of an alien life-form who takes over the bodies of Human hosts.

lore.name: Parasite V: Dark Birth Replica Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Helmet Damage Reduction: 10% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Seven years after the original vid shocked the empire, Parasite V: Dark Birth took terror to a new level. CC's Conversions celebrated the release of the latest installment by collaborating with the vid's creators on an official and fully functional replica helmet. A special sensor built into the parasite's eye allows you a clear view of the reactions to every appalling detail. Carefully designed to honor the original prop and withstand the real rigors of space travel, the helmet is a premiere replica that will turn you into a walking nightmare!

lore.name: Parted Undercut
lore.description: Slicked down, side-parted hair with a neat undercut.

lore.description: Partillium description.

lore.name: Party Favors
lore.description: Small items used to help encourage a festive mood. Typically given or sold to celebrants in attendance at an event or party.

lore.name: Parvat Jacket Stony Brae
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Weather the cold with this waterproof and insulated jacket from Escar Limited. Featuring a stylish design and unique dual-layer collar, the Parvat will keep you warm when you need it most.

lore.name: Parway Gloves
lore.description: Whether engaged in work or play, the Parway gloves provide protection and the perfect fit. Synthetic leather cuffs overlap with a lightweight metal plate to offer protection from impacts. The fingers and palm mix fleece and a special perforated polymer to keep your hands dry and cool while still being able to interact with touchscreens.

lore.name: Pascal
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Competition Broad and Rabiee engineered the ultimate computing experience when they designed the new lighter and faster Pascal data system.

lore.name: Pathfinder IV Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 4 The Pathfinder proximity missile has been a consistent member of Behring's already robust arsenal thanks to its tried and tested propulsion system and heat seeking guidance array.

lore.name: Pathfinder IV-G Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 4 The Pathfinder proximity missile has been a consistent member of Behring's already robust arsenal thanks to its tried and tested propulsion system and heat seeking guidance array. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

lore.name: PC-FF
lore.description: The Plasma Coil - Field Fusion tangles 2 streams of plasma energy into a dense coil before unraveling it, allowing it to shoot far distances with intense energy. Unfortunately this process creates a lot of sound for the user, even though many muffle mechanics are usually built within the chamber of weapons that use this type of plasma energy.

lore.name: Pelerous
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Blue Triangle Inc. Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Stealth Aggressors can’t attack what they can’t see, so keep your signature low with the Pelorous stealth radar from Blue Triangle Inc.

lore.name: Pembroke Backpack
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Backpack Carrying Capacity: 120K µSCU Temp. Rating: -75 / 225 °C Designed to extend the limits of Human endurance, the Pembroke was built to withstand the extreme heat of inhospitable high temperature environments. Based off of Caldera's best-in-class exploration armor platform, an advanced sensor suite intelligently adjusts to environmental conditions so the wearer's body temperature remains stable. Also featuring a cutting edge life support system and spacious carryall, those seeking to cross bold new horizons can depend on the Pembroke to see them to the journey's end.

lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Military Designed by Aegis to military standards, the Permafrost cooler has proven itself time and again to be more than capable of handling heat processing even while under the strains of combat.

lore.name: Perseus Alliance Aid Camo Livery
lore.description: Showcase your dedication to helping Alliance Aid assist the people of Levski during their time of need with this grey camo livery.

lore.name: Perseus Deadfire Livery
lore.description: Maintain your cover and an air of mystique with the Deadfire livery with its inky black base paint and red highlights.

lore.name: Perseus Flintlock Livery
lore.description: Accentuate the strong, angular design of the Perseus with the Flintlock livery. A distinct white section across the middle of the ship divides the pointed front half from the dark foreboding back.

lore.name: Perseus Hieron Livery
lore.description: The Hieron livery bring classical beauty to the modern war machine with its marble-inspired base paint and gold highlights.

lore.name: Perseus Incite Livery
lore.description: Proclaim the presence of the Perseus with the Incite livery, featuring a bold red front and grey and black rear.

lore.name: Perseus Repute Livery
lore.description: The unique Repute livery divides the Perseus into distinct sections with a tan front half and a red and blue back half.

lore.name: Perseus Resilient Livery
lore.description: The Resilient livery for the Perseus elegantly mixes grey and blue with red highlights.

lore.name: Perseus Thundercloud Livery
lore.description: Restyle your Perseus with a dazzle camouflage inspired paint scheme using various abstract patterns and shades of black, grey, and white.

lore.name: Perth Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU These straight-leg pants from City Lights are essential for everyday work and play. Both the front and back pockets feature metallic button accents to provide that perfect amount of flair. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: PGR Capacitor
lore.description: This high-capacity industrial capacitor features optimized voltage output to minimize power fluctuations, improving the performance of generators and heavy machinery alike.

lore.name: PH
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -38 / 68 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s With its excellent design and eye-catching style, the Arden-SL armor exemplifies why security specialists love Roussimoff Rehabilitation Systems. This versatile armor set lets the wearer stay agile but safe thanks to the precise placement of special composite armor plating and fabrics. It also features a fully enclosed helmet with an integrated cowl. Visor is AR crosshair compatible. PH

lore.name: PH - DF80s Shoes
lore.description: PH - Standard issue sneaker for recruits and training, DF80s feature increased arch support for long runs and a polyweave material that keeps your feet dry.

lore.description: NDR: 12 HEI: 03 A pickled cucumber that has been fermented in a brine flavored with coriander seeds, dill, and garlic.

lore.name: Pico the Penguin Luminalia Plushie
lore.description: Even Pico the Penguin takes time away from shredding the slopes to celebrate Luminalia. This version of microTech's charming mascot features him in a red and green jacket and holding a Luminalia-themed snowboard.

lore.name: Pico the Penguin Party Animal Green Plushie
lore.description: No one can shred the slopes or celebrate quite like Pico the Penguin. This version of the charming microTech mascot makes any occasion more fun and festive by sporting a vibrant green jacket and playful party hat.

lore.name: Pico the Penguin Party Animal Orange Plushie
lore.description: No one can shred the slopes or celebrate quite like Pico the Penguin. This version of the charming microTech mascot makes any occasion more fun and festive by sporting a vibrant orange jacket and playful party hat.

lore.name: Pico the Penguin Plushie
lore.description: This adorable mascot of New Babbage loves nothing more than carving their way down the snow covered slopes of microTech.

lore.name: Picoball
lore.description: An athletic ball modified to resemble the famous microTech mascot Pico the Penguin.

lore.name: Piconalia Sweater
lore.description: Light up the night this Luminalia with a little help from Pico the Penguin. Designed by MuyMuy in collaboration with microTech, the Piconalia Sweater was made with a blend of wools optimized to create long-lasting softness while preventing wear and tear.

lore.name: Pike Liberty Ale (Bottle)
lore.description: HEI: 23 Effects: Cognitive Impairment, Dehydrating Liberty Lake beer has been brewed by families on Terra for generations to provide a crisp, clean ale perfect to partake when you arrive at those little moments made to be spent enjoying life. Pike Liberty features sorghum for a sweet and spicy brew.

lore.name: PIN
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 0 Grade: C Class: Civilian With the PIN vehicle shield generator you can now trust Seal Corp to protect you whether you’re in space or atmosphere.

lore.name: Pingala Seeds
lore.description: Every aspect of the pingala follows the golden ratio resulting a visually arresting plant. This include its seeds which are highly sought after by plant collectors. Especially since attempts to cultivate the pingala in greenhouse environments has proven extremely difficult.

lore.name: Pink Heart Hologram
lore.description: Let your love proudly shine with this deployable hologram that displays a large, glowing pink heart. Makes an ideal backdrop for your next romantic evening or Coramor photoshoot.

lore.name: Pink Heart Lamp
lore.description: Emitting a soft, sensual pink glow, the curvaceous Pink Heart Lamp is sure to shine a light on any romantic evening.

lore.name: Pink QuikFlare
lore.description: Manufacturer: Shubin Interstellar Illuminate the way forward or signal for help with the Pink QuikFlare from Shubin Interstellar. For centuries, miners have counted on this flare as part of their core toolkit, thanks to its tried and true design and durability that ensures it stays ablaze in the various harsh weather and difficult atmospheric conditions encountered across the 'verse.

lore.name: Pint Glass
lore.description: A large drinking vessel able to hold a pint (568 ml) of liquid and made from tempered glassware.

lore.name: Pisces Citizens for Prosperity Garnet Livery

lore.name: Pisces Frontier Fighters Camo Livery

lore.name: Pisces Headhunters Trauma Livery
lore.description: Show your loyalty to the Headhunters gang with this livery featuring their logo emblazoned on a dark grey hull accented with a vibrant purple.

lore.name: Pisces PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Anvil Pisces with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: Pisces Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Anvil Aerospace Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the Anvil Pisces.

lore.name: Pisces TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Anvil Pisces with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: Pisces XenoThreat Purge Livery
lore.description: Let Humanity know you won't bow down to alien invaders with this XenoThreat livery featuring a muted teal with bright red accents.

lore.name: Pitambu
lore.description: NDR: 25 HEI: 10 Effects: Hydrating, Hypo-Metabolic, Immune Boosting The skin of the pitambu is thin and waxy and easily peeled away using its green leaf-like growths. Inside is a is crisp and watery, bright red flesh which is filled with tiny white seeds that have a mild, nutty taste. The flesh and seeds are traditionally consumed together.

lore.name: Pitbull Aquamarine Livery
lore.description: The Aquamarine livery gives a metallic teal base with subtle yellow accents to make a statement, before you throw a punch.

lore.name: Pitbull Bloodlet Livery
lore.description: Dive into combat with this blood red livery for your Pitbull to show everyone on the battlefield exactly what you're out for.

lore.name: Pitbull Hardstrike Livery
lore.description: When you want them to see you coming, the Hardstrike livery is a bold explosion of yellow to make every fight even more vibrant.

lore.name: Pitbull Wind Chill Livery
lore.description: The Wind Chill livery for the Pitbull features crisp white paint with black highlights and silver accents.

lore.name: Pixie
lore.description: The platonic ideal of the pixie haircut.

lore.name: Pizza Box
lore.description: Keep your oven-fresh pizza piping hot while transporting.

lore.name: Plastic Cup
lore.description: A sturdy plastic cup with a wide lip and two ridges to make it easy to grip.

lore.name: Pleurotus Cornusymphonia (Opera Mushroom) Plant
lore.description: Created by a team of genetic researchers at the University of Rhetor, the opera mushroom is unique in the fungus genus for the various audible tones that it produces. The hollow central chamber of the cap acts as a reverberation chamber amplifying the sounds caused by it’s unique cell structure stretching and compressing as water moves through its mycelium.

lore.name: Polar
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Military Built to the high demands of daily military service, Aegis’ Polar cooler features a reinforced frame for increased durability. You can rest assured that when you drop into the fires of combat, the Polar will keep your ship cool.

lore.name: Polaris 2955 Ship Showdown Holographic Flag
lore.description: Though the 2955 Ship Showdown may be over, your memories of the Polaris taking the top spot can last thanks to this large holographic standing flag honoring the winner.

lore.name: Polaris 2955 Ship Showdown Poster
lore.description: Congratulations to the Polaris for winning the 2955 Ship Showdown. This poster celebrates the beloved corvette-class capital ship that sports devastating firepower and a hangar that can fit a light fighter.

lore.name: Polaris Apex Livery
lore.description: Equip the Apex livery to give the mighty Polaris a distinct green and grey look.

lore.name: Polaris Best in Show 2955 Livery
lore.description: Commemorate the Polaris taking the crown as the winner of the 2955 Ship Showdown with this striking metallic orange and black Best in Show livery.

lore.name: Polaris Black Magic Livery
lore.description: The Black Magic livery for the Polaris mixes a macabre black with glowing orange highlights for a look inspired by the sinister spirit of Day of the Vara.

lore.name: Polaris Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Polaris with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Polaris Quasar Livery
lore.description: Ribbons of gold set against a matte black base paint bring a restrained and elevated beauty to the Polaris Quasar livery.

lore.name: Polaris Sirius Livery
lore.description: Patrol, protect, and impress with the Polaris by outfitting it with the Sirius livery, which masterfully mixes blue, grey, and tan.

lore.name: Polished Buzz
lore.description: A short buzz with defined edges.

lore.name: Pollux Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 3K µSCU Durable comfort becomes fashion forward thanks to the edgy details in the Pollux pants from Rambler. The thick, woven fabric is reinforced with leather panels and accented by the unique lace front. Men's sizes currently not available.

lore.name: Polonium
lore.description: A volatile, highly radioactive metal with no stable isotopes. It has a half-life of around 138 days.

lore.name: Pompadour
lore.description: Reach for the sky with this tall, classic hairstyle.

lore.name: Ponos Boots
lore.description: Quite simply, R6 Pro's Ponos boots were built for backbreaking work. Constructed out of Thermosulate technology, these waterproof and insulated workboots are rated for sub-arctic environments while the composite outsole ignores hazards to maintain traction when you need it most.

lore.name: Pontes
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Wei-Tek Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Military When placed under stress tests, the proprietary alloys used by Wei-Tek to build the Pontes proved themselves against competitors in the same class.

lore.name: Pork Katsu Sandwich
lore.description: NDR: 41 Effects: None Dry brined for 72 SEH, breaded and deep fried to a golden brown, our signature pork cutlet sits atop a bed of shredded cabbage and tzatziki sauce. Served on semolina bread. At Twyn's, it's what's inside that counts.

lore.name: Potassium
lore.description: Potassium description.

lore.name: Power Plant
lore.description: Default Description space for power plant.

lore.name: PowerBolt
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian The PowerBolt provides all the power and performance you need for your journey through the stars. You can trust Lightning Power to get you there.

lore.name: PPB-116 "Pepperbox"
lore.description: Item Type: PDC Manufacturer: Behring Storing sixteen S1 missiles, the PPB-116 "Pepperbox" is as disruptive as it is deadly, excelling at both inflicting damage and overwhelming evasive maneuvers.

lore.name: PPC Burrito
lore.description: NDR: 49 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hyper-Metabolic Torpedo Burrito crams a full payload of flavor into their hearty and healthy PPC burrito, featuring a blend of pollo (chicken), peas, carrots, and rice wrapped in their signature size-4 multi-grain tortilla.

lore.name: Praseodymium
lore.description: A malleable and ductile rare earth metal. Highly reactive. Pure praseodymium develops a green coat upon oxidizing.

lore.name: Predator
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Blue Triangle Inc. Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Stealth Created for those that want to keep a low profile, the Predator radar operates with low electromagnetic emissions, to help reduce your signature.

lore.name: Predator Scattergun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Ballistic Scattergun Size: 3 The Predator scattergun preys upon nearby opponents with an overwhelming barrage of ballistic ammo. The size three version of Apocalypse Arms' feared scattergun trades effective range for a wide spread.

lore.name: Predator Scattergun Sharkmouth Edition
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Ballistic Scattergun Size: 3 With its devastating effectiveness at close range, the exclusive Sharkmouth Edition Predator Scattergun from Apocalypse Arms features aggressive styling that is sure to make a lasting impression on your enemies as you unleash fire and hell.

lore.name: Pressurized Ice
lore.description: Ice that has been purified and compressed to transparent by restricting natural expansion. This allows for more efficient transport in bulk.

lore.name: Prestige MISC Racing Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1k µSCU Part of City Lights' stylish collection of racewear, the Prestige MISC Racing Jacket is high-quality, durable outerwear that features a colorful asymmetric design celebrating the precision and relentless speed of MISC's line of racing vehicles.

lore.name: Prestige Murray Cup Racing Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1k µSCU Part of City Lights' stylish collection of racewear, the Prestige Murray Cup Racing Jacket is high-quality, durable outerwear created to celebrate the most prestigious racing league in the universe, the Murray Cup.

lore.name: Prestige Origin Racing Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1k µSCU Part of City Lights' stylish collection of racewear, the Prestige Origin Racing Jacket is high-quality, durable outerwear that features a colorful asymmetric design celebrating Origin's line of luxury racing vehicles.

lore.name: Prevenir
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: GNP Size: 0 Grade: C Class: Military The Prevenir has been refined by extensive military field testing, making it the go-to vehicle radar for many across the UEE.

lore.name: Prim Shoes
lore.description: Professional yet casual, the Prim utilizes cutting-edge synthetic construction to provide maximum comfort and a shine that won't fade.

lore.name: Prim Shoes (Modified)
lore.description: This version of Fiore's Prim shoes has been modified from its original form. Professional yet casual, the Prim utilizes cutting-edge synthetic construction to provide maximum comfort and a shine that won't fade.

lore.name: Prism "ArcCorp" Laser Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: Shotgun Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 10 Rate of Fire: 120 rpm Effective Range: 10m Attachments: Barrel (S3), Optics (S1), Underbarrel (S2) Firing powerful shortrange bursts of energy, engineers at Verified Offworld Laser Technologies have developed the Prism laser shotgun so that as the weapon's heat-levels rise, the pellets begin fusing together into slug-like projectiles that inflict higher damage on targets. This special edition features ArcCorp branding.

lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: Shotgun Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 20 Rate of Fire: 200 - 450 rpm Effective Range: 10m Attachments: Optics (S2), Underbarrel (S2) Firing powerful shortrange bursts of energy, engineers at Verified Offworld Laser Technologies have developed the Prism laser shotgun so that as the weapon's heat-levels rise, the pellets begin fusing together into slug-like projectiles that inflict higher damage on targets. The Irradiated edition features a valakkar spraying it's toxic venom.

lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: Shotgun Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 10 Rate of Fire: 120 rpm Effective Range: 10m Attachments: Barrel (S3), Optics (S1), Underbarrel (S2) Firing powerful shortrange bursts of energy, engineers at Verified Offworld Laser Technologies have developed the Prism laser shotgun so that as the weapon's heat-levels rise, the pellets begin fusing together into slug-like projectiles that inflict higher damage on targets. lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: Shotgun Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 20 Rate of Fire: 200 - 450 rpm Effective Range: 10m Attachments: Optics (S2), Underbarrel (S2) Firing powerful shortrange bursts of energy, engineers at Verified Offworld Laser Technologies have developed the Prism laser shotgun so that as the weapon's heat-levels rise, the pellets begin fusing together into slug-like projectiles that inflict higher damage on targets.

lore.name: Prism Laser Shotgun Battery (20 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Battery Capacity: 20 This battery for the Prism Laser Shotgun holds enough energy for 20 shots.

lore.name: Processed Food
lore.description: A nutritional substance that has been transformed trough physical or chemical means into food.

lore.name: Processed Goods
lore.description: Items that are manufactured or assembled from a conglomeration of components.

lore.name: Prophet
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Blue Triangle Inc. Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Stealth The art of seeing without being seen has never been better exemplified than by the Prophet radar system. Blue Triangle Inc. has managed to maximize sensitivity while minimizing pulse emissions to create a radar ideal for remaining off other people’s.

lore.name: Prospector Aphorite Livery
lore.description: Decorate your Prospector with the Aphorite livery, which gets its name and color from the precious purple gemstone prized for its multi-hued tones.

lore.name: Prospector Deck the Hull Livery
lore.description: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.

lore.name: Prospector Dolivine Livery
lore.description: Sharing the name with a gemstone prized for its beauty and industrial applications, the Dolivine livery blends shades of light green to give your Prospector a unique look.

lore.name: Prospector Foundation Guide Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Prospector Hadanite Livery
lore.description: The Hadanite livery for your Prospector gives the ship a distinct pink hue that mirrors the look of the gemstone of the same name.

lore.name: Prospector IceBreak Livery
lore.description: Equip your Prospector with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

lore.name: Prospector Keystone Livery
lore.description: Crisp white with blue accents, the Keystone livery celebrates the workers whose mining, refining, hauling, salvaging, and more have made the empire what it is today.

lore.name: Prospector Nebula Livery
lore.description: Balancing black and white, the Nebula livery for the Prospector lets you blast rocks in style.

lore.name: Prospector Outcast Livery (Modified)
lore.description: This version of the livery has been modified from its original form with the addition of graffiti. Embrace chaos with the Outcast livery. It features rough splashes of neon green against black to give the Prospector an aggressively chaotic appearance.

lore.name: Prospector Polar Livery
lore.description: Modify your Prospector with this white and grey livery specifically designed for the 2950 IAE event on microTech.

lore.name: Prospector Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: This custom Prospector livery was created to celebrate the 2950 IAE on microTech. It blends black and electric blue to give the ship a cool new look.

lore.name: Prota
lore.description: A resilient slime mold that can form in extremely corrosive environments and pressure, Prota secretes a strong adhesive that can be distilled into a commercial-grade glue.

lore.name: Protean Boots
lore.description: These rugged and durable boots from R6 Pro are perfect to wear on your ship or while planetside. Padded insole cushions ensure they'll also be comfortable in any situation. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Protean Boots (Modified)
lore.description: This version of R6 Pro's Protean boots has been modified from its original form. These rugged and durable boots from R6 Pro are perfect to wear on your ship or while planetside. Padded insole cushions ensure they'll also be comfortable in any situation.

lore.name: ProtSkin Undersuit Scarlet
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 10% RRS' ProtSkin combat undersuit provides basic protection against impacts and scuffs while serving as a foundation for compatible body armor options.

lore.name: Prowler Darkrift Livery
lore.description: Slyly drift through darkened skies with the Darkrift livery, which tampers the luster of its metal finishes to make it less conspicuous.

lore.name: Prowler Deadlock Camo Livery
lore.description: Disguise the silhouette of the Prowler with the Deadlock Camo livery, featuring a grey camo pattern with yellow highlights.

lore.name: Prowler Elysian Livery
lore.description: Beautiful blues swirl together with the Elysian livery to bring a truly special look to the Prowler.

lore.name: Prowler Hamada Livery
lore.description: The Hamada livery mixes tan and various shade of brown on the Prowler.

lore.name: Prowler Harmony Livery
lore.description: The Harmony livery is meant to showcase Humanity's peaceful relationship with aliens with a semi-pearlescent blue main coat marked with organic reflective red to suggest the coming together of disparate species and cultures. The Harmony livery has been designed and produced by the UEE's Diplomatic Corps and freely licensed to all spacecraft manufacturers. Now Esperia Prowler owners can celebrate the UEE's intentions of working toward a peaceful galaxy.

lore.name: Prowler Luminary Livery
lore.description: The Luminary livery gives the Prowler a glossy green base paint with brown highlights for a dazzlingly beautiful and complex design.

lore.name: Prowler Ocellus Livery
lore.description: The Ocellus livery replicates the look of the Prowler during the Second Tevarin War. It features a bold red fuselage meant to draw attention and trick aggressors into shooting at the most heavily armored part of the ship.

lore.name: Prowler Panthera Livery
lore.description: The Panthera livery brings bright orange and black highlights to the Prowler.

lore.name: Prowler Polar Camo Livery
lore.description: Modify your Prowler with this white and grey camo livery specifically designed for the 2950 IAE event on microTech.

lore.name: Prowler Silverado Livery
lore.description: Elevate the Prowler above the ordinary with the Silverado livery featuring striking silver with black and gold highlight.

lore.name: Prowler Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: This custom Prowler livery was created to celebrate the 2950 IAE on microTech. It integrates black and electric blue accents to give the ship a cool new look.

lore.name: Prowler Torchbearer Livery
lore.description: A special shimmering finish makes the Torchbearer livery either orange or red depending on the angle your viewing the Prowler.

lore.name: Prowler Utility Tractor Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Turret Manufacturer: Esperia Size: 1 This turret allows for the mounting of a turret beam to facilitate the transfer of cargo aboard the Prowler.

lore.name: Prowler Wanderer Livery
lore.description: The Wanderer livery features crisscrossing purple and grey lines over a platinum foundation. Inspired by the sacred Xi'an gardens of R.aip?uang, famous for its trails that wander in surprising ways and encourage a focus on the journey instead of the destination.

lore.name: PS-10
lore.description: Pulse Slug 10 is a small focused energy that molds into the shape of a small ball of energy. The projectile shocks biotics and disrupts electronics. It can be clustered or shot in single form, but the chaotic nature of how the slugs are created from the energy can cause chaotic formations in its execution, much like a bubble gun.

lore.name: PSX Pistol Case
lore.description: Remain discreet yet ready with this sleek case capable of holding a pistol and several attachments. It features a hard outer shell and an inside lined with a special, rigid polyurethane foam designed to securely hold a wide variety of attachments.

lore.name: PT1 (1x Holographic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Type: Projection Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 1x Zoom: 1x-1.5x Aim Time: +15% Size: 1 Experience Behring precision with this non-magnifying projection sight. Featuring a highly visible target marker, the PT1 provides ultimate target acquisition to find and lock onto hostiles with ease.

lore.name: PT2 (2x Holographic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Type: Projection Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 2x Zoom: 2x-2.5x Aim Time: +15% Size: 1 Improve your combat accuracy with this 2x magnifying sight from Behring. Built with meticulous care and craftsmanship, the PT2 has become an essential optic for everyone from sport shooters to law enforcement professionals.

lore.name: PT3 "Deadfall" (3x Holographic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Type: Projection Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 3x Zoom: 3x-3.5x Aim Time: +15% Size: 1 Get up close and personal with this 3x magnifying optic from Behring. The PT3 projects a highly visible target marker allowing you to confidently cover your field of view across various lighting and environmental conditions. The "Deadfall" variant of the scope is muted green.

lore.name: PT3 (3x Holographic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Type: Projection Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 3x Zoom: 3x-3.5x Aim Time: +15% Size: 1 Get up close and personal with this 3x magnifying optic from Behring. The PT3 projects a highly visible target marker allowing you to confidently cover your field of view across various lighting and environmental conditions.

lore.name: PTV Agate Gray Livery
lore.description: One of the most popular liveries on the Greycat, Agate Gray is a two-toned paint scheme that brings the buggy?s interior colors as accents on the exterior, unifying the Greycat into a single cohesive aesthetic.

lore.name: PTV All Terrain Camouflage: Forest (ATC-F) Livery
lore.description: ATC-F livery uses a non-reflective paint surface ideal for anyone looking to lower their profile in the wild. Perfect for military, sporting enthusiasts or naturalists.

lore.name: PTV Cherry Livery
lore.description: Speed isn?t just about mechanics, it?s about perception. Your Greycat will look and feel faster without changing a thing. The Cherry livery topcoat system uses cutting-edge raw materials and composition coating technology to maintain its glossy finish.

lore.name: PTV Gunmetal Livery
lore.description: Who says a buggy can?t be elegant? The Gunmetal livery is a medium gloss, two-component technology that maximizes gloss retention and durability.

lore.name: PTV Rifle Green Livery
lore.description: Rifle Green livery uses a premium two-component technology designed to endure harsher environments without fading or scratching.

lore.name: PTV Tactical Stealth Livery
lore.description: The Tactical Stealth livery uses a near zero gloss paint that incorporates a catalyzed urethane process for unsurpassed durability making it highly resistant to UV rays, chemicals and chips.

lore.name: Pulse "ArcCorp" Laser Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: Pistol Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 60 Rate of Fire: 500 rpm (1000 rpm rapid) Effective Range: 15m Attachments: Optics (S1), Underbarrel (S1) The Pulse Laser Pistol is a fully automatic pistol intended for close quarter combat. VOLT designed the weapon with a unique capacitor that condenses the pistol's laser energy, increasing its rate of fire at the cost of greater inaccuracy and a higher risk of overheating. This special edition features ArcCorp branding.

lore.name: Pulse 2956 Auspicious Red Rat Livery
lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Rat livery. Outfit your Pulse with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a rat.

lore.name: Pulse Auspicious Red Livery
lore.description: The Auspicious Red livery brings a bold red base paint and striking gold accents to the Pulse.

lore.name: Pulse Corona Livery
lore.description: Spotlight the incredible speed of the Pulse with Corona livery. Its dynamic stylings feature a two-tone blue with an angular orange across the front.

lore.name: Pulse Crossfire Livery
lore.description: The Crossfire livery is a rich red with black highlights, which includes lettering spelling Mirai across the bottom half.

lore.name: Pulse Dominion Livery
lore.description: Primarily black with sumptuous bronze highlights, the Dominion livery is a prestigious Pulse tint that displays a striking but understated elegance.

lore.name: Pulse Fortuna Livery
lore.description: Make luck your co-pilot. Boldly set your sights on the stars and adventure forth in style with the Fortuna livery. This Stella Fortuna themed paint scheme is primarily green with gray accents.

lore.name: Pulse GCD-Army Livery
lore.description: In honor of the soldiers who protect the Empire, Mirai crafted this limited-edition GCD-Army livery. The glints of gold against grey camo makes it a memorable choice for the Pulse.

lore.name: Pulse Laser Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: Pistol Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 60 Rate of Fire: 500 rpm (1000 rpm rapid) Effective Range: 15m Attachments: Optics (S1), Underbarrel (S1) The Pulse Laser Pistol is a fully automatic pistol intended for close quarter combat. VOLT designed the weapon with a unique capacitor that condenses the pistol's laser energy, increasing its rate of fire at the cost of greater inaccuracy and a higher risk of overheating.

lore.name: Pulse Laser Pistol Battery (60 Cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Battery Capacity: 60 This battery for the Pulse Laser Pistol holds enough energy for 60 shots.

lore.name: Pulse Nightrider Livery
lore.description: The Nightrider livery can easily blend into the blackness of space, but upon closer inspection reveals itself to be silver with lettering spelling Mirai across the bottom half.

lore.name: Pulse Star Kitten Livery
lore.description: Embody Sally the Star Kitten's racing spirit with this custom Mirai Pulse livery. Combining the bright pinks and pale blues of the beloved cartoon mascot, this livery's smiling decals bring a playfulness your competitors are sure to enjoy.

lore.name: Pulse Undertow Livery
lore.description: Speed through the shadows with the Undertow livery and its subtle style mixing black and silver with blue highlights.

Based on a modified FS9, the Pulverizer LMG wastes no time with pleasantries, instead lends itself to a more direct confrontational approach. The Bleach version features a white paintjob.

lore.name: Punk Cut

lore.name: Purifier Mask AA Support
lore.description: Temp. Rating: -5 / 50 °C Ensure every breath you take is crisp and clean with the Purifier mask. It features a wide faceplate rimmed with a special synthetic rubber to provide an airtight fit, while two small lights on each side deliver a clear view ahead. The AA Support edition is sharp red, blue, and black. An Alliance Aid decal on the front guarantees that the filter is certified to purify the air of Molina Mold.

lore.name: PX-T12 "Apex" Torpedo
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 12 Behring precision meets devastating stopping power with the PX-T12 "Apex". Designed as an anti-ship and anti-installation weapon, Behring engineers worked tirelessly to ensure this torpedo was a bold strategic statement. The PX-T12 "Apex" features a wide blast radius ideal for when the ultimate defense is an overwhelming offensive attack.

lore.name: PYAM Security Keycard
lore.description: This single-use keycard unlocks Security Access doors aboard Pyrotechnic Amalgamated stations.

lore.name: PYAM Supervisor Keycard
lore.description: This single-use keycard unlocks Supervisor Access doors aboard Pyrotechnic Amalgamated stations.

lore.name: Pyro Crab T-Shirt
lore.description: Pyro may be a dangerous system but worth a visit to see their famous whip crabs. The shirt was created by a Banu souli as part of a series dedicated to the cute creature found in Human space.

lore.name: Pyro Resupply Commemorative Display
lore.description: Remember your part in resupplying the dangerous Pyro system with this commemorative display featuring artfully arrayed large cargo containers tagged with decorative graffiti.

lore.name: Pyro RYT "ArcCorp" Multi-Tool
lore.description: ATTACHMENTS SOLD SEPARATELY! Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Utility Class: Gadget Magazine Size: Integrated Battery Rate of Fire: N / A (Beam) Effective Range: 0.5 m The Pyro from Greycat Industrial is a pistol-sized power tool for the modern space engineer that is capable of charging, cutting and patching; achieving a multitude of uses thanks to its wide assortment of attachments. Perfect for making a tough job a little bit easier. This special edition features ArcCorp branding.

lore.name: Pyro RYT Multi-Tool (Old Identifier!!!)
lore.description: This multi-tool from Greycat Industries is the ideal choice for a wide variety of jobs. Capable of stripping, cutting, and patching; it's multiple attachments allow it to assist in everything from salvage and repairs, to cutting, spot welds, and more.

lore.name: Pyro RYT Multi-Tool Battery
lore.description: This battery powers Greycat's Pyro RYT Multi-Tool, so that you can tackle a variety of tasks.

lore.name: PyroBurst Scattergun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Item Type: Plasma Scattergun Size: 3 You ship will spread havoc with A&R’s PyroBurst plasma shotgun. Effective in close quarters, the PyroBurst sprays self-detonating plasma projectiles, sacrificing pinpoint accuracy for area saturation.

lore.name: Pyrotechnic Amalgamated Toolbox
lore.description: Proudly put your multi-tool on display with this toolbox reclaimed from the Pyro system that's not only withstood the star's dangerous flares but also the ravages of time.

lore.name: QuadraCell
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Military Few military-grade power plants get better than the Aegis QuadraCell. It wasn’t just built to survive the heat of battle, it was built to thrive in it.

lore.name: QuadraCell MT
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Military An Aegis intern crafted the initial design for the QuadraCell MT power plant, inspiring a phrase often heard around their office, “Fresh eyes bring fresh innovation.” This military-grade component still outperforms any other medium power plant they make.

lore.name: QuadraCell MX
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Military Aegis engineers set out to create a power plant that could deliver the performance and durability needed during prolonged engagements. The QuadraCell MX was the result. This large power plant received years of strenuous field testing before finally becoming available to the public.

lore.name: Quantainium
lore.description: A highly unstable mineral used in the production of quantum fuel.

lore.name: Quantum Drive
lore.description: Default description for quantum drive component.

lore.name: Quantum Fuel
lore.description: Fuel used by quantum drives to propel ships at high speeds or, if equipped with a jump module, through jump tunnels to other systems.

lore.name: Quantum Fuel Tank
lore.description: This Quantum Fuel Tank stores fuel to power the Mauler's quantum engine.

lore.name: Quarreler Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kruger Intergalactic Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 3 Crafted with precision manufactured parts forged to extremely tight tolerances, designed for top-of-class heat management and assembled to exceed all industry standards, the Quarreler laser autocannon was created by Kruger Intergalactic for true defensive dependability.

lore.name: Quartz
lore.description: A chiral crystal composed of silicon and oxygen that can be found in a wide variety of forms and colors.

lore.name: Quartz "ArcCorp" Energy SMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: SMG Class: Energy (Electron) Battery Size: 45 Rate of Fire: Beam Effective Range: 15-20 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Underbarrel (S1) Manufacturer VOLT's Quartz SMG utilizes exciting new weapon technology that fires a short range beam that fractures into multiple beams the longer it fires, making it an extremely effective close quarter weapon. This special edition features ArcCorp branding.

lore.name: Quasi Grazer Tongue
lore.description: The tundra Quasi grazer has evolved a long coat and insulating fat reserves that allow it to stay warm at arctic-level temperatures. The animal's tongue is especially renowned for the fat it contains, which can be rendered into a lubricant that remains fluid in extreme cold.

lore.name: Quell Suppressor1
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Suppressor Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 1 Heat: +10% Spread: -25% Aim Recoil: -25% Visual Recoil: -25% Fire Rate: -5% Audible Range: -33% The Quell Suppressor1 utilizes an advanced carbon polymer that reduces both noise and recoil at the cost of increased heat build-up.

lore.name: Quell Suppressor2
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Suppressor Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 2 Heat: -25% Spread: +7.5% Aim Recoil: -22.5% Visual Recoil: - 22.5% Audible Range: -33% With careful placement of high insulation materials to allow increased heat dissipation, the Quell Suppressor2 ensures you'll stay cool under pressure in favor of a slightly wider bullet spread.

lore.name: Quell Suppressor3
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Suppressor Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 3 Spread Min: -15% Spread Per Shot: +25% Audible Range: -33% Designed for stealth work, the Quell Suppressor3 rewards those who take slow, steady shots.

lore.name: Quest
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Civilian Why mess with perfection? Tarsus has been manufacturing the Quest drive for centuries to provide everyone an affordable medium-sized component to carry them on their adventures.

lore.name: QuikCool
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: ACOM Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Competition The QuikCool provides superior performance over other coolers in its class. This competition grade component from ACOM sacrifices stealth and some durability to be one of the most powerful entry-level coolers around.

lore.name: QV Secure Storage Keycard
lore.description: This keycard grants access to the secure storage rooms located in the Logistics Office of QV Breaker Stations.

lore.name: R97 "Crimson Camo" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 18 Rate Of Fire: 120 rpm / 60 rpm Effective Range: 15 m / 35 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S2) The R97 combines sleek design and stopping power for an elegant and effective close quarters weapon. This ballistic shotgun from Gemini features two distinct fire modes — a semi-auto wide spread mode ideal for dealing quick damage and a focused mode that offers increased range at the expense of some power. This combat flexibility has made the R97 a popular personal defense weapon across the Empire. This edition features a bold red digital camo pattern.

lore.name: R97 "Kismet" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 18 Rate Of Fire: 120 rpm / 60 rpm Effective Range: 15 m / 35 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S2) The R97 combines sleek design and stopping power for an elegant and effective close quarters weapon. This ballistic shotgun from Gemini features two distinct fire modes — a semi-auto wide spread mode ideal for dealing quick damage and a focused mode that offers increased range at the expense of some power. This combat flexibility has made the R97 a popular personal defense weapon across the Empire. Protect yourself and your loved one with the special Kismet edition of the R97, which features pink and black coloring reminiscent of the ship Yuri Ilyin flew to track down his lost lover Corazon Tan in the classic vid Coramor.

lore.name: R97 "Righteous" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 18 Rate Of Fire: 120 rpm / 60 rpm Effective Range: 15 m / 35 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S2) The R97 combines sleek design and stopping power for an elegant and effective close quarters weapon. This combat flexibility has made the R97 a popular personal defense weapon across the Empire. The "Righteous" edition features a bold red paint perfect for showing your dedication to the fight.

lore.name: R97 "Scorched" Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 18 Rate Of Fire: 120 rpm / 60 rpm Effective Range: 15 m / 35 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S2) The R97 combines sleek design and stopping power for an elegant and effective close quarters weapon.
