lore.name: R97 Shotgun Magazine (18 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 18 This magazine for the Gemini R97 ballistic shotgun comes pre-loaded with eighteen 12-gauge shells.

lore.name: Rabat Hat Blue
lore.description: A classic structured baseball cap with an accent stripe to add a pop of color. City Lights' proprietary COOL-WEV technology keeps your head cool and dry in any environment. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Rabum Hat
lore.description: Habidash's simple and stylish head covering provides warmth, along with protection from the elements and prying eyes. The Rabum is made from a synthetic extra-long cotton to be light, absorbent, and easily laundered.

lore.name: Radegast Distillery 2947 Homeward Collection
lore.description: With an unparalleled reputation for crafting phenomenal whiskeys of uncompromising quality for over four centuries, Radegast Distillery is proud to announce the 2947 release of its Homeward Limited-Edition Collection 40 SEY. Award-winning Master Distiller Hanshi Wilkes skillfully hand-blends the Martian spirit before it is re-barreled in Angeli casks and transported along a unique homeward flight path to maximize specific astronomical conditions which develop a peppery smoke-forward expression underpinned with charcoal, mace, ripe gooseberries, and citron notes. Once it has safely returned to Mars, the blend is aged for several more years to ensure it has the distinct smooth and mellow profile Radegast is known for. The result is a 40-year-old dram that embraces the adventurous flavor profiles of Angeli with the traditional personality of a Martian whiskey; a drink worthy of coming home for.

lore.name: Radford Shirt
lore.description: The Radford dress shirt and tie combo proves that simple elegance is eternal. The shirt features a unique side seam that provides a tailored fit. A silver tie bar is the perfect finishing accent to make sure everything stays in place.

lore.name: Radford Shirt Crusader Edition
lore.description: The Radford dress shirt and tie combo proves that simple elegance is eternal. The shirt features a unique side seam that provides a tailored fit. A silver tie bar is the perfect finishing accent to make sure everything stays in place. The Crusader Edition was made specifically for employees of Crusader Industries.

lore.name: Radford Shirt Crusader Edition White Pinstripe
lore.description: The Radford dress shirt and tie combo proves that simple elegance is eternal. The shirt features a unique side seam that provides a tailored fit. A silver tie bar is the perfect finishing accent to make sure everything stays in place. The Crusader Edition was made specifically for employees of Crusader Industries.

lore.name: Radford Shirt White Pinstripe
lore.description: The Radford dress shirt and tie combo proves that simple elegance is eternal. The shirt features a unique side seam that provides a tailored fit. A silver tie bar is the perfect finishing accent to make sure everything stays in place.

lore.name: Radiance
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Civilian Considering its extensive and extremely diverse line of products, it’s incredible that Sakura Sun can maintain such quality and consistency. The Radiance power plant is a perfect example. A staple of their product line for years, the Radiance has won multiple consumer awards for its reliability and overall performance.

lore.name: Radix
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 0 Grade: C Class: Civilian With more than enough get up and go to handle your vehicle’s daily energy needs, the Radix from Lightning Power Ltd. is a power plant you can count on to get you where you’re going.

lore.name: RAFT Alliance Aid Green Livery
lore.description: Showcase your dedication to helping Alliance Aid assist the people of Levski during their time of need with this green livery with yellow accents.

lore.name: RAFT Anchor Livery
lore.description: The Anchor livery for the Argo RAFT gets it great look by blending various shades of grey with green undertones.

lore.name: RAFT ArcCorp Livery
lore.description: The ArcCorp livery for the RAFT features the company's logo atop a maroon base paint with black and yellow highlights.

lore.name: RAFT Crusader Livery
lore.description: The Crusader livery for the RAFT features the company's logo atop a light blue base paint with black and white highlights.

lore.name: RAFT Hazard Livery
lore.description: Black with yellow highlights, the Hazard is another great livery option for the Argo RAFT.

lore.name: RAFT Hurston Livery
lore.description: The Hurston livery for the RAFT features the company's logo atop a grey base paint with yellow highlights.

lore.name: RAFT Keystone Livery
lore.description: Crisp white with blue accents, the Keystone livery celebrates the workers whose mining, refining, hauling, salvaging, and more have made the empire what it is today.

lore.name: RAFT Lovestruck Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your RAFT.

lore.name: RAFT microTech Livery
lore.description: The microTech livery for the RAFT features the company's logo atop a white base paint with light blue and grey highlights.

lore.name: RAFT Polar Livery
lore.description: Modify your RAFT with this white and grey livery specifically designed for the 2951 IAE.

lore.name: RAFT Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom RAFT livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.

lore.name: Railen Agapanthia Livery
lore.description: The Agapanthia edition bears a sleek black base with subtle dark gold highlights that flow down the ship's hull.

lore.name: Railen Ch.iiing Livery
lore.description: The Ch.iiing edition boasts a bold white base with eye-catching gold highlights that flow down the ship's hull.

lore.name: Railen Hyaotan Livery
lore.description: The Hyaotan edition features a subtle dark grey, wave-like pattern over its light grey base, with embedded blue lights unique to this edition to give off that otherworldly shine.

lore.name: Railen Hyaotan Livery
lore.description: Make your Railen cargo ship even more visually distinct and dynamic with the Hyaotan livery that's black with blue highlights.

lore.name: Railen Insularis Livery
lore.description: The Insularis livery adds a sleek, ethereal teal and patina metal finish to emphasize and celebrate the otherworldly nature of the Railen.

lore.name: Railen Malachitus Livery
lore.description: The Malachitus edition features an iridescent green, wave-like pattern over it's black base, which gives off a mesmerizing glow in the light of the stars.

lore.name: Railen Uamchuai Livery
lore.description: The Uamchuai edition breaks the mold with grey and sand-brown base, with flattering dusty gold highlights that flow down the ship's hull.

lore.name: Ramming Blade
lore.description: Blade component that can be used for ramming.

lore.name: Rampart
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Industrial Basilisk understands that escape isn’t always an option. That’s why they built the Rampart industrial shield generator to take an incredible amount of damage before it’s depleted.

lore.name: RangeFinder Jacket Element
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 3K µSCU This insulation outdoor jacket from DMC is lined with reinforced padding to provide durable comfort for everyday wear.

lore.name: Ranger
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian Rely on the Ranger to guide you through the stars. The quality and reliability of this classic Tarsus quantum drive has made it a ship staple for centuries.

lore.name: Ranger
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian Rely on the Ranger to guide you through the stars. The quality and reliability of this classic Tarsus quantum drive has made it a ship staple for centuries.

lore.name: Ranta Dung
lore.description: A dry cube-shaped dung that comes from a large isopod-like crustacean known as a Ranta. It has recently been discovered that the dung contains a unique bacterial biome that helps the Ranta process and digest minerals and some researches are hopeful will lead to industrial or medical innovations.

lore.name: RapidCool
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: ACOM Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Competition ACOM brings its performance first philosophy to this medium cooler. The RapidCool trades signature strength and durability for better performance.

lore.name: Raptor IV Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Electromagnetic Size: 4 Utilizing advanced electromagnetic tracking and balanced precision flight, the Talon Raptor strike missile is a fierce addition to any ship's arsenal.

lore.name: Rattler II Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Nova Pyrotechnica Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 2 The Rattler is a cost-effective cluster missile that will no doubt appeal to a wide variety of pilots. When fired, the Rattler will track the opponent’s IR signature and create an opening barrage that weakens the armor or shields, leaving the target vulnerable to the full payload that follows.

lore.name: Ravager-212 "Bright Star" Twin Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 16 Rate Of Fire: 105 rpm Effective Range: 15 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S2) The Kastak Arms Ravager-212 Twin shotgun earns its name from its unique dual-barrels that allow for multiple ammo types to be used in conjunction with each other for maximum tactical possibilities. Ice blue and grey gives the Bright Star edition a look befitting a distant shimmering star.

lore.name: Ravager-212 "Outcast" Twin Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 16 Rate Of Fire: 105 rpm Effective Range: 15 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S2) The Kastak Arms Ravager-212 Twin shotgun earns its name from its unique dual-barrels that allow for multiple ammo types to be used in conjunction with each other for maximum tactical possibilities. The rough splashes of neon green against the gunmetal gray give the Outcast edition an aggressively chaotic appearance.

lore.name: Ravager-212 "Red Alert" Twin Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 16 Rate Of Fire: 105 rpm Effective Range: 15 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S2) The Kastak Arms Ravager-212 Twin shotgun earns its name from its unique dual-barrels that allow for multiple ammo types to be used in conjunction with each other for maximum tactical possibilities. The "Red Alert" edition mixes grey and a vibrant red for a bold and dynamic design.

lore.name: Ravager-212 "Scorched" Twin Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 16 Rate Of Fire: 105 rpm Effective Range: 15 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S2) The Kastak Arms Ravager-212 Twin shotgun earns its name from its unique dual-barrels that allow for multiple ammo types to be used in conjunction with each other for maximum tactical possibilities. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

lore.name: Ravager-212 Twin Shotgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Shotgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 16 Rate Of Fire: 105 rpm Effective Range: 15 m Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S2) The Kastak Arms Ravager-212 Twin shotgun earns its name from its unique dual-barrels that allow for multiple ammo types to be used in conjunction with each other for maximum tactical possibilities.

lore.name: Ravager-212 Twin Shotgun Magazine (16 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 16 This magazine for the Kastak Arms Ravager-212 Twin Shotgun holds sixteen 12-gauge shells.

lore.name: Raw Ice
lore.description: Raw Ice can be refined into Hydrogen and Oxygen

lore.name: Raw Ouratite
lore.description: Notable for its ability to withstand kinetic impacts, ouratite is a solid hydrocarbon that is found only in the Stanton system. Once refined, this rare material can be used as combat armor plating.

lore.name: Raw Silicon
lore.description: A strong and brittle element with good thermal conductivity. Crystalizes in a diamond form.

lore.name: Razor Aspire Livery
lore.description: With the Aspire livery, blue and white combine to evoke both the colors and frigid temperatures of New Babbage. In honor of the landing zone that inspired it, the livery also features a depiction of the Aspire Grand building that dominates the city's skyline.

lore.name: Razor Central Tower Livery
lore.description: Give the Razor a dramatic new look with the Central Tower livery. The orange and black color scheme is inspired by the furnaces of industry powering Lorville, and also features a representation of the landing zone's iconic Central Headquarters and Shared Services Center, aka Central Tower.

lore.name: Razor Fortuna Livery
lore.description: Make luck your co-pilot. Boldly set your sights on the stars and adventure forth in style with the Fortuna livery. This Stella Fortuna themed paint scheme is primarily green with grey accents.

lore.name: Razor Foundation Guide Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Razor Hosanna Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the gorgeous clouds that enshroud Orison, the Hosanna livery blends red, ivory, and pink to give the Razor a distinct appearance. It also features a silhouette of the landing zone's famous Hosanna tree complete with its pink flowers.

lore.name: Razor Polar Livery
lore.description: Modify your Razor with this white and grey livery specifically designed for the 2951 IAE.

lore.name: Razor Racing Livery
lore.description: Pull away from the pack with this daring Mirai Racing livery. Combining coral reds with an undercurrent of teal, you're guaranteed to grab the attention of those you overtake when racing in these bold colors.

lore.name: Razor Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom Razor livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.

lore.name: Razorback Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU DMC's Razorback pants are made to be worn. Built from industrial quality material, they feature reinforced kneepads to prevent tears on the job and stay rugged yet comfortable. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: RB-CX4 Prosthetics
lore.description: Made specially for Battaglia after a mining accident, the prosthetics feature tough iron plating with mustard yellow accents. The hand, developed with precise movement in mind, makes complicated finger movement possible. The leg, powered by kinetic sensors in the ankle, allows the prosthetic leg to adapt to her movement needs without need for manual adjustment.

lore.name: RD-1 Jaeger (1x Red Dot)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Type: Red Dot Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 1x - 3x Aim Time: +5% Parallax: Low Size: 1 The RD-1 Jaeger's simple and functional design provides pinpoint accuracy and rapid target acquisition in close-quarters combat.

lore.name: Re-Authorizer
lore.description: Released by Lortell Computing as a way to gain access to a system with a lost or forgotten password, the slow but reliable Re-Authorizer cryptokey is considered an affordable option for people who want to attempt to repair their system themselves.

lore.name: Ready-Up Helmet
lore.description: The Ready-Up is a dependable, affordable softshell helmet alternative. Built from space-age plastic, the Ready-Up provides a vacuum-ready seal to keep you breathing for longer.

lore.name: Ready-Up Helmet "Pathfinder"
lore.description: The Ready-Up is a dependable, affordable softshell helmet alternative that provides a vacuum-ready seal to keep you breathing for longer. The Pathfinder edition uses special space-age plastic with a purple tint to produce a truly unique look.

lore.name: ReadyGrip Tractor Module
lore.description: Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Tractor Beam Max Angle: 60° Max Range: 150 m Full Strength Distance: 75 m The Ready Grip Tractor Module compresses the dependability and power of Greycat’s signature tractor beam technology into a smaller sub-component that can be attached to a salvaging laser head.

lore.name: ReadyMeal (Bean and Rice Burrito)
lore.description: NDR: 60 Effects: None The classic taste that's all you need, this Bean and Rice Burrito from ReadyMeal features lavash bread wrapped around hearty beans and seasoned rice all ready-to-eat in seconds.

lore.name: ReadyMeal (Beef Chunks)
lore.description: NDR: 60 Effects: None The classic taste that's all you need, these Beef Chunks from ReadyMeal features browned meat pieces enrobed in a thick gravy all ready-to-eat in seconds.

lore.name: ReadyMeal (Chicken Dinner)
lore.description: NDR: 60 Effects: None The classic taste that's all you need, this Chicken Dinner from ReadyMeal features roast-flavor chicken paired with ferns and cassava mash all ready-to-eat in seconds.

lore.name: ReadyMeal (Chicken Patty and Noodles)
lore.description: NDR: 60 Effects: None The classic taste that's all you need, this Chicken Patty and Noodles from ReadyMeal features a crispy chicken patty paired with garlic butter noodles all ready-to-eat in seconds.

lore.name: ReadyMeal (Meatball Marinara)
lore.description: NDR: 60 Effects: None The classic taste that's all you need, this Meatball Marinara from ReadyMeal features tender balls of protein and thick tomato sauce over pasta all ready-to-eat in seconds.

lore.name: ReadyMeal (Vegetarian)
lore.description: NDR: 60 Effects: None The classic taste that's all you need, this Vegetarian option from ReadyMeal features a mixture of freshly picked vegetables in a citrus herb sauce all ready-to-eat in seconds.

lore.name: Reaper V Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Electromagnetic Size: 5 The Reaper strike torpedo features a favorable destructive yield-to-expense ratio and a proven Talon EM tracking suite.

lore.name: Reaper V-G Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Electromagnetic Size: 5 The Reaper strike torpedo features a favorable destructive yield-to-expense ratio and a proven Talon EM tracking suite. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

lore.name: ReCast Station
lore.description: Item Type: Manufacturing Station Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Class: Industrial The ReCast ship-based manufacturing station that can store raw materials into custom crafted containers, as well as use those same resources to craft several useful items, like multitools, allowing for longer expeditions and more sustainable operations.

lore.name: Reclaimed Water
lore.description: HEI: 44 Effects: Hydrating, Toxic Filtered water that has been reclaimed from various sources.

lore.name: Reclaimer 2949 Best In Show Livery
lore.description: Customize your Reclaimer with this special 2949 Best in Show livery.

lore.name: Reclaimer 2954 Best in Show Livery
lore.description: This purple and white 2954 Best in Show Livery celebrates the Reclaimer making it to the final four of the 2954 Ship Showdown.

lore.name: Reclaimer 2954 Ship Showdown Poster
lore.description: Celebrate the Reclaimer, Aegis Dynamics' industrial salvage ship, making the final four of the 2954 Ship Showdown with this poster. Equipped with a reinforced cargo bay, a long-range jump drive and launch pods for unmanned drones, the Reclaimer is an ideal ship for taking advantage of deep space wrecks.

lore.name: Reclaimer Aphorite Livery
lore.description: Decorate your Reclaimer with the Aphorite livery, which gets its name and color from the precious purple gemstone prized for its multi-hued tones.

lore.name: Reclaimer Dolivine Livery
lore.description: Sharing the name with a gemstone prized for its beauty and industrial applications, the Dolivine livery blends shades of light green to give your Reclaimer a unique look.

lore.name: Reclaimer Hadanite Livery
lore.description: The Hadanite livery for your Reclaimer gives the ship a distinct pink hue that mirrors the look of the gemstone of the same name.

lore.name: Reclaimer Material Depot
lore.description: Item Type: Storage Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Capacity: 360 SCU This internal storage space contains all raw materials a Reclaimer collects until they are fed into the ship’s manufacturing stations.

lore.name: Reclaimer Schematics "2949 Best in Show"
lore.description: This schematics showcases the sheer size and scope of the Aegis Reclaimer. This beloved deep-space salvage ship was voted a Best in Show finalist at the 2949 Intergalactic Aerospace Expo.

lore.name: Recon Marine Action Figure
lore.description: Outside of outright planetary invasion, the UEE Marines’ Recon Division train extensively in infiltration operations when a smaller footprint is needed. These highly-trained soldiers are experts in sabotage, intelligence gathering, and close-quarter combat. This exclusive figure in Takuetsu’s Military Might series depicts one of these ghost-like marines. Adorned in period accurate combat suit, this Recon Marine’s ready to cause trouble wherever you put them.

lore.name: Recon Marine Action Figure (Imperator Edition)
lore.description: Outside of outright planetary invasion, the UEE Marines’ Recon Division train extensively in infiltration operations when a smaller footprint is needed. These highly-trained soldiers are experts in sabotage, intelligence gathering, and close-quarter combat. This exclusive figure in Takuetsu’s Military Might series depicts one of these ghost-like marines. Adorned in period accurate combat suit, this Recon Marine’s ready to cause trouble wherever you put them.

lore.name: Recycled Material Composite
lore.description: Recycled Material Composite, commonly referred to as RMC, is the end result of low-tier salvaging where a myriad of alloys and polymers are mixed together during the collection process.

lore.name: RED
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 0 Grade: D Class: Civilian Seal Corp reworked their classic component to make the RED vehicle shield generator both effective and affordable.

lore.name: Red Festival Envelope Display
lore.description: Showcase your Red Festival envelopes with this beautiful display. This three-level stand is made with sustainably sourced mahogany and features a red quilted backing with fringe detailing and a golden trim.

lore.name: Red Festival Feast Combat Ration
lore.description: NDR: 80 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic, Cognitive Boosting A full meal combat ration specially formulated to provide complete high-performance nutrition for UEE Army personnel.

lore.name: Red Heart Plushie
lore.description: Huggable, lovable, and thoroughly squashable, this red heart plushie will fill your heart with joy. With a firm but springy filling, this plush cushion consist of a synthetic leather casing dyed with a passionate scarlet coloring.

lore.name: Red QuikFlarePro
lore.description: Manufacturer: Shubin Interstellar Illuminate the way forward or signal for help with the Red QuikFlarePro from Shubin Interstellar. For centuries, miners have counted on this flare as part of their core toolkit, thanks to its tried and true design and durability that ensures it stays ablaze in the various harsh weather and difficult atmospheric conditions encountered across the 'verse. The QuikFlarePro uses advanced tech to glow longer than regular flares.

lore.name: Red Renew Smoothie
lore.description: HEI: 39 NDR: 15 Effects: Immune Boosting Garcia's Greens Red Renew Smoothie is the perfect way to reset and promote a healthier you with it's anti-calcifying formula.

lore.name: Red Wind Cargo Plushie
lore.description: Here's a haul you can hug. This plushie shaped like a cargo container features Red Wind Linehaul branding with the company's logo and grey and red color scheme.

lore.name: Red Wind Container Model
lore.description: There's no need for a tractor beam to move this cargo container. This finely detailed model features Red Wind Linehaul branding with the company's logo and grey and red color scheme.

lore.name: Red Wind Hat
lore.description: A gray cadet hat with Red Wind Linehaul's name and logo emblazoned across the front and back panels.

lore.name: Redeemer 2953 Best in Show Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the Aegis Redeemer being voted a Best in Show finalist for 2953 with this pearlescent purple and cyan livery.

lore.name: Redeemer 2953 Ship Showdown Poster
lore.description: A poster commemorating the Aegis Dynamics Redeemer blasting its way in the final four of the 2953 Ship Showdown. It captures the ship not just surviving, but thriving in its natural environment: the heat of battle.

lore.name: Redeemer Fortuna Livery
lore.description: Make luck your co-pilot. Boldly set your sights on the stars and adventure forth in style with the Fortuna livery. This Stella Fortuna themed paint scheme is primarily green with grey accents.

lore.name: Redeemer Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Redeemer with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Redeemer PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Aegis Redeemer with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: Redeemer Polar Camo Livery
lore.description: Modify your Redeemer with this white and grey camo livery specifically designed for the 2951 IAE.

lore.name: Redeemer Scrubland Camo Livery
lore.description: Use the Scrubland Camo livery to outfit the Redeemer in green camo. A classic and commanding look that's also ideal for excursions across forests and grasslands.

lore.name: Redeemer Seraphim Livery
lore.description: The striking white Seraphim livery for the Redeemer helps make the ship both a beauty and a beast.

lore.name: Redeemer Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the Aegis Redeemer.

lore.name: Redeemer Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom Redeemer livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.

lore.name: Redeemer TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Aegis Redeemer with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: Redeemer Underworld Livery
lore.description: Apply the Underworld livery to the Redeemer and it will be pitch black and ready to attack.

lore.name: Redeemer Valencia Livery
lore.description: Mixing metallic orange and black, the Valencia livery brings a bold and beautiful styling to the Redeemer.

lore.name: Redfin Energy Modulators
lore.description: Made by various Banu manufacturers, this energy modulator is distinct for its red-hued heatsinks. Though it can be installed into most Human component subsystems to reduce power draw, its extremely dangerous fail rate has caused it to be banned for import into the UEE.

lore.name: Reformation Distortion Scattergun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Preacher Armaments Item Type: Distortion Scattergun Size: 3 Turn hostiles into non-combatants with the Reformation. This size three scattergun from Preacher Armaments delivers devastating distortion damage at a close range.

lore.name: Regal-CS1 Helmet Scarlet
lore.description: The Regal Combat Set from RRS is a cost-effective way to provide a little extra protection on the job. Whether you're running local security or just want a little extra assurance on the long haul, the Regal's StopTac plating provides extra protection for you head, vitals and extremities. The Regal's helmet features a uniquely angled design intended to increase chances of ricochets and the integrated visor tech gives you protection while not hampering your visibilty.

lore.name: Regulus
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Military The Regulus is the power plant you can count on when everyone is counting on you. Made to exceed exacting military standards, Aegis’ design team has made sure that you have the extra power you need, when you need it most.

lore.name: Reign-3 Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 3 Hurston Dynamics has partnered with Tumbril Land Systems to craft the powerful Reign-3 laser repeater specifically for the Storm assault vehicle's turret. Utilizing Hurston Dynamics' proprietary cascade technology, the Reign-3 delivers increased performance and greater energy output as the frenetic pace of combat starts to heat up.

lore.name: Relentless L-21 Gatling
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kruger Intergalactic Item Type: Ballistic Gatling Size: 4 Enemies will regret getting within range of the L-21 Wolf and its bespoke Relentless L-21 gatling. Kruger's expert engineering allows this rotary cannon to fire rounds at a head spinning speed with little worry of a misfire.

lore.name: Reliance
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Industrial Haulers have been a fan of the Reliance power plant for years. The component’s clean design and Juno Starwerk’s lauded customer support have made this power plant a fixture on ships around the Empire.

lore.name: Reliant Cernan Camera Package
lore.description: Item Type: Camera Package Manufacturer: MISC Size: 4 Capture heart-pounding action and the splendor of the stars with the Cernan camera package. Standard to the Reliant Mako, this state-of-the-art image enhancement suite is popular among news crews across the universe.

lore.name: Reliant Frostbite Camo Livery
lore.description: Soar like the winter winds with the Frostbite Camo livery for your Reliant.

lore.name: Reliant Gilroy Gimbal
lore.description: Item Type: Weapon Mount (Reliant Exclusive) Manufacturer: MISC Size: 4 MISC built the Gilroy as a custom wing mounted gimbal for use exclusively with the Reliant. Standard on the Tana, it allows a S4 weapon better movement when tracking targets.

lore.name: Reliant Invictus Blue and Gold Livery
lore.description: Featuring a vibrant blue base color and gold highlights, the Invictus Blue and Gold livery will give your Reliant a striking style.

lore.name: Reliant Mako Livery
lore.description: Standard livery for the MISC Reliant Mako.

lore.name: Reliant Missile Launcher Cap
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Launcher Cap Manufacturer: MISC Size: 5 Bespoke missile launcher cap used by the MISC Reliant.

lore.name: Reliant Samos Sensor Suite
lore.description: Item Type: Sensor Suite Manufacturer: MISC Size: 4 Standard on the Reliant Sen, the Samos sensor suite was designed to aid in the discovery and study of space phenomena.

lore.name: Reliant Sen Livery
lore.description: Standard livery for the MISC Reliant Sen.

lore.name: Reliant Tana Livery
lore.description: Standard livery for the MISC Reliant Tana.

lore.name: Reliant Tana Missile Launcher
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Launcher Manufacturer: MISC Size: 5 Missiles: 8xS2 Bespoke missile launcher built into the wings of the Tana to make this Reliant variant a deceptively deadly dogfighter.

lore.name: Reliant Timberline Livery
lore.description: Customize your Reliant with the Timberline livery that's olive green with orange accents.

lore.name: Reliant Toshima Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Turret (Reliant Exclusive) Manufacturer: MISC Size: 4 Specifically built to be used exclusively on the MISC Reliant, the Toshima turret system comes with a camera that can be remoted into while providing a wide range of motion for two Size-2 weapons.

lore.name: Reliant Utility Mount Cap
lore.description: Item Type: Utility Mount Cap (Reliant Exclusive) Manufacturer: MISC Size: 4 A utility mount cap designed specifically for use on the wings of the MISC Reliant.

lore.name: Remote Turret
lore.description: Multitask on the battlefield with this remote turret system. Featuring precise controls and a wide field of fire, the turret allows pilots to add combat support to their resume.

lore.name: Renegade Cut Vest
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Reveal your inner rebel with the Renegade Cut vest, featuring a wide notched lapel and metal studs on the left shoulder. High quality synthetic leather and an insulated lining give the vest both comfort and style.

lore.name: Renegade Cut Vest (Modified)
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU This version of the Renegade Cut vest has been modified from its original form. Reveal your inner rebel with the Renegade Cut vest, featuring a wide notched lapel and metal studs on the left shoulder. High quality synthetic leather and an insulated lining give the vest both comfort and style.

lore.name: Renegade Helmet Tactical
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -39 / 69 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Kastak Arm's Renegade combat helmet is a light but durable infantry helmet designed for added protection and impact-reduction during in-atmosphere operations. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Renegade Racing Vest (Modified)
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU This version of the Renegade Racing vest has been modified from its original form. The Renegade Racing vest provides protection against road rash without adding to your lap time. Graphene-based nanocomposite plating makes the vest extremely light yet ultra-durable. Ideal for everything from idyllic rides to heart pounding last laps.

lore.name: Renegade Vest Cargo
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 3K µSCU Enjoy the open road and courier goods with the Renegade Cargo vest. A special synthetic weave bestows the vest with incredible tensile strength that can support the custom 0.375 SCU pannier, while reinforced straps keep it secured to your back even while traversing rugged terrain.

lore.name: Renegade Vest Racing
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Renegade Racing vest provides protection against road rash without adding to your lap time. Graphene-based nanocomposite plating makes the vest extremely light yet ultra-durable. Ideal for everything from idyllic rides to heart pounding last laps.

lore.name: Reno Work Vest
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Reno work vest was crafted by Habidash from durable synth-leather cut in a bold asymmetric patchwork pattern, and features a secure double-clasp with reinforced armholes to extend the longevity of the garment.

lore.name: Renovar XTR Salvage Beam
lore.description: Item Type: Field Emitter Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Class: Industrial Designed to easily break down debris and vehicles into material composite, the Renovar XTR Salvage Beam has become the industry-standard for structural salvage. It alternates between two field modes: Fracture, which uses high-frequency vibrations to break objects apart, and Disintegration, which reduces the pieces into a usable resource.

lore.name: REP-8 EMP Generator
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: EMP Generator The REP-8 is a highly regarded EMP-focused burst generator from Behring. It balances a manageable charge time with a strong blast of distortion damage that knocks out electronic components caught within its radius. Solid engineering and centuries of use have made this a standard non-lethal deterrent across the Empire.

lore.name: REP-VS EMP Generator
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Burst Generator Size: 4 Damage Type: EMP Deliver distortion damage with the REP-VS burst generator built specifically for the Aegis Vanguard Sentinel. Behring modified the technology used in their reputable REP-8 to design an effective non-lethal weapon that integrates seamlessly with the Sentinel.

lore.name: Rescue Required T-Shirt
lore.description: In space, no one can hear your scream. That's why they created ECN alerts. Commemorate the kindness of strangers with the Rescue Required shirt, featuring an astronaut fleeing from danger.

lore.name: Resolu
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Groupe Nouveau Paradigme Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Military Invented with larger ships in mind, the Resolu radar provides the same level of three-dimensional scanning technology without sacrificing dependability.

lore.name: Restored Pants Brown
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU These pants may have seen better days, but they've got a lot of life left in them yet. Years of use have made them more comfortable than the day they were purchased.

lore.name: Retaliator Backlash Livery
lore.description: The bright and bold Backlash livery brings a dynamic design to the Retaliator, featuring a black central stripe ringed in yellow with red highlights.

lore.name: Retaliator Calico Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the subtle shifts in color when sunlight strikes desert sands, the Calico livery for the Retaliator features shades of tan and brown with red highlights.

lore.name: Retaliator Cargo Front Module
lore.description: Retaliator owners can equip their ship with this front module to allow for storage of an additional 36 SCU of cargo.

lore.name: Retaliator Cargo Rear Module
lore.description: Retaliator owners can equip their ship with this rear module to allow for storage of an additional 36 SCU of cargo.

lore.name: Retaliator Grey Livery
lore.description: Customize your Retaliator with this grey livery.

lore.name: Retaliator Invictus Blue and Gold Livery
lore.description: Show your support for the newest batch of Navy recruits by customizing your Retaliator with this special Blue and Gold livery to commemorate the 2950 Invictus Launch Week.

lore.name: Retaliator Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Retaliator with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Retaliator Ordnance Front Module
lore.description: Standard equipment for most UEE military Retaliators, this front module can carry 4x S9 torpedoes.

lore.name: Retaliator Ordnance Rear Module
lore.description: Standard equipment for most UEE military Retaliators, this rear module can carry 2x S9 torpedoes.

lore.name: Retaliator Twilight Livery
lore.description: Customize your Retaliator with this fragmented grey livery.

lore.name: Retaliator Underbrush Livery
lore.description: The Underbrush livery for the Retaliator was introduced during the First Tevarin War. This classic styling uses various shades of green and yellow highlights.

lore.name: Retaliator Unladen Front Module
lore.description: This empty front module comes equipped by default on the Retaliator's base chassis.

lore.name: Retaliator Unladen Rear Module
lore.description: This empty rear module comes equipped by default on the Retaliator's base chassis.

lore.name: Retired Drill Head
lore.description: While this retired drill head may no longer be boring holes in asteroids, mounted on a secure frame, guests are sure to "dig" this conversation piece when displayed in your personal space.

lore.name: Revenant Gatling
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Ballistic Gatling Size: 4 If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. And if you want it broke, aim a Revenant at it. Solidly built on a foundation of centuries-old tech, Apocalypse Arms puts an innovative spin on battle-tested designs to create a rugged ballistic Gatling that can steadily hurtle death across the void. Though it’s slow to spin up and cool down, the Revenant’s dependability makes it a favorite for those expecting to find trouble.

lore.name: Revenant Pod
lore.description: Contrary to its ominous name, the Revenant is actually a variety of the Altrucia Tree, an indigenous plant of Terra known for its thick and colorful leaves. Geoengineers introduced fields of Altrucias to Hyperion in an effort to break up the dust storms. Although the project failed, the Altrucia trees adapted to the perpetual wind patterns, shedding its leaves and thickening the wood in the trunk. Botanists initially believed that the Altrucias had died, but on closer inspection, discovered that they were quite alive and thus, the name was born.The pods are collected because the pollen is processed and turned into Altruciatoxin.

lore.name: Revenant Tree Pollen
lore.description: The pollen of Revenant Tree (altrucia lacus).

lore.name: Revere
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Industrial No matter the job, you need to be sure that you're life support system is going to do its part - day in, day out. That's why Juno Starwerk built the Revere life support system to be tough enough so you could breath easy.

lore.name: Revere Advanced
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Industrial No matter the job, you need to be sure that you're life support system is going to do its part - day in, day out. That's why Juno Starwerk built the Revere life support system to be tough enough so you could breath easy.

lore.name: Revere Compact
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 0 Grade: B Class: Industrial No matter the job, you need to be sure that you're life support system is going to do its part - day in, day out. That's why Juno Starwerk built the Revere life support system to be tough enough so you could breath easy.

lore.name: Revere Pro
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Industrial No matter the job, you need to be sure that you're life support system is going to do its part - day in, day out. That's why Juno Starwerk built the Revere life support system to be tough enough so you could breath easy.

lore.name: Reynie QED
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Enforcement Device Manufacturer: Wei-Tek Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Military This combination Quantum Enforcement Device from Wei-Tek contains both a Quantum Snare for pulling crafts out of quantum travel and a Quantum Dampener for preventing the engaging of quantum drives. With the ability to catch and hold, the Reynie offers an ideal all-in-one solution for security personnel.

lore.name: RF1 (1x Reflex)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Type: Reflex Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 1x Aim Time: +15% Size: 1 Perfect for close-quarter combat, the RF1 non-magnifying reflex optic was the first to use Behring's Hyper-Lumen substrate coating to ensure the aiming reticle could be seen in wide range of light conditions, day or night.

lore.name: Rhodes Jacket (Modified)
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU This version of City Light's Rhodes jacket has been modified from its original form. A classic racer jacket elevated by detailed seam work, a collar strap and decorative, eye-catching flourishes on the chest and arms. City Lights has once again redefined fashion and comfort.

lore.name: Rhodes Jacket White
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU A classic racer jacket elevated by detailed seam work, a collar strap and decorative, eye-catching flourishes on the chest and arms. City Lights has once again redefined fashion and comfort.

lore.name: Ribbon Fish
lore.description: Ribbon fish (Vario Vitas) have become a very popular first pet among children due to the minimal amount of care needed to keep them alive and the variety of their vibrant coloration.

lore.name: Riccite
lore.description: Found on worlds with heavy seismic activity, this metal is extremely flexible and has some self-healing properties.

lore.name: Riccite (Ore)
lore.description: Found on worlds with heavy seismic activity, this metal is extremely flexible and has some self-healing properties.

lore.name: Ridgely Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The extra-thick high collar of DMC’s Ridgely is part of a removable hood that makes the jacket surprisingly versatile and is a major reason why the Ridgely jacket is a perennial favorite amongst customers that live in, or venture through, cold environments.

lore.name: Ridgewalker Boots
lore.description: Functional style meets modern comfort with the Ridgewalker boots. Made with a lightweight yet durable synthetic leather, these boots feature a custom cushioned footbed and total traction soles that will keep you on your feet for hours. Fit for adventure or fashion the Ridgewalker boots are perfect for any occasion.

lore.name: Ridgewalker Boots (Modified)
lore.description: This version of Octagon's Ridgewalker boots has been modified from its original form. Functional style meets modern comfort with the Ridgewalker boots. Made with a lightweight yet durable synthetic leather, these boots feature a custom cushioned footbed and total traction soles that will keep you on your feet for hours. Fit for adventure or fashion the Ridgewalker boots are perfect for any occasion.

lore.name: Ringaling
lore.description: NDR: 10 Effects: Energizing, Hyper-Metabolic This holiday favorite cookie features a crumbly shortbread ring filled with a sweet and tart jam. Often enjoyed during Luminalia.

lore.name: Ripper
lore.description: A modified version of the Tigersclaw cryptokey, the Ripper earned its name for being able to "rip systems apart.' Incredibly fast, what it gains in speed, it also gains in instability as the extra draws on the processor results in greater error frequency.

lore.name: Ripper "Sunblock" SMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Unknown Item Type: SMG Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 60 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 30 m Scrapped together from whatever parts and pieces were available, the Ripper SMG can probably do enough damage to get you out of a tight spot. Just be ready for things to get messy. The Sunblock edition feature a yellow finish.

lore.name: Ripper SMG
lore.description: Manufacturer: Unknown Item Type: SMG Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 60 Rate Of Fire: 800 rpm Effective Range: 30 m Scrapped together from whatever parts and pieces were available, the Ripper SMG can probably do enough damage to get you out of a tight spot. Just be ready for things to get messy.

lore.name: Ripper SMG Battery (60 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Battery Capacity: 60 This battery for the Ripper SMG holds enough energy for 60 shots.

lore.name: RipTops Shoes
lore.description: Fun and funky. That was the directive NorthStar designers were given when tasked with creating a new sneaker. The result? NorthStar's RipTop line of all-purpose footwear. Mission accomplished.

lore.name: ROC Aphorite Livery
lore.description: Decorate your ROC with the Aphorite livery, which gets its name and color from the precious purple gemstone prized for its multi-hued tones.

lore.name: ROC Black Cherry Livery
lore.description: Black paint with red highlights make the Black Cherry livery a subtle yet stylish look for the ROC and ROC-DS.

lore.name: ROC Dolivine Livery
lore.description: Sharing the name with a gemstone prized for its beauty and industrial applications, the Dolivine livery blends shades of light green to give your ROC a unique look.

lore.name: ROC Hadanite Livery
lore.description: The Hadanite livery for your ROC gives the ship a distinct pink hue that mirrors the look of the gemstone of the same name.

lore.name: ROC Harvester Livery
lore.description: The Harvester livery for the ROC and ROC-DS brings a bold look to any jobsite.

lore.name: ROC Hazard Livery
lore.description: Live bold with this high visibility ROC and ROC-DS Hazard livery.

lore.name: ROC Mining Arm
lore.description: Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial With a wide range of motion and smooth movement, this highly precise mining arm was designed by Greycat Industrial to allow the operator full gimbaled control of the mining laser head when deployed.

lore.name: ROC Quicksilver Livery
lore.description: Turn heads with this slick Quicksilver livery for your ROC and ROC-DS.

lore.name: Rock
lore.description: Excess rock which is a by-product of the mining process.

lore.name: Rockridge Boots
lore.description: With the Rockridge, Grindstone has created a comfortable boot with a wide laced collar that allows wearers to adjust the fit to their level of comfort while still keeping the elements out.

lore.name: Rokmor Suit Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1k µSCU The Rokmor is a stylish suit jacket ideal for the executive with an eye for quality. Not only is it wrinkle-resistant and able to retain its shape well, but the angular design of both the shoulder pads and the lapels strengthen the wearer's silhouette for a strong aesthetic sure to impress any boardroom.

lore.name: Roll Mav Thruster
lore.description: Aegis Winnowing D1 Rotational Thruster

lore.name: Roughneck
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Industrial For its class, the Roughneck power plant from Juno Starwerk is an ideal component for haulers looking for maximum performance.

lore.name: Roughneck Pants
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU DMC's Roughneck pants are low cut for maximum comfort with extra size pockets and built to weather the storms of life.

lore.name: Roughneck Pants (Modified)
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU This version of DMC's Roughneck pants has been modified from its original form. DMC's Roughneck pants are low cut for maximum comfort with extra size pockets and built to weather the storms of life.

lore.name: RPEL
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Civilian See why more people trust Seal Corporation to protect their ship than any other company. With the RPEL shield generator you can be certain you’ll be sealed off from danger.

lore.name: RS-Barrier
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 4 Grade: Bespoke Class: Industrial Designed to defend against the debris common during large-scale salvage projects, Aegis Dynamics developed this bespoke industrial shield generator in-house for the Reclaimer.

lore.name: RS1 Odysey Spacesuits
lore.description: These imitation RSI Odyssey undersuits are cheaply made counterfeits that are hazardous to use.

lore.name: RSI Accent Chair
lore.description: Styled after the seats aboard the RSI Constellation Phoenix, this grey and white accent chair is fantastic way to show your love of space travel even when staying at home.

lore.name: RSI Apollo Medivac
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Medical Along with superior armor and dual missile racks, the 2948 Apollo Medivac model pays homage to the classic 2910 film, Astromedics: Back from the Brink, with livery that accurately recreates the headlining Kithara.

lore.name: RSI Apollo Medivac S02 Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Roberts Space Industries Size: 2 Missiles: 8xS2 Bespoke missile rack for the RSI Apollo that fires eight S2 missiles.

lore.name: RSI Apollo S02 Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Roberts Space Industries Size: 2 Missiles: 4xS2 Bespoke missile rack for the RSI Apollo that fires four S2 missiles.

lore.name: RSI Apollo Triage
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Medical The legendary Apollo chassis from Roberts Space Industries is the gold standard in medevac and rapid emergency response, having provided critical aid to the known universe for well over two centuries.

lore.name: RSI Aurora CL
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Light Freight Customized for mercantile and trading excursions, the Aurora Clipper is the perfect vessel for aspiring entrepreneurs and seasoned traders alike. Swapping a smaller power plant and armor capabilities for an expanded cargo capacity, the Clipper ups the ante for personal merchant craft.

lore.name: RSI Aurora ES
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Pathfinder The Aurora is the modern day descendant of the Roberts Space Industries X-7 spacecraft which tested the very first jump engines. Utilitarian to a T, the Aurora is the perfect beginner's ship: what it lacks in style it makes up for in ample room for upgrade modules.

lore.name: RSI Aurora LN
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Light Fighter With a more robust shield generator and a pair of additional weapon hard points, the Legionnaire is a dedicated combat fighter, built to handle any obstacle the universe can throw at you.

lore.name: RSI Aurora Lx
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Pathfinder Be proud of your roots with the brand new Aurora Deluxe, built for the discerning pilot who never forgets where he or she came from. The LX features patent leather interior to guarantee comfort for those long stretches in the black.

lore.name: RSI Aurora MR
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Light Fighter Perhaps you're looking for something that offers carrying capacity but has combat capabilities too? The Aurora Marque comes with a pair of Behring-quality lasers and a high quality gun cooler system.

lore.name: RSI Ballistic Repeater S9 Ammo Box
lore.description: Ammunition case for RSI's Ballistic Repeater S9.

lore.name: RSI Constellation Andromeda
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Medium Freight / Gunship The Constellation Andromeda, a multi-person freighter, is the most popular ship in RSI's current production array. Constellations are beloved by smugglers and merchants alike because they are modular, high powered... and just downright iconic-looking.

lore.name: RSI Constellation Aquila
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Expedition Explore any distant horizons! The Constellation Aquila features a redesigned cockpit for maximum visibility, advanced sensors and an onboard Ursa rover for planetary exploration. Let’s see what’s out there!

lore.name: RSI Constellation Bottom Turret
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 0 Featuring a three-barrel sequential fire design, the Klaus & Werner CF-007 Bulldog repeater is capable of high rates of fire while maintaining accuracy. It has low damage per projectile and, although it has relatively low power consumption over-all, several publications have commented on its somewhat lackluster efficiency. Even so, the CF-007 remains a favorite among new pilots who are outfitting their first ship.

lore.name: RSI Constellation Painting
lore.description: Rendered with incredible detail, this beautiful painting features RSI's iconic ship sailing through a tempestuous stretch of unexplored space.

lore.name: RSI Constellation Phoenix
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Medium Freight Enjoy the adventure of a multi-crew Constellation on a budget. The Constellation Taurus is a dedicated freighter. Fully configurable but without all the bells and whistles, the Taurus is a great way to get started with crewed ships.

lore.name: RSI Constellation Phoenixemerald
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Touring A dedicated luxury spacecraft for the discerning captain, the Constellation Phoenix features a luxurious redesigned interior, a Lynx rover, and a Kruger P-72 Archimedes Snub ship.

lore.name: RSI Constellation Taurus
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Medium Freight Enjoy the adventure of a multi-crew Constellation on a budget! The Constellation Taurus is a dedicated freighter. Fully configurable but without all the bells-and-whistles, the Taurus is a great way to get started with crewed ships.

lore.name: RSI Constellation Top Turret
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Laser Repeater Size: 0 Featuring a three-barrel sequential fire design, the Klaus & Werner CF-007 Bulldog repeater is capable of high rates of fire while maintaining accuracy. It has low damage per projectile and, although it has relatively low power consumption over-all, several publications have commented on its somewhat lackluster efficiency. Even so, the CF-007 remains a favorite among new pilots who are outfitting their first ship.

lore.name: RSI Hat
lore.description: The iconic RSI logo graces the front panel of this black hat featuring a burnt orange accent stripe.

lore.name: RSI Lesath Missile Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Turret Manufacturer: RSI Perfect for producing a wave of rapid-fire destruction, this bespoke RSI Scorpius missile turret, the Lesath, holds up to sixteen S2 missiles and offers a powerful alternative to the gun turret that comes as standard.

lore.name: RSI Medusa Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Item Type: Ballistic Cannon Size: 8 Building on centuries of RSI weapon technology, the Perseus utilizes bespoke size 8 Medusa Cannons that deliver devastating salvos of ballistic fire, capable of starting fights just as easily as ending them. These custom made RSI cannons excel at punishing larger targets at long, making it a formidable battlefield equalizer.

lore.name: RSI Orion
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Heavy Mining Roberts Space Industries' goal has always been to make the stars available to individual Citizens. Now, with the RSI Orion mining platform, RSI is letting individuals take over a process formerly controlled by megacorporations. The Orion's features include high-grade turret-mounted tractor beam arrays, plenty of mineral storage, and a cabin designed by the team that brought you the Aurora and Constellation. The listed Cargo Capacity is only for the dedicated Cargo Room and does not account for the mined material capacity in the storage pods.

lore.name: RSI Polaris Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: RSI Size: 10 Missiles: 8xS3 This bespoke S10 mount for the Polaris holds a missile rack carrying eight S3 missiles.

lore.name: RSI Polaris Remote Turret Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: RSI Size: 4 Missiles: 12xS2 A bespoke remote turret for the Polaris outfitted with a S4 mount holding a missile rack equipped with twelve S2 missiles.

lore.name: RSI Polaris Schematic
lore.description: Next in the “Masters of Design” series from Esperia are schematics for RSI’s latest Corvette-class capital ship which has quickly become popular with both the military and militias for its aggressive torpedo loadout.

lore.name: RSI Polaris Torpedo Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Torpedo Rack Manufacturer: RSI Size: 10 Torpedo: 7xS10 Bring the impressive firepower of the Polaris to bear with this bespoke torpedo rack holding seven massive S10 torpedoes.

lore.name: RSI T-Shirt
lore.description: Celebrate the company most responsible for bringing Humanity to the stars. This classic black t-shirt features the iconic RSI logo.

lore.name: RSI Ursa
lore.description: Manufacturer: RSI Focus: Exploration Built by RSI specifically for the planetside explorer, the Ursa Rover offers civilians military-grade all-terrain capabilities and stands as the rugged standard in ground-based scouting, mapping, and discovery applications.

lore.name: RSI-KRIG Main Thruster
lore.description: RSI Thruster developed in conjunction with KRIG specifically for use on the P-52 Merlin and P-72 Archimedes.

lore.name: Rubidium
lore.description: A slightly radioactive metal containing an isotope with a half-life of 49 billion years. Ductile and soft.

lore.name: Rush
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: ArcCorp Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian The Rush is a popular commercial quantum drive that lives up to its name.

lore.name: Rust (Bottle)
lore.description: HEI: 07 Effects: Cognitive Impairment, Dehydrating Rumored to be so potent that it can be used to strip rust off ship components, those who regularly drink this harsh, strong-tasting alcohol swear by it, claiming everything else tastes weak by comparison.

lore.name: Rustic Jacket Brown
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Assembled from an old Dusters flag, salvaged armor, and derelict ship parts, this serviceable jacket is secured to its wearer via sturdy leather straps.

This special edition features an imperial blue slide to commemorate the ongoing efforts of 'One Empire,' a community-based government initiative.

lore.name: S71 "Ascension" Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gemini Item Type: Assault Rifle Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 30 Rate Of Fire: 300 rpm / 900 rpm Effective Range: 50 m Attachments: Optics (S2), Barrel (S2), Underbarrel (S2) With the S71, Gemini designed an ergonomic assault rifle ideal for mid-range engagements. Chambered with a smaller caliber round than other weapons in its class, the S71 has become popular among private military professionals for its sleek aesthetics and precise accuracy. Designed in honor of IAE 2953, the Ascension edition has been decorated with sleek steel and copper accents that were inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.

lore.name: Sabre 2952 Auspicious Red Monkey Livery
lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Monkey livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a monkey's head.

lore.name: Sabre Ashcloud Livery
lore.description: Equip the Sabre in this dark and discreet Ashcloud livery that's predominantly black with beautiful carbon fiber and copper details.

lore.name: Sabre Beyond Livery
lore.description: Featuring dark teals with yellow trim, the Beyond livery for the Sabre is sure to inspire on your next mission.

lore.name: Sabre Black Magic Livery
lore.description: The Black Magic livery for the Sabre mixes a macabre black with glowing orange highlights for a look inspired by the sinister spirit of Day of the Vara.

lore.name: Sabre Blue Steel Livery
lore.description: Catch the focus of passing ships with the Blue Steel livery for the Sabre featuring a dark, polished metal finish with vibrant blue highlights.

lore.name: Sabre Darkshade Livery
lore.description: Envelop your Sabre in deep black for a sleek, professional look with the Darkshade livery.

lore.name: Sabre Firebreak Livery
lore.description: Ignite envy in others with the Sabre Firebreak livery, featuring vibrant red highlights against the black base paint.

lore.name: Sabre Harvest Livery
lore.description: The Harvest livery for the Sabre features orange highlights that stand in bold contrast to the black base paint.

lore.name: Sabre Landslide Livery
lore.description: The Landslide livery for the Sabre features a tan fuselage with grey wings and subtle silver highlights.

lore.name: Sabre Polar Camo Livery
lore.description: Modify your Sabre with this white and grey camo livery specifically designed for the 2950 IAE event on microTech.

lore.name: Sabre Star Kitten Livery
lore.description: Embody Sally the Star Kitten's racing spirit with this custom Sabre livery. Combining the bright pink, vibrant blue, and crisp white of the beloved cartoon mascot, this livery brings a playfulness your competitors are sure to enjoy.

lore.name: Sabre Starlight Livery
lore.description: An elegant black with chrome highlights, the Starlight livery brings a subtly striking and timeless look to the Sabre.

lore.name: Sabre Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: This custom Sabre livery was created to celebrate the 2950 IAE on microTech. It blends black and electric blue with white accents to give the ship a cool new look.

lore.name: Sabre Tribunal Livery
lore.description: Head out to the frontlines with your Sabre looking ready for action with the Tribunal livery in military green and yellow trim.

lore.name: Sabre Windbreak Livery
lore.description: The Windbreak livery exudes style by giving the Sabre a green body, dark grey wings, and silver and orange highlights.

lore.name: Sadaryx
lore.description: A durable crystal, sadaryx is commonly used in the production of industrial focal lenses in laser applications.

lore.name: Sadaryx Focus Lens
lore.description: This lens is crafted from durable sadaryx crystals and can be used to focus and improve power-throughput of high-powered industrial laser beams.

lore.name: Safe
lore.description: This safe provides secure storage for valuable or sensitive items.

lore.name: SafeCore Boots
lore.description: The SafeCore boots are a soft-shelled offering from Grindstone intended to provide more flexibility while traversing in adverse conditions.

lore.description: The SafeCore boots are a soft-shelled offering from Grindstone intended to provide more flexibility while traversing in adverse conditions.

lore.name: Safehab
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 4 This capital-class life support system was designed specifically for the Idris frigate.

lore.name: SafeTow S3 Towing Beam
lore.description: Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Towing Beam Max Angle: 160° Max Range: 250 m Full Strength Distance: 200 m The safe and secure choice of recovery teams across the empire, the SafeTow towing beam from Greycat Industrial boasts enough strength, power, and control to transport both heavy cargo and vehicles across the ‘verse.

lore.name: SafeTow S3-Q Towing Beam
lore.description: Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Towing Beam Max Angle: 160° Max Range: 250 m Full Strength Distance: 200 m The safe and secure choice of recovery teams across the empire, the SafeTow towing beam from Greycat Industrial boasts enough strength, power, and control to transport both heavy cargo and vehicles across the ‘verse. This "Q" model includes a special quick placement mode to assist with the transfer of cargo.

lore.name: Sag Paneer Combat Ration
lore.description: NDR: 64 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic, Cognitive Boosting A single serving combat ration specially formulated to provide complete high-performance nutrition for UEE Army personnel.

lore.name: Sakura Fun Blue ORC-mkX Armor Bobblehead
lore.description: Like the armor set it features, the Blue ORC-mkX Bobblehead is exquisitely detailed and made with high quality materials. Place Sakura Sun's latest edition to the Sakura Fun line of bobbleheads on a ship's dashboard for an ideal cockpit companion ready to ride along on daring space adventures.

lore.name: Sakura Fun Green ORC-mkX Armor Bobblehead
lore.description: Like the armor set it features, the Green ORC-mkX Bobblehead is exquisitely detailed and made with high quality materials. Place Sakura Sun's latest edition to the Sakura Fun line of bobbleheads on a ship's dashboard for an ideal cockpit companion ready to ride along on daring space adventures.

lore.name: Sakura Fun White ORC-mkX Armor Bobblehead
lore.description: Like the armor set it features, the White ORC-mkX Bobblehead is exquisitely detailed and made with high quality materials. Place Sakura Sun's latest edition to the Sakura Fun line of bobbleheads on a ship's dashboard for an ideal cockpit companion ready to ride along on daring space adventures.

lore.name: Sakura Sun Hat
lore.description: A purple and pink cadet hat with Sakura Sun's name and logo emblazoned across the front panel.

lore.name: Saldynium
lore.description: A rare metal that has traditionally been extremely difficult to find in large quantities owing to the particular environmental requirements for its formation. It is sought after for its use in the production of high-powered lasers. It also shows some antimicrobial properties though its scarcity has seen it used less for medical purposes.

lore.description: A rare metal that has traditionally been extremely difficult to find in large quantities owing to the particular environmental requirements for its formation. It is sought after for its use in the production of high-powered lasers. It also shows some antimicrobial properties though its scarcity has seen it used less for medical purposes.

lore.name: Salluq Mask Brown
lore.description: Made for hostile environments, the Salluq Mask keeps dirt, dust, and grit out of your eyes while providing you with a wide field of vision. Please note that this mask is not space-rated and should only be worn in naturally breathable environments.

lore.name: Salvaged Polaris Captain's Chair
lore.description: Salvaged from the wreckage of a UEE Polaris ship, this mostly intact captain's seat makes for a good talking point inside your hangar.

lore.name: Salvaged Skull 1 SCU Container
lore.description: It may be used to transport “goods”, but this battered and scarred 1 SCU container is anything but thanks to its vivid skull markings.

lore.name: Salvaged Skull 2 SCU Container
lore.description: It may be used to transport “goods”, but this battered and scarred 2 SCU container is anything but thanks to its vivid skull markings.

lore.name: Salvaged Skull 4 SCU Container

lore.name: Salvaged Skull 8 SCU Container
lore.description: It may be used to transport “goods”, but this battered and scarred 8 SCU container is anything but thanks to its vivid skull markings.

lore.name: Salvaged Skull Couch
lore.description: Why risk your reputation as a serious outlaw by sitting on anything but the most hardcore of couches? Featuring hand-printed skulls and make-shift repairs, this couch will have your guests saying, “this person is definitely a criminal.”

lore.name: Salvaged Skull Lounge Chair
lore.description: Ripped out of a busted ship and ready for lounging, this former cockpit seat has been tagged with a vivid skull print to make for an aggressive seating addition to your hideout.

lore.name: Salvaged Skull Table
lore.description: From planning your next heist to high-stakes card games, this salvaged table featuring a large skull marking is the perfect place for gathering with your last known associates.

lore.name: Salvation Chimaera Livery
lore.description: The Chimaera livery for the Salvation is primarily blue and black with yellow highlights.

lore.name: Salvation Disco Livery
lore.description: Equip the ship livery used by ace pilot Disco in the classic children's cartoon Rory Nova. While it turns the Salvation metallic dark blue, black, and red, whether you turn into the 'dynamic, instinctive spacecraft operator' that inspired the livery's name is up to you.

lore.name: Salvation Distortion Scattergun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Preacher Armaments Item Type: Distortion Scattergun Size: 4 Disable an enemy's ship without damaging it with the Salvation scattergun from Preacher Armaments. With its wide spread and low rate of fire this size four scattergun is most potent at close range.

lore.name: Salvation Eureka Livery
lore.description: The Eureka livery features glittering gold highlights against a black base paint for the Salvation.

lore.name: Salvation Foundation Fest Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Salvation Lovestruck Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish iridescent pink and black look for your Salvation.

lore.name: Salvation Safeguard Livery
lore.description: The colorful industrial design of the Safeguard livery for the Salvation includes a vibrant blue and yellow stripes.

lore.name: Salvation Vespid Livery
lore.description: The Vespid livery turns the Salvation white with orange highlights that stand in stark contrast to its black base paint.

lore.name: Salvo Esteban Frag Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hedeby Gunworks Item Type: Frag Pistol Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 8 Rate Of Fire: 140 rpm Effective Range: 80 m / 10 m (Charged) Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) While the Salvo can be used as a normal pistol, Hedeby didn't stop there. With a longer trigger pull, a freezing primer is injected into the chamber and when released, the heavy firing pin hits with enough force to pulverize the supercooled casing. Accidentally developed as an attempt to mitigate overheating, this charged fire option discharges a deadly spray of high-velocity fragments followed by an ear-shattering boom. This special edition pistol features beautifully detailed scrollwork personally design by Hedeby master gunsmith Rey Esteban.

lore.description: Manufacturer: Hedeby Gunworks Item Type: Frag Pistol Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 8 Rate Of Fire: 140 rpm Effective Range: 80 m / 10 m (Charged) Attachments: Optics (S1), Barrel (S1), Underbarrel (S1) While the Salvo can be used as a normal pistol, Hedeby didn’t stop there. lore.name: Samark Woven Hat
lore.description: Shade yourself from the sun with the Samark Woven hat. Its precisely woven to divert rain off the wide brim instead of seeping through onto you. The hat also features an adjustable strap to ensure a snug and comfortable fit.

lore.name: Samya Tank White
lore.description: This Samya Tank is your perfect staple for hot weather. Made with soft and breathable fabric, it features moisture-wicking technology and reinforced binding at the openings to protect it from wear and tear. A detachable sleeve is included with each shirt.

lore.name: San'tok.yāi Gimbal Mount
lore.description: Manufacturer: Aopoa Item Type: Weapon Mount Size: 3 Line up the perfect shot with help from this S3 gimbal mount. Made by Aopoa specifically for the San'tok.yāi, this gimbal can handle weapons up to S3.

lore.name: San'tok.yai Harmony Livery
lore.description: The Harmony livery is meant to showcase Humanity's peaceful relationship with alien species with a semi-pearlescent blue main coat marked with organic reflective red to suggest the coming together of disparate species and cultures. The Harmony livery has been designed and produced by the UEE's Diplomatic Corps and freely licensed to all spacecraft manufacturers. Now Aopoa San'tok.yai owners can celebrate the UEE's intentions of working toward a peaceful galaxy.

lore.name: San'tok.yāi Missile Rack
lore.description: Item Type: Missile Rack Manufacturer: Aopoa Size: 3 Missiles: 2xS2 Built to hold two S2 missiles, Aopoa designed these missile racks specifically to work in harmony with the unique design of the San'tok.yāi.

lore.name: San'tok.yai Ocellus Livery
lore.description: The Ocellus livery adapts and updates the iconic colors and design used on some Tevarin ships to bring a striking new look to the San'tok.yai. The livery adds a distinct red pattern to the fuselage while shimmering green covers the rest of the ship. Grey lines swoop across the entire ship to help break up its silhouette.

lore.name: San'tok.yai Tuiping Livery
lore.description: Make the San'tok.yai pristine white with red trim with the Tuiping livery.

lore.name: San'tok.yai Xua'cha Livery
lore.description: Outfit the San'tok.yai in fiery red and black trim with the Xua'cha livery.

lore.name: San'tok.yai Yilen Livery
lore.description: The shimmering iridescence of the Yilen livery delivers a distinct look for the San'tok.yai.

lore.name: Sand Nomad Plant Pot
lore.description: Inspired by traditional sand nomad pottery, the desert hues of this plant pot are evocative of the immense dunes of Leir III.

lore.name: Sangar Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -90 / 115 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s The Sangar helmet from Vigil is both practical and eye-catching, thanks to a prominent brow ridge meant to absorb and disperse strikes through the helmet's special impact-resistant inner lining. Featuring high quality diamond laminate lens over the eyes and a top tier dual sensor air filtration system protruding from the front like fangs, Virgil has ensured that the Sangar helmet can take a beating and look good doing it in every situation from a hostile environment to a frantic firefight.

lore.name: Sangar Helmet (Modified)
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -90 / 115 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s This version of Virgil's Sangar helmet has been modified from its original form. The Sangar helmet from Vigil is both practical and eye-catching, thanks to a prominent brow ridge meant to absorb and disperse strikes through the helmet's special impact-resistant inner lining. Featuring high quality diamond laminate lens over the eyes and a top tier dual sensor air filtration system protruding from the front like fangs, Virgil has ensured that the Sangar helmet can take a beating and look good doing it in every situation from a hostile environment to a frantic firefight.

lore.name: Sarilus
lore.description: A material first introduced into Human manufacturing after trade with the Banu. It is extremely distortion resistant. Though Human made Sarilus does a good job, many hold that the Banu manufactured product is superior.

lore.name: Sarrab Glasses
lore.description: The Sarrab are stylish half-rim glasses that are so light you'll forget you're wearing them. Ideal for everyday use, these glasses feature clear polycarbonate temple arms that complement the lens without demanding too much attention.

lore.name: Saskia Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Be formal and fashionable with the Saskia jacket. This hybrid jacket and collared shirt features dynamic geometric patterns, including diagonal lines that swoop across the front and back.

lore.name: Savoir
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Groupe Nouveau Paradigme Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Military Boasting a decent range and energy efficiency, the Savoir is a radar designed for those that favor reliability.

lore.name: Savrilium
lore.description: This metal, first discovered in the Nyx system, was a main economic driver for early miners of the system thanks to its unique alloyed properties.

lore.name: Savrilium (Ore)
lore.description: This metal ore, first discovered in the Nyx system, was a main economic driver for early miners of the system thanks to its unique alloyed properties once refined.

lore.name: Sawtooth "Bloodstone" Combat Knife
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: 16 cm Don't end up on the wrong side of the Sawtooth combat knife. The blade embodies Kastak Arms' aggressive styling and was designed to stab, slice, or saw. It features a strong tip for piercing, a straight edge for slicing, and a unique serrated edge with microblades for when you really need to rip through something. The blade is also made with a special ceramic polymer coating that enhances its strength and overall wear resistance. For the special Bloodstone edition, a red color was added to the coating to make it even more visually distinct.

lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: 16 cm Don't end up on the wrong side of the Sawtooth combat knife. The blade embodies Kastak Arms' aggressive styling and was designed to stab, slice, or saw.
