The blade embodies Kastak Arms' aggressive styling and was designed to stab, slice, or saw. It features a strong drop tip for piercing, a straight edge for slicing, and a unique serrated edge with microblades for when you really need to rip through something. The blade is also made with a special ceramic polymer coating that enhances its strength and overall wear resistance. For the special Sunspike edition, an orange handle and aged finish was added to make the blade more visually distinct.

lore.name: SB-Station 'Cargo Deck A' Keycard
lore.description: This keycard grants access to 'Cargo Deck A' located in the Shattered Blade Station.

lore.name: SC-1 LIDAR Grenade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Grenade Damage Type: Non-Lethal The Behring SC-1 LIDAR allows users to understand the battlefield before entering it. Once activated in the field, it emits an omni-directional scan that maps everyone in its radius and then sends their precise positions to the operator.

lore.name: Scaleweave Undersuit
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% This baseline undersuit from Kastak Arms offers complete protection seal from the elements and compatibility with multiple armor types.

lore.name: Scalpel "Permafrost" Sniper Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Sniper Rifle Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 8 Rate Of Fire: 30 rpm Effective Range: 120 m Attachments: Optics (S3), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S2) The Scalpel is a unique and versatile sniper rifle from Kastak Arms. Designed with a vertical two barrel configuration, it has two fire modes so you can adapt your shot to the situation to deliver a single, powerful shot from a long distance, or fire both barrels in quick succession to create a double-shot burst. This special Permafrost edition features blue and grey coloring reminiscent of a glacier under a blinding winter sky.

lore.name: Scalpel Sniper Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Sniper Rifle Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 8 Rate Of Fire: 30 rpm Effective Range: 120 m Attachments: Optics (S3), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S2) The Scalpel is a unique and versatile sniper rifle from Kastak Arms. Designed with two barrels stacked atop of each other, it has two fire modes so you can adapt your shot to the situation. It can deliver a single, powerful shot from a long distance, or fire both barrels in quick succession to create a double-shot burst.

lore.name: Scalpel Sniper Rifle Magazine (12 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 12 This magazine for the Kastak Arms Scalpel comes loaded with eight 7.62mm rounds.

lore.name: Scimitar V Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Electromagnetic Size: 5 The Scimitar missile tracks targets via their EM signature to deliver a devastating size five payload.

lore.name: Scimitar V-G Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Electromagnetic Size: 5 The Scimitar missile tracks targets via their EM signature to deliver a devastating size five payload. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

lore.name: Scorch Plasma Grenade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Kastak Arms Item Type: Grenade Area of Effect: 7.5 m Damage Type: Plasma Kastak Arms Scorch plasma grenade is sure to be a devastating addition to your next battle. Once primed and ready, the Scorch will explode on impact, unleashing a burst of intense plasma damage on your target that leave a lingering hazard area behind.

lore.name: Scorpion GT-215 Gatling
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gallenson Tactical Systems Item Type: Ballistic Gatling Size: 2 The Scorpion GT-215 is a hydraulically-driven Gatling-type rotary cannon designed to deliver smaller rounds at a very high rate of fire. The Scorpion is designed to shred armor on very fast targets, sacrificing power for absolute saturation of the target area.

lore.name: Scorpius Antares PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your RSI Scorpius Antares with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: Scorpius Antares Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Roberts Space Industries Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the RSI Scorpius Antares.

lore.name: Scorpius Antares TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your RSI Scorpius Antares with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: Scorpius Avalanche Livery
lore.description: White with grey and orange accents, the Avalanche livery for the Scorpius gives the ship a pristine and refined style.

lore.name: Scorpius Blight Livery
lore.description: The Blight livery for the Scorpius paints this advanced combat platform green with black and tan highlights.

lore.name: Scorpius Deck the Hull Livery
lore.description: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.

lore.name: Scorpius IceBreak Livery
lore.description: Equip your Scorpius with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

lore.name: Scorpius Lovestruck Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the colors of Coramor, the Lovestruck livery is a stylish metallic pink and black look for your Scorpius.

lore.name: Scorpius Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Scorpius with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Scorpius PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your RSI Scorpius with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: Scorpius Red Alert Livery
lore.description: Embody the furious firepower of the Scorpius with the metallic red and black look of the Red Alert livery.

lore.name: Scorpius Shock Force Livery
lore.description: Featuring ferocious firepower and a bold bi-wing design, the Scorpius deserves a paint scheme to match. The eye-catching Shock Force livery pairs a blend of yellow and orange hues with a dark grey trim.

lore.name: Scorpius Skullcrusher Livery
lore.description: Exude attitude with the Skullcrusher livery for the Scorpius, which features a massive skull decal across the top.

lore.name: Scorpius Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Roberts Space Industries Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the RSI Scorpius.

lore.name: Scorpius Stiletto Livery
lore.description: The Scorpius features a sleek and dynamic design that's highlighted by the Stiletto livery, which mixes shades of blue and orange and white highlights.

lore.name: Scorpius Stinger Livery
lore.description: The exclusive Scorpius Stinger livery features a black finish and an orange decal in the shape the famously lethal arachnid that is the ship's namesake.

lore.name: Scorpius Storm Cloud Livery
lore.description: Strike true and deliver justice with the Scorpius Storm Cloud livery featuring slate-teal panels with black trim and subtle orange highlights.

lore.name: Scorpius Sunburn Livery
lore.description: A ship designed to be a daring dogfighter deserves an equally audacious look. The Scorpius Sunburn livery is primarily white with a dynamic mix of orange and black highlights.

lore.name: Scorpius Tiburon Livery
lore.description: As if the Scorpius and its rail-mounted turret isn't menacing enough, the exclusive Tiburon livery features two rows of sharpened teeth flanking the cockpit. The rest of the paint scheme features shades of grey intermixed with red and white highlights.

lore.name: Scorpius TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your RSI Scorpius with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: Scourge "Quite Useful" Railgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Railgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 5 Rate Of Fire: 60 rpm Effective Range: 200 m Attachments: Optics (N/A), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S4) Equally devastating to larger threats and hostile vehicles, this shoulder mounted railgun from Apocalypse Arms uses electromagnets to deliver its payload accurately over great distances, making it the Scourge of land, air and space. One of the many items Wikelo has acquired in his travels, the 'Quite Useful' edition is a must have for any serious collector.

lore.name: Scourge Railgun
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Railgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 5 Rate Of Fire: 60 rpm Effective Range: 200 m Attachments: Optics (N/A), Barrel (N/A), Underbarrel (S4) Equally devastating to larger threats and hostile vehicles, this shoulder mounted railgun from Apocalypse Arms uses electromagnets to deliver its payload accurately over great distances, making it the Scourge of land, air and space.

lore.name: Scourge Railgun (Desert Shadow, Nightstalker)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Railgun Class: Ballistic Magazine Size: 10 Rate Of Fire: 60 rpm Effective Range: 200 m Equally devastating to larger threats and hostile vehicles, this shoulder mounted railgun from Apocalypse Arms uses electromagnets to deliver its payload accurately over great distances, making it the Scourge of land, air and space.

lore.name: Scourge Railgun Magazine (5 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 5 This magazine holds the large specially designed.937 caliber tungsten sabot rounds fired by the Apocalypse Arms Scourge railgun.

lore.name: SCR
lore.description: After centuries of production, this common form of rubber emerged as the the industry standard. Standard Commercial Rubber (SCR) can be produced rapidly and cost effectively.

lore.name: Scrap
lore.description: Waste that is ready to be converted into new materials for reuse.

lore.name: Scrap

lore.name: Scrap Bearing
lore.description: A circular piece of worn metal, most likely an old bearing.

lore.name: Scrap Cable Bundle
lore.description: A small bundle of electronic cables, damaged beyond use.

lore.name: Scrap Cable Coil
lore.description: A coiling loop of broken cables, serving no particular purpose.

lore.name: Scrap Valve
lore.description: A discarded piece of machinery that no longer serves a purpose.

lore.name: Screwdriver
lore.description: HEI: 07 Effects: Cognitive Impairment, Dehydrating A blend of grain vodka and citrus juice.

lore.name: ScrubClean Filter
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Filter Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech The ScrubClean filter exceeds UEE standards for removing harmful unwanted particles from the atmosphere, to provide a clean and breathable environment.

lore.name: Seanut
lore.description: NDR: 17 HEI: 07 Effects: None Easy to grow and care for, these tubular sea creatures have become a popular food in the outer reaches of systems. When eaten raw, seanuts have a chewy and crisp texture with a bright briny and nutty flavor.

lore.name: Second Life Undersuit
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% Featuring the same relatively reliable construction as the Why Not helmet, the Second Life takes some of those tattered old undersuits and gives them new life.

lore.name: Second Tevarin War Red Dress Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Honor the heroes that served in the Second Tevarin War by wearing a replica Navy uniform. Historically accurate down to every last stitch, period appropriate materials were used to make these uniforms match military specifications of the era. The red Dress Jacket features a sash adorned with metals and was worn for formal occasions and ceremonies.

lore.name: Second Tevarin War Red Dress Trousers
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU Honor the heroes that served in the Second Tevarin War by wearing a replica Navy uniform. Historically accurate down to every last stitch, period appropriate materials were used to make these uniforms match military specifications of the era. The red Dress Trousers were worn with the matching jacket for formal occasions and ceremonies.

Historically accurate down to every last stitch, period appropriate materials were used make these uniforms match military specifications of the era. The Service Jacket is primarily blue with a white and red stripe across the right shoulder and arm.

lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU Honor the heroes that served in the Second Tevarin War by wearing a replica Navy uniform. Historically accurate down to every last stitch, period appropriate materials were used to make these uniforms match military specifications of the era. The Service Trousers are blue with red piping and worn with the matching jacket.

The white Dress Trousers were worn with the matching jacket for formal occasions and ceremonies.

lore.name: SecureHyde
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Gorgon Defender Industries Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Military Get extra protection with the SecureHyde shield generator. This military-grade component provides superior durability over every other shield generator in its class.

lore.name: SecureScreen
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Gorgon Defender Industries Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Military Gorgon Defender Industries brings military might to their entry-level, large shield generator. Featuring best-in-class durability, the SecureScreen was built to take a beating and survive.

lore.name: SecureShield
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Gorgon Defender Industries Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Military Get military-grade protection for your ship with the SecureShield from Gorgon Defender Industries. Their cutting edge emitter tech allows for superior shield absorption across the spectrum of damage types.

lore.name: Sedulity
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Industrial When you need a power plant that’s as reliable as you are, then snag yourself a Sedulity. This component has been a staple of the Juno Starwerk line for years, making it truly worthy of the name.

lore.name: Seeker IX Torpedo
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Electromagnetic Size: 9 Talon's Seeker torpedo is a precision, EM-targeting torpedo capable of delivering a massive payload quickly and accurately.

lore.name: Seeker IX-G Torpedo
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Electromagnetic Size: 9 Talon's Seeker torpedo is a precision, EM-targeting torpedo capable of delivering a massive payload quickly and accurately. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

lore.name: Selby Jacket Black
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Look as good as you feel with this trendy jacket from DMC. The Selby also features a soft inner lining to provide extra comfort and insulation. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Selenium
lore.description: A chalcogen often found in combination with heavy metals. In its refined form, it increases in electrical conductivity when exposed to light.

lore.name: Sens
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: GNP Size: 0 Grade: B Class: Military The cutting-edge GNP Sens design elevates radar technology to meet or exceed the specifications used by most military organizations operating today.

lore.name: Serac
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Wen/Cassel Size: 4 Grade: Bespoke Class: Civilian Only available for Origin Jumpworks' luxury liner, Wen/Cassel specially designed the Serac cooler to keep the 890 Jump operational through the diverse conditions typically encountered while cruising the stars.

lore.name: Serenity F10
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: RSI Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Military Operating to the exacting standards expected of RSI, the Serenity life support system provides consistent performance across a wide variety of scenarios.

lore.name: Serenity F20
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: RSI Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Military Operating to the exacting standards expected of RSI, the Serenity life support system provides consistent performance across a wide variety of scenarios.

lore.name: Serenity F30
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: RSI Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Military Operating to the exacting standards expected of RSI, the Serenity life support system provides consistent performance across a wide variety of scenarios.

lore.name: Serenity FV
lore.description: Item Type: Life Support Manufacturer: RSI Size: 0 Grade: C Class: Military Operating to the exacting standards expected of RSI, the Serenity life support system provides consistent performance across a wide variety of scenarios.

lore.name: SF7B Gatling
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Ballistic Gatling Size: 7 Slug it out with large spacecraft and swiftly shred smaller ships with the SF7B ballistic Gatling. Built specifically for the Ares Inferno Star Fighter, the weapon seamlessly integrates into the body of the ship. The weapon's impressive rate of fire unleashes high-density rounds that tear through armor and shields, making it a perfect choice for situations where target saturation is key.

lore.name: SF7E Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Item Type: Laser Cannon Size: 7 Engineers from Behring and Crusader collaborated to make the SF7E laser cannon the ideal weapon for the Ares Ion Star Fighter. A custom shell allows the massive weapon to seamlessly integrate into the body of the ship. Ideal for long-range engagements involving large and capital-class spacecraft, the SF7E's impressive accuracy and high damage-per-round make it a devastating weapon in the hands of a skilled shooter.

lore.name: Shackleton Shirt
lore.description: Distressed to impress, the Shackleton line provides comfort with an edge. Escar Limited abrades the shirt fabric to give it a repurposed charm and unique look that fits in at home or on the streets.

lore.name: Shade Repeater
lore.description: Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms Item Type: Ballistic Repeater Size: 4 Apocalypse Arms' Shade repeater is a semi-automatic ballistic weapon, capable of providing sustained, accurate fire on target. Its multiple barrels allow the Shade to have an increased rate of fire over similar weapons of its class.

lore.name: Sharud Wrap and Arm Bands
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Sharud is an ideal top for staying cool in hot weather. Advanced production techniques allow Habidash to make a light yet absorbent shawl that looks and feels like handspun natural cotton but at a fraction of the cost. The three arm band pieces provide stylish accents and come embedded with microchips that tracks body temperature and other vitals.

lore.name: Shattered Blade Holographic Banner
lore.description: Looted from one of the infamous smugglers' hideouts, this red holographic banner features the Shattered Blade's fearsome iconography that serves as warning to any who dare enter, Human and Vanduul alike.

lore.name: Shattered Vanduul Lance Display
lore.description: Mounted onto a standing case, this display shows the remains of a Vanduul lance recovered from the aftermath of the Battle of Vega.

lore.name: Shaved
lore.description: Shaved hairstyle for an aerodynamic look.

lore.name: Sheut
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Ascension Astro Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Stealth Keep your shield’s heat from giving you away by using a Sheut. Another outstanding stealth shield generator from Ascension Astro.

lore.name: Shield Generator
lore.description: Default Description for the ship generator component.

lore.name: Shimmer
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Ascension Astro Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Stealth Ascension Astro is known for one thing — quality stealth components. Their Shimmer shield generator was built not only to help avoid detection, but also provide protection when needed most.

lore.name: Ship Showdown '52 C8X Pisces Coin
lore.description: Voters in the 2952 Ship Showdown definitely didn't snub the C8X Pisces Expedition. This coin honors its top four finish with an image of the ship on one side and the Anvil Aerospace logo on the other.

lore.name: Ship Showdown '52 Carrack Coin
lore.description: A coin to celebrate the Carrack winning the 2952 Ship Showdown. The beloved expedition ship soars across one side of the coin ringed in red with the Anvil Aerospace logo appearing on the reverse.

lore.name: Ship Showdown '52 Coin
lore.description: This commemorative coin from the 2952 Ship Showdown embodies the spirit of the competition by featuring the silhouette of a Cutlass and Hornet facing off against a blue and orange background divided by a lightning bolt.

lore.name: Ship Showdown '52 Mercury Coin
lore.description: The Mercury Star Runner delivered a strong showing in the 2952 Ship Showdown with its second place finish. Ringed in blue, this coin commemorates the iconic courier ship with its image on one side and the Crusader Industries logo on the other.

lore.name: Ship Showdown '52 Scorpius Coin
lore.description: Thanks to its revolutionary rail-mounted turret the Scorpius blast its way into the final four of the 2952 Ship Showdown. This commemorative coin features the ship's unmistakable bi-wing design on one side with the Roberts Space Industries logo on the reverse.

lore.name: Shiv
lore.description: Manufacturer: Unknown Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: N/A A deadly, improvised knife made by an industrious prisoner by securing a sharpened piece of metal to an OxyPen with a bit of thin cord. Considered contraband within prison facilities.

lore.name: Shiv "Barebones" Bodykit Front
lore.description: It's your ship, so shouldn't it match your style? With the Barebones bodykit you can give your Grey's Market Shiv a lean and mean aftermarket makeover.

lore.name: Shiv Blue Blossom Livery
lore.description: Turn the Shiv into a beauty and a brute with the Blue Blossom livery, featuring a colorful and ornate flower pattern across the top of the ship.

lore.name: Shiv Earthquake Livery
lore.description: Upgrade the patchwork look of the Shiv with the Earthquake livery, which artfully mixes shades of beige and black.

lore.name: Shiv Gideon Livery
lore.description: The Gideon livery for the Shiv features a heavily worn green and grey finish with yellow accents.

lore.name: Shiv Meridian Livery
lore.description: The Meridian livery gives the Shiv a simple yet stylish metallic silver finish.

lore.name: Shiv Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Shiv with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Shiv Nightmare Livery
lore.description: Featuring a sinister skull atop a brown base paint, the Nightmare livery gives the Shiv a look that sends shivers down the spine.

lore.name: Shiv PHB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Shiv with the PHB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating forward thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased precision handling during tight maneuvers.

lore.name: Shiv Skull and Crossbones Livery
lore.description: This livery embraces classic pirate iconography by featuring several skull and crossbones symbols across the Shiv's dark hull with blood red highlights.

lore.name: Shiv Spectre Livery
lore.description: Make the Shiv dark and discreet with the all black Spectre livery.

lore.name: Shiv Standard Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Grey's Market Type: Flight Blade This is the standard issue flight blade for the Shiv.

lore.name: Shiv TSB Flight Blade
lore.description: Manufacturer: Broad & Rabiee Type: Flight Blade Unlock the potential of your Shiv with the TSB Flight Blade from Broad & Rabiee. By re-allocating lateral thrust resources, you can expect your ship to deliver increased top speeds in the straightaway.

lore.name: Shizhen Surgical Gown
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Ensure complete upper body coverage and comfort with the Shizhen surgical gown. Its unique design features a light, breathable long sleeve shirt underneath a see through surgical gown, delivering dual layer protection against fluids and pathogens.

lore.name: Shizhen Surgical Head Cover
lore.description: The Shizhen surgical head cover provides complete coverage during medical procedures. Lightweight, breathable and anti-bacterial, the head cover even includes a tinted lens to reduce heat and eye strain that may occur during procedures involving lasers.

lore.name: Shogun Kiba Helmet Akuma
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Inspired by ancient Human folklore, the Shogun Kiba helmet features a demonic face with long fangs paired with curved-horns and a flared back plating. The use of high-end treated metals creates an ornamental aesthetic, whilst still providing substantial protection from all angles. Visor is AR crosshair compatible. The Akuma edition strikes fear with its bold metallic red faceplate paired with black armor backing.

lore.name: Shogun Kiba Helmet Stronghold
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Inspired by ancient Human folklore, the Shogun Kiba helmet features a demonic face with long fangs paired with curved-horns and a flared back plating. The use of high-end treated metals creates an ornamental aesthetic, whilst still providing substantial protection from all angles. Visor is AR crosshair compatible. The Stronghold edition features the fierce symbology of the Nine Tails gang with bold neon pink accents.

lore.name: Short Mohawk
lore.description: High fade with a short mohawk.

lore.name: Short Mohawk
lore.description: For a more reserved look without completely losing your edge.

lore.name: Shoyu Lapsha
lore.description: NDR: 40 Effects: Dehydrating, Hyper-Metabolic A soy sauce based home-style chicken noodles. Perfect for warming up those cold berths.

lore.name: Shrimp Typhoon Burrito
lore.description: NDR: 38 Effects: Dehydrating Torpedo Burrito crams a full payload of flavor into their Shrimp Typhoon burrito, unleashing a storm of succulent shrimp drenched in a tropical sauce wrapped in their signature size-4 multi-grain tortilla.

lore.name: Shroud
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Ascension Astro Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Stealth The Shroud shield generator from Ascension Astro provides a layer of protection for your vessel while still helping you maintain emission levels to provide a lower signature.

lore.name: Shutter Flashbang
lore.description: Manufacturer: Roussimoff Rehabilitation Systems (RRS) Item Type: Grenade Area of Effect: 15 m Damage Type: None The Shutter Flashbang is a cornerstone of RRS's line of non-lethal armaments. The device is designed to temporarily incapacitate targets within its blast radius, disorienting their senses.

lore.name: Side Bob
lore.description: Classic single length bob with a side part.

lore.name: Side Part
lore.description: Perfect for any occasion.

lore.name: Siebe Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Utility Damage Reduction: 25% Temp. Rating: -75 / 225 °C Radiation Protection: 33600 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 147.42 REM/s Durability and a classic aesthetic combine with the Siebe helmet; designed by Caldera to thrive amidst extreme conditions found both in space and atmosphere. Resilient yet lightweight plating and an impact resistant visor provide premium protection, while an integrated monitoring system helps protect the wearer from environmental fluctuations.

lore.name: Siege
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 0 Grade: B Class: Industrial The Siege generates top-of-the-line, industrial-grade durability for your vehicle’s shield. That’s why it’s the most trusted vehicle shield component.

lore.name: SightRight Goggles
lore.description: Stegman's SightRight goggles strike a careful balance between ultralight comfort and professional-quality protection. The enhanced polycarbonate frame offers maximum eye safety with a durable scratch-resistant lens construction that also features an award-winning anti-fog coating to maintain visibility in the harshest of worksites.

lore.name: Silco Shirt
lore.description: With a sleek design and durable material, the Silco Shirt by Habidash is a comfortable shirt that can be conveniently worn either as an undershirt or on its own.

lore.name: Silicon
lore.description: A strong and brittle element with good thermal conductivity. Crystalizes in a diamond form.

lore.name: Silnex
lore.description: An advanced silica ceramic developed by early RSI researchers to allow ships to better withstand atmospheric reentry.

lore.name: Silverton Jacket AA Collections
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU When you're on the frontier, you need reliable clothing that won't fray when the going gets tough. That's why DMC made the Silverton jacket with double-stitched, element-resistant leather and plenty of roomy pockets so you can keep your supplies on hand. With the Silverton, you'll be prepared for anything. The AA Collections edition is olive green with bold white lettering across the chest showcasing that the wearer was a part of Alliance Aid's Collections Division, assisting Levski during their time of need.

lore.name: Silverton Pants CFP
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Made with a sturdy blend of tough and flexible materials, the Silverton pants are the perfect fit for someone who needs heavy-duty workwear without sacrificing mobility. Got a job to do? We've got you covered. The CFP edition is a deep fjord blue with black accents.

lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Made with a sturdy blend of tough and flexible materials, the Silverton pants are the perfect fit for someone who needs heavy-duty workwear without sacrificing mobility. Got a job to do? We've got you covered.

lore.name: Singe Cannon (S1)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Banu Item Type: Tachyon Cannon Size: 1 Made popular by a Banu souli, the Singe tachyon cannon consistently delivers devastating energy damage across vast distances. Though slow to fire, the lightning-fast tachyon projectile strikes targets almost instantaneously, making the Singe a favorite choice for Banu security ships. Although the Banu have long forgotten the origin of this high tech weapon, several unique design choices have led scholars to suspect that the Banu might have appropriated the tech into their culture, instead of inventing it themselves.

lore.name: Sinkhole Backpack
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Backpack Carrying Capacity: 105K µSCU Core Compatibility: Medium & Heavy Stop lugging all your loot by hand. The Sinkhole backpack gives you plenty of space to store everything you need, while leaving your hands free for whatever mischief you have in mind.

lore.name: Sion "Scorched" Compensator2
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Ballistic Compensator Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 2 Spread: -10% Projectile Speed: -12.5% Aim Recoil: -20% Visual Recoil: -40% Damage: -10% Maintain accuracy by countering muzzle rise with the Sion Compensator2. ArmaMod's expertly designed S2 barrel attachment efficiently expels gasses to keep every shot on target. The Scorched edition features a unique flame patina.

lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Ballistic Compensator Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 1 Aim Recoil: +35% Visual Recoil: -30% Recoil Time: -33% Fire Rate: +12.5% Maintain accuracy by countering muzzle rise with the Sion Compensator1. ArmaMod's expertly designed S1 barrel attachment efficiently expels gasses to keep every shot on target. This "Tweaker" version has been unofficially modified for a faster fire rate.

ArmaMod's expertly designed S2 barrel attachment efficiently expels gasses to keep every shot on target. This "Tweaker" version has been unofficially modified for a smoother firing experience.

lore.name: Siren
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Wei-Tek Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Military Recent changes by Wei-Tek to the alloys used in the Siren have improved its performance without sacrificing durability, making it a respectable military-grade quantum drive.

lore.name: Six-Sided Rotating Die Orange
lore.description: This orange six-sided die houses a rotating core that features the numbers one through six. When rolled along a surface, a random number will display on the upper face of the die as the rotating core comes to rest.

lore.name: Six-Sided Rotating Die Red
lore.description: This red six-sided die houses a rotating core that features the numbers one through six. When rolled along a surface, a random number will display on the upper face of the die as the rotating core comes to rest.

lore.name: Six-Sided Rotating Die White
lore.description: This white six-sided die houses a green rotating core that features the numbers one through six. When rolled along a surface, a random number will display on the upper face of the die as the rotating core comes to rest.

lore.name: Sizi Knife
lore.description: Manufacturer: Banu Item Type: Knife Class: Melee Size: 16 cm With its trailing point tip, curved belly, and sturdy spine, the Sizi knife was crafted with meticulous attention to detail, balance, and usability. Featuring an intricate Banu design, additional chromium was added to the metal to ensure long-term resistance against corrosion.

lore.name: Skellig Pants Dark
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Get down and dirty with CBD's Skellig-wear. These utility pants feature durable vinyl-composite material with reinforced ridged kneepads.

lore.name: Skullcap Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Helmet Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Doomsday's latest in headgear marries subtle practicality with the company's signature edge. This helmet features all the standard protection you could hope for, including subtle built-in filtration system along the tough, hand-molded skeletal mask, thick but lightweight metal protecting your real skull, as well as premium eye protection unaffected by the stylishly ominous red LEDs.

lore.name: Skyhigh City T-Shirt White
lore.description: There's no need for ground when each of Orison's platforms is outfitted with special thrusters to maintain a constant elevation. This shirt features a stylized shot of Orison's famous floating platforms sitting comfortably among the clouds.

lore.name: Slacker T-Shirt
lore.description: Announce your apathy in this Gutterwash tee. Or don't. Like it'll really make a difference either way. CBD out. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: SLAM
lore.description: Most commonly ingested as a gas. Vials of SLAM are cracked and inhaled. Initially developed as a performance enhancer for athletes, SLAM targets the user's nervous system acting as a fear-inhibitor and painkiller. Once the severe physical side effects were discovered, the drug went underground and found popularity among mercs and outlaws who relied on it to provide that slight edge in combat. Unfortunately, SLAM is also heavily addictive, so many of these mercs ended up getting burned out on the drug. Heavy-duty SLAM junkies are easily identifiable in public; they have ‘the shakes’ -- involuntary muscle twitches. Important to note that this is not a sign of withdrawal, simply a side effect.

lore.name: Slayer Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Hurston Dynamics Item Type: Ballistic Cannon Size: 5 Designed specifically for the Nova tank, Hurston Dynamics' Slayer ballistic cannon earned its illustrious reputation through countless battlefield engagements during the Second Tevarin War. This battlefield beast excels against armored targets and fortified emplacements by firing large caliber artillery rounds with astounding accuracy and velocity. Hurston worked closely with Tumbril when the tank manufacturer decided to bring back the Nova. Though they painstakingly honored the original Slayer design, Hurston also updated it for the 30th century by improving the pivot speed, heat resistance, and associated software to provide a state-of-the-art gunner UI.

lore.name: Sledge I Mass Driver Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Mass Driver Cannon Size: 1 Take down distant targets with the Sledge I Mass Driver Cannon. Klaus & Werner utilized railgun technology to accurately fire high damage ballistic projectiles over long distances. Be sure to make every shot count though, as the weapon sacrifices rate of fire for raw, devastating damage.

lore.name: Sledge II Ammo Box
lore.description: Ammunition case for Klaus & Werner's Sledge II.

lore.name: Sledge II Mass Driver Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Mass Driver Cannon Size: 2 The Klaus & Werner Sledge II Mass Driver Cannon is a 60mm hard-ammo ballistic weapon capable of firing multiple types of ammunition. This weapon’s increased shield penetration capabilities comes at a cost, however; magazine space is limited, and ammunition must be replenished regularly. Because it does not use energy-based projectiles, the K&W mass driver has a reduced power cost and therefore results in a reduced EM signature.

lore.name: Sledge II Mass Driver Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Mass Driver Cannon Size: 2 The Klaus & Werner Sledge II Mass Driver Cannon is a hard-hitting ballistic weapon capable of firing multiple types of ammunition. This weapon’s increased shield penetration capabilities comes at a cost, however. Magazine space is limited, so ammunition must be replenished regularly. Because it does not use energy-based projectiles, the K&W mass driver has a reduced power cost and therefore results in a reduced EM signature.

lore.name: Sledge III Mass Driver Cannon
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Item Type: Mass Driver Cannon Size: 3 The Sledge III is the size three variant of Klaus & Werner's popular mass driver cannon series. Though slow to fire, the weapon successfully blends the company's philosophy of simple design with cutting edge railgun technology to fire ballistic projectiles with surgical precision at range.

lore.name: Slick Back Fade
lore.description: A high fade with long, slicked back locks.

lore.name: Slickdry Waders
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 400 µSCU The popular Slickdry Waders by Alejo Brothers are a combination of pants and boots made of a synthetic hydrophobic material and ensure the wearer will stay dry even if just stepping out of a river.

lore.name: Slicked Side Part
lore.description: Slicked back and stylish.

lore.name: Slipstream
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Stealth Tyler Design & Tech uses an expensive alloy on its Slipstream power plant to reduce its overall emissions. This design choice is key to making this small power plant’s detectable signature one of the lowest on the market.

lore.name: Slugger Heavy Armor
lore.description: Be an immovable force with Kastak Arm's Slugger heavy armor. Its resilient armor plating and variety of attachment points are designed to withstand attacks long enough to give you the opportunity to react and respond to combat on your own terms.

lore.name: Slugger Heavy Armor
lore.description: Be an immovable force with Kastak Arm's Slugger heavy armor. Its resilient armor plating and variety of attachment points are designed to withstand attacks long enough to give you the opportunity to react and respond to combat on your own terms.

lore.name: Slugger Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -80 / 105 °C Radiation Protection: 52800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 251.1 REM/s Seems like common knowledge to place the most protection on the most vital parts, right? Kastak Arms' Slugger helmet doublesdown on that approach. This heavy combat helmet features multiple layers of composite armor types providing maximum protection against everything from environments to weapon fire. Although field of view may be slightly compromised, the Slugger will keep you alive long enough to see your enemy.

lore.name: Small Artifact Fragment (Damaged)
lore.description: A small artifact fragment of unknown origin and made of an unidentified material. Broken and considered damaged, it features intricate etchings that subtly glow.

lore.name: Small Artifact Fragment (Flawed)
lore.description: A small artifact fragment of unknown origin and made of an unidentified material. Broken and considered in flawed condition, it features intricate etchings that subtly glow green.

lore.name: Small Artifact Fragment (Pristine)
lore.description: A small artifact fragment of unknown origin and made of an unidentified material. Though broken, it's otherwise considered in pristine condition, and features intricate etchings that subtly glow green.

lore.name: SmartGen
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Military The no-frills SmartGen is A&R’s entry-level large power plant that delivers solid performance for the price.

lore.name: Smoltz (Bottle)
lore.description: HEI: 18 Effects: Cognitive Impairment, Dehydrating Crafted from select rice and barley for a traditional flavor passed down by generations of brewmasters. That’s the taste of Smoltz.

lore.name: Smoltz (Pint)
lore.description: HEI: 20 Effects: Cognitive Impairment, Dehydrating Crafted from select rice and barley for a traditional flavor passed down by generations of brewmasters. That’s the taste of Smoltz.

lore.name: Smoltz Light (Bottle)
lore.description: HEI: 18 Effects: Cognitive Impairment, Dehydrating Crafted from select rice and barley for a traditional flavor passed down by generations of brewmasters. That’s the taste of Smoltz Light.

lore.name: Snaggle Protein Stick (Pepper^3)
lore.description: NDR: 14 Effects: Hypertrophic, Dehydrating Snag one of these premium protein sticks and experience the ultimate in "real meat" snacking. Pepper Pepper Pepper Snaggle sticks deliver a triple blast of intense pepper flavor guaranteed to wangjangle your taste buds.

lore.name: Snaggle Stick (New Austin Bold)
lore.description: NDR: 14 Effects: Hypertrophic, Dehydrating Snag one of these premium protein sticks and experience the ultimate in "real meat" snacking. New Austin Bold Snaggle sticks feature that sweet and spicy tang the city is famous for.

lore.name: Snaggle Stick (Original)
lore.description: NDR: 14 Effects: Hypertrophic, Dehydrating Snag one of these premium protein sticks and experience the ultimate in "real meat" snacking. Original Snaggle sticks feature a classic blend of smoke and spices for a pure boost of flavor energy.

lore.name: Snaggle Stick (Smoke Daddy)
lore.description: NDR: 14 Effects: Hypertrophic, Dehydrating Snag one of these premium protein sticks and experience the ultimate in "real meat" snacking. Smoke Daddy Snaggle sticks feature an extra blast of intense smoky flavor that delivers satisfaction.

lore.name: Snaggle Stick (Tikoro Bite)
lore.description: NDR: 14 Effects: Hypertrophic, Dehydrating Snag one of these premium protein sticks and experience the ultimate in "real meat" snacking. Tikoro Bite Snaggle sticks up the heat with a signature spice blend that'll have you sweating through your helmet.

lore.name: Snapback Boots
lore.description: Vibrant light green leather and bold metallic accents bring an eye catching look to the Snapback boots. Grindstone Boots' classic thick, cushioned sole and an odor absorbing insole are complemented by a steel toe, magnetic clasps protecting the laces, and a metallic counter for additional support.

lore.name: Snapper S2 Repeater
lore.description: With its rapid rate of fire and high-intensity heat per blast, the Snapper laser repeater builds on the standards of its kind and improves on them with its combination of components from a range of other guns.

lore.name: Snarling Vanduul Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Helmet Damage Reduction: 10% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s With the Snarling Vanduul helmet, CC's Conversions developed a special space-age vulcanized silicone rubber to replicate everything from the Vanduul's menacing smile to the ridges on the back of its head. Molded over a lightweight flight helmet, this Vanduul visage is wearable both in and out of atmosphere, allowing you to be the ultimate space invader wherever you celebrate Day of the Vara.

lore.name: SnowBlind
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Tyler Design & Tech Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Stealth An IR signature that is running hot is a surefire way to alert the entire sector to your whereabouts and can often potentially prove to be dangerous. With the Tyler Design & Tech Snowblind cooling system onboard you can significantly reduce your heat emissions while keeping your ship running within optimal thermal conditions.

lore.name: Snowfall
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Industrial Few things can be as damaging to your ship over time as excess heat build up. The Juno Starwerk Snowfall cooler helps ensure that your ship stays the right temperature for longer, which means that you can keep flying for longer.

lore.name: Snowpack

lore.name: SNSR5

The Tarsus Sojourn quantum drive takes all the worry out of quantum travel so that you can focus on what’s important, the journey.

lore.name: Spark I Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Firestorm Kinetics Tracking Signal: Cross Section Size: 1 Those that believe size doesn’t matter would do well to stay clear of the Firestorm Kinetics Spark. Using cross section targeting, this lightweight proximity missile packs a considerable punch.

lore.name: SparkFire

lore.name: SparkJet

lore.name: SparkJet Pro
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Lighting Power Ltd. Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Civilian Looking to upgrade your power plant on a budget? Lightning Power Ltd's SparkJet Pro gives you reliability across the board, making it a solid choice to get you out and flying.

lore.name: Sparrer Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -35 / 65 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Kastak Arm's Sparrer helmet features a single-sheet laminate covering with reinforced understructure to protect against impact and penetration, but is mostly known for its projected HUD elements, which, while providing valuable tactical data, also provides an intimidating sight for would-be enemies.

lore.name: Sparrer Light Armor
lore.description: When evasion is essential, Kastak Arm's Sparrer armor won't drag you down. Its patented lightweight weave is sufficiently strong to maintain the suit's integrity long enough for you to get where you need to go.

lore.name: Sparrer Light Armor
lore.description: When evasion is essential, Kastak Arm's Sparrer armor won't drag you down. Its patented lightweight weave is sufficiently strong to maintain the suit's integrity long enough for you to get where you need to go.

lore.name: Spartan Polar Camo Livery

lore.name: Spartan Ranger Livery
lore.description: With its camo green paint scheme, the Spartan Ranger livery is an ideal choice when traveling and deploying troops in verdant fields or forests.

lore.name: Spartan Sidewinder Livery
lore.description: Blend into rocky, desert landscapes with the Sidewinder livery for the Spartan.

lore.name: Spartan Snowstorm Livery
lore.description: Primarily white with grey and black accents, the Snowstorm livery for the Spartan gives this troop transport a crisp and cool look.

lore.name: Spartan Stormbringer Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the 2951 IAE with this custom Spartan livery. Blending blue and black with white accents, the paint scheme gives the ship an electric new look.

lore.name: Spearhead GVI-CS Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Tracking Signal: Cross Section Size: 1 (Ground Vehicle Only) Behring specifically designed the Spearhead line of missiles for ground vehicles. The company's rigorous testing and renowned precision ensures that this missile will elevate your surface-to-air defensive capabilities.

lore.name: Spectre

Expertly crafted by RAMP, this quantum drive disperses heat and hides IR and EM signatures to make it a great small component for those that want to go unnoticed.

lore.name: Spettro Shoes

lore.name: Spirit ArcCorp Livery

lore.name: Spirit Ardent Livery

lore.name: Spirit Crimson Livery
lore.description: Strike a bold impression with this deep red paint scheme featuring an enlarged Crusader logo angling across both wings.

lore.name: Spirit Crusader Livery
lore.description: The Crusader livery for the Spirit features the company's logo atop a light blue base paint with black and white highlights.

lore.name: Spirit Deck the Hull Livery
lore.description: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.

lore.name: Spirit Hazard Livery
lore.description: Make the Spirit stand out with the Hazard livery featuring a bright yellow base paint and diagonal black stripes.

lore.name: Spirit Headhunters Reaper Livery
lore.description: The Headhunters Reaper livery lets you proudly proclaim your allegiance to the gang. It features the gang's name and highlights in red on a beige and grey paint scheme.

lore.name: Spirit Hurston Livery

lore.name: Spirit IceBreak Livery
lore.description: Equip your Spirit with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

lore.name: Spirit Intrepid Livery
lore.description: Featuring a matte moss green with dusty orange highlights and accent stripes, this livery ensures your Crusader Spirit is one to watch.

lore.name: Spirit microTech Livery
lore.description: The microTech livery for the Spirit features the company's logo atop a white base paint with light blue and grey highlights.

lore.name: Spirit of the Starman Statue
lore.description: Originally commissioned for the UEE Navy recruitment center in New York City on Earth, 'Spirit of the Starman' proudly displays an unnamed pilot, serving as a reminder of the solidarity and sacrifice the Empire's military demonstrate everyday as they serve as guardians of freedom and justice, and champions of honor and valor.

lore.name: Spirit Olympia Livery
lore.description: Exude understated elegance with the Olympia livery for the Spirit. The beautiful and bold black and gold paint scheme makes sure you'll be remembered.

lore.name: Spirit Radiant Livery
lore.description: Let the sight of the Spirit burn brightly with the Radiant livery, which is a vibrant yellow with black highlights.

lore.name: Spirit Resolute Livery
lore.description: With a dual tone grey body and steel blue trim, this subtle livery will ensure you Crusader Spirit is worth a second look.

lore.name: Spirit Ruby Livery
lore.description: The deep red of this livery enhances the already bold lines of the Crusader Spirit, while the subtle taupe and navy highlights give it extra panache.

lore.name: Spirit Stalwart Livery
lore.description: The Stalwart livery gives the Spirit a look that is blue as the sky with subtle white and red highlights.

lore.name: Spirit Valor Livery
lore.description: Where ever your mission takes you, this livery featuring dark grey with sky blue highlights and white trim will make sure that your Crusader Spirit looks the part.

lore.name: Spruce Cap Kel-To
lore.description: Lightweight and constructed from a sweat absorbant material that is easy to wash, Stegman's Spruce cap is ideal for comfortable all day wear.

lore.name: Spyglass
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Blue Triangle Inc. Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Stealth Designed to help you remain undetected by hostile parties, the Spyglass radar operates with lower emissions while still giving you the full picture.

lore.name: SRV Dark Storm Livery
lore.description: Black with yellow highlights, the Dark Storm livery gives the SRV a sleek yet discreet look.

lore.name: SRV Lovestruck Livery

lore.name: SRV Overcast Livery
lore.description: Have your SRV looking good on recovery operations with the Overcast livery, which is white with black highlights.

lore.name: SRV Sky Blue Livery
lore.description: The Sky Blue livery is a striking light blue that helps make it easily seen during space-based operations.

lore.name: Star Kitten Damon Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -61 / 91 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Celebrate your love of Genady Kuzo's classic Star Kitten cartoon with this commemorative helmet from Sakura Sun. The custom molding for this medium helmet faithfully recreates the show's icon character design without sacrificing its defensive capabilities. Integrated accent lights provide pops of color and highlight the helmet's unique silhouette. The helmet is sure to be a collectible among fans of the show and unusual armor enthusiasts. The Star Kitten Damon edition is primarily black to look like Sally's close friend who constantly tempts her to join his mischievous adventures.

lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Integrated accent lights provide pops of color and highlight the helmet's unique silhouette. The pink Star Kitten helmet is sure to be a collectible among fans of the show and unusual armor enthusiasts.

lore.name: Star Kitten Mug
lore.description: The cuteness can't be contained but hot beverages can be with this Star Kitten mug. Personally designed by the character's legendary creator Genady Kuzo, it features an extra large handle that makes it easy to hold and is constructed with an ultra-durable ceramic so its adorableness won't chip or fade away.

The Star Kitten Sally edition is white to look like the show's good-natured main character.

lore.name: StarBurn
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: ACOM Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Competition The StarBurn power plant is another excellent addition to the ACOM line of components. This medium-sized component delivers solid performance without overheating, so you won't risk burning your hands while making important repairs on the fly.

lore.name: Starfarer Black Livery
lore.description: Customize your Starfarer with this black chrome livery.

lore.name: Starfarer Foundation Guide Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Starfarer Light Grey Livery
lore.description: Customize your Starfarer with this light grey livery.

lore.name: Starfarer Storm Surge Livery
lore.description: Customize your Starfarer with this fragmented blue livery.

lore.name: Stark Compensator1
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Compensator Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 1 Recoil Time: +10% Fire Rate: -20% Damage: +17.5% Redirecting gases from the barrel to increase the force of bullet impact, this Stark Compensator1 slows the rate of fire but significantly increases damage output.

lore.name: Stark Compensator2
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Compensator Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 2 Aim Time: +7.5% Spread: +15% Aim Recoil: -25% Visual Recoil: -35% The Stark Compensator2 disperses energy more evenly from the gun barrel to counteract recoil, helping you stay sure and steady with every shot.

lore.name: Stark Compensator3
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Compensator Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 3 Spread: +30% Projectile Speed: +7.5% Fire Rate: +15% Damage: +7.5% Designed by ArmaMod to cycle rounds quicker, the Stark Compensator3 amplifies the speed in which the bullets leave the chamber in exchange for reduced accuracy.

lore.name: Starlancer ArcCorp Livery
lore.description: The ArcCorp livery for the Starlancer features the company's logo atop a maroon base paint with black and yellow highlights.

lore.name: Starlancer Atlantic Livery

lore.name: Starlancer Pacific Livery

lore.name: Starlite Bonfire Livery

lore.name: Starlite Mojave Livery

lore.name: Steadfast
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 0 Grade: C Class: Industrial When the road ahead is long, Juno Starwerk’s Steadfast power plant is there to see you and your vehicle through to the end by providing on-demand power and durability.

lore.name: Steel
lore.description: An alloy of iron and carbon, this ancient material is still in uses thanks to its affordable price and high tensile strength.

lore.name: Stella Fortuna '54 Coin
lore.description: With Stella Fortuna 2954 on one side and the other featuring a lucky clover embossed with the words ‘Tempt Fate,’ this golden coin dares anyone to take luck into their own hands.

lore.name: Stellate
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 4 Grade: Bespoke Class: Civilian Sakura Sun worked with Origin to fine tune the Stellate into the perfect power plant for the 890 Jump, providing the power and performance necessary for a ship of such grand design.

lore.name: Sterne Katzen AG Hornisse-36
lore.description: Sterne Katzen AG known about protection. With their low emissions bubble shield the Hornisse-36, you'll keep attacks at bay while keeping your sig low.

lore.name: Steward
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Industrial The Steward is Basilisk’s entry-level industrial shield generator. Its reinforced housing adds an extra level of durability to an already robust system, guaranteeing that your shield will be projecting even in the harshest conditions.

lore.name: Stileron
lore.description: This metal is ideally suited to the rigors of physical-based warfare. It is favored by defense manufacturers in armor construction for its ability to take a beating. However, it does not handle distortion well and is notoriously difficult to refine.

lore.name: Stileron (Ore)
lore.description: This metal is ideally suited to the rigors of physical-based warfare. It is favored by defense manufacturers in armor construction for its ability to take a beating. However, it does not handle distortion well and is notoriously difficult to refine.

lore.name: Stims
lore.description: Composed of various combinations of tobacco, caffeine, and mood-enhancer, stims are smoked as a cigarette.

lore.name: Stinger Black Widow Livery
lore.description: Sink your claws into your prey with the black and deep reds of the Esperia Stinger's Black Widow livery.

lore.name: Stinger Deathstalker Livery
lore.description: Bring pain to the battlefield on bronze-clad wings with the Deathstalker livery for the Esperia Stinger.

lore.name: Stinger Insularis Livery
lore.description: The Insularis livery adds a sleek, ethereal teal and patina metal finish to emphasize and celebrate the otherworldly nature of the Stinger.

lore.name: Stinger Mamba Livery
lore.description: Your enemies will never see you coming with the black-on-black Mamba livery for the Esperia Stinger.

lore.name: Stinger Meridian Livery
lore.description: The Meridian livery gives the Stinger a simple yet stylish metallic silver finish.

lore.name: Stinger Pit Viper Livery
lore.description: The Pit Viper livery for the Esperia Stinger features metallic green plating accented with dark bronze.

lore.name: Stingray Domain Camo Livery
lore.description: The Domain Camo livery consists of various shades of grays in a digital camo pattern.

lore.name: Stingray Manta Livery
lore.description: The Manta livery features fiery orange accents that cut through the otherwise solid black hull.

lore.name: Stingray Marina Livery
lore.description: Featuring thin, fluid lines resembling gills, the Marina's blues and golds bring an aquatic theme to the Stingray.

lore.name: Stingray Protocol Livery
lore.description: Crisp whites contrast against a deep black in the Protocol livery, completed with an eye-catching red that follows the smooth edges of the Stingray.

lore.name: Stir Fry Vegetables and Beef Omni Pack
lore.description: NDR: 56 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic Omni Packs use premium certified organic ingredients to create a complete balanced ready-to-eat meal with a premium taste.

lore.name: Stirling Exploration Backpack
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Backpack Carrying Capacity: 180K µSCU Core Compatibility: Heavy This heavy duty backpack is compatible with the Stirling suit and provides a convenient storage solution.

lore.name: Stirling Exploration Backpack Alkaline Edition
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Backpack Carrying Capacity: 180K µSCU Core Compatibility: Heavy This heavy duty backpack is compatible with the Stirling suit and provides a convenient storage solution. Influenced by refined ores, the Alkaline Edition fuses black, bronze, and gray accents.

The ASD Edition was contracted specifically by Associated Science & Development to provide protection for their scientists working in laboratories with radioactive materials.

lore.name: Stirling Exploration Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Utility Damage Reduction: 25% Temp. Rating: -75 / 225 °C Radiation Protection: 33600 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 147.42 REM/s Designed to withstand inhospitable environments, the Stirling Exploration Suit provides a base level of protection from environmental hazards including radiation. Combining Caldera's advanced insulation fabrics with sophisticated polymers, the Stirling is able to safeguard the wearer whilst minimizing disruption to movement. Additionally, a self-cleaning system automatically activates after radiation exposure to expunge dangerous excess down to nominal levels. This helmet is only compatible with the Stirling Exploration Suit.

lore.name: Stitcher Arms
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -52 / 82 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Dress to impress in scrapheap chic! The Stitcher armor might look like it's held together with tape and good intentions but we swear it's space safe. The intentional ramshackle design features a funky double collar, plenty of storage, and a ribbed industrial hose attached to a metal cylinder on the back just for the hell of it.

lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. lore.name: Stoic Suppressor1
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Suppressor Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 1 Spread: +20% Horizontal Aim Recoil: -45% Vertical Aim Recoil: -15% Visual Recoil: -33% Recoil Time: -20% Audible Range: -33% Featuring a more spacious chamber that widens shot spread, the Stoic Suppressor1's increased size reduces noise while allowing for superior recoil control.

lore.name: Stoic Suppressor2
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Suppressor Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 2 Aim Time: +12.5% Spread: -12.5% Horizontal Aim Recoil: -45% Vertical Aim Recoil: -15% Visual Recoil: -33% Recoil Time: -5% Audible Range: -33% Using a more heavyweight barrel attachment for increased control, the longer chamber of the Stoic Suppressor2 grants reduced noise and increased accuracy at the cost of slower responsiveness.

lore.name: Stoic Suppressor3
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Suppressor Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 3 Aim Time: -10% Spread Max: -50% Aim Recoil: -25% Audible Range: -33% As the largest suppressor in the series, the Stoic Suppressor3's heavy duty design reduces noise and recoil, while tightening shot spread.

lore.name: Stone Bug Shell
lore.description: Known to curl into a tight ball when threatened, the stone bug is sought after for its tough shell, which can be removed and used as a durable material that has even been utilized in certain armor composites.

lore.name: Stoneskin Helmet Desert
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Helmet Damage Reduction: 15% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Kastak Arms' Stoneskin series is built upon CDS' famous TCS-4 system based on extensive feedback from the operators who rely on this technology in the field. The Stoneskin is set to rival competitors as a rugged and reliable helmet.

lore.name: Stoneskin Helmet Tactical
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Helmet Damage Reduction: 15% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Kastak Arms' Stoneskin series is built upon CDS' famous TCS-4 system based on extensive feedback from the operators who rely on this technology in the field. The Stoneskin is set to rival competitors as a rugged and reliable helmet.

lore.name: Stoneskin Undersuit
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% Kastak Arms' Stoneskin series of combat undersuits are built upon CDS' famous TCS-4 system based on extensive feedback from the operators who rely on this technology in the field. Offering a myriad of options for armor and EVA capabilities, the Stoneskin is set to rival CDS as a rugged and reliable undersuit.

lore.name: Stoneskin Undersuit
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% Kastak Arms' Stoneskin is a combat undersuit that are built upon CDS' famous TCS-4 system based on extensive feedback from the operators who rely on this technology in the field. Offering a myriad of options for armor and EVA capabilities, the Stoneskin is set to rival CDS as a rugged and reliable undersuit.

lore.name: STOP
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Civilian Utilizing a design that has proven itself time and again, the STOP shield generator by Seal Corporation has featured the same classic design for years due to its consistent, stellar performance.

lore.name: Stor*All 1 SCU Self-Storage Container
lore.description: Designed by one of the most trusted names in cargo pods, the Stor*All Self-Storage Container provides a convenient place to keep anything too cumbersome to carry on your person. Its durable impact-resistant construction is sealed to survive the vacuum of space.

lore.name: Stor*All 1/8 SCU Storage Box
lore.description: Designed by one of the most trusted names in cargo pods, the Stor*All Storage Box provides a convenient place to keep any small items. Its durable impact-resistant construction is sealed to survive the vacuum of space.

lore.name: Stor*All Big Box Model A
lore.description: Manufacturer: Stor*All Item Type: Storage Made with the same rugged construction techniques as the smaller 5 ton model, the Stor*All model A Big Box cargo pod upgrade for the Aurora doubles the available cargo space. (Replaces default cargo option.)

lore.name: Stor*All Big Box Model H
lore.description: Manufacturer: Stor*All Item Type: Storage Designed exclusively for the Hornet F7C, the Stor*All Big Box model H replaces the void left by the turret system of the military-spec craft with a respectable cargo hold. Transforming the flagship fighter of the UEEN into a durable hauling ship.

lore.name: Stor*All Big Box Model H2
lore.description: Manufacturer: Stor*All Item Type: Storage Designed for the Hornet F7C Mk II, the Stor*All Big Box model H2 replaces the turret system of the military-spec craft with a respectable cargo hold.

lore.name: Stor*All Mini
lore.description: Manufacturer: Stor*All Item Type: Storage The 5 ton Stor*All Mini cargo pod allows the enterprising Aurora pilot to begin his business in the commodities transportation sector. It has a double wall and pressurized construction that can withstand the rigors of space or the occasional laser blast.

lore.name: Storage Container Access Card
lore.description: A single use access code for a Nine Tails' storage container.

lore.name: Storm Darkside Livery
lore.description: The Darkside livery gives the Storm a black and grey camouflage pattern to make it hard to see in low light situations.

lore.name: Storm Frost Line Livery
lore.description: White with grey accents, the Frost Line livery for the Storm is ideal for blending in with cold weather regions.

lore.name: Storm GCD-Army Livery
lore.description: In honor of the soldiers who protect the Empire, Tumbril crafted this limited-edition GCD-Army livery for the Storm. The golden seal of the UEE army and gold highlights stand out against the grey camo base paint.

lore.name: Storm Landfall Livery
lore.description: Ready the Storm for adventures through forests and grasslands with the Landfall livery with its various shades of green.

lore.name: Storm Summit Livery
lore.description: The Summit is a two-tone livery for the Storm with a white front half and grey back half.

lore.name: Stormburst Bomb
lore.description: Manufacturer: FireStorm Kinetics Item Type: Explosive Bomb Size: 5 Wreak havoc on ground forces from the skies above, with the Stormburst. Designed by FireStorm Kinetics to maximize destructive impact at a more moderate size, these S5 bombs feature a mixed composite ordnance to decimate armored targets. The Stormburst also utilizes FireStorm Kinetics' patented Atmo-Xact fins to ensure the payload reaches its target.

lore.name: Stormwal Sculpture Replica
lore.description: With careful attention to detail, this scaled down version of the famed "Until Again" sculpture that graces Orison's skyline captures the majesty and grace of the endangered stormwal.

lore.name: STR-E2 Gimbal Mount
lore.description: Item Type: Gimbal Mount Manufacturer: Kruger Intergalactic Size: 2 This custom made gimbal mount for the Stingray is able to support up to S2 weaponry and allows for adaptive targeting.

lore.name: Straight Caesar
lore.description: A straight version of the Caesar.

lore.name: Strata Arms
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -61 / 91 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Made for miners but ready for any adventure, Greycat Industrial's Strata armor provides premium protection and convenient features. Each piece features an angular and precise design to deliver coverage where it's most needed most. A toolbelt with convenient pouches and a reinforced backpack offers plenty of storage. The award-winning helmet design has been copied by other manufacturers, but the original still reigns supreme with its high quality materials and next-gen air filtration system that enables clean breathing whether in a deep mine or hostile atmospheres.

Rating: -50 / 80 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Made for miners but ready for any adventure, Greycat Industrial's Strata armor provides premium protection and convenient features. Each piece features an angular and precise design to deliver coverage where it's most needed most. A toolbelt with convenient pouches and a reinforced backpack offers plenty of storage. The award-winning helmet design features high quality materials and a next-gen air filtration system that enables clean breathing whether in a deep mine or hostile atmospheres. The Crusader Black variant was made specifically for the company.
