lore.name: TruHold Tractor Beam Attachment
lore.description: MUST BUY BASE MULTI-TOOL TO USE: "Pyro RYT Multi-Tool" Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Multi-Tool Attachment Class: Tractor Beam Whether your feet are on the floor or floating in zero-G, the TruHold attachment for the Pyro RYT Multi-Tool makes lifting and positioning items easier than ever. With its impressive and efficient pull/draw ratio and easy-to-read range finder, the TruHold can be used solo or paired with other beams to tackle heavier targets. Plus, the TruHold has the added benefit of functioning as a personal zero-G traversal device when coupled to an object with a high enough mass.

lore.name: TS-2
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Wei-Tek Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Military Advanced protective plating provides the TS-2 with superior durability and protection against the elements and aggressors, making it an ideal quantum drive for those moments when danger calls.

lore.name: TS-2
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Wei-Tek Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Military Advanced protective plating provides the TS-2 with superior durability and protection against the elements and aggressors, making it an ideal quantum drive for those moments when danger calls.

lore.name: TS-25 Basara (2.5x Telescopic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Type: Telescopic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 2.5x - 5x Aim Time: +5% Parallax: Low Size: 2 Utilizing the precise and immaculately crafted lenses that Klaus & Werner are known for, the TS-25 Basara provides unparalleled clarity and accuracy when equipped.

lore.name: TS-35 Basara (3.5x Telescopic)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Klaus & Werner Type: Telescopic Attachment Point: Optic Magnification: 3x - 5.5x Aim Time: +5% Parallax: Low Size: 2 The TS-35 Basara continues to expand on the high quality of the Basara series, by adding enhanced magnification to the sights, without compromising on quality.

lore.name: Tulsi Jacket Conifer
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU This Tulsi jacket features an outer shell designed to cut down on wind shear and an inner shell made to retain warmth without sacrificing comfort. For ease of use, it also features an gentle-glide zipper with a secure top stop and roomy pockets that guarantee you'll always have what you need on hand.

lore.name: Tumbler Glass
lore.description: A short and wide drinking vessel made from tempered glassware.

lore.name: Tumbril Hat
lore.description: Tumbril Land Systems made this hat to celebrate the release of their legendary Nova tank to the civilian market.

lore.name: Tumbril Storm AA Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Turret Manufacturer: Tumbril Land Systems A bespoke turret designed for the Tumbril Storm AA single-operator mini-tank.

lore.name: Tumbril Storm Turret
lore.description: Item Type: Turret Manufacturer: Tumbril Land Systems A bespoke turret designed for the Tumbril Storm single-operator mini-tank.

lore.name: Tumbril T-Shirt
lore.description: This orange and gray shirt displays the famed logo of Tumbril Land Systems, makers of legendary land vehicles such as the Nova tank and the Cyclone buggy. In need of a military-grade vehicle at a civilian price? Think Tumbril.

lore.name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
lore.description: NDR: 38 Effects: None Tuna salad and cucumbers on wheat bread.

lore.name: Tuna with Vegetables Omni Pack
lore.description: NDR: 70 Effects: Hypertrophic, Hypo-Metabolic Omni Packs use premium certified organic ingredients to create a complete balanced ready-to-eat meal with a premium taste.

lore.name: Tundra
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Military Constructed by Aegis with military performance in mind, the Tundra’s reliable performance has made it a standard cooler of the UEE Navy.

lore.name: Tundra
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Military Constructed by Aegis with military performance in mind, the Tundra’s reliable performance has made it a standard cooler of the UEE Navy.

lore.name: Tungsten
lore.description: Used in many different alloys, tungsten in its pure form becomes malleable while maintaining its hardness.

lore.name: Tungsten (Ore)
lore.description: Used in many different alloys, tungsten in its pure form becomes malleable while maintaining its hardness.

lore.name: TurboDrive
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Size: 2 Grade: C Class: Military The TurboDrive is a common military-grade power plant from A&R that slightly favors performance over durability and stealth.

lore.name: Turkey Sandwich
lore.description: NDR: 41 Effects: None Juicy 62°C Turkey is sliced thin and married with muhammara sauce, arugula, 4-year-old blue gouda, and crisp vermillion apple all on spelt bread. At Twyn's, it's what's inside that counts.

lore.name: Tuserac Plena (Emperor Blossom) Plant
lore.description: A member of the Tuserac family of flowers, the Emperor Blossom is one of the most recognizable indigenous plants from Terra. For most of the year, the flower is obscured, covered by what appears to be an unremarkable brown husk, similar to the Typha/Cattail of Earth. When an ideal temperature is reached, the plant enters its blooming phase: the petals peel back, revealing the striking colors underneath. Tens of thousands cross the Zaffre Bay every year for the Twilight Festival which coincides with the blooming of this beautiful flower.

lore.name: Tussock Boots Coal
lore.description: A proprietary blend of natural and artificial leather provides the Tussock Boot with unbeatable toughness, making it the perfect fit for both work and leisure.

lore.name: Tuvic Outerwear Jacket Mil-Green
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Alejo Brothers have seamlessly blended functionality and style with the Tuvic line of outerwear. These rugged jackets feature reinforced leather padding to offer additional protection and support while still maintaining a modern aesthetic. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Tuvic Outerwear Jacket Rust Society
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Proudly wear your support of the Rust Society with this custom version of Alejo Brothers' classic Tuvic Outerwear industrial jacket. The perfect companion for those long hauls and endless digs. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Tuvois Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Created in collaboration with legendary designer Avon, OpalSky is proud to unveil the Tuvois, an open vest featuring stark, bold styling that's destined to make an impression. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Twenty-Sided Die Blue
lore.description: When rolled along a surface, this blue twenty-sided die will display a numerical result on the upper face as it comes to rest.

lore.name: Twenty-Sided Die Green
lore.description: When rolled along a surface, this green twenty-sided die will display a numerical result on the upper face as it comes to rest.

lore.name: Twenty-Sided Die Red
lore.description: When rolled along a surface, this red twenty-sided die will display a numerical result on the upper face as it comes to rest.

lore.name: Twenty-Sided Die Ship Manufacturers
lore.description: When you have too many choices in your hangar, this fun novelty die is a great way to decide what to pilot. Rolled along a surface, this twenty-sided die will display the logo of a ship manufacturer or the Intergalactic Aerospace Expo. If you get the IAE logo, we suggest taking your newest vehicle out for a ride.

lore.name: Twenty-Sided Plushie Blue
lore.description: Ready to roll? Make your randomly generated numbers a little more squeezable with this plush icosahedron. Each surface of the large blue die features a different easy-to-read number.

lore.name: Twenty-Sided Plushie Green
lore.description: Ready to roll? Make your randomly generated numbers a little more squeezable with this plush icosahedron. Each surface of the large green die features a different easy-to-read number.

lore.name: Twenty-Sided Plushie Red
lore.description: Ready to roll? Make your randomly generated numbers a little more squeezable with this plush icosahedron. Each surface of the large red die features a different easy-to-read number.

lore.name: Tyche
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RSI Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian The Tyche quantum drive harmoniously balances performance, durability, and stealth to create a well-rounded component capable of adeptly handling a variety of situations.

lore.name: Tyche
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: RSI Size: 3 Grade: B Class: Civilian The Tyche quantum drive harmoniously balances performance, durability, and stealth to create a well-rounded component capable of adeptly handling a variety of situations.

lore.name: Tyger (Project Purple) Shirt
lore.description: Vaporwear's Tyger messaging shirt features the brand's distinct camo pattern with a programmable monocolor digital cloth statement strip. The all-purple and black design isn't likely to keep anyone truly camouflage in all but the most alien jungle, but it's sure to make a statement in any crowded metropolis.

lore.name: Tyilui Agapanthia Livery
lore.description: The Agapanthia edition bears a sleek black base with subtle dark gold highlights that flow down the ship's hull.

lore.name: Tyilui Ch.iing Livery
lore.description: The Ch.iing edition boasts a bold white base with eye-catching gold highlights that flow down the ship's hull.

lore.name: Tyilui Insularis Livery
lore.description: The Insularis livery adds a sleek, ethereal teal and patina metal finish to emphasize and celebrate the otherworldly nature of the Tyilui.

lore.name: Tyilui Tatomidae Livery
lore.description: The Tatomidae edition features an elegant, metallic, maroon wave-pattern across the sleek, dark hull.

lore.name: Tyilui Uamchuai Livery
lore.description: The Uamchuai edition breaks the mold with grey and sand-brown base, with flattering dusty gold highlights that flow down the ship's hull.

lore.name: Typhoon IX Torpedo
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 9 Designed by Talon, the Typhoon heat seeking strike torpedo delivers a heavy payload sure to serve as a deterrent from any further hostile actions.

lore.name: Typhoon IX-G Torpedo
lore.description: Manufacturer: Talon Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 9 Designed by Talon, the Typhoon heat seeking strike torpedo delivers a heavy payload sure to serve as a deterrent from any further hostile actions. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

lore.name: Tyros Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Tyros white synth-leather jacket from Habidash features a striking side-closure pattern with silver clasps, reinforced ribbing at the cuffs and collars, and a silver-inlaid polygonal pattern across the chest and sleeve.

lore.name: UC
lore.description: Uranium Core ammunition stabilizes uranium for portable weapon usage in small doses. Each 'magazine' contains a set charge of power with the uranium and can be safely disposed of/stored after use. When used, it controls an intense amount of radioactive energy from whatever method the radiation is disposed. The condensed radiation is powerful enough to get through most armor types except Heavy/TITAN armor.

lore.name: UDF Hat
lore.description: A blue and red cadet hat with Unified Distribution Management's name and logo emblazoned across the front and back panels.

lore.name: UDM Cargo Plushie
lore.description: Here's a haul you can hug. This plushie shaped like a cargo container features Unified Distribution Management branding with the company's logo and white and purple color scheme.

lore.name: UDM Container Model
lore.description: There's no need for a tractor beam to move this cargo container. This finely detailed model features Unified Distribution Management branding with the company's logo and white and purple color scheme.

lore.name: UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Damaged)
lore.description: A medal given to members of the UEE Marines 6th Platoon for distinguished service. The esteemed 6th Platoon 'Phantoms' have received this honor on numerous occasions, including for operations during the Second Tevarin War, on the Vanduul front and for rescuing a UEE survey team taken hostage by the Outsiders on Leir III. The discoloration of the ribbon and broken, corroded metal have left this medal in damaged condition.

lore.name: UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Pristine)
lore.description: A medal given to members of the UEE Marines 6th Platoon for distinguished service. The esteemed 6th Platoon 'Phantoms' have received this honor on numerous occasions, including for operations during the Second Tevarin War, on the Vanduul front and for rescuing a UEE survey team taken hostage by the Outsiders on Leir III. The excellent appearance of the ribbon and etchings on the observe have left this medal in pristine condition.

lore.name: UEE 6th Platoon Medal (Worn)
lore.description: A medal given to members of the UEE Marines 6th Platoon for distinguished service. The esteemed 6th Platoon 'Phantoms' have received this honor on numerous occasions, including for operations during the Second Tevarin War, on the Vanduul front and for rescuing a UEE survey team taken hostage by the Outsiders on Leir III. The discoloration of the ribbon and corroded metal have left this medal in worn condition.

lore.name: UEE Holographic Flag
lore.description: Show your empire pride with this large standing holographic UEE flag.

lore.name: UEEx T-Shirt
lore.description: Proclaim your passion for poli-rock rebels The Leedos with this lightweight and supremely soft shirt from CBD, featuring artwork from their United Empire of Extinction tour. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: Ultra-Flow
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Industrial Juno Starwerk has crafted the Ultra-Flow to not only withstand the demanding cooling needs of your ship’s systems as it works, but to do it longer and better than other coolers in its class.

lore.name: UltraFlux
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Amon & Reese Co. Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Military Initially designed under a military contract, A&R's UltraFlux medium power plant decimated the required performance milestones and enjoyed a storied career as a dependable military asset. When the military’s exclusive rights to this high quality component lapsed, A&R eagerly released this to the commercial market.

lore.name: Umbra
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Ascension Astro Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Stealth Slip through the darkness of space like a phantom with the Umbra stealth shield generator. Best when used in conjunction with other low signature components from Ascension Astro.

lore.name: Uncut SLAM
lore.description: Initially developed for athletes before being outlawed, SLAM acts as a combat performance enhancer, targeting the user's nervous system as a fear-inhibitor and painkiller. Uncut SLAM is the concentrated form of the drug, and must be diluted to non-lethal dosages before it can be packaged into dispersal vials and consumed.

lore.name: UNE Gold Ingot (Damaged)
lore.description: A heavily damaged gold ingot cast by the United Nations of Earth (UNE). These ingots were used in areas of the UNE where technological issues often hampered secure and instant money transfers. Broken but still rare, an elaborate, textured pattern is still apparent on the ingot.

lore.name: UNE Gold Ingot (Flawed)
lore.description: A gold ingot cast by the United Nations of Earth (UNE) that is rated as being in flawed condition. These ingots were used in areas of the UNE where technological issues often hampered secure and instant money transfers. This rare item features the a worn three ring, six star logo used by the UNE within a circular recess and an elaborate, textured pattern across the rest of it.

lore.name: UNE Gold Ingot (Pristine)
lore.description: A gold ingot cast by the United Nations of Earth (UNE) that has remained in pristine condition. These ingots were used in areas of the UNE where technological issues often hampered secure and instant money transfers. This rare item features the three ring, six star logo used by the UNE within a circular recess and an elaborate, textured pattern across the rest of it.

lore.name: UNE Silver Ingot (Damaged)
lore.description: A heavily damaged silver ingot cast by the United Nations of Earth (UNE). These ingots were used in areas of the UNE where technological issues often hampered secure and instant money transfers. Broken but still rare, an elaborate, textured pattern is still apparent on the ingot.

lore.name: UNE Silver Ingot (Flawed)
lore.description: A silver ingot cast by the United Nations of Earth (UNE) that is rated as being in flawed condition. These ingots were used in areas of the UNE where technological issues often hampered secure and instant money transfers. This rare item features a worn three ring, six star logo used by the UNE within a circular recess and an elaborate, textured pattern across the rest of it.

lore.name: UNE Silver Ingot (Pristine)
lore.description: A silver ingot cast by the United Nations of Earth (UNE) that has remained in pristine condition. These ingots were considered official currency and used in areas of the UNE where technological issues often hampered secure and instant money transfers. This rare item features the three ring, six star logo used by the UNE within a circular recess and an elaborate, textured pattern across the rest of it.

lore.name: UNE Unification War Medal (Damaged)
lore.description: A campaign medal from the United Nations of Earth (UNE) military that commemorates meritorious service during the Unification Wars (2380-2384). Considered to be in poor condition due to the faded ribbons colors and broken, corroded metal.

lore.name: UNE Unification War Medal (Pristine)
lore.description: A campaign medal from the United Nations of Earth (UNE) military that commemorates meritorious service during the Unification Wars (2380-2384). Considered to be in pristine condition thanks to the bright colors still present in the ribbon and well-preserved etching on the medal itself.

lore.name: UNE Unification War Medal (Worn)
lore.description: A campaign medal from the United Nations of Earth (UNE) military that commemorates meritorious service during the Unification Wars (2380-2384). Considered to be in worn condition due to the faded ribbons colors and corroded metal.

lore.name: Union Pants (Modified)
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU This version of 987's Union pants has been modified from its original form. 987 delivers comfort, durability, and style with the Union pants. Designed with a special, next-gen blend of high-performance synthetic fabrics, these pants are enduringly fashionable in these modern times.

lore.name: Union Pants Blue
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU 987 delivers comfort, durability, and style with the Union pants. Designed with a special, next-gen blend of high-performance synthetic fabrics, these pants are enduringly fashionable in these modern times.

lore.name: United Empire of Earth Mini-Flag
lore.description: Celebrate the United Empire of Earth (UEE) wherever you go by flying a holographic version of the flag. The small and sleek stands makes it an ideal accessory for a desk or ship. Featuring a vibrant blue color offset by white, this iconic symbol incorporated iconography from the previous UPE flag to represent the next phase of Humanity's united government as it grew into a massive empire.

lore.name: United Nations of Earth Mini-Flag
lore.description: Fly the flag of the first united Human government, the United Nations of Earth (UNE). First revealed in 2380, the inaugural flag design features interlocking circles symbolizing Humanity's three main populations centers (Earth, Mars, and Croshaw system) and six stars representing the ambition to continue expanding into space. This small metal stand flies a holographic version of the UNE flag, making it an ideal accessory for history buffs to place on their desk or aboard their ships.

lore.name: United Planets of Earth Mini-Flag
lore.description: This small metal stand flies a holographic flag of the United Planets of Earth (UPE). Designed in 2523 when Humanity replaced the United Nations of Earth (UNE) with a new political system better suited for its expanding governance over multiple systems. To symbolize this progression, the UPE flag kept the interlocking rings from the UNE flag while adding a circle with breaks to represent the continued desire to expand and laurel branches symbolizing the success of Humanity's space exploration.

lore.name: Unknown Item Type: Launcher Class: Rocket Magazine Size: 1 Rate Of Fire: 20 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best. Launcher Class: Rocket Magazine Size: 1 Rate Of Fire: 20 rpm Effective Range: 100 m Who's got time to aim? Once you got enough room to clear the arming distance, just point the Boomtube launcher at whatever you don't like, squeeze the trigger, and watch the triple-grenade rocket thingy take care of the rest. Sometimes simple is best.

lore.name: Uranium
lore.description: Once enriched, radioactive uranium is commonly used in energy production. Though once depleted, its hardness lends itself to structural uses like plating.

lore.name: UrbEx Boots Grey
lore.description: From bustling backstreets to crowded clubs, the UrbEx boots will make your next step a bold one. The boots blend a stylish design with reinforced high ankle support and ultra durable outsoles.

lore.name: Ursa Aja Livery
lore.description: Inspired by the hue of a medicinal plant found on Terra, the Aja livery for the Ursa is dark blue with white and grey highlights.

lore.name: Ursa Deck the Hull Livery
lore.description: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.

lore.name: Ursa Fortuna Livery
lore.description: Standard livery for the RSI Ursa Rover Fortuna.

lore.name: Ursa IceBreak Livery
lore.description: Equip your Ursa with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

lore.name: Ursa Oasis Livery
lore.description: Announce your arrival with the Oasis livery for the Ursa, which is a vibrant teal tint with grey and white accents.

lore.name: Ursa Red Livery
lore.description: Customize your RSI Ursa Rover with this red livery.

lore.name: Ursa Respite Livery
lore.description: The Respite is an exclusive livery for the Ursa, which is black and grey with white highlights.

lore.name: Ursa Skullcrusher Livery
lore.description: Exude attitude with the Skullcrusher livery for the Ursa, which features a massive skull across the top.

lore.name: Utility Grav-Cart
lore.description: Thanks to grav-lev, this utility hand truck makes carting heavy loads much easier.

lore.name: UTV Bonanza Livery
lore.description: The Bonanza livery gives the UTV a lustrous look with its gold and black finish.

lore.name: UTV Keystone Livery
lore.description: Crisp white with blue accents, the Keystone livery celebrates the workers whose mining, refining, hauling, salvaging, and more have made the empire what it is today.

lore.name: UTV Reckoner Livery
lore.description: Bright pops of orange stand out against the grey base paint of the Reckoner livery.

lore.name: UTV Resistor Camo Livery
lore.description: Light brown and grey camo combine with red highlights for the Resistor Camo livery.

lore.name: UTV Wilderness Camo Livery
lore.description: The Wilderness Camo livery brings a classic green and grey camo pattern to the UTV with red highlights.

lore.name: V60-26
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Groupe Nouveau Paradigme Size: 0 Grade: A Class: Military Providing crucial information during your operation, the V60-26 radar offers highly accurate and detailed updates on nearby emissions.

lore.name: V801-11
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: GNP Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Military Designed for the battlefield, the V801-11 is a cut above the rest thanks to the rigid, iterative testing, guaranteeing its performance when you need it most.

lore.name: V801-12
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: GNP Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Military During field operations, the GNP V801-12 radar system allows for increased strategic planning owing to its capability for detecting a wide variety of emission signatures, revealing hazards and hostiles alike.

lore.name: V880
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: Groupe Nouveau Paradigme Size: 3 Grade: A Class: Military Providing useful assistance when detecting hostiles, the V880 brings the power of military technology to the consumer market.

lore.name: Vacha Jacket Sandalwood
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 400 µSCU The Vacha jacket offers the wearer an admirable degree of comfort across a wide range of environments thanks to its sealed cuffs and utility neck collar. Additionally, the rugged design features a sealed cross closure, incorporated belt, and auxiliary ports. The garment's sheer durability and utility has cemented the Vacha jacket as a perennial favorite in Habidash's collection.

lore.name: Vacuums Kill T-Shirt
lore.description: This short sleeve shirt features the iconic warning sign found near airlocks across the universe. Wear the Vacuums Kill shirt to remind everyone of the horrors that happens when one removes their helmet in the vacuum of space.

lore.name: Vagabond Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU When you need to move like your life depends on it. This lightweight layered jacket-and-poncho combination won't tie you up when things get tight. lore.name: Valakkar Fang
lore.description: The valakkar continually sheds its teeth throughout its lifetime. As the animal burrows through the sand and catches prey, its teeth are frequently damaged. Once a new tooth finishes forming, it severs the connective tissue that was holding the old tooth in place, causing it to break off and fall to the ground. The fangs of the valakkar can also be extracted from the animal's mouth after its death. Collectors seek out the valakkar fangs for use in crafting various luxury items.

lore.name: Valakkarfang Irradiated
lore.description: The valakkar continually sheds its teeth throughout its lifetime. As the animal burrows through the sand and catches prey, its teeth are frequently damaged. Once a new tooth finishes forming, it severs the connective tissue that was holding the old tooth in place, causing it to break off and fall to the ground. The fangs of the valakkar can also be extracted from the animal's mouth after its death. This fang was exposed to radiation over a long period of time and has developed unusual coloration.

lore.name: Valakkarpearl Irradiated
lore.description: The valakkar pearl is harvested from the skin of the valakkar. As the valakkar moves through its environment, a large piece of grit will sometimes penetrate its thick hide. If the grit is unable to be expelled on its own, the valakkar's skin will grow to encase it. Layers of organic matter will then coat the piece of grit, isolating it from the valakkar's vulnerable dermis, thus ensuring that it will not cause infection. These "pearls" can become substantial in size over time. Because the valakkar that grew this pearl was exposed to radiation over a long period of time, it has developed unusual properties.

Rating: -38 / 68 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Whether you’re discovering bold new frontiers or simply stretching your legs after a long spaceflight, Robert Space Industries’ Venture Explorer Suit takes vacuum-safe wear to the next level with its incorporation of top-of-class safety features seamlessly blended with phenomenal freedom of movement. And now you no longer have to choose between exceptional styling and performance thanks to the tasteful gold detailing only available with the special limited Executive Edition.

lore.name: Venture Arms Lovestruck
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -38 / 68 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Robert Space Industries’ Venture Explorer Suit provides exceptional protection against the dangers of space. Designed for those who don't know where their next adventure might go, the suit combines comfort and safety without sacrificing mobility. This special Lovestruck edition features a stylish metallic pink and black color scheme inspired by the colors of the Coramor festival.

It also features an anti-scuff laminate faceplate that offers an unparalleled upward field of view, providing unobstructed sightlines to whatever wonders you discover.

lore.name: Vera Compensator1
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Compensator Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 1 Aim Time: +20% Spread: +35% Visual Recoil: -33% Recoil Time: -25% Ideal for operators that specialize in precision aiming, the Vera Compensator1's high density materials increases aim time in favor of reduced recoil.

lore.name: Vera Compensator2
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Compensator Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 2 Aim Time: +30% Spread: +40% Aim Recoil: -30% Visual Recoil: -30% Recoil Time: -6% Fire Rate: +6% The heavy-duty materials utilized in the Vera Compensator2 reduce recoil and increase aim time for precise, controlled bursts.

lore.name: Vera Compensator3
lore.description: Manufacturer: ArmaMod Type: Compensator Attachment Point: Barrel Size: 3 Aim Time: -35% Spread Min: -10% Spread Max: +10% Aim Recoil: +50% Recoil Time: -15% Projectile Speed: -25% Fire Rate: +15% When modified with the Vera Compensator3, your weapon will have a faster recovery time at cost of some loss of finesse allowing you to provide devastating salvos of suppressive fire.

lore.name: Vermillion Apple
lore.description: NDR: 18 HEI: 06 Effects: Hydrating This crisp and sweet apple can be stored for long periods of time without significant loss in quality, texture, or taste.

lore.name: Vertine QD
lore.description: Manufacturer: Wei-Tek Type: Quantum Dampener Size: 2 Internally designed by Wei-Tek for the Sabre Raven EX, the Vertine Quantum Dampener generates a field that prevents quantum drive activation and helps ensures that hostile targets can't escape.

lore.name: Vesta
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Industrial Ensure your goods get to where they need to go with the Vesta quantum drive. Juno Starwerk specifically designed the component to handle all the trials and tribulations of the long haul.

lore.name: Vesta
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Industrial Ensure your goods get to where they need to go with the Vesta quantum drive. Juno Starwerk specifically designed the component to handle all the trials and tribulations of the long haul.

lore.name: Vestal Water
lore.description: HEI: 44 Effect: Hydrating Sourced from carefully selected water-rich asteroids, this crystalline pure water contains naturally occurring minerals for a smooth, refreshing taste that makes it a perfect choice for all your hydration needs.

lore.name: Vice
lore.description: Items that are regarded as immoral or harmful by society.

lore.name: Vigilance
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: GNP Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Military Vigilance means keeping a careful watch for any possible dangerous threats and the GNP radar that bears this name allows you to do just that with its proprietary emission accrual.

lore.name: Vindel
lore.description: Generally found in shallow waters in the temperate regions of Locke, this species of fish feeds on waste and algae that collects at the bottom of rivers. The tentacles allow the fish to sift through the loose rock and soil. Though technically edible, most avoid eating them because they taste pretty terrible.

lore.name: Viper III Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Nova Pyrotechnica Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 3 Nova has worked hard to insure that their infrared tracking Viper strike missile lives up to its name by delivering agile and lethal attacks against hostile targets.

lore.name: Viper III-G Missile
lore.description: Manufacturer: Nova Pyrotechnica Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 3 Nova has worked hard to insure that their infrared tracking Viper strike missile lives up to its name by delivering agile and lethal attacks against hostile targets. Note: This missile may only be launched by ground vehicles.

lore.name: ViseLock S1 Tractor Beam
lore.description: Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial Item Type: Tractor Beam Max Angle: 80° Max Range: 135 m Full Strength Distance: 50 m The ViseLock tractor beam is an evolution of Greycat’s industry-standard tech, with added improvements specifically intended to help security forces restrain their targets. In its design, Greycat sacrificed some hold strength at greater distances to achieve a more powerful tether that is harder to escape.

lore.name: VitalityPen
lore.description: Manufacturer: CureLife Item Type: Medical Consumable From the Empire’s most trusted medical company, the CureLife VitalityPen delivers a combination of total parenteral nutrition and the detoxicant Resurgera to help relieve symptoms associated with malnutrition and high blood drug levels (BDL).

lore.name: Vivant Shoes
lore.description: Slip into style and comfort with the Vivant shoes from Hawksworth's. These synthetic leather loafers feature an accentuated cap toe, metallic inlay atop the vamp, and a lightweight yet durable outsole made from a unique blend of rubber nanocomposites.

lore.name: viVid Display
lore.description: From microTech, the makers of mobiGlas and VI Specs, comes the latest generation multi-viewer, the viVid display, featuring full spectrum color-bleed and first-in-class holo-optics to bring a wide array of visuals to vivid life.

lore.name: VK-00
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Wei-Tek Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Military When the stakes are high, Wei-Tek’s advanced VK-00 quantum drive is the only choice you should trust to get you where you need to be.

lore.name: Vogel
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: WillsOp Size: 0 Grade: B Class: Civilian As you ride to destinations new and afar, uncover the unknown with the Vogel radar from WillsOp that features innovative signature filtration and detection algorithms.

lore.name: Voidripper Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -90 / 115 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Embrace your inner beast by equipping the Voidripper helmet. Layers of heavy armor plating provide premium protection and an unforgettable visage featuring a heavy brow and piercing turquoise eyes. Sakura Sun designers complimented this striking form with supreme function, including a state of the art sensor suite attached to the helmet's right side. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Voidripper Helmet (Modified)
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -90 / 115 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s This version of Sakura Sun's Voidripper helmet has been modified from its original form. Embrace your inner beast by equipping the Voidripper helmet. Layers of heavy armor plating provide premium protection and an unforgettable visage featuring a heavy brow and piercing turquoise eyes. Sakura Sun designers complimented this striking form with supreme function, including a state of the art sensor suite attached to the helmet's right side. Visor is AR crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Voir
lore.description: Item Type: Radar Manufacturer: GNP Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Military The Voir is not just for the military anymore. Now you too can attach this small radar to your ship to stay safe.

lore.name: Volatus Balaclava Stealth Kitten
lore.description: The Volatus Balaclava is a staple for security and military operatives. Designed using strong, breathable, 100% Sol-grown cotton with reinforced polymer fibers embedded into the material, this balaclava serves to both keep you comfortable, as well as obscure your identity. The signature pink with blue whiskers imprinted on this mask, combined with the limited-edition Shinobi Sally icon make this face wear a statement piece for any look.

lore.name: Vortex
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Military Turn the tide of battle with the Aegis Vortex. Counted on by the UEE Navy, this power plant can be found on ships defending every corner of the universe.

lore.name: Voss Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Medium Armor Damage Reduction: 30% Temp. Rating: -65 / 80 °C Radiation Protection: 26400 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Why trade protection when you're looking for a lightweight option? The Voss boasts treated hide over a polyweave under-layer. The airtight neck seal keeps you alive while the full-face mask makes your presence as commanding as this helmet is durable. Visor is AR Crosshair compatible.

lore.name: Voyage
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Civilian Crafted by passionate people who have been leading the way in space exploration and travel for over six centuries, the Voyage by Tarsus is a quantum drive worthy of your next expedition.

lore.name: VT-T10 "Veritas" Torpedo
lore.description: Manufacturer: Behring Tracking Signal: Infrared Size: 10 Bring Behring's expert engineering to bear with the VT-T10 "Veritas" Torpedo. Originally designed for the Polaris, this size 10 torpedo has earned a reputation as a dependable and incredibly powerful ordnance.

lore.name: Vulcan
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Industrial Juno Starwerk designed the Vulcan to be both cost efficient and durable. It won’t win any awards for its performance but can be trusted to get you to your destination.

lore.name: Vulture 2953 Best in Show Livery
lore.description: Celebrate the Drake Vulture being voted a Best in Show finalist for 2953 with this pearlescent purple and cyan livery.

lore.name: Vulture 2953 Ship Showdown Poster
lore.description: Celebrate the Vulture, Drake Interplanetary's rugged wreck-ripper, making the final four of the 2953 Ship Showdown with this poster of the ship mid-flight.

lore.name: Vulture Assembly Livery
lore.description: Make them see red! The Assembly livery is a full fuselage red design with black and silver accents that makes sure your spacecraft is easily identifiable during salvage operations.

lore.name: Vulture Carbonide Livery
lore.description: When salvage operations need to be done quietly, the Carbonide livery offers a distinct grey-on-grey alternating layout intended to obscure the spacecraft against a usual starfield.

lore.name: Vulture Carnival Livery
lore.description: A working salvage crew needs any advantage they can get to be noticed in a busy environment. Enter the Carnival livery, a stunning pink hull with black highlights and distinctive stripes running down the ship's arms.

lore.name: Vulture Deck the Hull Livery
lore.description: Express your holiday spirit with the Deck the Hull livery, which uses the traditional Luminalia colors of green and red to celebrate the popular Banu festival that's become beloved by Humans.

lore.name: Vulture Dying Star Livery (Modified)
lore.description: This version of the livery has been modified from its original form with the addition of graffiti. Sold in 2943 to celebrate the 450th anniversary of Pyro's discovery, the Dying Star livery is tan with brown and black highlights. It also features branding from Pyrotechnic Amalgamated, the now defunct mining company that found and named the system.

lore.name: Vulture Foundation Guide Livery
lore.description: Foundation Festival is an opportunity for Citizens and Civilians to come together and strengthen the foundation of our community. Show your commitment to a better universe with this custom livery.

lore.name: Vulture Ghoulish Green Livery
lore.description: Embrace Day of the Vara mischievousness and mayhem any time of the year with this custom Vulture livery. It combines metallic green and black for a striking look that highlights the holiday's classic colors.

lore.name: Vulture Heartthrob Livery
lore.description: Make people weak in the knees by adorning the Vulture with the Hearthrob livery, featuring a shimmering violet paint scheme.

lore.name: Vulture IceBreak Livery
lore.description: Equip your Vulture with a paint scheme cooler than a snow storm. The IceBreak livery mixes crisp, cool white with a frostbitten blue for an exciting look suitable for any season.

lore.name: Vulture Longhorn Livery
lore.description: For the Vulture captain dedicated to a hard day's work, the Longhorn livery's black-and-burnt orange hull with rough silver highlights lend a classic industrial feel to the famed spacecraft.

lore.name: Vulture Material Depot
lore.description: Item Type: Storage Manufacturer: Drake Interplanetary Capacity: 14 SCU This internal storage space contains all raw materials a Vulture collects until they are fed into the ship’s manufacturing station.

lore.name: Vulture Oriole Livery
lore.description: The Oriole livery offers Vulture captains a no-nonsense matte grey toned hull patterned after those operated by military organizations. Understated orange highlights mark the craft's salvage-and-recovery role.

lore.name: Vulture Outcast Livery (Modified)
lore.description: This version of the livery has been modified from its original form with the addition of graffiti. Embrace chaos with the Outcast livery. It features rough splashes of neon green against black to give the Vulture an aggressively chaotic appearance.

lore.name: Vulture Pyrite Livery
lore.description: Vulture operators who choose the Pyrite livery never have to apologize for sporting a little style. A stealthy matte black and silver hull contrasts sharply with silver and yellow topped arms.

lore.name: Vulture Skullcrusher Livery
lore.description: Exude attitude with the Skullcrusher livery for the Vulture, which features a massive skull across the top.

lore.name: Wakame Laser Beam
lore.description: Manufacturer: Trident Attack Systems Item Type: Laser Beam Size: 6 Trident Attack Systems' size six energy weapon, the Wakame, can quickly overwhelm nearby adversaries before they have a chance to respond thanks to the targeted focus and sustained damage delivery of this laser beam.

lore.name: Waldron Jacket Blue
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU The Waldron suit exudes sophistication by fusing classic style with contemporary flourishes. OpalSky redefines success with this geometric patterned jacket, featuring a pinstriped false-shirt and tie layered underneath, plus a unique split-seam back.

lore.name: Waldron Pants Blue
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 0.5K µSCU The Waldron suit fuses classic style with contemporary flourishes in a way that's become definitively OpalSky. The repeating geometric pattern travels the length of the jacket and pants to create a cutting edge look that will turn heads wherever you go.

lore.name: Walesko
lore.description: Instructions for how to build this simple cryptokey were first published publicly in 2887 by political activist Aris Walesko who had hoped that it would lead to greater governmental transparency. Though not up to the standards of most modern security protocols, this slow and unreliable device it is still in use today owing to its ease of construction and wide availability from numerous small manufacturers.

lore.name: Wally's Bar Hologram Replica
lore.description: This replica of the holographic center piece at the infamous Wally's Bar in New Babbage features warm oranges and yellows that evoke the feeling of a tropical sunset in your personal habitat.

lore.name: Wan Shoes
lore.description: The Wan are synthetic leather loafers that perfectly balance a classic but modern style. Equally appropriate for work or casual wear, OpalSky designed these supremely comfortable slip-ons with an anti-scuff coating so there's no need for a polish and shine to keep them looking pristine.

lore.name: Wanderer
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Civilian Tarsus carefully designed and tuned the Wanderer into an all-around solid quantum drive, making it one of the more popular components in their revered line-up.

lore.name: Wanderer
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 3 Grade: C Class: Civilian Tarsus carefully designed and tuned the Wanderer into an all-around solid quantum drive, making it one of the more popular components in their revered line-up.

lore.name: Wanderer Boots "Pathfinder"
lore.description: Grindstone's Wanderer line is an all-purpose boot designed to take any punishment you throw at it. The rare Pathfinder edition is purple with silver highlights, discreetly bringing style to the jobsite.

lore.name: Wanderer Boots Base
lore.description: Grindstone's Wanderer line is an all-purpose boot designed to take any punishment you throw at it.

lore.name: Wanderer Boots Base
lore.description: PH - gsb_boots_07_01_01

lore.name: Ward
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Basilisk Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Industrial The Ward is Basilisk’s basic industrial-grade shield generator for large ships. It provides decent performance and durability while also keeping its signature respectable.

lore.name: Warden Backpack
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Backpack Carrying Capacity: 150K µSCU Core Compatibility: Heavy This hard backpack from Virgil, Ltd. makes travel easy. Whether you need a place to carry your weapons or you've decided to bring some extra rations along for a long journey, this backpack was designed to rise to any occasion. The interior features a generous, closeable pocket to keep your small items from falling out of place.

lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Backpack Carrying Capacity: 150K µSCU Core Compatibility: Heavy This hard backpack from Virgil, Ltd. makes travel easy. lore.name: Warlord Throne
lore.description: Reign over your subjects from the haughty heights of your very own throne. Fabricated from a disused engine, animal bones, scavenged metal parts, and a swathe of vibrant red feathers, this chair's menacing presence is reinforced by a golden plated skull sculpted into the back.

lore.name: Waste
lore.description: Unwanted and unusable materials that are designated to be discarded.

lore.name: Waste
lore.description: Unwanted and unusable materials that are designated to be discarded.

lore.name: Wasteland Keycard
lore.description: The best rewards are worth fighting for!

lore.name: Wastelander Undersuit
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% Roughly sewn together from a variety of ransacked materials, the Wastelander undersuit will just about do the job. This version features a bold rust color.

lore.name: Wastelander Undersuit Ransacker
lore.description: Item Type: Undersuit Damage Reduction: 5% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +90% Roughly sewn together from a variety of ransacked materials, the Wastelander undersuit will just about do the job.

lore.name: Water Bottle
lore.description: HEI: 44 Effects: Hydrating Water filtered to the highest UEE standards.

lore.name: Watermelon (Slice)
lore.description: NDR: 14 HEI: 10 Effects: Hydrating, Hyper-Metabolic Deliciously refreshing and juicy melon that makes a perfect treat on warmer days.

lore.name: Wavy Bob
lore.description: A somewhat longer bob with natural-looking waves.

lore.name: Wavy Side Part
lore.description: A side part style with a vintage feel.

lore.name: Wayfare
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Tarsus Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Civilian Speed through space without breaking the bank. The Warfare is a small quantum drive from Tarsus that was specifically designed to help make space travel affordable for the masses.

lore.name: Waylite Shoes Cobalt
lore.description: Stay on your feet all day with Northstar's Waylite. These slip resistant shoes utilize comfortable memory foam and shock absorbent technology to make these casual sneakers perfect for the office or home. Women's sizes currently out of stock.

lore.name: We Want You Poster
lore.description: Hang this dynamic recruiting poster from the UEEN on your wall and show your support for the United Earth Empire Navy!

lore.name: WEB
lore.description: Item Type: Shield Generator Manufacturer: Seal Corporation Size: 1 Grade: C Class: Civilian Tried, tested, and refined for centuries, the WEB shield generator balances sleek design with stellar performance to keep your ship safe under a wide variety of circumstances.

lore.name: Weekend Warrior Smoothie
lore.description: HEI: 39 NDR: 15 Effects: Immune Boosting Garcia's Greens Weekend Warrior Smoothie is the perfect way to energize your immune system thanks to this electric blend's hint of spice.

lore.name: Whamburger
lore.description: NDR: 38 Effects: Dehydrating, Hyper-Metabolic The original burger that put Whammer's on the starmap. All Whams come with crisp greens, tomatoes, piccamix, and Crave Sauce.

lore.name: Whamburger D-Lux
lore.description: NDR: 38 Effects: Dehydrating, Hyper-Metabolic Take your whamburger up a notch and make it D-Lux with twice the meat and double the cheese. All Whams come with crisp greens, tomatoes, piccamix, and Crave Sauce.

lore.name: Whiptail STR-E2 Repeater
lore.description: Item Type: Laser Repeater Manufacturer: Kruger Intergalactic Size: 2 Designed for the Stringray to unleash a torrent of laser fire, this custom made laser repeater is capable of firing in rapid succession to strip away defenses.

lore.name: Whiskey (Glass)
lore.description: HEI: 5 Effects: Cognitive Impairment, Dehydrating Distilled from fermented grains, whiskey is carefully aged to produce the drink's signature flavor.

lore.name: Whiskey & Cola
lore.description: HEI: 07 Effects: Cognitive Impairment, Dehydrating Whiskey blended with a dark cola.

lore.name: WhiteOut
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Civilian Your ship faces a lot of extreme conditions while flying. From the coldness of space to the burning heat of a desert planet, the last thing you want to worry about is if your cooler can keep up. The entry-level WhiteOut from Lightning Power provides thermal management that can help make sure you get where you’re going.

lore.name: WhiteRose
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Size: 1 Grade: A Class: Civilian Pull incredible performance from the WhiteRose. This small power plant from Sakura Sun shines when generating the kind of power that leaves the other small power plants in its wake.

lore.name: Why Not? Flight Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Helmet Damage Reduction: 15% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Just because a helmet's broken doesn't mean it's useless. This scavenged undersuit helmet should provide suitable protection against vacuum. If you like taking chances, take a chance on this. Why not?

lore.name: WiDoW
lore.description: Thick, ink-black synthetic opioid commonly used as a recreational drug. WiDoW has spread like wildfire throughout the Empire thanks to the fact that it's relatively easy to produce. This also creates a wide variety of quality between batches of the drug. Designed to be injected as a liquid directly into the bloodstream, the name derived from one of the main side effects from extensive use, the drug stains the veins black, creating web-like subcutaneous patterns through the body. Illegal inside the UEE.

lore.name: Wikelo Emporium Bust
lore.description: Hello, human neighbor. I am Wikelo and now live in your human system of Stanton. Have many things if you would like to come visit. Can make too. If not, I understand. Enjoy this gift from me. Bye.

lore.name: Wikelo Emporium Jacket
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU Super style! Supreme comfort! The Wikelo Emporium jacket is made with premium synthetic leather for a resilient and fashionable exterior, and an ultra-soft lining that enwraps the Human body like friend. Expect nothing less than the absolute best when Wikelo put their name on it.

lore.name: WillsOp Long Look Radar
lore.description: Manufacturer: WillsOp Item Type: Radar Size: 5 When the UEEN came to Anvil needing a ship to handle mobile C&C, Anvil turned to WillsOp, one of the most trusted names in scanning and deep-space radar. Together they developed the Long Look Radar (LLR) system as a way to upgrade the modern Hornets rather than developing an entirely new ship. Fully loaded with WillsOp’s suite of scan systems, the LLR now brings its raw analytical power to the civilian market, turning an already dependable vessel into a perfect scanning fighter.

lore.name: Winter-Star
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: J-Span Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Civilian Join the J-Span family by snagging the Winter-Star cooler for your ship. This entry-level model lacks flash but its strong performance record and price point make it a popular choice for pilots across the UEE.

lore.name: Winter-Star EX
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: J-Span Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Civilian The Winter-Star EX is a baseline cooler you can trust. Built by the experts at J-Span, it’s ready to handle whatever conditions you encounter.

lore.name: Winter-Star SL
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: J-Span Size: 0 Grade: D Class: Civilian The latest in J-Span’s Winter-Star line of coolers, the SL’s new Kivo system offers a unique dispersal method, allowing your vehicle to manage heat better than ever before.

lore.name: Winter-Star XL
lore.description: Item Type: Cooler Manufacturer: J-Span Size: 3 Grade: D Class: Civilian For two centuries, J-Span has dedicated itself to manufacturing coolers. The Winter-Star XL is their entry level large cooler. What it lacks in features, it more than makes up for in solid craftsmanship.

lore.name: WK-8 Shoes
lore.description: The WK-8 impact boots from R6 Pro continue the company's proud tradition of affordable, durable utility footwear. Designed to thrive in all kinds of environments, the WK-8's are the result of extensive field testing with the Empire's most trusted security operatives.

lore.name: Wolf Allegro Livery
lore.description: With a look inspired by racing ships, the Allegro livery spotlights the sleek, aerodynamic design of the Wolf.

lore.name: Wolf Antilles Livery
lore.description: The Antilles livery for the Wolf features a vibrant, electric blue base paint and bright red tail section.

lore.name: Wolf Frost Camo Livery
lore.description: The Frost Camo livery is crisp white with a subtle camo pattern and grey and red highlights.

lore.name: Wolf Heatsink Livery
lore.description: The Heatsink livery features a two-tone striped blue base paint with bold yellow and red highlights.

lore.name: Wolf HighSec Livery
lore.description: The HighSec livery gives the Wolf a carbon fiber finish with red accents.

lore.name: Wolf Iceflash Livery
lore.description: The Iceflash livery provides the Wolf a distinct look with grey spots breaking up its grey and white base paint.

lore.name: Wolf Nightbreak Livery
lore.description: Discreetly soar through the night sky in the Wolf with the Nightbreak livery, which is primarily black with red highlights.

lore.name: Wolf Nighttide Camo Livery
lore.description: Orange highlights provide a bit of color to the gray and black Nighttide Camo livery.

lore.name: Wolf Ranger Camo Livery
lore.description: Mixing a green camo pattern on the front with a bright yellow back makes the Ranger Camo an attention-getting choice for the Wolf.

lore.name: Wolf Riftwalker Livery
lore.description: Complement the elegant design of the Kruger Wolf with the Riftwalker livery, which is primarily black with bronze and blue highlights.

lore.name: Wolf Rosso Livery
lore.description: Live bright and bold with the stark red of the Rosso livery and ensure that everyone will see the unique beauty of the Kruger Wolf.

lore.name: Wolf Sylvan Camo Livery
lore.description: Brandish a green and brown camo pattern with red and yellow highlights on the Kruger Wolf with the Sylvan Camo livery.

lore.name: Wolfram
lore.description: Item Type: Computer Manufacturer: Saga Datasystems Size: 1 Grade: B Class: Industrial The Wolfram is one of the universe’s most powerful onboard computer systems. With Saga Datasystem’s incredible computing power and groundbreaking architecture, you’ll accomplish more than you ever thought possible.

lore.name: Wooden Rooster Charm (Large)
lore.description: Give the gift of good fortune and prosperity with this charm, handcarved by frontier settlers in honor of the Year of the Rooster. This generous gift is crafted from wood to represent one's efforts to put down roots in a new world while the robust and ornate rooster design represents those with ambition and fierce loyalty.

lore.name: Wooden Rooster Charm (Medium)
lore.description: Give the gift of good fortune and prosperity with this charm, handcarved by frontier settlers in honor of the Year of the Rooster. This thoughtful gift is crafted from wood to represent one's efforts to put down roots in a new world while this particular rooster design, larger than most of its counterparts, represents courage and confidence.

lore.name: Wooden Rooster Charm (Small)
lore.description: Give the gift of good fortune and prosperity with this charm, handcarved by frontier settlers in honor of the Year of the Rooster. This considerate gift is crafted from wood to represent one's efforts to put down roots in a new world while the rooster design represents hard work and resourcefulness.

lore.name: Workbench
lore.description: This workbench is the standard across UEE space. Get yours today and never borrow your neighbor's tools again!

lore.name: WorkLife Pants Black
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU With Stegman's, you know you're getting clothes made for workers, by workers. Featuring multiple external pockets with easy access tabs, WorkLife pants are rugged, functional and professional. Just like you.

lore.name: Worthy Journey T-Shirt White
lore.description: Whether you're piloting or simply enjoying the ride, a Crusader ship makes it a journey worth taking. This shirt celebrates that spirit by featuring a fleet of Crusader ships plus their iconic logo and tagline.

lore.name: WowBlast Desperado Toy Pistol Magazine (10 cap)
lore.description: Item Type: Magazine Capacity: 10 This magazine for the WowBlast Desperado holds ten darts.

lore.name: WowBlast Desperado Toy Pistol Magazine (10 cap)
lore.description: Manufacturer: Sakura Sun Item Type: Toy Pistol Class: Foam Dart Magazine Size: 10 Rate Of Fire: 450 rpm Effective Range: 35m Make friendly fire fun with the Sakura Sun WowBlast Desperado. Playfully fire foam darts at friends or fictitious foes with these ultra-colorful plastic toy pistols. Whether killing time at a landing zone or during a long-haul through the stars, the WowBlast toy line provides lighthearted excitement and entertainment for the entire family. The Desperado toy pistol is available in several vibrant colors, each featuring a unique sound effect!

lore.name: Wrecker Arms
lore.description: Item Type: Heavy Armor Damage Reduction: 40% Temp. Rating: -70 / 100 °C Radiation Protection: 26800 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Favored by the most brutal of hunters, the Wrecker armor is a fusion of discarded metal and pilfered fabric cobbled together to offer protection while stalking prey. It is sprayed with orange paint and anointed with bone fragments and Vanduul armor pieces.

lore.name: Wuotan Seed
lore.description: Harvested from the wuotan plant, these seed pods become bioluminescent when ripe to draw attention and encourage their spread. They are often collected to utilize as a natural light source.

lore.name: X1 2954 Auspicious Red Dog Livery
lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Dog livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a dog.

lore.name: X1 2954 Auspicious Red Dragon Livery
lore.description: Seek peace and prosperity in the new year with the Auspicious Red Dragon livery. Outfit your ship with this bold red base paint complemented by gold accents and a stylized graphic of a dragon.

lore.name: X1 Blueshift Livery
lore.description: Infinity Custom worked with Origin on the Blueshift livery, which is dark blue and black with X1 in vibrant white.

lore.name: X1 Scarlet Livery
lore.description: Infinity Custom worked closely with Origin to develop the exclusive Scarlet livery, which enhances the striking look of the X1 with bold red accents.

lore.name: X1 Shadow Livery
lore.description: Infinity Custom worked with Origin on the Shadow livery for the X1, which is primarily black with grey lettering and orange highlights.

lore.name: X1 Supersonic Livery
lore.description: Infinity Custom worked with Origin to design the Supersonic livery for the X1. It is grey with orange highlights to accent the vehicle's streamlined design.

lore.name: Xa'Pyen
lore.description: Only recently used in Human manufacturing, this complex alloy of Xi'an origin is a jack of all trades that is extremely useful in numerous applications.

lore.name: Xanthule Ascension Flight Helmet
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Helmet Damage Reduction: 15% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s Adapted by Syang Fabrication to meet the unique requirements of the Human physique, the Xanthule helmet faithfully recreates the bold silhouette preferred by Xi'an. When paired with the Xanthule suit, it creates a distinct and eye-catching look. This special IAE 2953 edition is decorated with a copper and white pattern inspired by Gatac Manufacture's Syulen.

lore.name: Xanthule Ascension Flight Suit
lore.description: Item Type: Flight Suit Damage Reduction: 15% Temp. Rating: -30 / 60 °C Radiation Protection: 15200 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 81 REM/s G-Force Tolerance: +97.5% Carrying Capacity: 6.5 µSCU Backpacks: Light Perfected through centuries of innovation, Syang Fabrication's sleek and stylish Xanthule flight suit has been meticulously adapted to the Human physique. lore.name: XDL "Forest" Monocular Rangefinder
lore.description: The highly accurate XDL Monocular Rangefinder from Behring is as suitable on an expedition as it is on the battlefield. Ruggedly constructed with high-quality lenses, easy-to-read display, and a light-amplification mode, the XDL provides 10x magnification to reliably provide exact-distance laser measurements on faraway targets. The Forest edition features a two-tone light and dark green finish.

lore.name: Xenon
lore.description: A dense, odorless, colorless noble gas that is generally unreactive. Exhibits a bluish glow when excited by electrical discharge.

lore.name: XenoThreat Encryption Key
lore.description: A custom chipset bearing a XenoThreat symbol. It appears to have a cryptokey interface for some encryption or decryption purpose.

lore.name: XForge P/S2-80 Main Engine
lore.description: The X-Forge P/S2-80 is a small thruster that mainly finds use on Aurora class starships. Boasting good thrust output and fuel efficiency, the P/S2-80 is an excellent choice for those with a bit of wanderlust.

lore.name: XIAN S3 Cannon
lore.description: A Size 3 Laser Autocannon S3 of Xi'an construction.

lore.name: XL-1
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Wei-Tek Size: 2 Grade: A Class: Military Wei-Tek might be a new company, but their line of military-grade components is already gaining notoriety. The XL-1 is their premier medium quantum drive that expertly blends performance and durability.

lore.name: XS-90 Explorer Goggles
lore.description: With a sleek design suitable for all face shapes, the XS-98 Explorer goggles ensure a fog-free view in any climate, and come with a patented coating that offers strong UV-protection and cuts down on unwanted glare.

lore.name: Xy'kara Arms
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -31 / 61 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s The Xy'kara Armor from Syang Fabrications offers the result of thousands of years of Xi'an combat expertise in a Human package. Closely patterned to the Human physique, the Xy'kara armor provides unparalleled protection without sacrificing mobility and combat effectiveness without sacrificing style.

lore.name: Xy'kara Core
lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -31 / 61 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s Carrying Capacity: 2K µSCU The Xy'kara Armor from Syang Fabrications offers the result of thousands of years of Xi'an combat expertise in a Human package. Closely patterned to the Human physique, the Xy'kara armor provides unparalleled protection without sacrificing mobility and combat effectiveness without sacrificing style.

lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. Rating: -31 / 61 °C Radiation Protection: 26000 REM Radiation Scrub Rate: 145.8 REM/s The Xy'kara Armor from Syang Fabrications offers the result of thousands of years of combat expertise in a Human package. lore.description: Item Type: Light Armor Damage Reduction: 20% Temp. lore.name: Yaeger Aviator Glasses
lore.description: When the future's looking bright, reach for these aviator shades from R6 Pro. With a design that has remained an acknowledged classic for centuries, you can salute the trailblazing aviators of the past as you seek tomorrow's new horizons.

lore.name: Yakisoba Dog
lore.description: NDR: 34 Effects: Dehydrating, Hyper-Metabolic Sweet-sauced noodles and veggies are grilled crisp and then served a top of a classic hot dog.

lore.name: Yaluk
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Juno Starwerk Size: 2 Grade: D Class: Industrial The bigger the haul, the harder your quantum drive has to work. With Juno Starwerk’s Yaluk onboard, you’ll know that you have a quantum drive that is up to the challenge of getting the job done.

lore.name: Yeager
lore.description: Item Type: Quantum Drive Manufacturer: Wei-Tek Size: 2 Grade: B Class: Military Whether you’re rushing to the rescue or simply patrolling through a sector, the Yeager quantum drive from Wei-Tek allows for greater performance when you need it most.

lore.name: Year of the Dog Coin
lore.description: A gilded red coin celebrating the Year of the Dog. Said to bring good fortune and prosperity in the upcoming cycle, coins like these have become a popular gift during the annual Red Festival.

lore.name: Year of the Dog Envelope
lore.description: A gilded red envelope celebrating the Year of the Dog. Exchanging these envelopes is one of the most popular ways of celebrating Red Festival. Often the envelope may include a small amount of credits inside to help those you care about have a strong start in the upcoming cycle. Growing in popularity is the newer tradition of hiding the envelopes as a way of spreading good fortune and prosperity to those that fate has deemed in need.

lore.name: Year of the Rat Lantern Display
lore.description: Celebrate Red Festival in style with this eye-catching homage to traditional lanterns. Giving off a warm and inviting light, this beautiful lantern sits within a large, intricately carved circular frame adorned with a rat in honor of 2956.

lore.name: Year of the Rooster Envelope
lore.description: A gilded red envelope celebrating the Year of the Rooster. Exchanging these envelopes is one of the most popular ways of celebrating Red Festival. Often the envelope may include a small amount of credits inside to help those you care about have a strong start in the upcoming cycle. Growing in popularity is the newer tradition of hiding the envelopes as a way of spreading good fortune and prosperity to those that fate has deemed in need. Stow the envelope as a token of luck, share it with a friend or loved one to spread good fortune, or exchange it at a commodities terminal and use the credits for a prosperous beginning to a new cycle.

lore.name: Yeast Extract and Butter Sandwich
lore.description: NDR: 38 Effects: None Savory yeast extract spread and butter on white bread.

lore.name: Yebira I
lore.description: Item Type: Rocket Pod Manufacturer: Firestorm Kinetics Size: 1 Rockets: 3xS3 The Yebira I rocket pod is the perfect system for efficient deployment of S3 ordnance. Manufactured by Firestorm Kinetics, this rocket pod carries three rockets and attaches to any size one hardpoint.

lore.name: Yebira II
lore.description: Item Type: Rocket Pod Manufacturer: Firestorm Kinetics Size: 2 Rockets: 6xS3 The Yebira II rocket pod is the perfect system for efficient deployment of S3 ordnance. Manufactured by Firestorm Kinetics, this rocket pod carries six rockets and attaches to any size two hardpoint.

lore.name: Yebira III
lore.description: Item Type: Rocket Pod Manufacturer: Firestorm Kinetics Size: 3 Rockets: 9xS3 The Yebira III rocket pod is the perfect system for efficient deployment of S3 ordnance. Manufactured by Firestorm Kinetics, this rocket pod carries nine rockets and attaches to any size three hardpoint.

lore.name: Yellow QuikFlarePro
lore.description: Manufacturer: Shubin Interstellar Illuminate the way forward or signal for help with the Yellow QuikFlarePro from Shubin Interstellar. For centuries, miners have counted on this flare as part of their core toolkit, thanks to its tried and true design and durability that ensures it stays ablaze in the various harsh weather and difficult atmospheric conditions encountered across the 'verse. The QuikFlarePro uses advanced tech to glow longer than regular flares.

lore.name: YellowJacket GT-210 Gatling
lore.description: Manufacturer: Gallenson Tactical Systems Item Type: Ballistic Gatling Size: 1 While the GT-210 YellowJacket may be small, it packs a mighty sting. This high-speed ballistic weapon is perfect for targeting smaller, more mobile targets and its DTX-8 ammo supply system almost completely eliminates weapon jams due to bad rounds.

lore.name: Yeng’tu Repeater
lore.description: Item Type: Laser Repeater Manufacturer: Torral Aggregate Size: 3 Inspired by Xi'an mil-tech and tailor-made by Torral Aggregate exclusively for the Aopoa San'tok.yāi, the Yeng'tu laser repeater accentuates the ship's dexterity with a fighter's edge.

lore.name: Yenny Shirt
lore.description: A simple, light grey, long-sleeved shirt constructed from moisture wicking fabric ideal for keeping you comfortable during work and play.

lore.name: Yormandi Eye
lore.description: Able to thrive in a wide variety of environments, the yormandi has a robust immune system that responds to unknown pathogens at incredible speed. Its eyes contain antibodies that are much sought-after by medical researchers.

lore.name: Yormandi Statue
lore.description: Artfully hewn from rock with resin accents, this fiercely realistic statue captures the indomitable spirit of the Yormandi as it faces down unsee prey.

lore.name: Yormandi Tongue
lore.description: The yormandi uses its sensitive tongue to taste its surroundings and detect prey from great distances. Renowned for its complex, subtle flavor, the tip of this organ is sought after by culinary enthusiasts throughout the Empire.

lore.name: Yubarev "Deadeye" Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Lightning Bolt Co. Item Type: Pistol Class: Electron Battery Size: 10 Rate Of Fire: 350 rpm Effective Range: 35m Attachments: Optics (S1), Underbarrel (S1) Engineering excellence only scratches the surface of the distinct Yubarev pistol. Former merc turned weapon manufacturing mogul Irina Arkadova oversaw every aspect of the weapon, imbuing it with power, practicality, and panache. Featuring a cutting edge barrel design, the Yubarev fires a charged electron shot that impacts not only your target, amplifying the charge with each hit, but can spread to additional conductive targets in range. The exclusive Deadeye edition is black with gold highlights.

lore.name: Yubarev "Igniter" Pistol
lore.description: Manufacturer: Lightning Bolt Co. Item Type: Pistol Class: Electron Battery Size: 10 Rate Of Fire: 350 rpm Effective Range: 35m Attachments: Optics (S1), Underbarrel (S1) Engineering excellence only scratches the surface of the distinct Yubarev pistol. Featuring a classic woodgrain grip and cutting edge barrel design, the Yubarev fires a charged electron shot that impacts not only your target, amplifying the charge with each hit, but can spread to additional conductive targets in range. A lustrous orange coating makes the Igniter edition a colorful addition to any loadout.

lore.description: Item Type: Battery Capacity: 10 This battery for the Yubarev Pistol holds enough electron energy for 10 shots.

lore.name: ZapJet
lore.description: Item Type: Power Plant Manufacturer: Lightning Power Ltd. Size: 1 Grade: D Class: Civilian The Lightning Power ZapJet is an ideal streamlined package perfect for anybody who wants a straightforward no-fuss power solution.

lore.name: Zelena Pants and Tall Bisbee Boots
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 7.3K µSCU Stay warm and dry on rainy days in the Zelena pants and the Bisbee boots. Both made with water-repellant materials and built-in sweat-wicking technology, they'll be your go-to choice for adventures on even the most hostile worlds.

lore.name: Zelena Pants Conifer and Bisbee Boots
lore.description: Carrying Capacity: 1K µSCU Stay warm and dry on rainy days in the Zelena pants and the Bisbee boots. Both made with water-repellant materials and built-in sweat-wicking technology, they'll be your go-to choice for adventures on even the most hostile worlds.

lore.name: Zenith "Darkwave" Laser Sniper Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: Sniper Rifle Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 22 Rate of Fire: 60-300 rpm Effective Range: 80 m Attachments: Optics (S3), Underbarrel (S2) The Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle from VOLT offers operational flexibility on the battlefield as it can fire lower-energy shots rapidly, or be allowed time to automatically charge to fire a much more powerful energy blast that also generates significantly more noise and heat. This Darkwave edition draws attention to the sharp contours and edges of the rifle's design.

lore.name: Zenith "Golden Blossom" Laser Sniper Rifle
lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: Sniper Rifle Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 22 Rate of Fire: 60-300 rpm Effective Range: 80 m Attachments: Optics (S3), Underbarrel (S2) The Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle from VOLT offers operational flexibility on the battlefield as it can fire lower-energy shots rapidly, or be allowed time to automatically charge to fire a much more powerful energy blast that also generates significantly more noise and heat. The Golden Blossom version is mostly black, embellished with intricate golden flowers, giving your enemies one final glimpse of life before death.

lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: Sniper Rifle Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 22 Rate of Fire: 60-300 rpm Effective Range: 80 m Attachments: Optics (S3), Underbarrel (S2) The Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle from VOLT offers operational flexibility on the battlefield as it can fire lower-energy shots rapidly, or be allowed time to automatically charge to fire a much more powerful energy blast that also generates significantly more noise and heat. lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: Sniper Rifle Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 22 Rate of Fire: 60-300 rpm Effective Range: 80 m Attachments: Optics (S3), Underbarrel (S2) The Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle from VOLT offers operational flexibility on the battlefield as it can fire lower-energy shots rapidly, or be allowed time to automatically charge to fire a much more powerful energy blast that also generates significantly more noise and heat. Featuring a white digital camo pattern, the Snow Camo edition is perfect for stalking prey in frozen environments.

lore.description: Manufacturer: Verified Offworld Laser Technologies Item Type: Sniper Rifle Class: Energy (Laser) Battery Size: 22 Rate of Fire: 60-300 rpm Effective Range: 80 m Attachments: Optics (S3), Underbarrel (S2) The Zenith Laser Sniper Rifle from VOLT offers operational flexibility on the battlefield as it can fire lower-energy shots rapidly, or be allowed time to automatically charge to fire a much more powerful energy blast that also generates significantly more noise and heat.
